커스터드-더블베리-토스트-Custard-Double-Berries-Toa.ingredients: 2 small slices rye sourdough bread, 1T blueberries, 1T raspberries, a little mint, 2T Greek yogurt, 1 egg, 1T honey, a little vanilla extract
커스터드-더블베리-토스트-Custard-Double-Berries-Toa.steps:
1. In a mixing bowl, combine 2T Greek yogurt, 1 egg, 1T honey, and a little vanilla extract, and mix well. A super-duper-simple custard cream is about to be born.
2. Press a cup into the center of each slice of rye sourdough bread to make a hollow, pour in the custard cream from step 1, top with blueberries, then bake in a 180°C oven or air fryer for 10 minutes until the custard sets.
3. Top with raspberries and a little chopped mint.

그린바나나-문어-샐러드-Calabrese-Octopus-Green-Ban.title: Calabrese Octopus & Green Banana Salad
그린바나나-문어-샐러드-Calabrese-Octopus-Green-Ban.intro:
20260615, #BreakfastDiary 1749, 23°C/mostly cloudy
Green bananas 🤔
Compared to yellow bananas, green bananas have about 20 times more resistant starch, making them excellent for blood sugar management. They're also rich in fiber, which promotes gut activity, and their low sugar content makes them very effective for weight loss too. Boiled, they taste a lot like potato.
Served with a spicy, creamy red pesto, about 550kcal, Calabrese Octopus & Green Banana Salad.
그린바나나-문어-샐러드-Calabrese-Octopus-Green-Ban.ingredients: 2 green bananas, 150g pre-cooked octopus, 80g Korean radish, 5-6 cloves garlic, 3 radishes, a little sage, 1T red pesto (Pesto alla Calabrese), 10g butter
그린바나나-문어-샐러드-Calabrese-Octopus-Green-Ban.steps:
1. Bring 600ml water and 80g radish to a boil in a pot. The diastase in the radish helps tenderize the octopus. Once it's boiling, add the thawed octopus, blanch for 1 minute, then plunge into cold water.
2. Trim both ends off the green bananas, halve them, boil in water, then peel and cut into bite-sized pieces.
3. Drizzle olive oil in a pan and sauté the garlic, then add the boiled green banana from step 2 and the halved radishes, sprinkle with salt, pepper, and paprika powder, and sauté.
4. In a pan, add olive oil, 10g butter, and a little sage, sprinkle with salt, pepper, and paprika powder, and sear the octopus from step 1 on both sides.
5. Spread the red pesto (Pesto alla Calabrese) on a plate, arrange the cooked octopus, garlic, and green banana on top, and sprinkle with chopped parsley.

레몬은-보이지-않지만-여름의-맛-레몬-오이-냉소면-Lemon-Cucumb.title: You Can't See the Lemon, But It's the Taste of Summer: Lemon Cucumber Cold Somen
레몬은-보이지-않지만-여름의-맛-레몬-오이-냉소면-Lemon-Cucumb.intro:
20260614, #BreakfastDiary 1748, 19°C/sunny
About 480kcal, You Can't See the Lemon But It's the Taste of Summer, Lemon Cucumber Cold Somen.
레몬은-보이지-않지만-여름의-맛-레몬-오이-냉소면-Lemon-Cucumb.ingredients: 1 serving somen noodles, cucumber, lemon, and other toppings you like, plus a little sesame seed, (broth) 1L water, 20g kombu, 2t salt, 3T mirin, 1T sugar, 1 lemon (zest and juice), 2 cloves garlic, 1t sesame oil
레몬은-보이지-않지만-여름의-맛-레몬-오이-냉소면-Lemon-Cucumb.steps:
1. Pour water into a pot, add the kombu, and steep over low heat for about 30 minutes. Once it comes to a boil, remove the kombu. Add the mirin, salt, and sugar, bring to a light boil, then turn off the heat and let cool.
2. Once the stock has cooled, add the lemon zest, lemon juice, minced garlic, and sesame oil, and mix well. Strain and chill in the fridge.
3. Slice the cucumber for topping thinly, sprinkle with salt, and let sit about 10 minutes to draw out the moisture. Gather your forearm strength with a gyro ball, then wring out the moisture until crisp.
4. Boil the somen, adding a splash of cold water about three times as it cooks, then rinse in cold water.
5. Place the somen in a bowl, top with the crisp cucumber and shio kombu from step 3, pour the broth over, and sprinkle with a little sesame seed.

치즈-토마토-딥에-찍어먹는-사워도우-토스트-Cheese-and-Tomat.title: Cheese and Tomato Sourdough Toast
치즈-토마토-딥에-찍어먹는-사워도우-토스트-Cheese-and-Tomat.intro:
20260613, #BreakfastDiary 1747, 19°C/sunny
One of my morning routines: I'm supposed to do 50 lunges, but lost in thought, I think I ended up doing 60-70. I should feel a bit cheated, but I feel nothing at all, thanks to whatever it was I was thinking about. It's some feeling like worry and being cheated, maybe even edging toward anger.
Scented with rosemary, about 600kcal, Cheese and Tomato Sourdough Toast.
치즈-토마토-딥에-찍어먹는-사워도우-토스트-Cheese-and-Tomat.ingredients: 1 slab sourdough, 2 cups cherry tomatoes, 90g white cheese, 1/2 cup olive oil, 5-6 cloves garlic, rosemary, salt, a little pepper
치즈-토마토-딥에-찍어먹는-사워도우-토스트-Cheese-and-Tomat.steps:
1. In an oven dish, combine 90g white cheese, 2 cups cherry tomatoes, 1/2 cup olive oil, 5-6 cloves garlic, rosemary, salt, and a little pepper, and bake in a 180°C oven for 30 minutes.
2. Brush the sourdough slab with olive oil and toast until crisp.
3. Mix the cherry tomatoes and cheese from step 1 well, and spoon over the sourdough slab from step 2 to eat.

살사-베르데와-정어리를-곁들인-판-콘-토마테-Pan-con-Tomate-.title: Pan con Tomate with Sardines and Salsa Verde
살사-베르데와-정어리를-곁들인-판-콘-토마테-Pan-con-Tomate-.intro:
20260612, #BreakfastDiary 1746, 17°C/sunny
About 540kcal, Pan con Tomate with Sardines and Salsa Verde.
살사-베르데와-정어리를-곁들인-판-콘-토마테-Pan-con-Tomate-.ingredients: 1 slab sourdough, 2 medium tomatoes (or tomato paste), 1 can sardines, (salsa verde) 3 baby pickles, 1T capers, a handful of parsley, 1T olives, 1T lemon juice, a pinch of salt
살사-베르데와-정어리를-곁들인-판-콘-토마테-Pan-con-Tomate-.steps:
1. Brush the sourdough slab with olive oil and toast until crisp.
2. Finely chop 3 baby pickles, 1T capers, and a handful of parsley, then mix with 1T olives, 1T lemon juice, and a pinch of salt to make the salsa verde.
3. (If you have fresh tomatoes, grate them; if not) mix 2T tomato paste with 2T water, then add 1T olive oil and a pinch of salt, and combine well.
4. Rub garlic on the sourdough slab, then top with the tomato sauce from step 3, 3 sardines from the can, and 2T of the salsa verde from step 2.

광어-세비체-White-Fish-Ceviche.title: White Fish Ceviche
광어-세비체-White-Fish-Ceviche.intro:
20260611, #BreakfastDiary 1745, 19°C/sunny
Unlike visual or auditory memories, memories tied to smell or taste are summoned instantly, the moment you encounter them. In Marcel Proust's novel In Search of Lost Time, there's a scene where the protagonist takes a bite of a madeleine soaked in tea and is flooded with vivid memories of childhood. This is why the phenomenon of a smell or taste summoning a memory from the past came to be called the Proust effect, or the madeleine effect.
I was reminded of a #ceviche from a few years back.
Flatfish cured in lemon and lime juice, Peruvian style, about 380kcal, White Fish Ceviche.
광어-세비체-White-Fish-Ceviche.ingredients: 200g flatfish, 1/2 cup fava beans, 1 cheongyang pepper, 2 shallots, 1/4 cucumber, 2 radishes, 1T hemp seeds, a little mint leaf, (dressing) 1T olive oil, 1 lemon, 1T lime juice, a pinch of salt and pepper
광어-세비체-White-Fish-Ceviche.steps:
1. Cut the cleaned flatfish into bite-sized pieces.
2. In a mixing bowl, combine 1T olive oil, juice of 1/2 lemon, 1T lime juice, a pinch of salt and pepper, and the flatfish from step 1, and mix well. Let marinate about 10 minutes — this is the process of "cooking" the fish using the strong acidity of the lemon and lime.
3. Boil 1/2 cup fava beans in water.
4. Cut 1 deseeded cheongyang pepper, 2 shallots, and 1/4 cucumber.
5. Pick the mint leaves and chop finely.
6. Into the mixing bowl from step 2, add the fava beans and peas from step 3, the pepper, shallot, and cucumber from step 4, the chopped mint from step 5, and 1T hemp seeds, and mix well.

쫄깃한-뇨끼-샐러드-Vinaigrette-Gnocchi-Salad.title: Vinaigrette Gnocchi Salad
쫄깃한-뇨끼-샐러드-Vinaigrette-Gnocchi-Salad.intro:
20260610, #BreakfastDiary 1744, 18°C/sunny
Boil the gnocchi, and scoop it out the moment it floats up. Toss it with olive oil and add it to a salad, and it gives you the chewiest texture in the world.
About 500kcal per serving, Chewy Gnocchi Salad, Vinaigrette Gnocchi Salad.
쫄깃한-뇨끼-샐러드-Vinaigrette-Gnocchi-Salad.ingredients: 3-4 leaves green leaf lettuce, 2 medium tomatoes, 1 cup (store-bought) gnocchi, 6 shrimp, 1 cup edamame, dressing (3T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard), parmesan cheese, pepper
쫄깃한-뇨끼-샐러드-Vinaigrette-Gnocchi-Salad.steps:
1. Rinse the lettuce under running water, shake off the excess, and tear into bite-sized pieces.
2. Cut the tomatoes into bite-sized pieces.
3. Boil the gnocchi, drain, then toss with olive oil. In the same gnocchi water, boil the shrimp and edamame one after the other.
4. In a bowl, combine the lettuce, tomatoes, gnocchi, edamame, and shrimp, add the vinaigrette dressing (3T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard), and top with freshly grated parmesan and pepper.

너티-크림치즈-사워도우-토스트-Nutty-Cream-cheese-Sour.title: Nutty Cream Cheese Sourdough Toast
너티-크림치즈-사워도우-토스트-Nutty-Cream-cheese-Sour.intro:
20260609, #BreakfastDiary 1743, 19°C/sunny
There are trials, but no failure.
About 550kcal, Nutty Cream Cheese Sourdough Toast.
너티-크림치즈-사워도우-토스트-Nutty-Cream-cheese-Sour.ingredients: 1 slab sourdough, 100g cream cheese, a little chopped scallion, 1/2 cup mixed nuts, 1/2T hemp seeds
너티-크림치즈-사워도우-토스트-Nutty-Cream-cheese-Sour.steps:
1. Brush the sourdough slab with olive oil and toast until crisp.
2. Thinly slice the scallion and finely chop the nuts. Set aside half the chopped nuts.
3. Bring the cream cheese to room temperature ahead of time. In a mixing bowl, combine 100g cream cheese with the chopped scallion, nuts, and hemp seeds, and mix well. Shape into a ball and roll in the reserved chopped nuts.
4. Place the cream cheese nut ball on top of the sourdough slab and spread evenly.

브로콜리-엔초비-파스타-Broccoli-Anchovy-Pasta.title: Broccoli Anchovy Pasta
브로콜리-엔초비-파스타-Broccoli-Anchovy-Pasta.intro:
20260608, #BreakfastDiary 1742, 18°C/mostly cloudy
While I carefully boil and finely blend it, the broccoli's nutrients go off somewhere far, far away~😃
About 500kcal per serving, Broccoli Anchovy Pasta.
브로콜리-엔초비-파스타-Broccoli-Anchovy-Pasta.ingredients: 1 head broccoli, 5 cloves garlic, 2 cups Vesuvio pasta, 1t anchovy paste (or 2 anchovy fillets), 2t crushed red pepper, 1/2 cup pecorino cheese
브로콜리-엔초비-파스타-Broccoli-Anchovy-Pasta.steps:
1. Cut the broccoli into pieces and boil until fully tender.
2. Blend the broccoli with olive oil, salt, and pepper until smooth.
3. Boil the Vesuvio pasta in water with 2T salt.
4. Drizzle olive oil in a pan and sauté the thinly sliced garlic, 2 anchovy fillets, and crushed red pepper,
5. then add the Vesuvio from step 3 and cook, followed by the blended broccoli from step 2, pecorino cheese, and some pasta water from step 3, and mix well.
6. Plate the pasta and top with a little more pecorino cheese and crushed red pepper.

초당옥수수-에그누들-Creamy-Corn-Silken-Tofu-Egg-N.title: Creamy Corn Silken Tofu Egg Noodles
초당옥수수-에그누들-Creamy-Corn-Silken-Tofu-Egg-N.intro:
20260607, #BreakfastDiary 1741, 19°C/cloudy
June, the season of Chodang sweet corn, has arrived.
Consommé-flavored, about 650kcal, Creamy Corn Silken Tofu Egg Noodles.
초당옥수수-에그누들-Creamy-Corn-Silken-Tofu-Egg-N.ingredients: 1 serving egg noodles, 1 ear Chodang sweet corn, 2 (red crab) stock coins, 3 shrimp, 200g silken tofu, fried shallots, a little olive oil
초당옥수수-에그누들-Creamy-Corn-Silken-Tofu-Egg-N.steps:
1. Boil the egg noodles.
2. Halve the corn and cut the kernels off the cob.
3. Pour 300ml water into a pot, add the corn kernels and cob along with 2 red crab stock coins, and simmer. Boil the shrimp in the same pot. (Let the boiled corn cool slightly.)
4. In a blender, combine 200g silken tofu with the corn kernels from step 2 and the broth, and blend until smooth.
5. Add a pinch of salt (or to taste) and mix well.
6. Place the egg noodles and shrimp in a bowl, pour over the broth from step 5, top with fried shallots, and add a little olive oil.

크랩-쌀국수-비빔면-Crab-Bibim-Rice-Noodles.title: Crab Bibim Rice Noodles
크랩-쌀국수-비빔면-Crab-Bibim-Rice-Noodles.intro:
20260606, #BreakfastDiary 1740, 18°C/mostly sunny
360kcal per serving, Crab Bibim Rice Noodles.
크랩-쌀국수-비빔면-Crab-Bibim-Rice-Noodles.ingredients: 100g rice noodles (dried), 3T crab paste, 1T minced garlic, 1/2 scallion, 20g crab-flavored surimi stick, 2T mirin, 1/2 block tofu, sesame oil
크랩-쌀국수-비빔면-Crab-Bibim-Rice-Noodles.steps:
1. Pour boiling water over the rice noodles. About 30 minutes should do it (about an hour if using cold water).
2. Drizzle oil in a pan and sauté 1T minced garlic and 2T finely chopped scallion.
3. Add 3T crab paste and sauté for 1-2 minutes until small bubbles start to rise.
4. Add 2T mirin, 60ml water, and 1/2 block tofu, and simmer about 5 minutes, then add the crab-flavored surimi (which apparently contains a whopping 6.54% crab) and the rice noodles from step 1, and mix well.
5. Plate and top with sesame oil and a little scallion.

사워도우-치아바타-토스트-Caviar-King-Oyster-Mushroo.title: Caviar & King Oyster Mushroom Sourdough Ciabatta Toast
사워도우-치아바타-토스트-Caviar-King-Oyster-Mushroo.intro:
20260605, #BreakfastDiary 1739, 16°C/partly cloudy
Mills Kaviar is a Norwegian fish roe spread. It's made from smoked, processed roe of fish like cod, and is apparently revered as a national spread in Norway. It tastes like well-grilled dried filefish dipped in mayonnaise.
👆 I have a feeling mixing bonito flakes into mayonnaise would give you something similar.
Topped with an umami explosion of Mills Kaviar and a nutty king oyster mushroom salad, about 450kcal, Caviar & King Oyster Mushroom Sourdough Ciabatta Toast.
사워도우-치아바타-토스트-Caviar-King-Oyster-Mushroo.ingredients: 2 slabs sourdough, 2 king oyster mushrooms, 1T tsuyu, 1T perilla oil, 1t perilla seeds, chopped scallion, (optional) Mills Kaviar (substitute mayonnaise)
사워도우-치아바타-토스트-Caviar-King-Oyster-Mushroo.steps:
1. Brush the sourdough slabs with olive oil and toast both sides until crisp. They crisp up nicely once they've cooled a bit.
2. Slice the king oyster mushrooms thinly with a peeler, blanch in boiling water for 1 minute, then squeeze out the moisture.
3. In a mixing bowl, toss the mushrooms with 1T tsuyu, 1T perilla oil, 1t perilla seeds, and a little chopped scallion. (Season it a bit mild, since it'll be paired with the Mills Kaviar.)
4. Spread Norway's national sauce, Mills Kaviar, on the sourdough, then top with the mushroom mixture from step 3.

버터-세이지-파스타-Butter-Sage-Pasta.title: Butter Sage Pasta
버터-세이지-파스타-Butter-Sage-Pasta.intro:
20260604, #BreakfastDiary 1738, 22°C/mostly cloudy
Nothing to say.
760kcal, Butter Sage Pasta.
버터-세이지-파스타-Butter-Sage-Pasta.ingredients: 1 serving conchiglie, 10 sage leaves, 1T pecans, 30g butter, 1/2 lemon, 20g parmesan cheese
버터-세이지-파스타-Butter-Sage-Pasta.steps:
1. Crush the pecans in a mortar, then toast in the air fryer at 150°C for 5 minutes.
2. Boil the conchiglie in salted boiling water.
3. In a pan, add 15g butter and place the cut side of the 1/2 lemon down, then cook. Once the butter melts, fry the sage leaves and set them aside. Strain the brown butter (melted butter) through a sieve.
4. In the pan, combine the conchiglie, the brown butter, 15g butter, and the juice squeezed from the pan-roasted lemon in step 3, and mix.
5. Add 20g parmesan cheese and 1/2 cup pasta water, and mantecare (emulsify) to finish.
6. Plate and top with the sage leaves set aside in step 3 and the pecans.

버터-세이지-파스타-Butter-Sage-Pasta-2.title: Butter Sage Pasta
버터-세이지-파스타-Butter-Sage-Pasta-2.intro:
20260604, #BreakfastDiary 1738, 22°C/mostly cloudy
Nothing to say.
760kcal, Butter Sage Pasta.
버터-세이지-파스타-Butter-Sage-Pasta-2.ingredients: 1 serving conchiglie, 10 sage leaves, 1T pecans, 30g butter, 1/2 lemon, 20g parmesan cheese
버터-세이지-파스타-Butter-Sage-Pasta-2.steps:
1. Crush the pecans in a mortar, then toast in the air fryer at 150°C for 5 minutes.
2. Boil the conchiglie in salted boiling water.
3. In a pan, add 15g butter and place the cut side of the 1/2 lemon down, then cook. Once the butter melts, fry the sage leaves and set them aside. Strain the brown butter (melted butter) through a sieve.
4. In the pan, combine the conchiglie, the brown butter, 15g butter, and the juice squeezed from the pan-roasted lemon in step 3, and mix.
5. Add 20g parmesan cheese and 1/2 cup pasta water, and mantecare (emulsify) to finish.
6. Plate and top with the sage leaves set aside in step 3 and the pecans.

원팬-감자-버섯-샐러드-One-Pan-Red-Potato-Vodam-So.title: One Pan Red Potato, Vodam Songi Mushroom & Egg Skillet
원팬-감자-버섯-샐러드-One-Pan-Red-Potato-Vodam-So.intro:
20260603, #BreakfastDiary 1737, 24°C/partly sunny
Cinnamon
It brings out the sweetness of the potatoes, doubles down on the mushrooms' nuttiness, and harmoniously mellows the balsamic's tartness. About 450kcal, with cinnamon doing all the heavy lifting - One Pan Red Potato, Vodam Songi Mushroom & Egg Skillet.
If lemon is what gets your appetite going before a meal, cinnamon flavor is what lingers long after it.
원팬-감자-버섯-샐러드-One-Pan-Red-Potato-Vodam-So.ingredients: 3 red potatoes, 5 vodam songi mushrooms, 2 eggs, a little parsley, 2T balsamic vinegar, 1T honey, 2T olive oil, 1T herbs, 1/2T minced garlic, 1 cinnamon stick, lemon zest, salt, pepper
원팬-감자-버섯-샐러드-One-Pan-Red-Potato-Vodam-So.steps:
1. Scrub the red potatoes clean, cut into bite-sized pieces with the skin on, and boil in a pot.
2. In an oiled pan, add 2T olive oil, 1T herbs, 1/2T minced garlic, 1 cinnamon stick, lemon zest, salt, and pepper, and slowly sauté over low heat until fragrant.
3. Dust off the vodam songi mushrooms from @uglyus.market and sauté them nicely in the pan from step 2.
4. Add the red potatoes from step 1 to the pan from step 3, along with 2T balsamic vinegar and 1T honey, and mix well.
5. Crack in 2 eggs, cover, and wait until the whites are set, then top with chopped parsley.

부라타-앤초비에-찍어먹는-사워도우-토스트-Burrata-Anchovy-T.title: Burrata Anchovy Toast
부라타-앤초비에-찍어먹는-사워도우-토스트-Burrata-Anchovy-T.intro:
20260602, #BreakfastDiary 1736, 20°C/mostly sunny
About 450kcal, Sourdough Toast for Dipping in Burrata & Anchovy - Burrata Anchovy Toast.
부라타-앤초비에-찍어먹는-사워도우-토스트-Burrata-Anchovy-T.ingredients: 1 slice sourdough, 1 burrata cheese, a pinch of salt and pepper, 2T olive oil, 5-6 anchovies, pink peppercorns, a handful of mint
부라타-앤초비에-찍어먹는-사워도우-토스트-Burrata-Anchovy-T.steps:
1. Place the burrata on a plate and spread it out, then top with salt, pepper, olive oil, anchovies, (smashed) mint, and pink peppercorns.
2. Dip crisply toasted sourdough into it and eat.

토마토밥-Tomato-Rice.title: Tomato Rice
토마토밥-Tomato-Rice.intro:
20260601, #BreakfastDiary 1735, 17°C/cloudy
The first day of June. Only a month left in the first half of 2026. I think about the things I didn't accomplish, and the things I kept putting off.
About 460kcal, Tomato Rice.
토마토밥-Tomato-Rice.ingredients: 3 medium tomatoes (as much tomato as you like), 1/2 bowl of rice, 1t minced garlic, a pinch of salt and pepper, 1t yeondu seasoning and tuna extract, 1T mozzarella cheese, 1T olive oil, a little parsley powder
토마토밥-Tomato-Rice.steps:
1. Score the tomatoes, blanch in boiling water, then plunge into cold water and peel.
2. In a pot, sauté olive oil and garlic, then add the tomatoes, 1/2 bowl of rice, and 1/2 cup water, cover, and simmer for 2-3 minutes, then mix well. (Add water as needed so the rice can soften fully.)
3. Add a pinch of salt and pepper, and 1t each of yeondu seasoning and tuna extract, and mix. Add the mozzarella cheese, cover, and wait until the cheese melts before mixing.
4. Finish with olive oil and parsley powder.

정어리-토마토-파스타.title: Sardine Tomato Pasta
정어리-토마토-파스타.intro:
20260531, #BreakfastDiary 1734, 20°C/sunny
Is there really such a thing as "cooking wine"? I think it's fine to just use a splash of whatever wine is good enough for me to drink. Today it's an Australian Chardonnay.
About 700kcal, Sardine Tomato Pasta.
정어리-토마토-파스타.ingredients: 1 serving linguine, 1 can sardines, 2T white wine (left over from drinking), 1/4 onion, 5 cloves garlic, a pinch of chili flakes, 5 cherry tomatoes, 1T lemon juice, a little basil and parmesan cheese
정어리-토마토-파스타.steps:
1. Boil the linguine in water with 2t salt.
2. Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté the thinly sliced onion and garlic. Add a pinch of chili flakes in place of peperoncino.
3. Add the sardines and pour in a splash of white wine to chase away any lingering fishy smell and add acidity. (Rinse the sardines in cold water before using. Set aside one whole sardine to use as a topping.)
4. Chop the tomatoes finely, add them in, and sauté a bit more.
5. Add 1/2 cup pasta water and the boiled linguine from step 1, and mix well.
6. Turn off the heat, add chopped basil, and mantecare to finish.
7. Plate the linguine, spoon over the sauce left in the pan, and top with the sardine set aside in step 3, lemon juice, and parmesan cheese.

메밀면.title: Buckwheat Noodles
메밀면.intro:
20260530, #BreakfastDiary 1733, 19°C/sunny
About 450kcal, Buckwheat Noodles for dipping in a nutty tofu dressing.
It's also good to use soy milk instead of water, and add finely ground sesame seeds.
메밀면.ingredients: 1 serving buckwheat noodles, 3T tsuyu, 1t sesame oil, 1t minced garlic, 1/2t lemon salt, finely chopped scallion, 1t wasabi
메밀면.steps:
1. Boil the buckwheat noodles in boiling water, adding cold water about 3 times whenever it foams up and threatens to boil over. Rinse in cold water.
2. (Silken tofu would be nice, but all I have is regular tofu, so) blend 1/2 block of regular tofu with 1 cup water for about 10 seconds until smooth. It's thick. (Adjust the consistency to your taste.)
3. Put half of the tofu from step 2 in a bowl and add 3T tsuyu, 1t sesame oil, 1t minced garlic, 1/2t lemon salt, finely chopped scallion, and 1t wasabi.
4. Dip the buckwheat noodles from step 1 into the dressing from step 3 and eat.

양송이버섯.title: Button Mushrooms
양송이버섯.intro:
20260529, #BreakfastDiary 1732, 18°C/mostly sunny
Sourdough ciabatta with about 500g of button mushroom scrambled eggs on the side.
양송이버섯.ingredients: 2 small pieces sourdough ciabatta, 5-6 button mushrooms, 1/2T mayonnaise, 1/4 onion, 1 cup scallion, 10g butter, 2 eggs, a little parmesan cheese, 1t chili oil, olive oil
양송이버섯.steps:
1. Finely dice 1/4 onion and the scallion, and dust off the button mushrooms and slice them thinly.
2. Pour a little olive oil in a pan and sauté the onion from step 1, then add the button mushrooms and scallion and sauté. Add 10g butter and sauté a bit more.
3. Add 2 eggs, 1t chili oil, and parmesan cheese, and lightly cook to make moist scrambled eggs.
4. Spread mayonnaise on lightly toasted sourdough ciabatta and top with the button mushroom scrambled eggs from step 3.

토마토-민트-샐러드-Tomato-Mint-Salad.title: Tomato Mint Salad
토마토-민트-샐러드-Tomato-Mint-Salad.intro:
20260525, #BreakfastDiary 1731, 17°C/partly cloudy
The taste of summer, tomato.
Seasoned with garlic powder my mom made, olive oil, and Maldon salt - 350kcal, Tomato Mint Salad.
토마토-민트-샐러드-Tomato-Mint-Salad.ingredients: 1 piece sourdough ciabatta, 4 tomatoes, a little ice, 1T olive oil, 1/2 lemon, 0.5t Maldon salt, 1.5t garlic powder
토마토-민트-샐러드-Tomato-Mint-Salad.steps:
1. Cut the tomatoes into big, rough chunks and put them in a bowl.
2. (The order matters.) Add the Maldon salt and garlic powder and wait about 10 minutes. Delicious juices will release. This is the moment.
3. Add the olive oil and a few pieces of ice and mix, then
4. Place mint leaves on your palm, smash them to break the veins, and lay them on top of the tomatoes.
5. Serve with crisply toasted sourdough ciabatta.

가지피자.title: #EggplantPizza
가지피자.intro:
20260524, #BreakfastDiary 1730, 15°C/sunny
An eggplant breakfast that no one could dislike. Plus (I don't usually think calories matter much for breakfast, but) even eating both, it's only about 600kcal - #EggplantPizza
가지피자.ingredients: 2 eggplants, 10 cherry tomatoes, 150g chicken breast, 3T mozzarella cheese, 1/2 onion, a little parmesan cheese, salt
가지피자.steps:
1. Press the eggplants flat, slit them open lengthwise, add a pinch of salt and a little olive oil inside, then roast in the air fryer at 180°C for 20 minutes.
2. Finely chop 20 cherry tomatoes and squeeze out the moisture.
3. Finely chop the onion and chicken breast and set aside.
4. Heat olive oil in a pan, add a pinch of salt, and sauté the cherry tomatoes and onion from step 2, then add the chicken breast and sauté. Add 1T miso and sauté a bit more.
5. Take out the eggplant from step 1, fill it with mozzarella cheese and the mixture from step 4, and top with parmesan cheese. Bake in the oven at 190°C for 5 minutes.

토마토와-가지를-넣은-감바스풍-알-아히요-Garlic-Gambas-Sty.title: Garlic Gambas-Style Veggie Egg Skillet
토마토와-가지를-넣은-감바스풍-알-아히요-Garlic-Gambas-Sty.intro:
20260523, #BreakfastDiary 1729, 16°C/cloudy
Made gambas al ajillo style with a generous pour of olive oil, but there's no gambas (shrimp) here - just al ajillo (garlic) taking center stage, mixed with vegetables and spaghetti tossed in. About 450kcal, Garlic Gambas-Style Veggie Egg Skillet with tomato and eggplant.
토마토와-가지를-넣은-감바스풍-알-아히요-Garlic-Gambas-Sty.ingredients: 1/2 cup olive oil, 5 cherry tomatoes, 1 eggplant, 2 eggs, 10 cloves garlic, 1T minced garlic, salt, pepper, 1/2T tuna extract
토마토와-가지를-넣은-감바스풍-알-아히요-Garlic-Gambas-Sty.steps:
1. In a cast-iron pan, add olive oil, minced garlic, and whole garlic cloves, and cook slowly.
2. Wash the cherry tomatoes, pat dry, and cut in half.
3. Wash the eggplant too, pat dry, and cut into pieces similar in size to the cherry tomatoes.
4. Add the cherry tomatoes and eggplant to the pan from step 1, along with salt, pepper, tuna extract, and crushed pepper.
5. Crack in 2 eggs, cover, and cook.
6. Add a little scallion and toss in spaghetti to eat.

두릅-프리타타-Aralia-Sprout-Frittata.title: Aralia Sprout Frittata
두릅-프리타타-Aralia-Sprout-Frittata.intro:
20260522, #BreakfastDiary 1728, 16°C/sunny
A mondegreen is the phenomenon of mishearing song lyrics or speech and interpreting them with a different meaning than intended. Classic examples: "All by myself" heard as "Oppa manse" (Hail, oppa), or "Isn't she lovely" heard as "Yi Sun-sin lovely" (the famous admiral).
Nailed it - dureup dureup dureup, Hit you with that DDU-DU DDU-DU DU,
Today's breakfast, made for the soundtrack. About 450kcal, Aralia Sprout Frittata.
두릅-프리타타-Aralia-Sprout-Frittata.ingredients: Aralia sprouts (enough to fill a small pound cake tin), a handful of spinach, 2 eggs, 1/2 cup milk, 1T cheddar cheese, 1/2t whole grain mustard, salt, pepper, 1/2t sugar, 1T shredded cheese
두릅-프리타타-Aralia-Sprout-Frittata.steps:
1. Trim the base of the aralia sprouts and use only the leaves and tender stems. Blanch for 1 minute, rinse in cold water, and squeeze out the moisture well. Sauté lightly in a pan for just 1-2 minutes (enough to drive off the moisture). The baby spinach, which will provide a softer flavor layer in contrast to the aralia sprouts, should be rinsed in cold water and squeezed dry.
2. Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté the chopped onion. (Since I used the same pan the aralia sprouts were cooked in, the onion turns reddish.)
3. Add 3 eggs, 1/2 cup milk, 1/2t whole grain mustard, salt, pepper, and 1/2t sugar, and gently mix with chopsticks or a whisk for just 20-30 seconds.
5. In a small pound cake tin, layer the aralia sprouts from step 1 and the onion from step 2, then pour in the egg mixture from step 3. On top of that, add spinach and aralia sprouts, pour in more egg mixture, then top with aralia sprouts again.
6. Bake in a 170°C oven for 20 minutes covered with cooking foil, then remove the foil and bake for another 10 minutes.

사워도우에-곁들인-고소하고-달디단-대파-딥.title: Nutty Sweet Scallion Dip with Sourdough
사워도우에-곁들인-고소하고-달디단-대파-딥.intro:
20260521, #BreakfastDiary 1727, 15°C/drizzle
Lucky Vicky again today 🍀
I was aiming for scallion gratin, but there wasn't enough scallion and too much cream, so it failed - quickly pivoted to a dip instead. About 590kcal, Nutty Sweet Scallion Dip with Sourdough.
사워도우에-곁들인-고소하고-달디단-대파-딥.ingredients: 1 piece sourdough, 4 scallions (white parts only), a little of the green scallion tops, 20g butter, salt, pepper, 2T shredded emmental cheese, 100ml heavy cream
사워도우에-곁들인-고소하고-달디단-대파-딥.steps:
1. Use the scallion's white part and green part in about an 8:2 ratio. Wash thoroughly and slice thinly.
2. In a cast-iron pan, add 20g butter and the scallion from step 1, and cook over medium heat, stirring well, for about 5 minutes. Add a pinch of salt and pepper.
3. Pour in 100ml heavy cream, top with shredded emmental cheese, cover, and cook. Finish with a little pepper.

밖에-안되는-쫄깃쫄깃-묵말랭이-훈제연어-샐러드-Acorn-Jelly-Sm.title: Acorn Jelly & Smoked Salmon Salad
밖에-안되는-쫄깃쫄깃-묵말랭이-훈제연어-샐러드-Acorn-Jelly-Sm.intro:
20260520, #BreakfastDiary 1726, 17°C/drizzle
So wonderfully chewy.
Only about 120kcal - chewy dried acorn jelly and smoked salmon salad, Acorn Jelly & Smoked Salmon Salad.
밖에-안되는-쫄깃쫄깃-묵말랭이-훈제연어-샐러드-Acorn-Jelly-Sm.ingredients: 50g dried acorn jelly, 1 cucumber, 50g smoked salmon, (dressing) 2t shio kombu, 1t minced garlic, 2t wasabi, 2t sesame oil
밖에-안되는-쫄깃쫄깃-묵말랭이-훈제연어-샐러드-Acorn-Jelly-Sm.steps:
1. Soak the dried acorn jelly in water before going to bed. Blanch in boiling water for 1-2 minutes.
2. Wash the cucumber under running water, trim off both ends, halve lengthwise, and remove the seeds. Cut into pieces the size of the acorn jelly.
3. In a mixing bowl, combine the soaked acorn jelly from step 1, the cucumber from step 2, and the smoked salmon torn into pieces, then add 2t shio kombu, 1t minced garlic, 2t wasabi, and 2t sesame oil, and mix well.
4. Plate and top with a little sesame seeds.

부라타치즈와-그린올리브를-얹은-사워도우-토스트.title: Sourdough Toast with Burrata and Green Olives
부라타치즈와-그린올리브를-얹은-사워도우-토스트.intro:
20260519, #BreakfastDiary 1725, 18°C/cloudy
About 400kcal, Sourdough Toast with Burrata and Green Olives.
부라타치즈와-그린올리브를-얹은-사워도우-토스트.ingredients: 1 big slice sourdough, 2 cups green olives, 1T olive oil, lemon zest and juice from 1/2 lemon, a pinch of chili flakes, chopped basil, 1 clove garlic, 1 burrata cheese, 1T pine nuts
부라타치즈와-그린올리브를-얹은-사워도우-토스트.steps:
1. Rinse the green olives under running water and pit them. This is a step you could skip if you buy pitted olives.
2. Put the green olives in a mixing bowl and roughly crush them with a masher.
3. To the bowl from step 2, add 1T olive oil, lemon zest and juice from 1/2 lemon, a pinch of chili flakes, and torn basil, and mix well.
4. Brush the sourdough with olive oil, toast it, and rub it with garlic.
5. Place the sourdough on a plate, tear the burrata over it, and top with toasted pine nuts, olive oil, and a little chili flakes.

토마토-냉우동.title: Cold Tomato Udon
토마토-냉우동.intro:
20260518, #BreakfastDiary 1724, 18°C/sunny
Park Chan-il writes, in his book Damn Tomatoes, Amazing Eggplants, that Italians look down on American-style tomato pasta, dismissing it as cowboy-style, and that they prefer noodles dressed in something thin and silky - because for them, pasta is about tasting the noodle itself, not the sauce.
It makes me wonder - is today's cold tomato udon really about the udon? Is the tomato just along for the ride? About 380kcal, Cold Tomato Udon.
토마토-냉우동.ingredients: 1 tomato, 1 serving udon noodles, a handful of basil, (dressing) 2T tsuyu, 1T lemon juice, 1/2T olive oil, 1/4t lemon salt
토마토-냉우동.steps:
1. Score the tomato, blanch in boiling water, then peel and dice.
2. Without discarding the water used to blanch the tomato, boil the udon noodles in it. Rinse under running water and drain in a sieve.
3. Combine 2T tsuyu, 1T lemon juice, 1/2T olive oil, and 1/4t lemon salt, and mix well.
4. In a mixing bowl, combine the tomato from step 1, the udon noodles from step 2, chopped basil, and the dressing from step 3, and mix well.

가지-토마토-샐러드-2.title: Eggplant Tomato Salad
가지-토마토-샐러드-2.intro:
20260517, #BreakfastDiary 1723, 17°C/sunny
Park Chan-il writes that the Mediterranean is probably where eggplant cookery has developed furthest in the world: grilled, it turns chewy and tender like steak, and flesh that seemed to hold no sweetness suddenly floods with it. Chopped small and sautéed with carrots and pine nuts, it becomes a Mediterranean-style ratatouille, what people there think of as a soul food, caponata.
After having eggplant tomato salad for breakfast, I stopped by the library and Chef Park Chan-il's book caught my eye. His vivid descriptions of eggplant (and all kinds of ingredients, really) spark the imagination in your mouth.
Tossing eggplant in olive oil and cooking it in the microwave lets you easily get a nicely textured eggplant without roasting it in the oven or pan. About 430kcal, Eggplant Tomato Salad.
가지-토마토-샐러드-2.ingredients: 1 eggplant, 1 medium tomato, 1T hemp seeds, a little baby spinach, (dressing) 2T olive oil, 1T red wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard, (1/4t lemon salt - optional)
가지-토마토-샐러드-2.steps:
1. Wash the eggplant under running water, pat dry, and slice into 0.5cm thick pieces.
2. Put the eggplant in a bowl, toss with 1T olive oil, cover with plastic wrap, and microwave for 3 minutes.
3. Wash the tomato under running water, pat dry, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
4. In a mixing bowl, combine the eggplant from step 2, the tomato from step 3, spinach, 1T hemp seeds, and the dressing, and mix well.

아스파라거스-보울.title: Asparagus Bowl
아스파라거스-보울.intro:
20260516, #BreakfastDiary 1722, 22°C/mostly sunny
I didn't have quite enough asparagus, so I added edamame along with it - turns out it looks nice and rounds out the nutrition too, so #LuckyVicky.
425kcal, Asparagus Bowl.
아스파라거스-보울.ingredients: 1/2 bowl rice, 100g asparagus, 1T hemp seeds, 2T edamame, 1 egg yolk, (dressing) 1T soy sauce, 1T mirin, 1T gim-jaban (seasoned seaweed flakes), 1T sesame seeds
아스파라거스-보울.steps:
1. Pour water into a pan, add salt, and boil the asparagus and edamame.
2. Combine 1T soy sauce, 1T mirin, 1T gim-jaban, and 1T sesame seeds and mix well to make the dressing.
3. Cut the boiled asparagus into 1cm diagonal pieces, put them in a mixing bowl with the boiled edamame and 1T hemp seeds, pour in the dressing from step 2, and mix.
4. Put freshly cooked rice in a bowl, add the mixed asparagus from step 3, and top with the egg yolk.

포칭-닭가슴살-오이-샐러드-Poached-Chicken-Breast-Cu.title: Poached Chicken Breast Cucumber Salad
포칭-닭가슴살-오이-샐러드-Poached-Chicken-Breast-Cu.intro:
20260515, #BreakfastDiary 1721, 19°C/sunny
About 430kcal, Poached Chicken Breast Cucumber Salad with peanut butter dressing.
포칭-닭가슴살-오이-샐러드-Poached-Chicken-Breast-Cu.ingredients: 100g chicken breast, 1 chwicheong cucumber, 1t sesame seeds, (dressing) 2T peanut butter, 1T soy sauce, 2t xylose, 1/2T lemon juice, 1T sesame oil, 3T water
포칭-닭가슴살-오이-샐러드-Poached-Chicken-Breast-Cu.steps:
1. Cook by poaching to bring out a moist chicken breast texture different from sous vide. Pour 500ml water into a pot, add 1/4t salt, and bring to a boil, then turn off the heat, add the chicken breast, take it out after 20 minutes, and let it rest for 5 minutes. It's moist. Shred thinly along the grain.
2. Julienne the cucumber thinly.
3. Arrange the cucumber on a plate, top with the chicken breast from step 1, the dressing (2T peanut butter, 1T soy sauce, 2t xylose, 1/2T lemon juice, 1T sesame oil, 3T water), and sesame seeds.

홍감자-에그오믈렛-Potato-Egg-Omelette.title: Potato Egg Omelette
홍감자-에그오믈렛-Potato-Egg-Omelette.intro:
20260514, #BreakfastDiary 1720, 15°C/sunny
A first meeting, the first day of daycare, the first day of school, the first day of work - "first" might just be the most thrilling word in the world.
About 360kcal, Potato Egg Omelette.
홍감자-에그오믈렛-Potato-Egg-Omelette.ingredients: 1 red potato, 2 eggs, 2T shredded cheese, 1/2 tomato, a little spinach
홍감자-에그오믈렛-Potato-Egg-Omelette.steps:
1. Peel the red potato and slice thinly with a mandoline.
2. Heat olive oil in a pan, lay in the potato from step 1, and lightly cook.
3. Beat 2 eggs in a bowl, season with salt and pepper, mix well, and pour into the pan from step 2.
4. Top with shredded emmental cheese, chopped tomato, and baby spinach, and fold in half. (Folding at about 2/3 rather than exactly in half so the filling peeks out seems better.)

해체주의적-카프레제-샐러드-Deconstructed-Caprese-Sal.title: Deconstructed Caprese Salad
해체주의적-카프레제-샐러드-Deconstructed-Caprese-Sal.intro:
20260514, #BreakfastDiary 1720, 14°C/sunny
The classic caprese ingredients (tomato, mozzarella, basil) taken apart and rearranged. About 420kcal, Deconstructed Caprese Salad.
해체주의적-카프레제-샐러드-Deconstructed-Caprese-Sal.ingredients: 1 piece sourdough, 2 tomatoes, 50g mozzarella cheese, 1T olive oil, 1T balsamic vinegar, a pinch of salt and pepper, a little basil
해체주의적-카프레제-샐러드-Deconstructed-Caprese-Sal.steps:
1. Wash the 2 tomatoes thoroughly and grate them directly onto a plate.
2. Add olive oil, balsamic vinegar, a little salt, mozzarella cheese, and basil. Finish with a little pepper.

Eat it on top of sourdough brushed with olive oil and toasted until crisp.

해체주의적-카프레제-샐러드-Deconstructed-Caprese-Sal.title: Deconstructed Caprese Salad
해체주의적-카프레제-샐러드-Deconstructed-Caprese-Sal.intro:
20260513, #BreakfastDiary 1719, 14°C/sunny
The classic caprese ingredients (tomato, mozzarella, basil) taken apart and rearranged. About 420kcal, Deconstructed Caprese Salad.
해체주의적-카프레제-샐러드-Deconstructed-Caprese-Sal.ingredients: 1 piece sourdough, 2 tomatoes, 50g mozzarella cheese, 1T olive oil, 1T balsamic vinegar, a pinch of salt and pepper, a little basil
해체주의적-카프레제-샐러드-Deconstructed-Caprese-Sal.steps:
1. Wash the 2 tomatoes thoroughly and grate them directly onto a plate.
2. Add olive oil, balsamic vinegar, a little salt, mozzarella cheese, and basil. Finish with a little pepper.

Eat it on top of sourdough brushed with olive oil and toasted until crisp.

그릭요거트-오이-닭가슴살-샐러드-Poached-Chicken-Cucumb.title: Poached Chicken Cucumber Salad
그릭요거트-오이-닭가슴살-샐러드-Poached-Chicken-Cucumb.intro:
20260512, #BreakfastDiary 1718, 16°C/cloudy
Cooked by poaching to bring out a moist chicken breast texture different from sous vide. Tossed with Greek yogurt and cucumber and served on lightly toasted sourdough. A breakfast where I put my whole heart into cooking the chicken breast.
Per serving, about 200kcal, Greek Yogurt Cucumber Chicken Breast Salad - Poached Chicken Cucumber Salad.
그릭요거트-오이-닭가슴살-샐러드-Poached-Chicken-Cucumb.ingredients: 1/2 onion, 1 cucumber, (for poaching chicken) 100g chicken breast, 1/4t salt, 1T lemon juice, pepper, (dressing) 5T Greek yogurt, 1T olive oil, 1T lemon juice, 1t minced garlic and a pinch of salt, pepper
그릭요거트-오이-닭가슴살-샐러드-Poached-Chicken-Cucumb.steps:
1. Pour 500ml water into a pot, add 1/4t salt, 1T lemon juice, and pepper, and bring to a boil, then turn off the heat, add the chicken breast, take it out after 20 minutes, and let it rest for 5 minutes. A moist chicken breast is complete. Shred thinly along the grain.
2. Finely chop 1/2 onion and thinly slice 1 cucumber.
3. In a mixing bowl, combine 5T Greek yogurt, 1T olive oil, 1T lemon juice, 1t minced garlic, a pinch of salt, and pepper, and mix well. Add the chicken breast from step 1, the onion, and the cucumber, and mix well. Finish with pink peppercorns.

버섯스테이크-Baked-Mushroom-Steak.title: Baked Mushroom Steak
버섯스테이크-Baked-Mushroom-Steak.intro:
20260511, #BreakfastDiary 1717, 11°C/mostly cloudy (rain expected from the afternoon)
It's not that long a stretch of time, but on days when I hand the cooking over to the oven, it somehow feels like I'm buying back time - a bit different from buying time in a way most people wouldn't relate to, like a fast-track pass.
"Meaty oyster mushroom" is a brand name - it's actually santari mushroom. Apparently it's branded meaty oyster mushroom because it's chewier and has more of a meat-like texture. I've used it instead of meat in various breakfasts, and it's quite good.
Even better roasted in the oven. About 240kcal, Baked Mushroom Steak.
버섯스테이크-Baked-Mushroom-Steak.ingredients: a handful of meaty oyster mushrooms, 3T tomato sauce, a little parsley and parmesan cheese
버섯스테이크-Baked-Mushroom-Steak.steps:
1. Place the meaty oyster mushrooms on an oven pan, sprinkle with olive oil, salt, and pepper, and roast in a 200°C oven for 20 minutes.
2. (It'd be nice to make my own tomato sauce, but today I'm just using store-bought.) Put the tomato sauce on a plate and microwave for 30 seconds. Top with the mushrooms from step 1, parsley, and parmesan cheese.

바질-방울토마토-샐러드-파스타-Basil-Tomato-Salad-Past.title: Basil Tomato Salad Pasta
바질-방울토마토-샐러드-파스타-Basil-Tomato-Salad-Past.ingredients: 1 serving spaghetti, 10 cherry tomatoes, a handful of basil, 3T mayonnaise, 1T balsamic vinegar, a pinch of salt and pepper
바질-방울토마토-샐러드-파스타-Basil-Tomato-Salad-Past.steps:
1. Wash the cherry tomatoes thoroughly, pat dry, and cut into quarters.
2. Wash the basil under running water, pat dry, and finely chop just the leaves.
3. In a mixing bowl, combine the cherry tomatoes from step 1 and the basil from step 2, add 3T mayonnaise, 1T balsamic vinegar, and a pinch of salt and pepper, and mix well.
4. A thin noodle like capellini would be ideal, but since I don't have any, I just boil regular spaghetti thoroughly.
5. Add the spaghetti from step 4 into the mixing bowl from step 3, and mix well.

애호박볶음국수.title: Stir-Fried Zucchini Noodles
애호박볶음국수.intro:
20260509, #BreakfastDiary 1715, 16°C/mostly cloudy
The zucchini I bought a few days ago showed up in my dream.
Per serving, about 550kcal, Stir-Fried Zucchini Noodles.
애호박볶음국수.ingredients: 2 servings somyeon noodles, 1 zucchini, 1/2 onion, 1 red chili and 1 cheongyang chili, 2 cloves garlic, 1t salt, 1T soy sauce, 1T red pepper powder, 1T plum extract, (noodle seasoning) 1T soy sauce, 1T sesame oil, 1T sesame seeds
애호박볶음국수.steps:
1. Mince 2 cloves garlic, slice 1/2 onion, and deseed and finely chop the red chili and cheongyang chili. Finely chop the zucchini too. Prep done.
2. Heat oil in a pan and sauté the garlic and onion. Add the red chili, cheongyang chili, and zucchini in that order and sauté. Add 1t salt, 1T soy sauce, 1T red pepper powder, and 1T plum extract, and sauté.
3. Boil the somyeon noodles in boiling water, then rinse in cold water. Add 1T soy sauce, 1T sesame oil, and 1T sesame seeds, and mix well.
4. Plate the noodles from step 3 and top with the stir-fried zucchini from step 2.

베수비오-웜-샐러드-파스타-Vesuvio-Warm-Salad-Pasta.title: Vesuvio Warm Salad Pasta
베수비오-웜-샐러드-파스타-Vesuvio-Warm-Salad-Pasta.intro:
20260508, #BreakfastDiary 1714, 12°C/sunny
Monte Vesuvio - the mountain that wiped out Pompeii in the Roman Empire in AD 79. Today, it wipes out breakfast instead. About 750kcal, Vesuvio Warm Salad Pasta.
베수비오-웜-샐러드-파스타-Vesuvio-Warm-Salad-Pasta.ingredients: 2 cups vesuvio pasta, 2 cups peas, 3 thick asparagus spears, 1T basil pesto, 1T olive oil
베수비오-웜-샐러드-파스타-Vesuvio-Warm-Salad-Pasta.steps:
1. Add the vesuvio pasta to boiling water with 2t salt.
2. Meanwhile, trim the asparagus and cut into 1cm pieces.
3. Once the vesuvio pasta from step 1 is nearly done, add the asparagus from step 2 and the peas and boil.
4. In a mixing bowl, combine the boiled vesuvio pasta, asparagus, peas, basil pesto, and olive oil, and mix until delicious.

블루베리-바나나-푸딩.title: Blueberry Banana Pudding
블루베리-바나나-푸딩.intro:
20260507, #BreakfastDiary 1713, 16°C/cloudy
A reinterpretation of Magnolia Bakery's New York banana pudding, but a bit healthier. Per serving, about 450kcal, Blueberry Banana Pudding.
블루베리-바나나-푸딩.ingredients: 2 bananas, 4t açaí berry powder, 400g Greek yogurt, 1 bag baebae (egg cookies), 1T hemp seeds, 1 cup blueberries, (custard cream) 2 egg yolks, 4T xylose, 2T starch, 150ml soy milk, a little vanilla extract
블루베리-바나나-푸딩.steps:
1. Let's make the custard cream. In a bowl, combine 2 egg yolks, 4T xylose, 2T starch, and 150ml soy milk, mix, and microwave for 3 minutes. Add a few drops of vanilla extract and microwave for another 3 minutes. Chill in the fridge for about 20 minutes.
2. Take it out of the fridge, add 400g Greek yogurt and 4t açaí berry powder, and mix well.
3. In a bowl, layer the custard cream from step 2, sliced bananas, baebae (egg cookies), and hemp seeds, then cover with more custard cream. Let it set in the fridge for a while.
4. Plate and top with a few blueberries.

말차그릭요거트-망고-사워도우-토스트.title: Matcha Greek Yogurt Mango Sourdough Toast
말차그릭요거트-망고-사워도우-토스트.intro:
20260506, #BreakfastDiary 1712, 0°C/sunny
The nuttiness of sourdough, the tang of Greek yogurt, and the sweetness of mango, balanced out by matcha's clean bitterness. About 200kcal, Matcha Greek Yogurt Mango Sourdough Toast.
말차그릭요거트-망고-사워도우-토스트.ingredients: 1 slice sourdough, 1T Greek yogurt, 1/2t matcha, 1T (frozen) mango, 1t coconut flakes
말차그릭요거트-망고-사워도우-토스트.steps:
1. Brush the sourdough with olive oil and toast until crisp.
2. Mix 1T Greek yogurt with 1/2t matcha until well combined.
3. Plate the sourdough and top with the matcha Greek yogurt from step 2, thawed mango, and coconut flakes.

말차그릭요거트-망고-사워도우-토스트-2.title: Matcha Greek Yogurt Mango Sourdough Toast
말차그릭요거트-망고-사워도우-토스트-2.intro:
20260506, #BreakfastDiary 1712, 13°C/sunny
In Han Kang's poem "Song of Recovery," she describes lying there wondering what it even means to go on living, sunlight falling across her face, and keeping her eyes closed, quite still, until the light passed.
I've been struggling with a cold and body aches for over a week. Standing in the wind by the Han River yesterday, eyes closed, feeling out how my body was doing, it felt like I'd completely burned through some hard-earned savings - the kind you build up by going without food, without new clothes, scrimping bit by bit.
The nuttiness of sourdough, the tang of Greek yogurt, and the sweetness of mango, properly balanced by matcha's clean bitterness. About 200kcal, Matcha Greek Yogurt Mango Sourdough Toast.
말차그릭요거트-망고-사워도우-토스트-2.ingredients: 1 slice sourdough, 1T Greek yogurt, 1/2t matcha, 1T (frozen) mango, 1t coconut flakes
말차그릭요거트-망고-사워도우-토스트-2.steps:
1. Brush the sourdough with olive oil and toast until crisp.
2. Mix 1T Greek yogurt with 1/2t matcha until well combined.
3. Plate the sourdough and top with the matcha Greek yogurt from step 2, thawed mango, and coconut flakes.

오코노미야키-Okonomiyaki.title: Okonomiyaki
오코노미야키-Okonomiyaki.intro:
20260505, #BreakfastDiary 1711, 17°C/sunny
In Japanese, okonomi (お好み) means "as you like it" and yaki (焼き) means "grilled," so loosely translated it means grilling something up however you please. After cooking one round, I belatedly looked up what okonomiyaki actually meant, dug some octopus out of the fridge, and threw it in to suit my taste. Maybe it's just me, but it looks a little burnt - still, about 400kcal, Okonomiyaki.
오코노미야키-Okonomiyaki.ingredients: 110g cabbage, 1 egg, 3T oatmeal, 2T water, 1T tsuyu, a pinch of seasoned salt, 2T tenkasu (tempura scraps), 1T mayonnaise, parsley powder and bonito flakes
오코노미야키-Okonomiyaki.steps:
1. In a mixing bowl, combine 1 egg, 3T oatmeal, 2T water, 1T tsuyu, and a pinch of seasoned salt, mix well, and let soak for at least 10 minutes. (Substituted oatmeal since I had no tempura flour.)
2. Slice the cabbage and set aside.
3. Add the cabbage from step 2 and 2T tenkasu to the mixing bowl from step 1, and mix well.
4. Pour oil into a pan and cook on both sides.
5. Plate and slather generously with mayonnaise, then top heavily with parsley powder and bonito flakes.

뿌리채소-샐러드-Roasted-Root-Vegetable-Salad.title: Roasted Root Vegetable Salad
뿌리채소-샐러드-Roasted-Root-Vegetable-Salad.intro:
20260504, #BreakfastDiary 1710, 10°C/sunny
Radish, lotus root, even sweet pumpkin - roasting up root vegetables packed with everything good for the body: fiber, minerals, vitamins, and more.
400kcal, Roasted Root Vegetable Salad.
뿌리채소-샐러드-Roasted-Root-Vegetable-Salad.ingredients: radish, lotus root, sweet pumpkin (as much as you like), 1 cup lentils, a little nuts, dressing (2T olive oil, 1T red wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard), a little chives
뿌리채소-샐러드-Roasted-Root-Vegetable-Salad.steps:
1. Boil the lentils in water with salt. About 10 minutes is enough.
2. Cut the radish into finger-sized pieces and slice the lotus root into 0.5cm pieces.
3. Heat olive oil, season the root vegetables from step 2 with salt and pepper, and roast until golden. Remove the root vegetables and toast the nuts using the residual heat.
4. Plate the lentils and top with the root vegetables, nuts, chopped chives, and vinaigrette dressing.

명란파스타.title: Mentaiko Pasta
명란파스타.intro:
20260503, #BreakfastDiary 1709, 12°C/drizzle
I deseeded and finely chopped the red chili and cheongyang chili. Their sharp heat pairs pleasantly with the umami of the mentaiko. About 710kcal, Mentaiko Pasta.
명란파스타.ingredients: 1 serving linguine, 2 mentaiko (seasoned pollock roe), 1 red chili and 1 cheongyang chili, 2 cloves garlic, olive oil, salt, a little parmesan cheese
명란파스타.steps:
1. Boil the linguine in salted water.
2. Prepare the red chili and cheongyang chili, deseed, and finely chop.
3. Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté the minced garlic, then add the red chili and cheongyang chili from step 2 along with the mentaiko, and sauté over low heat.
4. Add a ladle of pasta water and the linguine, cook slowly, and once the pasta water reduces down, mantecare to finish.
5. Plate the pasta and top with chives and grated parmesan cheese.

쪽파-래디시-버터-사워도우-Scallion-Radish-Butter-So.title: Scallion Radish Butter Sourdough
쪽파-래디시-버터-사워도우-Scallion-Radish-Butter-So.intro:
20260502, #BreakfastDiary 1708, 15°C/cloudy
Radis au beurre et sel - radish with butter and salt. In France, there's a dish where you spread butter on fresh radish and sprinkle it lightly with salt. The sharp bite of crisp radish paired with nutty butter and salt is quite the combination. Today, it's spread out on sourdough instead. About 140kcal, Scallion Radish Butter Sourdough.
쪽파-래디시-버터-사워도우-Scallion-Radish-Butter-So.ingredients: 1 slice sourdough, 2-3 chives, 2t butter, 1 radish, salt, pepper
쪽파-래디시-버터-사워도우-Scallion-Radish-Butter-So.steps:
1. Spread butter on the sourdough. (Let the butter and sourdough sit at room temperature before using.)
2. Chop the chives very, very finely and spread them on a wide plate. Press the buttered sourdough from step 1 face-down onto the chopped chives, pressing firmly so the chives stick all over with no gaps.
3. Place the sourdough on a plate and top with thinly sliced radish. Finish with a little Maldon salt and pepper.

스패니시-갈릭-수프-Spanish-Garlic-Soup-Sopa-de-A.title: Spanish Garlic Soup, Sopa de Ajo
스패니시-갈릭-수프-Spanish-Garlic-Soup-Sopa-de-A.intro:
20260501, #BreakfastDiary 1707, 18°C/clear
A garlic bomb to recover from a cold - Spanish-style garlic soup. Make it thick and it's good spooned over sourdough, too.
About 600kcal per serving, Spanish Garlic Soup, Sopa de Ajo.
스패니시-갈릭-수프-Spanish-Garlic-Soup-Sopa-de-A.ingredients: 20 cloves garlic, 5 slices sourdough, 1T paprika powder, salt, pepper, 1t chicken stock, 3 eggs, 1T chopped scallion
스패니시-갈릭-수프-Spanish-Garlic-Soup-Sopa-de-A.steps:
1. Thinly slice the garlic with a mandoline.
2. Cut the sourdough into bite-sized chunks, put in a pan, and toast lightly.
3. In a pot, heat plenty of olive oil, sauté the garlic from step 1, then add the paprika powder and sauté a bit more.
4. Add the sourdough from step 2 and sauté.
5. Pour in 600ml water, add 1t chicken stock, and bring to a boil. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
6. Add the 3 eggs, cover, and cook the eggs.
7. Once the eggs are cooked, top with chopped scallion.

완두콩-계란-토스트.title: Pea and Egg Toast
완두콩-계란-토스트.intro:
20260430, #BreakfastDiary 1706, 11°C/cloudy
06:51 to 07:20, 29 minutes total, 550kcal, Pea and Egg Toast.
완두콩-계란-토스트.ingredients: 1 slice sourdough, 1 cup peas, 1 egg, 1T ricotta cheese, 1T crunchy chili onion, 1T hemp seeds, salt, pepper, 2t everything bagel seasoning
완두콩-계란-토스트.steps:
06:51 - Boil the peas in boiling water. 1-2 minutes is enough.
06:54 - Brush the sourdough with olive oil and toast both sides until crisp.
07:04 - Cook 1 egg sunny-side up.
07:09 - Spread ricotta cheese on the sourdough.
07:12 - Top with the boiled peas and crunchy chili onion.
07:14 - Top with hemp seeds.
07:17 - Top with everything bagel seasoning.
07:19 - Cut in half.
07:20 - Eat happily.

뇨끼.title: Creamy Alfredo Garlic Spinach Gnocchi
뇨끼.intro:
20260429, #BreakfastDiary 1705, 7°C/mostly cloudy
My throat is scratchy. A thick, creamy white sauce would go down easy - alfredo sauce. But if I think about the calories, this is a dish I shouldn't be eating: Creamy Alfredo Garlic Spinach Gnocchi.
뇨끼.ingredients: 450g gnocchi, 3 cloves garlic, 1/2 onion, 1 cup heavy cream, 50g ricotta cheese, 1t paprika powder, 2t herb powder, 1 cup parmesan cheese, 2 cups spinach, salt, pepper
뇨끼.steps:
1. Bring water to a boil in a pot, add the gnocchi, and cook until the gnocchi float to the surface, then scoop them out. Transfer to a bowl and toss with a little olive oil so they don't stick together.
2. In a pan, heat olive oil and butter, and sauté the thinly sliced garlic and chopped onion.
3. Pour in the heavy cream, and once it comes to a light simmer, add the ricotta cheese and mix evenly.
4. Season with paprika powder, herb powder, salt, and pepper.
5. Add the parmesan cheese and stir slowly.
6. Add the chopped spinach and mix evenly.
7. Add the gnocchi from step 1 to the pan and toss lightly.
8. Plate it and sprinkle with parmesan cheese and a little pepper.

단호박-리코타치즈-샐러드.title: Sweet Pumpkin Ricotta Salad
단호박-리코타치즈-샐러드.ingredients: 300g sweet pumpkin (kabocha), 4 shiitake mushrooms, 1/4 onion, 1T yondu (soup soy sauce), ricotta cheese
단호박-리코타치즈-샐러드.steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté the shiitake mushrooms, sliced 1cm thick, seasoned with salt, pepper, and herbs.
2. Rinse the sweet pumpkin under running water and cut into bite-sized pieces, skin on.
3. Slice the onion thinly.
4. Put the shiitake mushrooms, pumpkin, and onion from steps 1-3 into a mixing bowl, add 1T yondu, cover with plastic wrap, and microwave for 7 minutes.
5. Let cool briefly, then lightly mash the pumpkin, add the ricotta cheese, and mix evenly.
6. Plate it and drizzle with a little olive oil~

버터향-가득-버섯과-감자-Buttered-Pan-Fried-Mushroo.title: Buttered Pan-Fried Mushroom and Potato
버터향-가득-버섯과-감자-Buttered-Pan-Fried-Mushroo.intro:
20260427, #BreakfastDiary 1703, 13°C/cloudy
I'm still not feeling back to normal, but I keep up the routine to get my daily life back on track. 250kcal per serving, Buttered Pan-Fried Mushroom and Potato.
버터향-가득-버섯과-감자-Buttered-Pan-Fried-Mushroo.ingredients: 4 red potatoes, 4 shiitake mushrooms, 2 eggs, salt, pepper, 10g butter, 1T hemp seeds, a little scallion
버터향-가득-버섯과-감자-Buttered-Pan-Fried-Mushroo.steps:
1. Wash the red potatoes clean, peel, and boil for 4-5 minutes.
2. Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté the prepped onion and shiitake mushrooms with a good pinch of salt and pepper. Add 5g butter and sauté a bit more.
3. Add the red potatoes from step 1 to the pan along with 5g butter and sauté.
4. Crack in 2 eggs, cover, and cook the eggs.
5. Top with a good pinch of pepper, hemp seeds, chopped scallion, and a little dill.

순두부-토마토탕.title: Soft Tofu Tomato Soup
순두부-토마토탕.intro:
20260426, #BreakfastDiary 1702, 26°C/mostly cloudy
Still feeling out of sorts, so once again I'm not living up to my name today - dinner instead, about 200kcal per serving, Soft Tofu Tomato Soup.
순두부-토마토탕.ingredients: 1 pack soft tofu, 2 tomatoes, 1/2 onion, a pinch of salt, 2T soy sauce, 1T vinegar, 1T yondu, 1T cornstarch slurry (1T water, 1t starch)
순두부-토마토탕.steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a pot and sauté the finely chopped onion, tomato, and a pinch of salt, then add 2t soy sauce and let it lightly infuse.
2. Add 900ml water, 1T vinegar, 1T yondu, and 1 pack soft tofu, and simmer briefly.
3. Turn off the heat, pour in the cornstarch slurry, and mix evenly. Plate it and top with chopped scallion and a good pinch of pepper.

들기름-메밀국수.title: Perilla Oil Buckwheat Noodles
들기름-메밀국수.intro:
20260425, #BreakfastDiary 1701, 15°C/clear
On top of my cold, the muscle soreness from last week's workout has amplified about tenfold. So this is how much it can hurt. Thanks to that, I skipped breakfast - dinner instead, about 700kcal, Perilla Oil Buckwheat Noodles.
들기름-메밀국수.ingredients: 1 serving buckwheat noodles, 1/2 cucumber, 1 egg, (dressing) 0.5T tsuyu, 0.5T soy sauce, 1t sugar, 2T perilla oil
들기름-메밀국수.steps:
1. Slice the cucumber thin, salt it well, let sit about 10 minutes, then squeeze out the moisture.
2. Boil 1 egg.
3. Boil the fresh buckwheat noodles in boiling water. Rinse in cold water, then put in a mixing bowl with 0.5T tsuyu, 0.5T soy sauce, and 1t sugar, and mix evenly.
4. Plate the buckwheat noodles, cucumber, and egg, and drizzle with perilla oil.

쑥연근전-Mugwort-Lotus-Root-Jeon.title: Mugwort Lotus Root Jeon
쑥연근전-Mugwort-Lotus-Root-Jeon.intro:
20260424, #BreakfastDiary 1700, 12°C/sunny
I ground it down until no trace remained, but the crunchy texture of the lotus root still comes through.
Venerable Sunjae's about 320kcal Mugwort Lotus Root Jeon.
쑥연근전-Mugwort-Lotus-Root-Jeon.ingredients: 40g mugwort, 300g lotus root, 1T starch, a pinch of salt, 1T ricotta cheese, 1/2 lemon
쑥연근전-Mugwort-Lotus-Root-Jeon.steps:
1. Trim off just the thick stems of the mugwort, rinse under running water, shake off the moisture, and cut into rough pieces.
2. Wash 300g lotus root clean under running water, peel, and grate finely.
3. In a mixing bowl, combine the mugwort from step 1 and grated lotus root from step 2 with 1T starch and a pinch of salt, and mix evenly.
4. Heat oil in a pan and fry the mugwort-lotus root batter from step 3 into pieces of your desired size.
5. Plate it and top with ricotta cheese and a slice of lemon.

쑥페스토에-버무린-리가토니.title: Rigatoni Tossed in Mugwort Pesto
쑥페스토에-버무린-리가토니.intro:
20260423, #BreakfastDiary 1699, 14°C/cloudy
According to old medical texts, young mugwort picked in the third lunar month (injin) can treat illness, but mugwort from the fourth month (bongho) is fit only for firewood - because by the fourth month the stems thicken and the toxicity increases. It's still the third lunar month, so I blanch the young mugwort (injin) briefly in boiling water to make a pesto.
About 600kcal, Rigatoni Tossed in Mugwort Pesto.
쑥페스토에-버무린-리가토니.ingredients: 2 cups rigatoni, 2T ricotta cheese, a pinch of red pepper flakes, (mugwort pesto) plenty of mugwort, 50g cashews, 2 cloves garlic, 50g parmesan cheese, a little salt and pepper, blended while pouring in 150ml olive oil, 1t lemon juice
쑥페스토에-버무린-리가토니.steps:
1. Trim off the thick stems of the mugwort and use only the leaves and tender stems. Salt the water, bring to a boil, blanch the mugwort for about 10 seconds, then plunge into cold water - the color turns vivid. Press out the water by hand.
2. In a food processor, combine the mugwort, 50g cashews, 2 cloves garlic, 50g parmesan cheese, and a little salt and pepper, blending while pouring in 150ml olive oil. Add 1t lemon juice.
3. Bring salted water to a boil in a pot and cook the rigatoni.
4. Put the rigatoni in a pan with the mugwort pesto from step 2 and a ladle of pasta water, and mantecare (emulsify) together.
5. Plate the rigatoni and top with ricotta cheese, olive oil, and red pepper flakes.

갈치-쑥국.title: Hairtail #MugwortSoup
갈치-쑥국.intro:
20260422, #BreakfastDiary 1698, 11°C/cloudy
Sneezing, a first wet dream, a first bout of flu, pain that suddenly arrives, the changes that happen in the body when we love someone, things like aging. To those of us accustomed to narratives of events, these records might feel a little unfamiliar and strange. But look a little closer, and what emerges isn't a narrative of events but a narrative of time. If we call the span from a person's birth to the moment they meet death 'life,' then isn't life, above all else, a story of the body? The first cry we ever let out, the first desire we ever felt, the moment aging begins, the last scenery we face before closing our eyes - all of it belongs to the body.
(Shin Yu-jin, A Man's Lifelong Record of His Body, Kept Since Age 12 [.txt])
So when was it, exactly, that my body came to know the taste of hairtail and the scent of mugwort? About 250kcal, Hairtail #MugwortSoup.
갈치-쑥국.ingredients: 150g mugwort, 1 anchovy stock packet, 1T miso, 1/4 radish, 4 pieces hairtail, 1T tuna extract, 1T perilla seed powder, a little cheongyang chili and red chili
갈치-쑥국.steps:
1. Pour 800ml water into a pot, dissolve in the anchovy stock and 1T miso, and make the broth.
2. Add the radish sliced into thin squares and boil until it's cooked to about al dente, then add the boneless hairtail, 1T tuna extract, red chili, and cheongyang chili, and boil a bit more. (Store-bought boneless hairtail - there's really not much to it, but still.)
3. Add the mugwort and perilla seed powder, boil for 1 minute, then turn off the heat. 1 minute is enough.
4. Plate it and eat with cold rice stirred in.

새우미역-미역.title: Shrimp Seaweed Soup
새우미역-미역.intro:
20260421, #BreakfastDiary 1697, 9°C/mostly sunny
I cooked a fresh batch of rice and added it in late, so the shrimp seaweed soup didn't have enough time to soak into the grains - a bit of a shame.
The band Pinocchio performs. #ShrimpSeaweed, somewhere between porridge and rice…
새우미역-미역.ingredients: 10g dried seaweed, 1T sesame oil, 1 packet seafood kelp stock, 1/2 bowl rice, 7 shrimp, 1T mirin, 1T tuna extract, (topping) 1T sesame oil, 1t sesame seeds
새우미역-미역.steps:
1. Soak the dried seaweed in water for 20-30 minutes.
2. In a pot, sauté the soaked seaweed from step 1 with sesame oil, then pour in 800ml water, add 1 packet seafood kelp stock and 1 bowl of rice, and bring to a boil.
3. Once the seaweed soup is boiling, add the 7 roughly chopped shrimp, 1T mirin, and 1T tuna extract, and boil a bit more.
4. Plate it and top with sesame oil and sesame seeds.

버섯볶음밥-Mushroom-Fried-Rice.title: Mushroom Fried Rice
버섯볶음밥-Mushroom-Fried-Rice.intro:
20260420, #BreakfastDiary 1696, 12°C/cloudy
Ground perilla seed powder oxidizes quickly, so it's best to grind only as much as you need each time.
About 500kcal per serving, #MushroomFriedRice Mushroom Fried Rice.
버섯볶음밥-Mushroom-Fried-Rice.ingredients: assorted mushrooms (today: shiitake, oyster, enoki), 1/2 bowl rice, 1T soy sauce, 1T oyster sauce, 5g butter, chopped scallion, 1T sesame oil, 2T perilla seed powder
버섯볶음밥-Mushroom-Fried-Rice.steps:
1. Slice the shiitake mushrooms lengthwise, pull the oyster mushrooms apart into individual pieces, and separate the enoki mushrooms strand by strand.
2. Heat olive oil in a pan, add the mushrooms from step 1, then add a good pinch of pepper, 1T soy sauce, and 1T oyster sauce, and sauté a bit more.
3. Add 1 bowl of rice and 5g butter and mix evenly. Press down firmly as if you're forming a crust of nurungji (crispy rice).
4. Turn off the heat, add the chopped scallion, 1T sesame oil, and a generous amount of perilla seed powder, and mix evenly.
5. Spread it out wide on the plate so the mushrooms are visible.

노슈가-노밀가루-포실포실-치즈케이크-오븐에-넣고-30분쯤-지난-뒤-원하는.title: No-Sugar, No-Flour Fluffy Cheesecake
노슈가-노밀가루-포실포실-치즈케이크-오븐에-넣고-30분쯤-지난-뒤-원하는.intro:
20260419, #BreakfastDiary 1695, 22°C/mostly cloudy
The original recipe calls for ricotta cheese and semolina, but I had no semolina and not quite enough ricotta either, so I added Greek yogurt and oatmeal instead. About 700kcal, No-Sugar, No-Flour Fluffy Cheesecake.
About 30 minutes into baking, once it reaches the color you want, it's best to loosely cover it with foil. If the coconut powder on top burns, it earns itself the modifier 'straight from hell.'
노슈가-노밀가루-포실포실-치즈케이크-오븐에-넣고-30분쯤-지난-뒤-원하는.ingredients: 150g ricotta cheese, 150g Greek yogurt, 2 eggs, 5T finely ground oatmeal, 3/4t baking powder, 1/4 cup raisins, (topping) 2T coconut powder
노슈가-노밀가루-포실포실-치즈케이크-오븐에-넣고-30분쯤-지난-뒤-원하는.steps:
1. In a mixing bowl, combine 150g ricotta cheese, 150g Greek yogurt, 2 eggs, 5T finely ground oatmeal, 3/4t baking powder, and 1/4 cup raisins, and mix evenly. Transfer to a baking dish and top with coconut powder.
2. Bake in a 180°C oven for 45 minutes.

토마토-참치-콘킬리에-파스타-Tomato-Tuna-Conchiglie-P.title: Tomato Tuna Conchiglie Pasta
토마토-참치-콘킬리에-파스타-Tomato-Tuna-Conchiglie-P.intro:
20260418, #BreakfastDiary 1694, 14°C/sunny
Conchiglie shells packed full of tomato, about 650kcal, Tomato Tuna Conchiglie Pasta.
토마토-참치-콘킬리에-파스타-Tomato-Tuna-Conchiglie-P.ingredients: 100g conchiglie, 2 cloves garlic, 1t anchovy paste, 1/2 onion, 150g tomato sauce, a little basil, 1 can tuna, a little parmesan cheese
토마토-참치-콘킬리에-파스타-Tomato-Tuna-Conchiglie-P.steps:
1. Boil the conchiglie in well-salted water.
2. Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté the minced garlic and 1t anchovy paste.
3. Add the chopped 1/2 onion and sauté.
4. Add the tomato sauce and a ladle of pasta water from step 1 to the pan and let it simmer.
5. Add the conchiglie to step 3 and toss lightly to mantecare. Once it reaches the consistency you want, turn off the heat, add the chopped basil, and mix evenly.
6. Plate the conchiglie and top with tuna, basil, and grated parmesan cheese.

콩비지샐러드-Soy-Bean-Pulp-Salad.title: Soybean Pulp Salad
콩비지샐러드-Soy-Bean-Pulp-Salad.intro:
20260415, #BreakfastDiary 1693, 14°C/sunny
I'll remember this.
580kcal, #SoybeanPulpSalad Soy Bean Pulp Salad.
콩비지샐러드-Soy-Bean-Pulp-Salad.ingredients: 300g soybean pulp (biji), 1T butter, 3T mayonnaise, 2T Greek yogurt, 1/2 cucumber, 1/2 apple, 1 tomato, 2 radishes, 10g cheddar cheese, salt, pepper
콩비지샐러드-Soy-Bean-Pulp-Salad.steps:
1. Cut the 1/2 cucumber, 1/2 apple, 1 tomato, and 10g cheddar cheese into bite-sized pieces, and slice the 2 radishes with a mandoline.
2. Microwave the soybean pulp for 2 minutes.
3. In a mixing bowl, combine the freshly warmed 300g soybean pulp with 1T butter and mix - the butter melts nicely. Add 3T mayonnaise and 2T Greek yogurt and mix. Add the ingredients prepped in step 1 and mix evenly. Season with salt and pepper.

토마토-바질-샌드위치-Tomato-Basil-Sandwich-2.title: Tomato Basil Sandwich
토마토-바질-샌드위치-Tomato-Basil-Sandwich-2.intro:
20260414, #BreakfastDiary 1692, 14°C/mostly sunny
Brand B's whole-wheat health soybean bread - it seems good for you and tastes good too, but when I made the sandwich and cut it in half, it crumbled to pieces. For tomato basil sandwiches, I think it's better to give up on health and use soft, chewy white milk bread instead.
450kcal, Tomato Basil Sandwich.
토마토-바질-샌드위치-Tomato-Basil-Sandwich-2.ingredients: 2 slices white bread, 2 tomatoes, a handful of basil, 2T mayonnaise, 1t balsamic vinegar, 1T hemp seeds, a good pinch of salt, a good pinch of pepper
토마토-바질-샌드위치-Tomato-Basil-Sandwich-2.steps:
1. Wash the 2 tomatoes under running water and cut into bite-sized pieces. Remove the seeds and pulp.
2. Chop a handful of basil.
3. In a mixing bowl, combine the tomato from step 1, basil from step 2, 2T mayonnaise, 1t balsamic vinegar, 1T hemp seeds, a good pinch of salt, and a good pinch of pepper, and mix evenly.
4. (Thinking of my health, instead of milk bread) top the fermented whole-wheat soybean bread with the tomato basil salad from step 2.

미나리.title: Minari (Water Parsley)
미나리.intro:
20260413, #BreakfastDiary 1691, 14°C/cloudy
I was going to make a tomato basil sandwich, but there's no bread. Even better.
About 240kcal to soothe an overheated stomach, Minari (Water Parsley) Tofu Miso Soup.
미나리.ingredients: minari (water parsley), a suitable amount, 1/2 bowl brown rice, 600ml water, 1 block tofu, 1t soup stock powder, 1T miso
미나리.steps:
1. Pour 600ml water into a pot, and once it boils, dissolve in 1t soup stock powder and 1T miso and stir.
2. Cut the tofu into 1cm dice and add it in.
3. Cut the minari stems, add them in, boil for 1 minute, and turn off the heat. (If you boil it too long, the minari's fragrance disappears.)
4. Plate it, add a good pinch of pepper, and eat with cold rice stirred in.

구남친토스트-라고-할까-Whole-Wheat-Toast-with-Blue.title: Should I Call It 'Old Flame Toast'? Whole Wheat Toast with Blueberry Compote
구남친토스트-라고-할까-Whole-Wheat-Toast-with-Blue.intro:
20260412, #BreakfastDiary 1690, 10°C/sunny
Whole wheat bread instead of white bread, stracciatella cheese instead of cream cheese, blueberry compote instead of blueberry jam - the deluxe version of the 'Ex-Boyfriend Toast' that makes even an ex-girlfriend who left come crawling back, about 580kcal. Should I call it 'Old Flame Toast'? Whole Wheat Toast with Blueberry Compote.
구남친토스트-라고-할까-Whole-Wheat-Toast-with-Blue.ingredients: 1 slice whole wheat bread, (blueberry compote) blueberries and xylose (sugar) at a 3:1 ratio, 1T lemon juice, (stracciatella cheese) 100g ricotta cheese, 60ml heavy cream, a pinch of salt
구남친토스트-라고-할까-Whole-Wheat-Toast-with-Blue.steps:
1. Make the blueberry compote before going to bed. Combine blueberries and xylose (sugar) at a 3:1 ratio and simmer over medium heat, then add 1T lemon juice and simmer over low heat until sticky. Let it cool as is until morning.
2. Brush the whole wheat bread with olive oil and toast both sides until crisp.
3. In a mixing bowl, combine 100g ricotta cheese, 60ml heavy cream, and a pinch of salt, and whip by hand to make the stracciatella cheese.
4. Top the whole wheat bread with the stracciatella cheese from step 4, then top with the blueberry compote from step 1.

아스파라거스-폴렌타-Polenta-with-Roasted-Asparagu.title: Polenta with Roasted Asparagus
아스파라거스-폴렌타-Polenta-with-Roasted-Asparagu.intro:
20260411, #BreakfastDiary 1689, 7°C/sunny
Polenta is a dish from northern Italy made from coarsely ground cornmeal. Boiled with water, it can be eaten light, almost like a porridge, which makes it a good breakfast.
Today I paired it with asparagus that still has some bite to it, and nutty, sweet peas - about 806kcal, #Polenta with Roasted Asparagus.
아스파라거스-폴렌타-Polenta-with-Roasted-Asparagu.ingredients: 1 cup polenta, 4 cups water, 5g butter, 10g pecorino cheese, 5 asparagus spears, 1 cup peas
아스파라거스-폴렌타-Polenta-with-Roasted-Asparagu.steps:
1. In a pan, combine 1 cup polenta, 4 cups water, and a good pinch of salt, and cook over low heat, stirring slowly. Add 5g butter and grated pecorino cheese.
2. Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté the trimmed asparagus and peas (blanched in boiling water) with a good pinch of salt and pepper.
3. In a mixing bowl, combine the asparagus and peas from step 2 with chopped basil and vinaigrette dressing, and mix evenly.
4. Plate the polenta from step 1, top with the asparagus and peas from step 3, then shave pecorino cheese over the top with a peeler.

원팬-uglyus-market-냉이-밥-One-pan-shepherd-s.title: One-Pan Shepherd's Purse Rice
원팬-uglyus-market-냉이-밥-One-pan-shepherd-s.intro:
20260410, #BreakfastDiary 1688, 9°C/cloudy
Before this season passes, I'm eating my fill of spring greens. Said to have been introduced by Lee Jung-hyun as a home-cooked dish, about 656kcal, One-Pan @uglyus.market #ShepherdsPurse Rice, One-pan shepherd's purse rice.
원팬-uglyus-market-냉이-밥-One-pan-shepherd-s.ingredients: 100g shepherd's purse, 2 cups rice, 1/2T miso, 1t soup stock powder, 5g butter
원팬-uglyus-market-냉이-밥-One-pan-shepherd-s.steps:
1. Soak 2 cups of rice in water. About 30 minutes is enough.
2. Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté 1/2 sliced onion.
3. Add the soaked rice from step 1 and stir well, pour in 2 cups water, add 1/2T miso and 1t soup stock powder, and cook over medium heat for 7 minutes until the water has mostly absorbed.
4. Add butter and stir well, top with the prepped shepherd's purse, cook over low heat for 3 minutes, then turn off the heat and let it steam for 5 minutes.

유채나물무침을-곁들인-간장메밀면.title: Soy Sauce Buckwheat Noodles with Seasoned Rapeseed Greens
유채나물무침을-곁들인-간장메밀면.intro:
20260409, #BreakfastDiary 1687, 10°C/rain
Rapeseed flower field
Just seeing the yellow blossoms
brought tears to my eyes
(Na Tae-ju, Rapeseed Flower Field)
Rapeseed greens are the young leaves of the rapeseed plant, eaten as a spring vegetable.
Starting the day thinking about what my own beginning was like, about 420kcal, Soy Sauce Buckwheat Noodles with Seasoned Rapeseed Greens.
유채나물무침을-곁들인-간장메밀면.ingredients: (seasoned rapeseed greens) rapeseed greens, 1T soy sauce, 1T anchovy fish sauce, 1T vinegar, 1t minced garlic, 1T red pepper flakes, 2T plum extract, 1T perilla oil, (soy sauce buckwheat noodles) 1 serving buckwheat noodles, 2T soy sauce, 2T perilla oil, 1/2T allulose, 1T seasoned laver flakes
유채나물무침을-곁들인-간장메밀면.steps:
1. Rinse the rapeseed greens under running water and trim off any tough stems. Cut into bite-sized pieces, then put in a mixing bowl with 1T soy sauce, 1T anchovy fish sauce, 1T vinegar, 1t minced garlic, 1T red pepper flakes, 2T plum extract, and 1T perilla oil, and toss to season well.
2. Cook the buckwheat noodles in boiling water, adding splashes of cold water as you go. Rinse in cold water to cool.
3. In a mixing bowl, combine the buckwheat noodles from step 2 with 2T soy sauce, 2T perilla oil, 1/2T allulose, and 1T seasoned laver flakes, and mix evenly.
4. Plate the rapeseed greens from step 1 and the buckwheat noodles from step 3, and drizzle with a little perilla oil.

콩샐러드.title: Bean Salad
콩샐러드.intro:
20260408, #BreakfastDiary 1686, 9°C/cloudy (rain in the forecast)
I meant to put Greek yogurt on the plate and pile the bean salad on top, but somewhere during the cooking it slipped my mind entirely.
About 500kcal per serving, #BeanSalad.
콩샐러드.ingredients: 3 cups assorted beans, 1 radish, 1 ear of corn, a little cilantro, lemon salt vinaigrette (2T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t wholegrain mustard, 1t lemon salt)
콩샐러드.steps:
1. Soak most of the beans in water the night before.
2. Boil the soaked beans, edamame, and peas in well-salted water.
3. Slice the radish and corn, and pick the cilantro leaves to prep.
4. In a mixing bowl, combine the beans, radish, corn, and cilantro from step 2 with the lemon salt vinaigrette, and mix evenly.

초록초록-콩과-분홍분홍-래디시를-곁들인-폴렌타-Creamy-Polenta.title: Creamy Polenta with Buttered Spring Vegetables
초록초록-콩과-분홍분홍-래디시를-곁들인-폴렌타-Creamy-Polenta.intro:
20260407, #BreakfastDiary 1685, 5°C/sunny
About 650kcal, Polenta with Green-Green Beans and Pink-Pink Radish, Creamy Polenta with Buttered Spring Vegetables.
초록초록-콩과-분홍분홍-래디시를-곁들인-폴렌타-Creamy-Polenta.ingredients: 1 cup polenta, 20g butter, pecorino romano cheese, 20g butter, 1/2 onion, 5 radishes, 1 cup each edamame and peas
초록초록-콩과-분홍분홍-래디시를-곁들인-폴렌타-Creamy-Polenta.steps:
1. In a pot, combine 4 cups water, 1 cup polenta, and a pinch of salt, and simmer, stirring occasionally. Add 10g butter and grated pecorino romano cheese and mix evenly to finish.
2. In a pan, melt 10g butter and sauté the chopped onion, then sauté the roughly chopped radishes. Add the edamame and peas and sauté a bit more.
3. Plate the polenta from step 1, top with the radishes, edamame, and peas from step 2, and finish with grated pecorino romano cheese.

아스파라거스-라자냐.title: Asparagus Lasagna
아스파라거스-라자냐.intro:
20260406, #BreakfastDiary 1684, 10°C/cloudy
About 650kcal, calling in summer, Asparagus Lasagna.
The original recipe uses stracciatella cheese instead of ricotta (that creamy stuff you find inside burrata). To get a similar texture, mix ricotta with heavy cream and salt, or if that's not on hand, add a little lemon juice and whip it.
아스파라거스-라자냐.ingredients: 2 sheets lasagna, 3T ricotta cheese, 5 asparagus spears, 1 cup peas, a little basil, parmesan cheese, 1/2 lemon (for zest and juice)
아스파라거스-라자냐.steps:
1. Boil the lasagna sheets in well-salted water.
2. Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté the trimmed asparagus and peas, then add a good pinch of salt and pepper and 20g butter to build up the flavor.
3. On a plate, layer a lasagna sheet, ricotta cheese, olive oil and pepper, the asparagus and peas from step 2, chopped basil, and parmesan cheese. Stack it up this way as many layers as you like.
4. Cover with a lasagna sheet, then top with the asparagus and peas from step 2, parmesan cheese, lemon zest, and a little lemon juice.

단호박-팍시.title: Sweet Pumpkin Farci
단호박-팍시.intro:
20260405, #BreakfastDiary 1683, 9°C/sunny
Flowers are blooming everywhere I look. About 570kcal, Sweet Pumpkin Farci.
단호박-팍시.ingredients: 2T each brown rice, beans, and quinoa, 1/2 sweet pumpkin, 1T Greek yogurt, chopped parsley and salt, pepper
단호박-팍시.steps:
1. Boil 2T each of brown rice, beans, and quinoa in water. Add a little salt too.
2. Cut the sweet pumpkin in half, peel it, scoop out the seeds, steam it, then sear the cut side in a pan.
3. In a mixing bowl, combine the brown rice, beans, and quinoa from step 1 with vinaigrette dressing (3T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t wholegrain mustard) and mix evenly. Since it will be eaten with the pumpkin, season it slightly on the salty side.
4. Place the pumpkin from step 2 on a plate, fill it with the mixture from step 3, then sprinkle with Greek yogurt, chopped parsley, and pepper.

오야코동-親子丼.title: Oyakodon (親子丼)
오야코동-親子丼.intro:
20260404, #BreakfastDiary 1682, 12°C/partly cloudy
Made with chicken and egg, and so named for parent (親) and child (子) - about 445kcal per serving, Oyakodon (親子丼).
오야코동-親子丼.ingredients: 200g chicken, 2 eggs, 1 small onion, (sauce) 2T soy sauce, 2T mirin, 1T sugar, 2t hondashi
오야코동-親子丼.steps:
1. Make the sauce. Combine 2T soy sauce, 2T mirin, 1T sugar, and 2t hondashi and mix evenly.
2. Pat the chicken dry with a paper towel, then heat oil in a pan and cook both sides.
3. Once the chicken turns golden, push it to one side, add the thinly sliced onion and sauté, then pour in the sauce from step 1 and mix evenly.
4. Turn the heat down low, then pour in the beaten eggs.
5. Serve over rice. Some chopped scallion would be nice, but I'm skipping it today~

콘킬리에-샐러드.title: Conchiglie Salad
콘킬리에-샐러드.intro:
20260403, #BreakfastDiary 1681, 9°C/cloudy
Conchiglie, meaning 'seashell,' seemed like it would pair well with whelk. It's usually served with cream sauce, but cooked this way and rinsed in cold water, it's also good eaten like a salad. Conchiglie holding a pea in its shell is just lovely.
Let's not be fooled by the calorie count. 820kcal per serving, Conchiglie Salad.
콘킬리에-샐러드.ingredients: 2 cups conchiglie, 1 can whelk (300g), 3 shiitake mushrooms, 1/2 zucchini, 1 cup peas, vinaigrette dressing (3T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t wholegrain mustard), a little parmesan cheese
콘킬리에-샐러드.steps:
1. Boil the conchiglie thoroughly in well-salted water. Rinse in cold water and drizzle with olive oil.
2. Blanch the whelk and boil the peas in boiling water.
3. Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté the thinly sliced shiitake mushrooms and zucchini with a good pinch of salt and pepper.
4. In a mixing bowl, combine the conchiglie from step 1, the whelk and peas from step 2, and the shiitake mushrooms and zucchini from step 3, pour in the vinaigrette dressing (3T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t wholegrain mustard), and mix evenly.
5. Plate it and top with a little parmesan cheese.

치쿠와-나루토마끼-샐러드-Japanese-fish-cake-chikuwa.title: Japanese Fish Cake (Chikuwa and Narutomaki) Salad
치쿠와-나루토마끼-샐러드-Japanese-fish-cake-chikuwa.intro:
20260402, #BreakfastDiary 1680, 7°C/sunny
Naruto (鳴門) refers to the massive whirlpool that forms in the Naruto Strait off the coast of Tokushima Prefecture in Japan. That, apparently, is how it lent its name to narutomaki, the fish cake with the swirl pattern.
Narutomaki is in it, but no whirlpool in sight - about 450kcal, Japanese Fish Cake (Chikuwa and Narutomaki) Salad.
치쿠와-나루토마끼-샐러드-Japanese-fish-cake-chikuwa.ingredients: 3 chikuwa, 1/2 narutomaki, 1T hemp seeds, 2T mayonnaise, 1T tsuyu, 2T tenkasu, a little basil powder
치쿠와-나루토마끼-샐러드-Japanese-fish-cake-chikuwa.steps:
1. Briefly blanch the chikuwa and narutomaki in boiling water, then shake off the moisture.
2. In a mixing bowl, combine the chikuwa (cut into long strips), narutomaki, and hemp seeds with 2T mayonnaise and 1T tsuyu, and mix evenly.
3. Add 2T tenkasu and a little basil powder, mix a bit more, then plate it.

날아갈-듯-가벼운-토마토-두부-베지볼-Tomato-Tofu-Vegie-B.title: Featherlight Tomato Tofu Veggie Ball
날아갈-듯-가벼운-토마토-두부-베지볼-Tomato-Tofu-Vegie-B.intro:
