20260401, #BreakfastDiary 1679, 11°C/cloudy
Spring feels like it's arrived all at once.
About 200kcal per serving, Featherlight Tomato Tofu Veggie Ball, Tomato Tofu Vegie Ball.
날아갈-듯-가벼운-토마토-두부-베지볼-Tomato-Tofu-Vegie-B.ingredients: 1 block tofu, 2T oatmeal, 5T hemp seeds, a pinch of salt and parsley, 1/4t minced garlic, (tomato sauce) 1 can whole peeled tomatoes, salt, pepper, a little olive oil
날아갈-듯-가벼운-토마토-두부-베지볼-Tomato-Tofu-Vegie-B.steps:
1. Microwave the tofu for 2 minutes and press out the moisture.
2. In a food processor, combine the tofu from step 1, 2T oatmeal, 5T hemp seeds, a pinch of salt and parsley, and 1/4t minced garlic, mix evenly, then shape into balls. Let rest for at least 15 minutes. (I was short on time today, so I seared them with a torch and microwaved off the moisture instead - don't recommend it.)
3. In a pan, sauté minced garlic in olive oil with a can of whole peeled tomatoes, then add a reasonable amount of salt, pepper, and herbs, and simmer gently to make the tomato sauce.
4. Add the veggie balls from step 2 and simmer over medium heat for about 10 minutes.
5. Plate it and sprinkle with a little parsley.

비비오틱-이다.title: It's #BibiBiotic
비비오틱-이다.intro:
20260331, #BreakfastDiary 1678, 11°C/partly cloudy
A big sweet pumpkin I bought a week ago had been on my mind the whole time. While thinking about how best to eat it, I remembered a braised pumpkin with red beans from a macrobiotic recipe I'd seen. But I had no red beans, so instead I used Bibibig - the popsicle I'd seen somewhere advertised as containing a whopping 35% red beans. A dessert of braised pumpkin with red beans, 210kcal. It's #BibiBiotic.
👆Macrobiotic is a compound of the Greek 'macro,' meaning 'large,' and 'biotic,' meaning 'life' - it refers to a nature-friendly way of eating for health and longevity.
비비오틱-이다.ingredients: 400g sweet pumpkin, 1 Bibibig popsicle, 2T Greek yogurt, 1T mixed nuts, 1/2t ginger, 1/2t soy sauce
비비오틱-이다.steps:
1. Cut off the pumpkin skin, chop into bite-sized pieces, cover with plastic wrap, and microwave for 3 minutes.
2. Pour 50ml water into a pan, add 1/2t minced ginger and 1/2t soy sauce, mix evenly, then add the pumpkin from step 1 and 1 Bibibig popsicle, and braise for about 5 minutes.
3. Once the liquid has reduced down, add the mixed nuts and mix evenly.
4. Plate it and top with a little honey and 1T Greek yogurt.

주키니-오픈-토스트-Rye-Toast-with-jammy-courgett.title: Rye Toast with Jammy Courgettes and Ricotta
주키니-오픈-토스트-Rye-Toast-with-jammy-courgett.intro:
20260330, #BreakfastDiary 1677, 9°C/cloudy
Zucchini or courgette slow-cooked over low heat until the moisture evaporates and the sweetness concentrates like jam is called 'Jammy Courgettes.' (Courgette is the British word for zucchini.)
About 320kcal, Zucchini Open-Faced Toast, Rye Toast with Jammy Courgettes and Ricotta.
주키니-오픈-토스트-Rye-Toast-with-jammy-courgett.ingredients: 1 slice rye whole wheat bread, 1/2 zucchini, 5 cloves garlic, 1T ricotta cheese, red chili flakes, olive oil, salt, pepper
주키니-오픈-토스트-Rye-Toast-with-jammy-courgett.steps:
1. Brush the rye whole wheat bread with olive oil and toast until crisp.
2. Slice the zucchini into thin rounds.
3. Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté the minced garlic, then add the zucchini from step 1 with a good pinch of salt and pepper, and cook slowly over low heat.
4. Top the toasted rye whole wheat bread with ricotta cheese, then the zucchini from step 3.
5. Top with a little red chili flakes.

봄동-사과-샌드위치-Spring-Cabbage-Apple-Rye-Sand.title: Spring Cabbage Apple Rye Sandwich
봄동-사과-샌드위치-Spring-Cabbage-Apple-Rye-Sand.intro:
20260327, #BreakfastDiary 1676, 5°C/partly cloudy
This year's first ingredient for the Endless Paradise Project is spring cabbage. Its subtle bitterness and natural sweetness, piled on crisp rye whole wheat bread, balance beautifully with the nutty sauce, and the bright tartness of the apple lingers after. This spring, too, will be gone before long.
The final dish of Endless Spring Cabbage Paradise, about 417kcal, Spring Cabbage Apple Rye Sandwich.
봄동-사과-샌드위치-Spring-Cabbage-Apple-Rye-Sand.ingredients: 2 slices rye whole wheat bread, 1 apple, (spring cabbage salad) 1T mayonnaise, 1T olive oil, 1t white wine vinegar, 1t wholegrain mustard, parmesan cheese and pepper
봄동-사과-샌드위치-Spring-Cabbage-Apple-Rye-Sand.steps:
1. Brush the rye whole wheat bread with olive oil and toast until crisp.
2. In a mixing bowl, combine chopped spring cabbage, 1T mayonnaise, 1t wholegrain mustard, and a little parmesan cheese and pepper, and mix evenly. (I was supposed to add well-drained tuna, but I forgot.)
3. On a plate, layer the crisply toasted rye whole wheat bread, thinly sliced apple, and the spring cabbage salad from step 2, then cover with another slice of rye whole wheat bread.

봄동-들기름-막국수-Spring-Cabbage-Perilla-Oil-Ma.title: Spring Cabbage Perilla Oil Makguksu
봄동-들기름-막국수-Spring-Cabbage-Perilla-Oil-Ma.intro:
20260326, #BreakfastDiary 1675, 7°C/mostly sunny
This year's first ingredient for the Endless Paradise Project is spring cabbage. Its crisp, fresh texture meets the sweet-tart juice of plum extract to deliver a freshness like a spring breeze.
About 800kcal, Spring Cabbage Perilla Oil Makguksu.
봄동-들기름-막국수-Spring-Cabbage-Perilla-Oil-Ma.ingredients: 1 serving buckwheat noodles (100g), 2T seasoned laver flakes, (spring cabbage seasoning) 1T tsuyu, 1T anchovy fish sauce, 1t allulose, 1t minced garlic, 2T plum extract, (buckwheat dressing) 2T tsuyu, 1t allulose, 2T perilla oil
봄동-들기름-막국수-Spring-Cabbage-Perilla-Oil-Ma.steps:
1. Cut the spring cabbage into bite-sized pieces, put in a mixing bowl, and toss with 1T dark soy sauce, 1T anchovy fish sauce, 1t allulose, 1t minced garlic, and 2T plum extract.
2. Boil the buckwheat noodles, rinse in cold water, then toss with 2T dark soy sauce, 1T allulose, and 2T perilla oil.
3. Plate the buckwheat noodles from step 2, the seasoned spring cabbage, and top with the seasoned laver flakes.

봄동-콘킬리에-파스타.title: Spring Cabbage Conchiglie Pasta
봄동-콘킬리에-파스타.intro:
20260325, #BreakfastDiary 1674, 6°C/mostly cloudy
This year's first ingredient for the Infinite Paradise Project is spring cabbage. Added to pasta, it softly rounds out the flavor. Against the rich taste of garlic, olive oil, and baby octopus, the faintly sweet, fresh grassy aroma and crisp texture of spring cabbage bring a small, quiet joy.
About 600kcal, Spring Cabbage Conchiglie Pasta.
봄동-콘킬리에-파스타.ingredients: A little conchiglie, 3 cloves garlic, a little parsley, 7 baby octopus, parmesan cheese, salt, pepper, a little crushed red pepper flakes
봄동-콘킬리에-파스타.steps:
1. Boil the shell-shaped conchiglie in salted water.
2. Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté thinly sliced garlic and parsley stems. Once the garlic is cooked, remove the parsley stems.
3. Add the cleaned baby octopus to the pan and blanch briefly. (It should only be blanched for about 1 minute over high heat - I blanched it too long and ruined it.)
4. Add the spring cabbage and blanch lightly, then add the conchiglie from step 1 along with some pasta water and mix.
5. Season with parmesan cheese, pepper, and salt.
6. Plate and top with parsley and a little crushed red pepper flakes.

시저샐러드.title: Caesar Salad
시저샐러드.intro:
20260324, #BreakfastDiary 1673, 6°C/mostly cloudy
This year's first ingredient for the Infinite Paradise Project is spring cabbage. In 1924, at Caesar's Place restaurant in Tijuana, Mexico, owner-chef Caesar Cardini found himself short on ingredients and, in a pinch, threw together a salad on the spot from whatever was left - romaine, bread, and so on. It became an unprecedented hit, and that's supposedly how today's #CaesarSalad came to be. Today, made with spring cabbage instead of romaine, 450kcal Caesar Salad.
시저샐러드.ingredients: 10 spring cabbage leaves, a piece of baguette, a little parmesan cheese and pink peppercorn, (dressing) 2T mayonnaise, 1T lemon juice, 1T whole grain mustard, 1T honey
시저샐러드.steps:
1. Let's make croutons. Tear the baguette into rough chunks and toast in a pan until extra crispy.
2. Mix 2T mayonnaise, 1T lemon juice, and 1T whole grain mustard to make a lemon mayonnaise. Today I added 1T honey to make it a bit sweeter.
3. Pull the leaves off the spring cabbage, cut into bite-sized pieces, and pile onto a plate. Top with the lemon mayonnaise and baguette croutons from above, then parmesan cheese. Crush a little pink peppercorn over the top.

향긋하고-아삭한-봄동이-씹히는-오니기리-Spring-Cabbage-Oni.title: Spring Cabbage Onigiri
향긋하고-아삭한-봄동이-씹히는-오니기리-Spring-Cabbage-Oni.intro:
20260323, #BreakfastDiary 1672, 5°C/sunny
This year's first ingredient for the Infinite Paradise Project is spring cabbage. Having endured the harsh Korean winter and pushed up through the frozen earth to finally show its face above ground, spring cabbage holds within it, in concentrated form, all the time it took to survive and the sheer force of the season. We tend to put that force into numbers instead: 'Spring cabbage has 6 times the beta-carotene and 2.5 times the vitamin C of regular napa cabbage.'
About 435kcal, fragrant, crunchy Spring Cabbage Onigiri.
향긋하고-아삭한-봄동이-씹히는-오니기리-Spring-Cabbage-Oni.ingredients: 3 spring cabbage leaves, 250g brown rice, 1T dried baby shrimp, 1T tenkasu (tempura scraps), 1T furikake, 1t shio kombu, 1t sesame oil
향긋하고-아삭한-봄동이-씹히는-오니기리-Spring-Cabbage-Oni.steps:
1. Pull the leaves off the spring cabbage and blanch in boiling water for 10 seconds. Squeeze out the excess water and chop finely with a knife.
2. In a mixing bowl, combine 250g rice, 1T dried baby shrimp, 1T tenkasu, 1T furikake, 1t shio kombu, 1t sesame oil, and the spring cabbage from step 1. Mix well, then press into a mold to shape the onigiri.

밤.title: Chestnuts
밤.intro:
20260322, #BreakfastDiary 1671, -1°C/clear
The chestnuts my mother gave me had been sitting in a corner of the freezer for a long time. I thought a chestnut paste would go well with the baguette I bought yesterday, so I cut back on the sugar and added hemp seeds to make it a little healthier. Butter Chestnut Paste Baguette.
밤.ingredients: One 20cm piece of baguette, 20g butter, a handful of toasted walnuts, (chestnut paste) 600g chestnuts, 300ml water, 200g xylose sugar, 1T honey, 2T hemp seeds (optional)
밤.steps:
1. Let's start with the chestnut paste. Pour water into a pot, add 610g peeled chestnuts, and cook. Let cool slightly.
2. In a food processor, combine the chestnuts from step 1, 300ml water, 200g xylose sugar, and 1T honey, and blend until smooth.
3. Pour the chestnut puree from step 2 into a pot and cook over low heat, stirring.
4. Once it reaches the texture you want, pass it through a sieve, pressing with a spatula. Mix in the hemp seeds. The smooth chestnut paste is done.
5. Microwave the baguette along with a small bowl of water for 10 seconds, twice.
6. Split the baguette in half. Spread butter on one side and chestnut paste on the other. Lightly toast the walnuts in a pan and top with them.

봄동-쏨땀-Spring-Cabbage-Som-Tam.title: Spring Cabbage Som Tam
봄동-쏨땀-Spring-Cabbage-Som-Tam.intro:
20260321, #BreakfastDiary 1670, -1°C/clear
Spring cabbage is in season. Actually, no - yesterday was the spring equinox, so technically it's just past its peak.
A global event meant I had to go into the office, so it was a hurried, busy morning - I tossed spring cabbage with som tam dressing, gave it a quick mix, and wolfed it down standing up. About 250kcal, Spring Cabbage Som Tam.
봄동-쏨땀-Spring-Cabbage-Som-Tam.ingredients: Spring cabbage, carrot, and cherry tomatoes to taste, 1/2 lemon, a little cilantro, 1t crushed red pepper flakes, 1 clove garlic (minced), 1T dried shrimp, (dressing) 1T tamarind sauce, 1T fish sauce, 1t coconut sugar
봄동-쏨땀-Spring-Cabbage-Som-Tam.steps:
1. Mix 1T tamarind sauce, 1T fish sauce, and 1t coconut sugar to make the dressing.
2. In a mixing bowl, combine 1t crushed red pepper flakes, 1 clove minced garlic, 1T ground dried shrimp, and lemon cut into small pieces, and mash together.
3. Add the spring cabbage and carrot cut into long strips and the cherry tomatoes cut in half to the bowl, pour in the dressing from step 1, and mix well.
5. Plate and top with cilantro.

참나물-페스토-오르조.title: Chamnamul Pesto Orzo
참나물-페스토-오르조.intro:
20260320, #BreakfastDiary 1669, 2°C/sunny
I made chamnamul tofu chutney yesterday, and used the leftover chamnamul to make a pesto. Serves 1, about 650kcal, Chamnamul Pesto Orzo.
참나물-페스토-오르조.ingredients: 2 cups orzo, (chamnamul pesto) 50g chamnamul, 20g walnuts, 1 clove garlic, a pinch of salt and pepper, 20g parmesan cheese and 1/3 cup olive oil
참나물-페스토-오르조.steps:
1. Wash the chamnamul thoroughly, drain, and prepare mostly the leaves. Lightly toast the walnuts in a pan over low heat to bring out more nutty flavor.
2. In a blender, combine 50g chamnamul, 20g walnuts, 1 clove garlic, a pinch of salt and pepper, 20g parmesan cheese, and about 1/3 cup olive oil, and blend until smooth. Adjust the consistency with more olive oil.
3. Cook the orzo in salted boiling water.
4. Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté thinly sliced garlic, then lower the heat, add the chamnamul pesto, the orzo from step 3, and a ladle of pasta water, and cook a little longer, stirring. (Adjust the consistency with pasta water.)
5. Plate and top with parmesan cheese and a little chamnamul.

사워도우.title: Sourdough
사워도우.ingredients:
1 sourdough loaf, (chamnamul chutney) 1 block tofu, 1/3 bunch chamnamul (mostly leaves), 2T olive oil, 1T whole grain mustard, 1T oligosaccharide syrup, 1t lemon salt (or regular salt), 1 lemon (juice of 1 lemon, zest of 1/2 lemon)
👆Adjust the amount of each ingredient by adding a little at a time.
사워도우.steps:
1. Wrap the tofu in paper towels, weigh it down with a steak press, and drain overnight.
2. Finely chop the chamnamul.
3. In a blender, combine the tofu from step 1, the chamnamul from step 2, 2T olive oil, 1T whole grain mustard, 1T oligosaccharide syrup, 1t lemon salt (or regular salt), and 2T lemon juice, and blend until smooth.
4. Plate and top with lemon zest.

망고-쉬림프-샐러드를-얹은-타코-보트-Mango-Shrimp-Taco-B.title: Mango Shrimp Taco Boat
망고-쉬림프-샐러드를-얹은-타코-보트-Mango-Shrimp-Taco-B.intro:
20260318, #BreakfastDiary 1667, 4°C/drizzle
The product I used for today's breakfast is technically a Taco Tub, but I've decided to think of it as a Taco Boat. About 777kcal, Mango Shrimp Taco Boat.
망고-쉬림프-샐러드를-얹은-타코-보트-Mango-Shrimp-Taco-B.ingredients: 4 taco tubs (shells), 7 shrimp, 1 apple mango, 1 avocado, a handful of cilantro, 1T hemp seeds, 1T olive oil, 1T lime juice
망고-쉬림프-샐러드를-얹은-타코-보트-Mango-Shrimp-Taco-B.steps:
1. Pat the shrimp dry, then heat olive oil in a pan and sauté with salt, salt, pepper, pepper, paprika, paprika.
2. Cut the apple mango in half, score it, and cut into pieces. (I was short, so I added a little frozen apple mango.) Cut the avocado into the same size.
3. In a mixing bowl, combine the apple mango and avocado from step 2, a handful of cilantro, 1T hemp seeds, 1T olive oil, and 1T lime juice, and mix well. Add the shrimp from step 1 and mix.
4. Spoon the mango shrimp salad from step 3 into the taco tubs, then finish with pepper, pepper.

달래-들기름-카펠리니.title: Wild Chive Perilla Oil Capellini
달래-들기름-카펠리니.intro:
20260317, #BreakfastDiary 1666, 2°C/mostly sunny
Wild chives - I make this once or twice every year around this time. Today I tossed them in perilla oil, over capellini.
350kcal, Wild Chive Perilla Oil Capellini.
달래-들기름-카펠리니.ingredients: 1 serving capellini, a handful of wild chives, 2T soy sauce, 3T perilla oil, 1T plum extract, 1T whole sesame seeds, 1 clove garlic
달래-들기름-카펠리니.steps:
1. Cut the wild chives into 3cm pieces, then mix with 2T soy sauce, 3T perilla oil, 1T plum extract, minced garlic, and 1T ground sesame seeds.
2. Boil the capellini in salted water. Rinse several times in cold water, then toss with a little perilla oil.
3. Plate the capellini and top with the wild chives from step 1.

구운-연어-아보카도-사워도우-타르틴-Smash-Grilled-Salmon.title: Smash-Grilled Salmon Avocado Sourdough Tartine
구운-연어-아보카도-사워도우-타르틴-Smash-Grilled-Salmon.intro:
20260316, #BreakfastDiary 1665, 1°C/clear
For the little bit of leftover salmon and avocado, about 600kcal, Smash-Grilled Salmon Avocado Sourdough Tartine.
구운-연어-아보카도-사워도우-타르틴-Smash-Grilled-Salmon.ingredients: 1 slice sourdough, 100g salmon, 1 avocado, a little chopped scallion and parmesan cheese, 2T everything bagel sesame seasoning, a little olive oil
구운-연어-아보카도-사워도우-타르틴-Smash-Grilled-Salmon.steps:
1. Brush the sourdough with olive oil and toast both sides until crispy.
2. (The leftover salmon is a bit short, but there's no helping it.) Heat olive oil in a pan, sprinkle the salmon generously with everything bagel sesame seasoning, and sear both sides. Mash with a fork.
3. Cut the avocado in half, peel, then place on the sourdough from step 1, mash with a fork, and top with the salmon from step 2, parmesan cheese, and chopped scallion.

시오콤부-시금치-파스타-Shio-Kombu-Spinach-Pasta.title: Shio Kombu Spinach Pasta
시오콤부-시금치-파스타-Shio-Kombu-Spinach-Pasta.intro:
20260315, #BreakfastDiary 1664, 4°C/cloudy
Made in one pan, about 350kcal, Shio Kombu Spinach Pasta.
시오콤부-시금치-파스타-Shio-Kombu-Spinach-Pasta.ingredients: 1 serving pasta, 1t chicken stock, 10g shio kombu, 4-5 stalks spinach, 1 clove garlic, pepper, parmesan cheese, crushed red pepper flakes
시오콤부-시금치-파스타-Shio-Kombu-Spinach-Pasta.steps:
1. In a pan, bring 600ml water, 1t chicken stock, and 10g shio kombu to a boil.
2. Once boiling, add the pasta and cook thoroughly for about 10 minutes.
3. Lower the heat, then mix in the trimmed spinach, 1t minced garlic, and pepper, pepper.
4. Plate the pasta and sprinkle with parmesan cheese and crushed red pepper flakes.

시오콘부-오니기리.title: Shio Kombu Onigiri
시오콘부-오니기리.intro:
20260314, #BreakfastDiary 1663, 2°C/sunny
Shio kombu (塩昆布) is made by simmering kelp (kombu) in salt (shio), or soy sauce and sugar, then salting and drying it. Thanks to its abundant glutamic acid, it's packed with umami. About 439kcal, Shio Kombu Onigiri.
시오콘부-오니기리.ingredients: 250g rice, 10g shio kombu, 2T chopped scallion, a handful of bonito flakes, 1T sesame seeds, 2t sesame oil
시오콘부-오니기리.steps: 1. In a mixing bowl, combine 250g rice, 10g shio kombu, 2T chopped scallion, a handful of bonito flakes, 1T sesame seeds, and 2t sesame oil. Mix well, then press into a mold to shape the onigiri.

레몬-리코타-마팔디네-Lemon-Riccotta-Mafaldine.title: Lemon Ricotta Mafaldine
레몬-리코타-마팔디네-Lemon-Riccotta-Mafaldine.intro:
20260313, #BreakfastDiary 1662, 2°C/sunny
Apparently there are even developers who hand everything over to Claude these days and haven't written a single line of code themselves in months. They say it's gotten to the point where people talk about "B.C." - meaning "Before Claude."
As Fujiwara Hiroshi put it, food has a 58,000 percent chance of becoming the last analog thing left to humanity.
What gave me today's unmistakably analog experience: about 620kcal, Lemon Ricotta Mafaldine.
레몬-리코타-마팔디네-Lemon-Riccotta-Mafaldine.ingredients: 1 serving mafaldine, parmesan cheese, a little pink peppercorn, (cream) 3T ricotta cheese, zest and juice of 1/2 lemon, 2T olive oil and 2t Maldon salt
레몬-리코타-마팔디네-Lemon-Riccotta-Mafaldine.steps:
1. Boil the mafaldine thoroughly in salted water.
2. In a mixing bowl, combine 3T ricotta cheese, the zest and juice of 1/2 a lemon, 2T olive oil, and 2t Maldon salt, and mix well.
3. Add the mafaldine from step 1 to the mixing bowl and toss.
4. Plate the mafaldine and top with olive oil, parmesan cheese, pink peppercorn, and lemon zest.

금귤.title: Kumquats
금귤.intro:
20260312, #BreakfastDiary 1661, 1°C/mostly sunny
'You could tell what work the season had done, and what share time had taken on.' I love this line from 'Ipdong' (The Onset of Winter), in Kim Ae-ran's short story collection Outside Is Summer. Even now, I find myself quoting this line whenever I get the chance, bringing it up in my writing and in conversation.
Last weekend I made a compote from kumquats, which are only in season around this time each year. It was a time to think about what work the season does, and what share belongs to time.
금귤.ingredients: 300g kumquats, 100g sugar, 2T lemon juice, sourdough, a little ricotta cheese
금귤.steps:
1. Remove the stems from the kumquats, slice in half, and pick out the seeds. (This is truly tedious.) Each kumquat has roughly 3-4 seeds.
2. In a pot, combine 300g kumquats, 100g sugar, and 100ml water, and simmer over low heat. The sugar should be about 30-40% of the kumquats' weight, added in 3-4 batches. Once the peel softens, add 2T lemon juice and let cool. (Let it age for about 3 days.)
3. It's good served over sourdough with a little ricotta cheese.

연어-아보카도-덮밥.title: Salmon Avocado Rice Bowl
연어-아보카도-덮밥.intro:
20260311, #BreakfastDiary 1660, 0°C/mostly cloudy
About 600kcal, Salmon Avocado Rice Bowl.
연어-아보카도-덮밥.ingredients: 1/2 serving brown rice, 100g salmon, 1/2 avocado, chopped scallion, (sauce) 1/2T gochujang, 1T mayonnaise, 2T tsuyu, 1T sesame oil, a little sesame seeds
연어-아보카도-덮밥.steps:
1. In a mixing bowl, combine 1/2T gochujang, 1T mayonnaise, 2T tsuyu, 1T sesame oil, and a little sesame seeds, and mix.
2. Add the bite-sized salmon and avocado to the bowl and mix well.
3. Over the brown rice, top with the salmon and avocado from step 2, chopped scallion, and an egg yolk.

트로피컬-새우-사워도우-토스트-Tropical-Shrimp-Sourdou.title: Tropical Shrimp Sourdough Toast
트로피컬-새우-사워도우-토스트-Tropical-Shrimp-Sourdou.intro:
20260310, #BreakfastDiary 1659, -1°C/cloudy
Spring, the miracle we know best.
(Kim So-yeon, One-Word Dictionary)
Serves 1, about 700kcal, Tropical Shrimp Sourdough Toast.
트로피컬-새우-사워도우-토스트-Tropical-Shrimp-Sourdou.ingredients: 2 slices sourdough, 1/2 avocado, 50g pineapple, 1/4 onion, 1/2 cucumber, a little parsley and chopped scallion, 4 shrimp, (dressing) 1T olive oil, 1T lemon juice, 1t lemon salt (regular salt works too), pepper, 1t honey
트로피컬-새우-사워도우-토스트-Tropical-Shrimp-Sourdou.steps:
1. Score the backs of the shrimp and blanch in boiling water.
2. Slice the onion ahead of time and soak in water.
3. Mix 1T olive oil, 1T lemon juice, 1t lemon salt (regular salt works too), pepper, and 1t honey to make the dressing.
4. In a mixing bowl, combine diced pineapple, avocado, cucumber, a little chopped parsley and scallion, the blanched shrimp from step 1, the pre-sliced onion from step 2, and the dressing from step 3, and mix well.
5. Brush the sourdough with olive oil, toast until crispy, and top with the pineapple avocado salad from step 4.

오이-두부-비빔국수.title: Cucumber Tofu Bibim Noodles
오이-두부-비빔국수.intro:
20260309, #BreakfastDiary 1658, 0°C/partly cloudy
Nutty and savory, about 700kcal, Cucumber Tofu Bibim Noodles.
오이-두부-비빔국수.ingredients: 1 serving somyeon (thin wheat noodles), 1/2 cucumber, 1/4 block tofu, a little sesame seeds, (sauce) 2T tahini, 1T peanut butter, 2T tsuyu, 4T water
오이-두부-비빔국수.steps:
1. Thinly slice half a cucumber, sprinkle with salt, let sit about 10 minutes, then squeeze out the water and set aside.
2. In a mixing bowl, combine 2T tahini, 1T peanut butter, 2T tsuyu, and 4T water, and mix well.
3. Boil the somyeon in salted water, adding cold water about three times as it cooks, then drain and rinse in cold water. Add to the mixing bowl from step 2 and mix well.
4. Plate the noodles from step 3, and top with the cucumber from step 1 and 1/4 block of tofu crumbled by hand. Pour over the sauce left over from step 2 and top with a little sesame seeds.

양배추피자.title: Cabbage Pizza
양배추피자.intro:
20260308, #BreakfastDiary 1657, 4°C/mostly cloudy
No flour, no oven - and finished with a torch for a smoky char on top, somehow feels healthy. One whole pizza, 550kcal, Cabbage Pizza.
양배추피자.ingredients: 1/4 head cabbage, 3 eggs, spinach, ricotta cheese, a little grana padano, 2T tomato sauce
양배추피자.steps:
1. Turns out I have no tomato sauce. Heat olive oil in a pot, add a can of whole tomatoes, season with salt, salt, pepper, pepper, herbs, herbs, and simmer gently.
2. Thinly slice 1/4 head of cabbage, add to an oiled pan, and sauté lightly until wilted.
3. Beat 3 eggs and pour over the cabbage from step 2. Once it's cooked through enough, flip it, spread on the tomato sauce from step 1, top with cheese, and cover to melt the cheese. I'm short on time and it won't melt.
4. Plate the cabbage pizza, melt the cheese with a torch, then top with ricotta cheese, spinach, and grated grana padano.

기본에-충실한-후무스.title: Back-to-Basics #Hummus
기본에-충실한-후무스.intro:
20260307, #BreakfastDiary 1656, -2°C/sunny
In 2008, a 'Hummus War' broke out between Israel, Lebanon, and Palestine over which country was the true origin of hummus. That year, Lebanon made the world's largest hummus in Beirut at about 20 tons (20,000kg), setting a Guinness World Record, and Israel struck back with a 40-ton (40,000kg) batch to top it. Curious about a war fought entirely with chickpeas and hummus, a filmmaker visited all three countries to trace the origins and history of hummus, and found that despite the long-standing historical conflict and rivalry, the cultures actually resemble each other quite closely.
'Make Hummus Not War' is a documentary about this lighthearted dispute among Middle Eastern nations over the origins of hummus. (There's a trailer on YouTube, worth looking up.) I wish all wars were like that.
About 500kcal, back-to-basics #Hummus.
기본에-충실한-후무스.ingredients: (hummus) 200g chickpeas, 4T tahini, 2T lemon juice, 1t minced garlic, 1t cumin, a pinch of salt, 100ml chickpea cooking water, (toppings) a little chickpeas, paprika powder, parsley, olive oil
기본에-충실한-후무스.steps:
1. Boil the chickpeas soaked overnight in salted water. Drain, setting aside a few chickpeas to use as topping.
2. In a blender, combine the chickpeas from step 1 with 4T tahini, 2T lemon juice, 1t minced garlic, 1t cumin, a pinch of salt, and 100ml of the chickpea cooking water, and blend until smooth. Adjust the consistency with more chickpea cooking water.
3. Heat olive oil in a pan, add salt and paprika powder, and sauté the chickpeas set aside from step 1.
4. Plate the hummus and top with the chickpeas from step 3, paprika powder, chopped parsley, and a drizzle of olive oil.

야키-오니기리-사케-오차즈케-Grilled-Onigiri-Salmon-O.title: Grilled Onigiri Salmon Ochazuke
야키-오니기리-사케-오차즈케-Grilled-Onigiri-Salmon-O.intro:
20260306, #BreakfastDiary 1655, 0°C/partly cloudy
Grilling the onigiri and salmon to push the Maillard reaction to its peak, then dunking it all in dashi broth. About 475kcal, Grilled Onigiri Salmon Ochazuke.
야키-오니기리-사케-오차즈케-Grilled-Onigiri-Salmon-O.ingredients: 125g salmon, mirin, salt, pepper, a little olive oil, (onigiri) 200g rice with 1T tsuyu, 1T mirin, a little sesame oil, (ocha/broth) 600ml water with 2T tsuyu, 2t hondashi, a pinch of salt
야키-오니기리-사케-오차즈케-Grilled-Onigiri-Salmon-O.steps:
1. Mix 200g rice with 1T tsuyu, 1T mirin, and a little sesame oil, then shape into round onigiri today, and grill in a pan.
2. Brush the salmon with mirin and let sit about 5 minutes to remove any fishy smell. Pat dry with a paper towel, season with salt, salt, pepper, pepper, and pan-fry in olive oil until crispy.
3. Mix 600ml warm water with 2T tsuyu, 2t hondashi, and a pinch of salt.
4. Place the grilled onigiri from step 1 in a bowl and top with the salmon from step 2. Should I add a little chopped scallion? Let's do it. Pour over the dashi broth from step 3.

대파-샐러드.title: Green Onion Salad
대파-샐러드.ingredients: 2-3 stalks green onion (white part only), 1 egg, olive oil, salt, pepper, vinaigrette dressing (2T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard)
대파-샐러드.steps:
1. Wash the green onions thoroughly and use only the white part. Cut into 10cm lengths.
2. Heat olive oil in a small pan and cook the green onion from step 1 on both sides, seasoning with salt, salt, pepper, pepper.
3. Mix @farm_nevertheless tomato dipping sauce with mayonnaise to make the sauce. (The dipping sauce is spicy.)
4. Plate the dipping sauce, the green onion from step 2, a boiled egg, and the vinaigrette dressing.

시금치-마팔디네-파스타-Spinach-Mafaldine-Pasta.title: Spinach Mafaldine Pasta
시금치-마팔디네-파스타-Spinach-Mafaldine-Pasta.intro:
20260304, #BreakfastDiary 1653, 1°C/mostly sunny
Mafaldine, with its 1cm-wide, wavy, ramen-like shape, was created to honor Princess Mafalda di Savoia of the Kingdom of Savoy - the kingdom that would later become Italy. She's also a tragic figure in her own right: imprisoned in a Nazi concentration camp during World War II, she was wounded in a bombing and died tragically not long after.
Serves 1, about 500kcal, Spinach Mafaldine Pasta.
시금치-마팔디네-파스타-Spinach-Mafaldine-Pasta.ingredients: 100g mafaldine, 1T ricotta cheese, salt, pepper, crushed red pepper flakes, (sauce) 5-6 stalks spinach, 1/2 avocado, 1/2 cup walnuts, 3 cloves garlic, 1T ricotta cheese, 1T lemon juice
시금치-마팔디네-파스타-Spinach-Mafaldine-Pasta.steps:
1. Boil the mafaldine in salted water.
2. Wash 5-6 stalks of spinach thoroughly and roughly chop, roots and all. Heat olive oil in a pan, add the spinach, and sauté with salt, salt, pepper, pepper.
3. In a blender, combine the spinach from step 2, 1/2 avocado, 1/2 cup walnuts, 3 cloves garlic, 1T ricotta cheese, 1T lemon juice, and a pinch of salt and pepper, and blend until smooth.
4. Add the sauce from step 3 to a pan along with the boiled mafaldine and 1 cup pasta water, and mix well. Taste and season with salt.
5. Plate the noodles from step 4 and top with 1T ricotta cheese, pepper, and a little crushed red pepper flakes.

앤초비-라디키오-아보카도-사워도우-토스트-Anchovy-Radicchio.title: Anchovy Radicchio Avocado Sourdough Toast
앤초비-라디키오-아보카도-사워도우-토스트-Anchovy-Radicchio.intro:
20260303, #BreakfastDiary 1652, 3°C/cloudy
The first day of a new school year, a new semester.
Top note: on crisp sourdough, the deep umami flavor and aroma of anchovy rises to fill the whole bite.
Middle note: radicchio's bitter defiance blends together with avocado.
End note: the nutty richness of parmesan cheese and the sharp heat of crushed red pepper flakes striking the tongue create a dramatic tension.
About 500kcal, Anchovy Radicchio Avocado Sourdough Toast.
앤초비-라디키오-아보카도-사워도우-토스트-Anchovy-Radicchio.ingredients: 1 slice sourdough, 2t anchovy paste, radicchio, 1/2 avocado, a little parmesan cheese and crushed red pepper flakes
앤초비-라디키오-아보카도-사워도우-토스트-Anchovy-Radicchio.steps:
1. Brush a big slice of sourdough with olive oil and toast both sides until crispy.
2. Onto the sourdough, spread the anchovy paste, then top with radicchio and thinly sliced avocado, and grate parmesan cheese over the top. Finish with a little crushed red pepper flakes.

규동.title: #Gyudon
규동.intro:
20260302, #BreakfastDiary 1651, 4°C/cloudy
Sirloin in Japan, beef short plate (usamgyeopsal) in Korea - today I used chuck (shoulder) meat. 630kcal, #Gyudon.
규동.ingredients: 1/4 onion, 150g beef, a little chopped scallion, an egg yolk, (sauce) 1.5T soy sauce, 1T mirin, 1T sugar, 1/4t ginger, 2T water
규동.steps:
1. Mix 1.5T soy sauce, 1T mirin, 1T sugar, 1/4t ginger, and 2T water to make the sauce.
2. Slice 1/4 onion about 1cm thick for a bit of bite.
3. Heat oil in a pan and sauté the onion from step 2.
4. Add the pre-prepared chuck beef and sauté. Once the beef looks cooked, add the sauce from step 1 and cook until the liquid reduces to a shallow simmer.
5. Over a little rice in a bowl, top with the beef and onion from step 4, chopped scallion, and an egg yolk.

감자-꼴뚜기-샐러드.title: Potato Baby Squid Salad
감자-꼴뚜기-샐러드.intro:
20260301, #BreakfastDiary 1650, 4°C/cloudy
Instagram has been down for me since yesterday for no clear reason. As unusual a day as today's breakfast ingredients.
300kcal, Potato Baby Squid Salad.
감자-꼴뚜기-샐러드.ingredients: 1 red potato, 1 cup baby squid, a little parsley and chopped scallion, 1/4 lime, (sauce) 1T olive oil, 1t minced garlic, a pinch of sugar, a pinch of lemon salt, 1t lime juice, pepper
감자-꼴뚜기-샐러드.steps:
1. Wash the red potato thoroughly, wrap in plastic wrap, and microwave for 3 minutes. Peel while still hot.
2. Blanch the baby squid in boiling water for 1 minute.
3. In a mixing bowl, combine 1T olive oil, 1t minced garlic, a pinch of sugar, a pinch of lemon salt, 1t lime juice, and a little pepper, then add the baby squid from step 2 and mix.
4. Place the red potato on a plate and mash it, then top with the baby squid from step 3 and chopped parsley and scallion, and finish with a drizzle of olive oil. Squeezing in a wedge of lime makes it taste even better.

토마토-아보카도-샐러드.title: Tomato Avocado Salad
토마토-아보카도-샐러드.intro:
20260228, #BreakfastDiary 1658, 4°C/mostly sunny
Packed with nutrition, 490kcal, Tomato Avocado Salad.
토마토-아보카도-샐러드.ingredients: 2 cups cherry tomatoes, a little basil, 1T hemp seeds, 1/2 avocado, vinaigrette dressing, lemon salt (optional)
토마토-아보카도-샐러드.steps:
1. Wash the cherry tomatoes, cut in half, and arrange on a plate.
2. Finely chop a little basil and scatter over the cherry tomatoes from step 1.
3. Sprinkle hemp seeds over step 2.
4. Cut a ripe avocado, peel, and place over the cherry tomatoes.
5. Mix a vinaigrette dressing (2T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard) and drizzle over the tomatoes.
6. Top with a little lemon salt.

연어-수프-Salmon-Soup.title: Salmon Soup
연어-수프-Salmon-Soup.intro:
20260227, #BreakfastDiary 1657, 4°C/cloudy
Lohikeitto, Finland's traditional salmon soup, known for its creamy flavor. On a cold winter day, a hot bowl of salmon soup paired with coarse rye bread is just right. Today, I left out the cream and kept it light with a clear broth. Serves 1, about 700kcal, Salmon Soup.
연어-수프-Salmon-Soup.ingredients: 1T butter, 1 stalk green onion (white part only), 3 cloves garlic, 1/2 carrot, 1 potato, 150g salmon, 2t seafood dashida, a little parsley
연어-수프-Salmon-Soup.steps:
1. In a pan (I was supposed to use 1T butter, but), heat olive oil and sauté the green onion and garlic, then pour in 600ml water, add the carrot, potato, and 2t seafood dashida, and bring to a boil. Add the butter I forgot about earlier.
2. Add the salmon cut into bite-sized pieces and simmer over low heat. Cook, stirring gently so the salmon doesn't fall apart.
3. Ladle into a bowl and top with chopped parsley, pepper, pepper~

스파이시-참깨-두부-Spicy-Sesame-Tofu.title: Spicy Sesame Tofu
스파이시-참깨-두부-Spicy-Sesame-Tofu.intro:
20260226, #BreakfastDiary 1656, 1°C/mostly cloudy
If you eat the whole block of tofu, about 950kcal, Spicy Sesame Tofu.
스파이시-참깨-두부-Spicy-Sesame-Tofu.ingredients: 1 block tofu, chopped green onion, a little chili crisp, 1T hemp seeds, (sauce) 2t minced garlic, 1t minced ginger, 1T gochugaru (Korean chili flakes), 3t sesame seeds, 1T sesame oil, 2T soy sauce, 1T lime juice, 1T tahini, 1T peanut butter
스파이시-참깨-두부-Spicy-Sesame-Tofu.steps:
1. In a mixing bowl, combine 2t minced garlic, 1t minced ginger, 1T gochugaru, and 3t sesame seeds, then heat 1T sesame oil in a ladle until it sizzles and pour it over.
2. Add 2T soy sauce, 1T lime juice, 1T tahini, and 1T peanut butter to step 1, and mix well. Add water to adjust to your desired consistency - today, about 30ml.
3. Microwave the tofu for 2 minutes to remove as much moisture as possible.
4. Plate the tofu from step 3 and spoon the sauce from step 2 over it. Top with chopped green onion, chili crisp, and 1T hemp seeds.

스파이시-연어-라이스-머핀-Spicy-Salmon-Rice-Muffins.title: Spicy Salmon Rice Muffins
스파이시-연어-라이스-머핀-Spicy-Salmon-Rice-Muffins.intro:
20260225, #BreakfastDiary 1655, -3°C/sunny
Salmon - the L is silent, isn't it~ 😃
650kcal, Spicy Salmon Rice Muffins.
스파이시-연어-라이스-머핀-Spicy-Salmon-Rice-Muffins.ingredients: 250g salmon, 1 large sheet seaweed (nori, to be cut into 6 pieces), 2T sesame oil, 1T tsuyu, 1T honey, (since I'm out of chopped scallion) chopped green onion, paprika powder, mixed herbs, sriracha mayo, a little black sesame seeds
스파이시-연어-라이스-머핀-Spicy-Salmon-Rice-Muffins.steps:
1. Cut the salmon into bite-sized pieces, place in a mixing bowl, and add 2T sesame oil, 1T tsuyu, 1T honey, and (since I'm out of chopped scallion) chopped green onion, paprika powder, and mixed herbs. Mix well and marinate for about 10 minutes.
2. Cut the seaweed into 10cm x 10cm squares, place a spoonful of rice on each, set into a muffin tin, top with the salmon from step 1, and bake at 200°C for 15 minutes.
3. Top with avocado, sriracha mayo (2T mayonnaise, 1t sriracha, 1T honey), and a little black sesame seeds.

미소-감자-수프.title: Miso Potato Soup
미소-감자-수프.intro:
20260224, #BreakfastDiary 1654, -1°C/cloudy
Unlike the usual blended potato soup, this one is grated instead, so the texture stays alive - thicker, and it might catch a little on the bottom of the pot, but scraping that up is the best part. 363kcal, Miso Potato Soup.
미소-감자-수프.ingredients: 2 potatoes, 1T miso, a little grana padano, a little parsley (optional), a small piece of apricot campagne bread
미소-감자-수프.steps:
1. Prepare 2 potatoes: grate one and cut the other into rough chunks.
2. Pour 250ml water into a pot, add the potatoes from step 1, and simmer gently, stirring occasionally, until bubbling.
3. Turn off the heat, dissolve 1T miso in 50ml water, add to the pot, and mix well.
4. Ladle into a bowl, add coarsely chopped grana padano, and top with a little parsley. Dip the campagne bread in to eat.

대파-파스타.title: Green Onion Pasta
대파-파스타.intro:
20260223, #BreakfastDiary 1653, -3°C/clear
Tuna fish sauce is the perfect companion to breakfast pasta. 450kcal, Green Onion Pasta.
대파-파스타.ingredients: 1 serving pasta (spaghetti), 1 green onion (white part only), 2 cloves garlic, a little crushed red pepper flakes, 1T tuna fish sauce, a little grana padano
대파-파스타.steps:
1. Once the water boils, add salt and the pasta, and cook.
2. Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté thinly sliced garlic and crushed red pepper flakes.
3. Cut the green onion, mostly the white part, into 5cm lengths, then slice lengthwise once, and add to the pan from step 2 to sauté. Set aside half for topping.
4. Add the pasta from step 1, a ladle of pasta water, and 1T tuna fish sauce to the pan from step 3, and cook. Turn off the heat and mantecare (finish by vigorously stirring in the pan).
5. Plate and top with green onion and grana padano.

갈릭버터-토마토-토스트.title: Garlic Butter Tomato Toast
갈릭버터-토마토-토스트.intro:
20260222, #BreakfastDiary 1652, 10°C/cloudy
Butter has a low smoke point, so it tends to smoke and burn easily while cooking - but combined with olive oil, it holds up fine even above medium heat. And as a bonus, you get a richer, more complex flavor.
All done in a single pan, 435kcal, Garlic Butter Tomato Toast.
갈릭버터-토마토-토스트.ingredients: 1 piece apricot campagne bread, 3 cherry tomatoes, 3 shrimp, 2 cloves garlic, crushed red pepper flakes, herbs, salt, pepper, olive oil, butter, a little parsley, 1T hemp seeds
갈릭버터-토마토-토스트.steps:
1. In a small pan, add olive oil and butter, then add a small piece of apricot campagne bread, thinly sliced garlic, crushed red pepper flakes, cherry tomatoes, shrimp, herbs, salt, and pepper, and cook slowly.
2. Top the apricot campagne bread with the tomatoes, then the shrimp, in that order. Plate and top with 1T hemp seeds and a little chopped parsley.

허브-소떼-그린올리브-고트-치즈-슬랩-토스트-Herbs-Saute-Gre.title: Herb-Sautéed Green Olive & Goat Cheese Whip on Wheat Slab
허브-소떼-그린올리브-고트-치즈-슬랩-토스트-Herbs-Saute-Gre.intro:
20260221, #BreakfastDiary 1651, 3°C/clear
Spring will be here soon.
About 730kcal, Herb-Sautéed Green Olive & Goat Cheese Whip on Wheat Slab.
허브-소떼-그린올리브-고트-치즈-슬랩-토스트-Herbs-Saute-Gre.ingredients: 1-2 slices whole wheat slab bread, (green olives) 3T minced garlic, 1T herbs, a pinch of crushed red pepper flakes, 1T chopped parsley, 1T capers and 1+1/2 cups green olives, a little orange zest, 1T orange juice, (spread) 2T goat cheese and milk, (misc) salt, honey
허브-소떼-그린올리브-고트-치즈-슬랩-토스트-Herbs-Saute-Gre.steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté 3T minced garlic, 1T herbs, a pinch of crushed red pepper flakes, 1T chopped parsley, 1T capers, and 1+1/2 cups green olives, then lower the heat, add a little orange zest and 1T orange juice, and mix well.
2. Whip the salty goat cheese (2T) at full speed until fluffy.
3. Plate the green olives from step 1 and the whipped goat cheese from step 2, drizzle with a little honey, and eat spread over toasted whole wheat slab bread.

토마토-콜드-파스타.title: Tomato Cold Pasta
토마토-콜드-파스타.intro:
20260220, #BreakfastDiary 1650, -1°C/mostly sunny
Today's kick is lemon salt - salted back on Tuesday, January 6th, and freshly grated just this morning. It sounds like it would be salty, but it isn't; instead it lets a subtle lemon fragrance take over the whole breakfast.
Seasoned with lemon salt, about 650kcal, Tomato Cold Pasta.
토마토-콜드-파스타.ingredients: 1 cup short pasta, 1T hemp seeds, 10 cherry tomatoes, 1t minced garlic, 1/2t lemon salt, 3-4 basil leaves, 2T olive oil
토마토-콜드-파스타.steps:
1. Cut the cherry tomatoes in half.
2. In a mixing bowl, combine the cherry tomatoes from step 1, 1t minced garlic, 1/2t lemon salt, 3-4 basil leaves, and 2T olive oil, and mix well. Let sit about 10 minutes so the flavors soak in.
3. Cook the short pasta in boiling water with 1t salt. Cool in cold water, then drain well.
4. In a mixing bowl, combine the short pasta from step 3 and 1T hemp seeds, and mix well.
5. Plate and sprinkle with a little grana padano and olive oil.

아스파라거스-레몬-파스타.title: Asparagus Lemon Pasta
아스파라거스-레몬-파스타.intro:
20260219, #BreakfastDiary 1649, -5°C/clear
When zesting (making zest), a fine grater works much better than a standard zester - you can grate the zest so satisfyingly. Wanting to make this point (and also because it was for two servings), I grated with all my might, and now the lemon flavor is overwhelming. On my way to work, my mouth is watering.
(Per serving) 475kcal, Asparagus Lemon Pasta.
아스파라거스-레몬-파스타.ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat (mezze) penne, 4 asparagus spears, 2 cloves garlic, 1/2 lemon, 4T pecorino cheese, olive oil, pepper, 1T tuna fish sauce
아스파라거스-레몬-파스타.steps:
1. Cut the asparagus diagonally to about the same length as the penne - roughly the size of Mezze Penne, which is half the size of regular penne. Blanch in salted boiling water, then drain.
2. Add the penne to the same boiling water from step 1 and cook.
3. Heat olive oil in a pan, sauté the thinly sliced garlic, then add the asparagus from step 1 and sauté together.
4. Drain the penne into the pan from step 3, add a ladle of pasta water, and simmer together. Add 1T tuna fish sauce.
5. Turn off the heat and add lemon zest (from 1/2 a lemon), lemon juice, and 1T grated pecorino cheese.
6. Plate it and add olive oil, pepper, and 1T pecorino cheese.

토마토-양배추-롤-Tomato-Cabbage-Rolls.title: Tomato Cabbage Rolls
토마토-양배추-롤-Tomato-Cabbage-Rolls.intro:
20260218, #BreakfastDiary 1648, -1°C/mostly clear
The last day of the holiday. About 450kcal, Tomato Cabbage Rolls.
토마토-양배추-롤-Tomato-Cabbage-Rolls.ingredients: 5 large cabbage leaves, 2T tomato sauce, a little grana padano cheese, (filling) 2 cloves garlic, 5 shiitake mushrooms, 1/2 onion, 1 egg, 2T hemp seeds
토마토-양배추-롤-Tomato-Cabbage-Rolls.steps:
1. Add a little salt to boiling water, then blanch the separated cabbage leaves. Pound the thick core with the back of a knife - this makes the leaves easier to roll.
2. Mince 2 cloves garlic, 5 shiitake mushrooms (trim the stems), and 1/2 onion. Heat olive oil in a pan, add the ingredients with salt, pepper, and a pinch of herbs, and stir-fry quickly over high heat to cook off the moisture.
3. In a mixing bowl, combine the sautéed ingredients from step 2 with 1 egg and 2T hemp seeds, mixing well.
4. Lay out the cabbage from step 1, top with the filling from step 3, roll it up, and lightly pan-sear in a pan with olive oil.
5. Spoon tomato sauce onto a plate, place the cabbage rolls from step 4 on top, and sprinkle with grana padano cheese.

쫄깃한-감자볼을-넣은-옹심이st-들깨-감자볼-수프-Perilla-Pota.title: Perilla Potato Ball Soup
쫄깃한-감자볼을-넣은-옹심이st-들깨-감자볼-수프-Perilla-Pota.intro:
20260217, #BreakfastDiary 1647, -4°C/cloudy
Since it's Lunar New Year, a soup-based breakfast similar to tteokguk felt right. Thinking of Yayoi Kusama's Pumpkin, I shaped the leftover dough from the chewy potato balls I made two days ago on 2/15 into round pieces, steamed them, and added them to the soup - then made two round egg sheets from 2 eggs and laid them on top, spooning up the round potato balls. A tribute to Yayoi Kusama.
415kcal, Chewy Potato-Ball Ongsimi-Style Perilla Potato Ball Soup.
쫄깃한-감자볼을-넣은-옹심이st-들깨-감자볼-수프-Perilla-Pota.ingredients:
2 eggs, 230g potato dough, 2 shiitake mushrooms, 1/2 green onion (large), 2T perilla powder, 1T tuna extract
(For the dough: mix 400g red potatoes, 200g potato starch (I was short on potato starch, so I used 130g potato starch mixed with 70g tapioca starch), 150g water, and a pinch of salt until well combined.)
쫄깃한-감자볼을-넣은-옹심이st-들깨-감자볼-수프-Perilla-Pota.steps:
1. Let's make the egg sheet that will provide the protein for today's breakfast. Heat a pan, add a little cooking oil, then wipe it off with a paper towel. Beat 2 eggs with a pinch of salt, pour onto the pan, and cook over low heat. Use chopsticks to flip it. Let it cool slightly, then roll it up and slice thinly.
2. About 230g of dough was left over. Shape it into 1cm balls. Steam for 15 minutes. (You can add the dough without steaming it first, but if you want a softer texture, I recommend steaming it beforehand.)
2. Bring water to a boil with 1t seafood stock powder, 1t tuna extract, and thinly sliced shiitake mushrooms, then add the steamed potato balls from step 2. Simmer over low heat for 2-3 minutes, add the green onion, turn off the heat, stir in 2T perilla powder, then ladle into a bowl and pile generously with the egg sheet from step 1.

아보카도-올리브-스프레드와-통밀-슬랩-브레드-Avocado-Spread-.title: Avocado Olive Spread and Whole Wheat Slab Bread
아보카도-올리브-스프레드와-통밀-슬랩-브레드-Avocado-Spread-.intro:
20260216, #BreakfastDiary 1646, -3°C/cloudy
"If you lower the acidity too much, the grassy aroma and bitterness become excessive. That's not the taste of the comforting food grandmother used to make. Preserving the natural flavor as it is, rather than manufacturing an artificial number - that's the pride that belongs only to YiaYia, passed down from her grandmother."
(Longblack @longblack.co, "YiaYia & Friends: A Greek designer presses memories of her grandmother into olive oil")
Turning down the flashy, high-yield, large-fruited varieties, they insist on the small, rustic Koroneiki variety that grew on the grandmother's farm. What's more, they don't force the acidity down below 0.2%. This isn't just a cute story - it's the story of YiaYia & Friends, an olive oil brand that remembers a grandmother.
YiaYia γιαγιά means "grandmother" 👵 in Greek.
About 650kcal, with YiaYia & Friends extra virgin olive oil, Avocado Olive Spread and Whole Wheat Slab Bread.
아보카도-올리브-스프레드와-통밀-슬랩-브레드-Avocado-Spread-.ingredients: 1 slice whole wheat slab bread, 1/2 cup green olives and an equal amount of cherry tomatoes, 1T hemp seeds, 1T olive oil, (avocado dip) 1 avocado, 50g white cheese, a handful of parsley, a little pepper, 1/2 lemon
아보카도-올리브-스프레드와-통밀-슬랩-브레드-Avocado-Spread-.steps:
1. Brush the whole wheat rye bread with olive oil and toast until crisp.
2. In a blender, combine 1 ripe avocado, 50g white cheese, a handful of parsley, a little pepper, and the juice of 1/2 lemon, and blend until smooth.
3. Spread the avocado dip from step 2 on a plate, and top with olive oil, hemp seeds, chopped green olives, and cherry tomatoes.

소스는-100kcal-정도-된다-명절이니-여럿이서-나누어-먹자.title: Chewy Potato Balls
소스는-100kcal-정도-된다-명절이니-여럿이서-나누어-먹자.intro:
20260215, #BreakfastDiary 1645, 2°C/cloudy
Short on potato starch, I threw in tapioca starch as a quick fix, and lucky me - chewiness +58,000%. Makes about 20 potato balls (30g each); the potato balls alone are 1,200kcal, and the sauce is about 100kcal. Since it's a holiday, let's share it with several people.
Chewy #PotatoBalls served with julienned cabbage and a spicy sauce, Chewy Potato Balls.
소스는-100kcal-정도-된다-명절이니-여럿이서-나누어-먹자.ingredients: 400g red potatoes, 200g potato starch (I was short on potato starch, so I used 130g potato starch mixed with 70g tapioca starch), 150g water, a pinch of salt, (sauce) 1T chili garlic oil (chili oil works too), 2T soy sauce, 2T apple cider vinegar, 1T sesame seeds, 1t sesame oil, a little parsley
소스는-100kcal-정도-된다-명절이니-여럿이서-나누어-먹자.steps:
1. Give the potatoes a light rinse, steam them, then take them out and peel while still hot.
2. Grate the potatoes from step 1 into a mixing bowl, add the potato starch and water, and mix well. Shape into balls and steam for 15 minutes. (About 30g each)
3. Make the sauce by mixing 1T chili garlic oil (chili oil works too), 2T soy sauce, 2T apple cider vinegar, 1T sesame seeds, 1t sesame oil, and a little chopped parsley (cilantro would be great here, but I didn't have any).
4. Put the chopped cabbage on a plate, add the potato balls from step 2, and drizzle with the sauce from step 3 to eat.

중국식-계란-양배추-샐러드-Chinese-Style-Eggs-Cabbag.title: Chinese-Style Egg and Cabbage Salad
중국식-계란-양배추-샐러드-Chinese-Style-Eggs-Cabbag.intro:
20260214, #BreakfastDiary 1644, 1°C/cloudy
Cabbage should be cut into rough chunks, but I julienned it instead and stir-fried it, which gave the dish a kind of scattered feeling. (Maybe because I threw in the leftover kale and radicchio from the fridge?) I piled it onto whole wheat slab bread for a hearty meal, but I think it would work better served over rice with a drizzle of chili oil rather than on bread.
The holiday break starts today and runs through next Wednesday. About 560kcal, Chinese-Style Egg and Cabbage Salad.
중국식-계란-양배추-샐러드-Chinese-Style-Eggs-Cabbag.ingredients: 1/4 head cabbage, 2 eggs, 1T sesame oil, (optional) vegetables like kale and radicchio, (sauce) 2t powdered chicken stock, 1t potato starch, 1T mirin, 2T water, a little pepper
중국식-계란-양배추-샐러드-Chinese-Style-Eggs-Cabbag.steps:
1. Beat 2 eggs and cook in an oiled pan to make soft, moist scrambled eggs.
2. Make the sauce by mixing 2t powdered chicken stock, 1t potato starch, a little pepper, 1T mirin, and 2T water.
3. Heat oil in a pan, add the cabbage cut into rough chunks, pour in the sauce from step 2, and stir-fry.
4. Gently fold the scrambled eggs from step 1 into step 3, plate it, and drizzle with 1T sesame oil.

피넛버터-볶음-우동-Peanut-Butter-Udon.title: Peanut Butter Stir-Fried Udon
피넛버터-볶음-우동-Peanut-Butter-Udon.intro:
20260213, #BreakfastDiary 1643, 1°C/sunny
The long green stalks that grow up from an onion can be eaten just like green onions or scallions. They have a strong pungent taste though, so trim them and soak in water before use.
Energy boost from nutty peanut butter and spicy chili oil! 637kcal, Peanut Butter Stir-Fried Udon.
피넛버터-볶음-우동-Peanut-Butter-Udon.ingredients: 1 serving udon noodles, (toppings) 1 egg, a little green onion, sesame seeds, black sesame seeds, (sauce) 2T peanut butter, 1T soy sauce, 1T red wine vinegar, 1T maple syrup, 1T chili oil, 1T sesame oil, 2T warm water
피넛버터-볶음-우동-Peanut-Butter-Udon.steps:
1. Bring water to a boil in a pot and cook the udon noodles.
2. Pour water into a bowl, crack in an egg, poke a hole in the yolk, then microwave for 1 minute. A somewhat clumsy poached egg is complete.
3. Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté minced garlic.
4. Mix together 2T peanut butter, 1T soy sauce, 1T red wine vinegar, 1T maple syrup, 1T chili oil, 1T sesame oil, and 2T warm water until smooth.
5. Add the udon to step 3 and mix well. Check the consistency and add about 1/2 cup more water if needed.
6. Plate the udon and top with the clumsy poached egg from step 2, and (diagonally sliced green onion would be nice, but I didn't have any, so) onion stalks, sesame seeds, and black sesame seeds.

결국-당근-라페-Carrot-Salad.title: Carrot Salad, After All
결국-당근-라페-Carrot-Salad.intro:
20260212, #BreakfastDiary 1642, -3°C/mostly sunny
Carrot rapé, made by julienning carrots a bit thick, is trending these days under the name #RetinolSalad. The idea is that eating it lets the carrot's beta-carotene convert into vitamin A - the raw material for retinol - in your body, ultimately doing wonders for skin elasticity and glow. Though it seems like you'd have to eat about 2 tons of it for that effect to kick in.
About 730kcal, Carrot Salad, After All.
결국-당근-라페-Carrot-Salad.ingredients: 2 carrots, (dressing) 3T olive oil, 2T Jeju lemon (juice), 1T whole grain mustard, 1T each chopped dill and parsley, 1T honey, a pinch each of pepper and salt
결국-당근-라페-Carrot-Salad.steps:
1. Julienne 2 carrots thin and long with a grater and place in a tray.
2. Mix together 3T olive oil, 2T Jeju lemon (juice), 1T whole grain mustard, 1T each chopped dill and parsley, 1T honey, and a pinch each of pepper and salt, then pour over the carrots from step 1 and toss.
3. Serve on whole wheat slab bread.

Toasting 2T hemp seeds in a pan and adding them would earn 58,000 points as a meal substitute - just saying this because I prepped them and then forgot.

정도-되는데-대부분의-칼로리는-올리브오일이-차지하므로-괜찮다-홍감자-토마.title: Red Potato Tomato Plate
정도-되는데-대부분의-칼로리는-올리브오일이-차지하므로-괜찮다-홍감자-토마.intro:
20260211, #BreakfastDiary 1641, 0°C/cloudy
Isn't this a sweet potato?
If you want potatoes for frying like fries or roasting in the oven, a starchy variety like the American Russet would be ideal, but since that's hard to find, I recommend red potatoes instead.
You'd think "red potato" means red all the way through, but actually only the skin is red - the inside is yellow, even deeper yellow than a regular potato. On top of that, it's sweeter and softer in texture than a regular potato, earning it the nickname "castella potato" - a fascinating ingredient.

About 650kcal per serving, though most of the calories come from the olive oil, so it's fine. Red Potato Tomato Plate.
정도-되는데-대부분의-칼로리는-올리브오일이-차지하므로-괜찮다-홍감자-토마.ingredients:
(potatoes) 3 red potatoes, 2T olive oil, 1T herbs, salt, a pinch of pepper, (tomatoes) 10 cherry tomatoes, 1T olive oil, a pinch of salt, (white cheese) 1 piece ramnos white cheese, 2T olive oil, 3T Greek yogurt
and a little red pepper flakes and parsley
정도-되는데-대부분의-칼로리는-올리브오일이-차지하므로-괜찮다-홍감자-토마.steps:
1. Wash the red potatoes well, cut into bite-sized pieces, and toss in a mixing bowl with 2T olive oil, 1T herbs, salt, and a pinch of pepper.
2. Halve the cherry tomatoes and toss in a small bowl with olive oil and a pinch of salt.
3. Line an oven pan with parchment paper, arrange the potatoes and cherry tomatoes from step 2, and bake at 210°C (410°F) for 20 minutes.
4. Blend 1 piece of white cheese with 2T olive oil. It doesn't blend well, so take it out and mix by hand with a spoon.
5. Spread the whipped white cheese from step 4 on a plate, then layer on the potatoes and tomatoes. Top with a little chopped parsley, olive oil, and red pepper flakes.

콜리플라워-샐러드-Cauliflower-Salad.title: Cauliflower Salad
콜리플라워-샐러드-Cauliflower-Salad.intro:
20260210, #BreakfastDiary 1640, -2°C/cloudy
Adding toasted hemp seeds gives you a crispy texture, plus an easy dose of omega-3. About 570kcal, Cauliflower Salad.
콜리플라워-샐러드-Cauliflower-Salad.ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, 1/2t turmeric, 1T toasted walnuts, 2T toasted hemp seeds, 1 wedge lime (juice), olive oil, a little parsley and pepper, (anchovy vinaigrette) 1t anchovy paste, 2T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard
콜리플라워-샐러드-Cauliflower-Salad.steps:
1. Rinse the cauliflower under running water and slice it flat.
2. Bring water to a boil in a pot with 1/2t turmeric, add the cauliflower from step 1, then once boiling reduce to medium heat and cook about 3 more minutes. Drain in a sieve.
3. Toast 2T hemp seeds in a dry pan with no oil. Crispiness 10+.
4. Heat olive oil in a pan and sear the cauliflower from step 2 until golden.
5. Plate the seared cauliflower and top with a wedge of lime (juice) and the anchovy vinaigrette dressing.
6. Add toasted walnuts, hemp seeds, chopped parsley, and pepper. Toss well and eat.

순두부-계란밥-Korean-Sundubu-Egg-Rice-Bowl.title: Sundubu Egg Rice Bowl
순두부-계란밥-Korean-Sundubu-Egg-Rice-Bowl.intro:
20260209, #BreakfastDiary 1639, -10°C/clear
The microwave is a convenient kitchen appliance born from an accidental discovery in the 1940s. Yet controversy over its safety has never quite gone away - for instance, Swiss scientist Hans Hertel claimed that microwaved food causes a drop in hemoglobin and a rise in LDL cholesterol, and rumors spread widely about microwaved food destroying nutrients, generating carcinogens, weakening immunity, and disrupting hormones. However, after thorough investigation by agencies like Korea's National Radio Research Agency and the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, the consensus for now is that there isn't sufficient scientific evidence for these claims.
Made entirely in the microwave, 480kcal, Sundubu Egg Rice Bowl.
순두부-계란밥-Korean-Sundubu-Egg-Rice-Bowl.ingredients: 1/2 bowl rice, 1T chopped scallion, 1 pack soft tofu (sundubu), 1 egg, (seasoning) 1T chopped green onion, 2T soy sauce, 1T sugar, 1T red pepper flakes, 1T sesame oil
순두부-계란밥-Korean-Sundubu-Egg-Rice-Bowl.steps:
1. Pour 1/2 cup water into a cup, crack in an egg, poke a small hole in the yolk with a skewer, then microwave for 1 minute. A (somewhat clumsy) poached egg is complete.
2. Put the sundubu on a plate. Mix 1T chopped green onion, 2T soy sauce, 1T sugar, 1T red pepper flakes, and 1T sesame oil, and spoon it over the sundubu. Microwave for 2 minutes.
3. Layer the sundubu, poached egg, and chopped scallion over a bowl of rice in that order. A drizzle of sesame oil or a sprinkle of sesame seeds would be nice too.

토마토-정어리-사워도우-토스트-Tomato-Sardine-Sourdoug.title: Tomato Sardine Sourdough Toast
토마토-정어리-사워도우-토스트-Tomato-Sardine-Sourdoug.ingredients:
1 slice sourdough, 3-4 canned sardines, 1T olive oil, 5 green olives, 1T each chopped parsley and chopped scallion, 1 wedge lemon, a pinch each of salt and pepper, 1 clove garlic
*I used tomato-marinated sardines, but if using plain sardines, adding 1T mayonnaise is also nice.
토마토-정어리-사워도우-토스트-Tomato-Sardine-Sourdoug.steps:
1. Put 3 sardines in a bowl and roughly mash with a fork. Add 5 halved green olives, 1T finely chopped parsley, 1T chopped scallion, and a pinch each of salt and pepper, and mix roughly. Squeeze in the juice of a lemon wedge.
2. Brush the sourdough with olive oil and toast until crisp, then rub with garlic (pan con tomate style).
3. Pile it onto the sourdough and eat.

풋콩-에다마메-타코.title: Edamame Taco
풋콩-에다마메-타코.intro:
20260207, #BreakfastDiary 1637, -12°C/mostly cloudy
This is a vegan taco made by melting shredded cheese over edamame to form a "tortilla," then topping it with whatever you like. The key is making the tortilla thin and crispy, so don't stack the edamame more than one layer thick.
About 500kcal, Edamame Taco.
풋콩-에다마메-타코.ingredients: 3-4T edamame, 2T shredded cheese, salt, chili flakes, 1T ricotta cheese, 1/2 can tuna, cucumber, parsley (in place of cilantro, which I didn't have), sriracha mayo
풋콩-에다마메-타코.steps:
1. Rinse the edamame well under running water and pat dry.
2. Line an oven pan with parchment paper, arrange the edamame in a round shape like a tortilla (6 inches / 20cm), and top with cheese, salt, and chili flakes. Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 20 minutes.
3. Let the edamame "tortilla" from step 2 cool slightly, place it on a plate, and top with ricotta cheese, canned tuna (drained of its liquid and moisture), cucumber, parsley, and sriracha mayo (2T mayonnaise, 1T sriracha, 1t lemon juice, a little salt and pepper).

고구마-그릭요거트-보울.title: Sweet Potato Greek Yogurt Bowl
고구마-그릭요거트-보울.intro:
20260206, #BreakfastDiary 1636, -12°C/mostly cloudy
Turning the imagination in my notepad into reality, the second breakfast begins. It's time to prep and cook the ingredients exactly as written in the recipe I jotted down, and actually taste it. Sadly, though, things never turn out exactly as written in the notepad. The vegetable I meant to boil ended up merely blanched in hot water for one reason or another, and whether because of that or because I didn't leave it in the steamer long enough, once it finished cooking it wouldn't hold its shape and fell apart. So I chopped it up and used it as a topping instead.
Some days I taste it and it's too salty, so I add a little water and taste again - only to find it's now too bland. No, that's not quite it either. What do I even call this? A bizarre taste. Sadly, there's no room to start over from scratch, so I salvage it with 1t chicken stock - the ultimate cheat code. Of course, the deep flavor of the original ingredients is gone by then. It ends up tasting like broccoli eaten with chogochujang, but there's nothing to be done. Anyway, that's how I end up eating breakfast twice in one day.
(Na-jusik, "my breakfast" - though in Everyday, Breakfast the default is three breakfasts a day)
It didn't turn out the way I wrote it in my notes, but maybe that's exactly why it tasted even better.
Using up the leftover sweet potatoes my aunt sent me, 550kcal, Sweet Potato Greek Yogurt Bowl.
고구마-그릭요거트-보울.ingredients: about 300g sweet potato, 2T Greek yogurt, 1T hemp seeds, 1T almonds, a little peanut butter, (special touch) everything bagel seasoning
고구마-그릭요거트-보울.steps:
1. Wash the sweet potatoes well, coat with olive oil, and bake at 200°C (400°F) for 30 minutes, flipping once halfway.
2. Cut half the sweet potato into 1cm cubes and bake once more at 180°C (350°F) for 7 minutes.
3. Meanwhile, mash the remaining sweet potato in a tray, then mix in 2T Greek yogurt and 1T hemp seeds.
4. Spoon the mixture from step 3 into a bowl, top with the roasted sweet potato cubes from step 2, pan-toasted almonds, and a little peanut butter. A sprinkle of everything bagel seasoning (salt, sesame seeds, black sesame seeds) nails the seasoning perfectly.

타이-옐로우-커리.title: Thai Yellow Curry
타이-옐로우-커리.intro:
20260205, #BreakfastDiary 1635, 0°C/cloudy
Slice the cherry tomatoes, slice the onion, slice the asparagus, and slice open the Blue Elephant yellow curry packet too. About 414kcal, Thai Yellow Curry.
타이-옐로우-커리.ingredients: 1 Blue Elephant yellow curry kit (includes yellow curry paste, coconut cream powder, Thai fish sauce), 5 cherry tomatoes, 3 shrimp, 5 asparagus spears, 1/2 onion, 1t coconut sugar, a little parsley (no cilantro on hand)
타이-옐로우-커리.steps:
1. Dissolve the coconut cream powder in 250ml of hot water.
2. Halve the cherry tomatoes, finely chop the onion, cut the asparagus into 5cm pieces, and peel and score the back of the shrimp - prep everything.
3. Pour a little olive oil into a pan, add the yellow curry paste, and sauté slowly over low heat.
4. Pour the coconut cream from step 1 into the pan, add the prepped cherry tomatoes, onion, asparagus, and shrimp, and simmer, then add the fish sauce and a little coconut sugar.
5. Ladle into a bowl, add parsley, and squeeze in the juice of a lime wedge.

양배추-카치오-페페-Cacio-e-Pepe-Cabbage.title: Cacio e Pepe Cabbage
양배추-카치오-페페-Cacio-e-Pepe-Cabbage.intro:
20260204, #BreakfastDiary 1634, -2°C/cloudy
Cacio means cheese, pepe means pepper, so cacio e pepe is a simple Italian pasta made with nothing but (pecorino romano) cheese and pepper. Today it's cacio e pepe cabbage - made with cabbage instead of pasta.
Just as pepper was once used as a symbol of wealth among nobles in the Middle Ages, I agonized over which pepper to use among white, green, red, black, and even a five-pepper blend - and settled on black in the end. The original really is the best.
About 450kcal, Cacio e Pepe Cabbage.
양배추-카치오-페페-Cacio-e-Pepe-Cabbage.ingredients: 1/2 head cabbage, 2t whole black peppercorns, 1 cup pecorino romano cheese, salt, 1 lemon wedge
양배추-카치오-페페-Cacio-e-Pepe-Cabbage.steps:
1. Slice the cabbage thin and set aside.
2. Coarsely crush the whole black peppercorns in a mortar. (Grinding them finer would probably be better.)
3. Heat a pan over medium heat, add the crushed pepper, and toast for about 1 minute. Add 1T olive oil and 2T butter and cook a bit longer.
4. Add the cabbage and stir-fry until wilted. Once wilted, reduce to low heat, cover, and cook about 5 minutes until completely soft.
5. Add 2T water and mix well, then grate in the pecorino romano cheese - about 1/2 cup is enough. Mix thoroughly so the cheese melts in. Taste and season with salt.
6. Plate the cabbage and top with pecorino romano cheese and pepper. A squeeze of lemon would be nice too.

라디키오-샐러드-Radicchio-Salad.title: Radicchio Salad
라디키오-샐러드-Radicchio-Salad.intro:
20260203, #BreakfastDiary 1633, -9°C/clear
Every time I used lemon, lime, or orange zest, I fought a tough battle with my zester. Most of the time it only produced a tiny, very delicate amount of zest, and on days I wanted a bit more, I'd inevitably end up with an unwanted nick on my finger. Today I used a fine grater instead of the zester, and it felt like discovering a whole new world.
About 480kcal, Radicchio Salad.
라디키오-샐러드-Radicchio-Salad.ingredients: 1/2 head radicchio, 1T fried shallots, 1T walnuts, 1T hemp seeds, a little well-dried dates, (dressing) zest of 2 oranges and the juice of 1, plus 1T balsamic glaze, 1T balsamic vinegar, 3T olive oil, a pinch each of salt and pepper
라디키오-샐러드-Radicchio-Salad.steps:
1. Make the dressing. Grate the zest of 2 oranges and mix with the juice of 1, plus 1T balsamic glaze, 1T balsamic vinegar, 3T olive oil, and a pinch each of salt and pepper.
2. Pull the leaves off the radicchio, slice them long, and lay them on a plate. Pour over the dressing from step 1. Add a scoop of ricotta cheese and grated grana padano cheese.
3. Top with hemp seeds, crushed walnuts, and a little crispy dried dates. I meant to finish it off with a drizzle of balsamic glaze, but I forgot.

미소-가지구이-Miso-Glazed-Eggplant.title: Miso-Glazed Eggplant
미소-가지구이-Miso-Glazed-Eggplant.intro:
20260202, #BreakfastDiary 1632, -5°C/mostly clear
I had leftover kimizu きみず sauce from yesterday, so I thinned it with a little white wine vinegar and water, brushed it onto eggplant, and grilled it.
About 320kcal, Miso-Glazed Eggplant.
미소-가지구이-Miso-Glazed-Eggplant.ingredients: 1 eggplant, 1T almonds, a little chopped scallion, a little bonito flakes, (miso sauce) 3T miso, 3T white wine vinegar, 1/2T sugar, 1 egg yolk
미소-가지구이-Miso-Glazed-Eggplant.steps:
1. Cut the eggplant lengthwise into quarters, brush with the miso sauce (kimizu), and grill in a pan.
2. Top with pan-toasted chopped almonds and chopped scallion.

일본식-미소-두부구이-Miso-Glazed-Pan-Fried-Tofu.title: Miso-Glazed Pan-Fried Tofu
일본식-미소-두부구이-Miso-Glazed-Pan-Fried-Tofu.intro:
20260201, #BreakfastDiary 1631, -6°C/mostly sunny
There's a Japanese sauce called kimizu きみず. Kimi きみ means egg yolk and zu ず means vinegar, so it's literally egg yolk mixed with vinegar - something like a Japanese mayonnaise or hollandaise. Once I made it, I felt the texture should have come out a bit thinner
(the original recipe called for a mix of 2 parts rice vinegar to 1 part vinegar), but there wasn't time to second-guess it. So I tried to torch it, but the bonito flakes (katsuobushi) burned first - don't even think about trying that~ 😃
About 510kcal, Miso-Glazed Pan-Fried Tofu.
일본식-미소-두부구이-Miso-Glazed-Pan-Fried-Tofu.ingredients: 1/2 block tofu, 1/2 cup starch, a little bonito flakes, a little chopped scallion, (miso sauce) 3T miso, 3T white wine vinegar, 1/2T sugar, 1 egg yolk
일본식-미소-두부구이-Miso-Glazed-Pan-Fried-Tofu.steps:
1. Microwave the tofu for 2 minutes to drain moisture. Pat dry with a paper towel, cut into bite-sized pieces, coat evenly with starch, and pan-fry in oil. It came out similar to atsuage.
2. Make the miso sauce. Mix 3T miso, 2T white wine vinegar, 1/2T sugar, and 1 egg yolk together, then cook over low heat, stirring, until thickened.
3. Top the tofu from step 1 with bonito flakes, then the miso sauce from step 2. I tried torching it, but don't do that. Bake at 180°C (350°F) for about 10 minutes instead.
4. Plate it and top with a little chopped scallion right before eating.

일본-스타일-가지교자-Japanese-Style-Eggplant-Gyoj.title: Japanese-Style Eggplant Gyoza
일본-스타일-가지교자-Japanese-Style-Eggplant-Gyoj.intro:
20260131, #BreakfastDiary 1630, -11°C/mostly clear
Folded just once, lightly - 110kcal per piece, Japanese-Style Eggplant Gyoza.
일본-스타일-가지교자-Japanese-Style-Eggplant-Gyoj.ingredients: 1 eggplant, 30g mushrooms (any kind), salt, cooking oil, 7 dumpling wrappers, perilla leaves, (filling) a pinch of salt, 1t ginger, 1T miso, 2t sugar, 1T sesame oil, 1t starch, 1 egg, (sauce) 1T red wine vinegar, a pinch of salt, 1T sugar
일본-스타일-가지교자-Japanese-Style-Eggplant-Gyoj.steps:
1. Cut the eggplant into 1cm cubes, place in a tray, sprinkle with salt, and let sit for about 10 minutes. Squeeze out the moisture afterward.
2. Finely chop the mushrooms and sauté in a pan with olive oil.
3. Make the filling. In a mixing bowl, combine the mushrooms from step 2 with a pinch of salt, 1t ginger, 1T miso, 2t sugar, 1T sesame oil, 1t starch, and 1 egg, mixing well. (The mixture is runny - add more starch and sift it to thicken.)
4. Lay a halved perilla leaf on a dumpling wrapper, top with the filling from step 3, and fold lightly so the filling stays visible. Wetting the edges helps them stick together.
5. Pour cooking oil into a pan and pan-fry the dumplings from step 4 over low heat. Once the bottoms turn golden, add water, cover, and steam for about 2 minutes.
6. Mix 1T red wine vinegar, a pinch of salt, and 1T sugar for a dipping sauce.

두부와-아보카도를-넣은-메밀소면-샐러드-Tofu-Avocado-Buckw.title: Tofu and Avocado Buckwheat Noodle Salad
두부와-아보카도를-넣은-메밀소면-샐러드-Tofu-Avocado-Buckw.intro:
20260130, #BreakfastDiary 1629, -12°C/partly cloudy
About 600kcal, Tofu and Avocado Buckwheat Noodle Salad.
두부와-아보카도를-넣은-메밀소면-샐러드-Tofu-Avocado-Buckw.ingredients: 1 serving buckwheat noodles, 1/2 block tofu, 1/2 avocado, 5 stalks each of parsley and chopped scallion, (dressing) 1t minced garlic, 2T soy sauce, 1T olive oil, lime zest and lime juice, a pinch each of red chili flakes and salt
두부와-아보카도를-넣은-메밀소면-샐러드-Tofu-Avocado-Buckw.steps:
1. Cook the buckwheat noodles in salted boiling water. Add the cubed tofu and blanch it too. Drain the noodles first and rinse several times in cold water. Drain the tofu as well.
2. In a tray, mix chopped parsley with an equal amount of chopped scallion, 1t minced garlic, 2T soy sauce, 1T olive oil, lime zest and lime juice, just a pinch of red chili flakes (since it's breakfast), and a pinch of salt.
3. Add the cooked buckwheat noodles and tofu from step 1 into step 2, toss well, and plate. Top with cubed avocado.

문어-풋콩-두부-샐러드-Octopus-Adamame-Tofu-Salad.title: Octopus Edamame Tofu Salad
문어-풋콩-두부-샐러드-Octopus-Adamame-Tofu-Salad.intro:
20260129, #BreakfastDiary 1628, -11°C/sunny
The original recipe calls for rice vinegar, but I substituted white wine vinegar. Brewed vinegar has a much higher acidity (about 4 times that of rice vinegar), which can coagulate proteins like tofu and change the texture. It tasted a bit bland, so I added a splash of lemon juice, and the balance came together.
About 611kcal, Octopus Edamame Tofu Salad.
문어-풋콩-두부-샐러드-Octopus-Adamame-Tofu-Salad.ingredients: 1 cucumber, 1/2 block tofu, 150g octopus, 100g edamame, 1T hemp seeds, (dressing) 1T tahini, a pinch of salt, a pinch of sugar, 1t sesame oil, 1T white wine vinegar, and 1 lemon wedge
문어-풋콩-두부-샐러드-Octopus-Adamame-Tofu-Salad.steps:
1. Slice the cucumber into thin rounds, sprinkle with salt, let sit about 5 minutes, then squeeze out the moisture.
2. Microwave the tofu for 2 minutes to remove moisture, then tear it into bite-sized pieces by hand.
3. Pat the thawed octopus dry with a paper towel, cut into bite-sized pieces, and sear in a pan with olive oil until golden.
4. Make the dressing. In a mixing bowl, combine 1T tahini, a pinch of salt, a pinch of sugar, 1t sesame oil, and 1T white wine vinegar, mixing well.
5. Into the mixing bowl from step 4, add the octopus from step 3, the edamame, the cucumber from step 1, the tofu from step 2, and 1T hemp seeds, and toss well. Plate it. And add the juice of a lemon wedge.

대봉감-오버나이트-오트밀-Persimmon-Overnight-Oats.title: Persimmon Overnight Oats
대봉감-오버나이트-오트밀-Persimmon-Overnight-Oats.intro:
20260127, #BreakfastDiary 1627, -10°C/clear
The conclusion of my deliberation over how exactly to eat the last remaining daebong persimmon my mother gave me: persimmon overnight oats. The basic overnight oats formula is 1 cup oats, 1 cup milk, and 1T chia seeds, but I added hemp seeds too. Hemp seeds are a superfood packed with omega-3s and all 9 essential amino acids, and they're great for building muscle - so I confidently recommend them to anyone worried about muscle loss.
About 750kcal, Persimmon Overnight Oats.
대봉감-오버나이트-오트밀-Persimmon-Overnight-Oats.ingredients: 1 cup oats, 1T chia seeds, 1T hemp seeds, 1 cup milk, 1/2 daebong persimmon, a little granola, crisp dried dates
대봉감-오버나이트-오트밀-Persimmon-Overnight-Oats.steps:
1. Before bed, mix 1 cup oats, 1T chia seeds, 1T hemp seeds, and 1 cup milk in a bowl, and refrigerate overnight.
2. Take it out of the fridge and spoon the now-chewy oats into a cup, then top with 1 cup Greek yogurt, the persimmon, and granola. Add a few pieces of the crisp dried dates my mother lovingly made, too.

미소-소스에-볶은-양송이버섯을-곁들인-각종-채소-샐러드.title: Assorted Vegetable Salad with Miso-Sauce Sautéed Button Mushrooms
미소-소스에-볶은-양송이버섯을-곁들인-각종-채소-샐러드.intro:
20260126, #BreakfastDiary 1626, -11°C/cloudy
Since it's Monday, I prepare a salad in a spirit of repentance. About 550kcal, Assorted Vegetable Salad with Miso-Sauce Sautéed Button Mushrooms.
미소-소스에-볶은-양송이버섯을-곁들인-각종-채소-샐러드.ingredients: 5 leaves kale, 5 button mushrooms, 1 cup edamame, 1T beet sauerkraut, 1/2 cup black olives, 1 egg, pepper, lemon juice, (mushroom sauce) 2T soy sauce, 1T miso, 1T minced garlic, 1T maple syrup, (dressing) 2T olive oil, 1T red wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard
미소-소스에-볶은-양송이버섯을-곁들인-각종-채소-샐러드.steps:
1. Halve the button mushrooms, add to a pan with a little water and the sauce (2T soy sauce, 1T miso, 1T minced garlic, 1T maple syrup), and sauté.
2. Boil the edamame in boiling water.
3. Put chopped kale on a plate and top with olive oil, the mushrooms from step 1, the edamame from step 2, beet sauerkraut, and 1/2 cup black olives.
4. Place a poached egg in the center, drizzle with the dressing, and add a little dill and lemon juice.

기름에-튀기-듯-만들지는-못했지만-스페인식-완두콩-프리터-Green-Pe.title: (Not Quite Deep-Fried, But Close,) Spanish-Style Green Pea Fritters
기름에-튀기-듯-만들지는-못했지만-스페인식-완두콩-프리터-Green-Pe.intro:
20260125, #BreakfastDiary 1625, -12°C/clear
Unlike jeon (Korean pancakes), where the batter is the star, a fritter puts the ingredients front and center, cooked almost like deep-frying for a crispy texture. Making this, it occurred to me that Korea actually has something similar - the mung bean pancake (nokdujeon) sold at Gwangjang Market.
About 450kcal per serving, (Not Quite Deep-Fried, But Close,) Spanish-Style Green Pea Fritters.
기름에-튀기-듯-만들지는-못했지만-스페인식-완두콩-프리터-Green-Pe.ingredients:
(batter) 220g green peas, 1/2 cup flour (cake flour), 1t baking powder, 1 egg, 30ml milk, 1/2 onion, 1t grated garlic, 1/4 cup shredded cheese, a little chopped parsley, salt, pepper, 1t whole grain mustard
(dip) 1/2 cup Greek yogurt, 1t grated garlic, dill, lemon, olive oil, salt, pepper
(other) pepper, 1 lemon wedge
기름에-튀기-듯-만들지는-못했지만-스페인식-완두콩-프리터-Green-Pe.steps:
1. Boil the green peas in salted boiling water for 2-3 minutes. Drain and roughly mash half of them.
2. Combine the mashed peas from step 1 with the remaining whole peas in a mixing bowl, then add 1/2 cup flour (cake flour), 1t baking powder, 1 egg, 30ml milk, 1/2 onion, 1t grated garlic, 1/4 cup shredded cheese, a little chopped parsley, salt, pepper, and 1t whole grain mustard, and mix.
3. Heat olive oil in a pan, scoop out the batter from step 2 into rounds of a suitable size, and pan-fry. (They burn easily - cook slowly over low heat.)
4. Make the dip. Mix 1/2 cup Greek yogurt, 1t grated garlic, dill, lemon, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
5. Stack the pea fritters from step 3, top with the dip from step 4, then 1/4 avocado. Finish with pepper and a squeeze of lemon juice~

알배기에-얹어-먹는-아보카도-버섯-메밀국수-샐러드.title: Avocado Mushroom Buckwheat Noodle Salad over Napa Cabbage
알배기에-얹어-먹는-아보카도-버섯-메밀국수-샐러드.intro:
20260124, #BreakfastDiary 1624, -10°C/sunny
About 300kcal per serving, Avocado Mushroom Buckwheat Noodle Salad Served over Napa Cabbage.
알배기에-얹어-먹는-아보카도-버섯-메밀국수-샐러드.ingredients: napa cabbage leaves, 1/2 avocado, 5 shiitake mushrooms, 5 green olives, 1 serving buckwheat noodles, crushed pepper, olive oil, (dressing) 2T soy sauce, 1T sesame oil, 1T lemon juice, 1T red wine vinegar, 1t minced garlic
알배기에-얹어-먹는-아보카도-버섯-메밀국수-샐러드.steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a pan, sauté the thinly sliced shiitake mushrooms with a little salt and pepper, then add the green olives and sauté a bit more.
2. Cut the ripe avocado into cubes.
3. Make the dressing by mixing 2T soy sauce, 1T sesame oil, 1T lemon juice, 1T red wine vinegar, and 1t minced garlic (about 2 cloves).
4. Add the buckwheat noodles to boiling water, and once it boils, add cold water about three times while cooking. Rinse in cold water, rubbing the noodles together (chewiness 10+). Shake off the water, put the noodles in a mixing bowl, pour in half the dressing from step 3, and toss well.
5. Tear apart the napa cabbage leaves and top with the buckwheat noodles from step 4, the shiitake mushrooms and olives from step 1, and the avocado from step 2, then drizzle with the remaining dressing from step 3 and (if you want a spicy kick) a little crushed pepper.

애호박-고추장아찌-비빔국수.title: Zucchini and Gochu-Pickle Bibim Guksu
애호박-고추장아찌-비빔국수.intro:
20260123, #BreakfastDiary 1623, -13°C/cloudy
About 450kcal, Zucchini and Gochu-Pickle Bibim Guksu.
In English: Bibim Guksu with Perilla Oil Stir-Fried Zucchini and Gochu Pickles.
애호박-고추장아찌-비빔국수.ingredients: 1 serving noodles, 1/2 zucchini, 5 pickled green peppers (gochu-jangajji), 1T soy sauce, salt, perilla oil, black sesame seeds
애호박-고추장아찌-비빔국수.steps:
1. Julienne the zucchini with a mandoline, sprinkle with salt, let sit about 5 minutes, then gently squeeze out the moisture without crushing it.
2. Chop the pickled green peppers (Pulmuone brand) and sauté in perilla oil. Set aside, then sauté the zucchini from step 1 in perilla oil as well.
3. Boil the noodles, adding cold water about three times as it cooks. Rinse in cold water.
4. Put the boiled noodles in a bowl, top with 1T soy sauce, the perilla-sautéed zucchini, and the pickled peppers, and sprinkle with black sesame seeds. Add a little perilla oil right before eating.

가지-카포나타-Eggplant-Caponata.title: Eggplant Caponata
가지-카포나타-Eggplant-Caponata.intro:
20260122, #BreakfastDiary 1622, -15°C/clear
Eggplant Caponata is a signature eggplant dish from Sicily, Italy, known for its sweet-and-sour flavor. It's said to have originated from Arab influence during the conquest of Sicily, with the fish once used in noble dishes replaced by the eggplant that commoners could easily get their hands on - and that's how today's eggplant caponata was born. It's traditionally eaten cold, but today I'll have no choice but to eat it warm.
About 657kcal, Eggplant Caponata.
가지-카포나타-Eggplant-Caponata.ingredients: 1 slice sourdough, 2 eggplants, 1/2 onion (chopped), 3 cloves garlic (chopped), 1 can whole tomatoes (use 2/3 of it), 3T red wine vinegar, 1/2 cup each green and black olives, 1t honey, a little chopped parsley
가지-카포나타-Eggplant-Caponata.steps:
1. Dice the eggplant, sprinkle with salt, let sit about 20 minutes, then pat dry with a paper towel.
2. Sauté the chopped onion and garlic in olive oil in a pan. (1T capers would add nice umami here, but I happened to be out, so I skipped it.)
3. Add the eggplant from step 1 and the canned whole tomatoes (peeled tomatoes work too) to step 2, along with 3T red wine vinegar, and sauté until the eggplant softens.
4. Add the green and black olives and 1t honey, and mix well.
5. Top with chopped parsley.

Serve on sourdough.

명란우동.title: #MentaikoUdon
명란우동.intro:
20260121, #BreakfastDiary 1621, -14°C/cloudy
