rebread_bakery-호밀사워도우.title: @rebread_bakery #RyeSourdough
rebread_bakery-호밀사워도우.intro:
20250925 #breakfastdiary day 1519, 20°C/cloudy
Rye sourdough has more tang than regular (wheat) sourdough, and is a bit moister and chewier than plain wheat sourdough. I went back and forth for a while yesterday between the two, and I'm glad I chose the rye sourdough.
Meanwhile, I nearly managed to make the world's moistest Gordon Ramsay-style scrambled eggs, but pretty much failed — a 570kcal @rebread_bakery #ryesourdough topped with dry-ish scrambled eggs and creamy avocado
I kept the seasoning mild with tomorrow's health checkup in mind. If I'd loaded the sourdough with mayo and piled on the rest, it would've been pure heaven.
rebread_bakery-호밀사워도우.ingredients: 1 slice rye sourdough, 1/2 avocado, pepper, Maldon salt, (scrambled eggs) 2 eggs, 1T butter, a little salt and pepper, 1T milk
rebread_bakery-호밀사워도우.steps:
1. Slice the rye sourdough, brush with olive oil, and toast both sides until crisp.
2. In a small pan, melt 1T butter, beat in 2 eggs, and cook while stirring constantly, alternating between heat and off-heat. Once it looks moist enough — (I should have stopped right there to nail the moist texture) — add a little salt, pepper, and 1T milk, mix thoroughly to finish the moist scrambled eggs.
3. Top the rye sourdough with the scrambled eggs from step 2 and avocado, and finish with pepper and Maldon salt.

사테-닭꼬치.title: Satay Chicken Skewers
사테-닭꼬치.intro:
20250924 #breakfastdiary day 1518, 22°C/mostly cloudy, 20min/exercise (M)
Once you reach stage 3, a vast, boundless world of breakfast opens up. If time allows, there's nothing you can't eat. Cantonese-style steamed cod, with scallion and ginger to cut the fishy smell, topped with scallion and finished with sizzling hot oil poured over, would offer an exotic flavor. If it's the season for large sweet persimmons, you could enjoy them on toast, piled onto thick Greek yogurt. What about a small rice ball with seasonal greens? Simple, but it'd make for a filling meal. And that's not all — from various types of pasta to seasonal-ingredient hot-pot rice, a single meal can be rich and varied.
(Najoshik, 'I've Been Drinking Breakfast Every Day')
So, once you're at around stage 3, you reach the level where you can enjoy Singapore-style satay-marinated chicken skewers for breakfast.
Curious what breakfast stage 1 (beginner), stage 2 (intermediate), and the final boss stage are? Click the Brunch Book link in the profile to read the full piece!
Singapore-style satay sauce is peanut-based with a tangy-sweet character. Not sure why I even had this at home, but there was a store-bought sauce, so I used it. Marinated from midnight last night for about 6 hours — looks like Singapore-style #satay, but in the end it's really just #chickenskewers
사테-닭꼬치.ingredients: Chicken on skewers, (Singapore-style) satay sauce, scallion, cherry tomatoes, oil, pepper
사테-닭꼬치.steps:
1. Line a tray with parchment paper, place the chicken skewers, brush with satay sauce, and marinate overnight.
2. Grill the chicken skewers on a pan, brushing with vegetable oil as you go.
3. Skewer the scallion and tomato as well, sprinkle with pepper, and grill.

아보카도-리코타치즈-토스트.title: Avocado Ricotta Cheese Toast
아보카도-리코타치즈-토스트.intro:
20250923 #breakfastdiary day 1517, 18°C/cloudy
About 60% of the world's population uses tools like chopsticks, spoons, forks, and knives to eat. The remaining 40%, in a hand-eating culture found across India, other parts of South Asia, the Middle East, Africa, and some of Southeast Asia, use their hands instead of tools. That's more than you'd think. Anyway, if you trace the origin of the tools people use to eat, it's probably efficiency and utility that mattered more than taste or preference. Cutting food into manageable pieces, sometimes stabbing or picking it up — the main goal, one way or another, was getting food to the mouth as efficiently as possible.
(Najoshik, 'A Cultural History of Eating Utensils' from Everyday Breakfast)
The 12th episode of Everyday Breakfast, now well into its second half, and the final episode of its 'Moments of Enjoying Breakfast' arc — 'A Cultural History of Eating Utensils' — has been published. ☝️Check the Brunch Book link in the profile.
Today, I set aside spoon, chopsticks, fork, and knife and gladly join the 40% of the world in the hand-eating culture. Eaten casually by hand, with turnips marinated in tahini dressing on the side — an approx. 500kcal avocado ricotta cheese toast
아보카도-리코타치즈-토스트.ingredients: 1 serving slab bread, 1/2 Japanese turnip (kokabu), 1T ricotta cheese, 1/2 avocado, olive oil, salt, pepper, a few mint leaves, (marinade dressing) 1T tahini, 2t soy sauce, 1t toasted sesame salt and 1t mixed herbs, 1t lemon juice
아보카도-리코타치즈-토스트.steps:
1. Brush the slab bread with olive oil and toast in a pan.
2. Mix 1T tahini, 2t soy sauce, 1t toasted sesame salt and 1t mixed herbs, and 1t lemon juice to make the dressing. (I meant to combine the sesame salt and mixed herbs for a za'atar-like flavor, but it was too thick as-is, so just use 1t total of sesame salt plus mixed herbs.)
3. Julienne the Japanese turnip a bit thick for a crisp texture, and marinate in the dressing from step 2.
4. Whip 1T ricotta cheese with a little olive oil.
5. On the slab bread, neatly arrange the whipped ricotta from step 4 and sliced avocado, then top with the marinated turnip from step 3 and pepper.

그린바나나-100-로-만든-글루텐프리-비건-동시에-고칼륨-고철분-푸실리.title: Green Banana (100% Green Banana, Gluten-Free, Vegan, and High in Potassium and Iron) #Fusilli
그린바나나-100-로-만든-글루텐프리-비건-동시에-고칼륨-고철분-푸실리.intro:
20250922 #breakfastdiary day 1516, 17°C/cloudy, 20min/exercise (M)
Then, following what I wrote in my notes, I prep and cook the ingredients. But the vegetable I meant to boil ends up blanched in hot water for one reason or another, and whether because of that or because it wasn't in the steamer long enough, the vegetable-packed steamed egg loses its shape and runs everywhere even after cooking is done. Some days I mess up the heat and add more water, then taste it and find it bland, so I add more salt or soy sauce, and it ends up tasting like nothing I've ever had before. There's no time to start over, so I hastily fix it with seasoned salt or chicken stock. Again, an all-purpose cheat code that can rescue a moment of crisis. Of course, the original ingredients' flavor is gone. It ends up tasting like broccoli eaten just for the chojang sauce, but it can't be helped.
(Najoshik, 'The Recipe's Golden Rule' from Everyday Breakfast) *unpublished piece.
I meant to roast the eggplant and tomato in the oven but didn't have time, so I pan-fried them instead, and the ricotta cheese I meant to whip with basil pesto ended up used straight from the tub. On top of that, something felt off, and I realized I'd forgotten the grana padano cheese I was supposed to top it with at the end.
Breakfast, work, life — none of it ever goes exactly according to the planned recipe. But that's fine. After all, I still got to eat breakfast, didn't I?
Green banana refers to unripe banana, which has less sugar and higher starch content, so it's widely used for cooking abroad.
A 610kcal #fusilli made from 100% green banana, served with roasted eggplant and tomato and tossed in ricotta cheese
그린바나나-100-로-만든-글루텐프리-비건-동시에-고칼륨-고철분-푸실리.ingredients: 1 eggplant, 10 cherry tomatoes, 2 cups fusilli, 2T ricotta cheese, five or six basil leaves
그린바나나-100-로-만든-글루텐프리-비건-동시에-고칼륨-고철분-푸실리.steps:
1. Cut the eggplant and tomato into 1cm pieces, add salt, herbs, and olive oil, and pan-fry.
2. Cook the green banana fusilli in salted boiling water.
3. In the pan from step 1, add 2T ricotta cheese, the boiled fusilli, 1/2 cup pasta water, and basil, and mix thoroughly. That's it.

써니사이드업-에그-앤-포테이토.title: Sunny-Side-Up Egg and Potatoes
써니사이드업-에그-앤-포테이토.intro:
20250921 #breakfastdiary day 1515, 18°C/partly cloudy, 20min/exercise (M)
The climate crisis always reaches the powerless first. The animals with no words to demand cooling for their barns; the elderly farmers who go out to check on the crops they've tended their whole lives, worried about the midday heat; the workers sorting and delivering packages and working at construction sites — among them especially, migrant workers in vulnerable legal positions — collapse and die. When Seoul flooded in the summer of 2022, poor people living in semi-basement rooms died. Climate disaster is not fair. There are always people pushed to the front line of natural disasters first, and forgotten by the world first once the crisis passes.
(Jeong Bo-ra, 'Let's Shout Climate Justice Together')
Once again, I look back and wonder whether I myself have been fueling the climate crisis and climate disasters in my daily life.
An approx. 400kcal sunny-side-up egg and potatoes, served with ricotta cheese brightened with lemon juice
써니사이드업-에그-앤-포테이토.ingredients: 2 potatoes, 2T ricotta cheese, 1T lemon juice, 2 eggs, salt, pepper, basil and basil powder
써니사이드업-에그-앤-포테이토.steps:
1. Wash the potatoes thoroughly and cut into wedges, skin on. Sprinkle with olive oil, salt, pepper, and basil, mix thoroughly, and air-fry for 10 minutes.
2. Whip 2T ricotta cheese with 1T lemon juice.
3. Sprinkle 2 eggs with salt, pepper, and basil, and fry sunny-side up.
4. Plate the Greek yogurt (ricotta) from step 2, the fried egg from step 3, and the potatoes from step 1, and finish with basil leaves and olive oil.

아사이보울-을-먹으면서-같이-먹을-친구를-생각했는데-아무래도-아사이보울은.title: While eating my #AcaiBowl, I thought about a friend to share it with — but I think acai bowls are probably better enjoyed alone.
아사이보울-을-먹으면서-같이-먹을-친구를-생각했는데-아무래도-아사이보울은.intro:
20250920 #breakfastdiary day 1514, 21°C/cloudy
Besides, patbingsu is a dessert of cooperation and friendship. First, you have to gently coax and scoop from all sides of the ice mountain with your spoon; second, there must be no mishap of spilling the contents outside the bowl; and third, the ratio of toppings to ice must run out perfectly together down to the very last spoonful. If only ice is left and the stage ends on a bland note, that's such a letdown! If you have a friend who can get through all of the above with you, without a word, just through eye contact alone — that friend is a true soulmate!
('Patbingsu,' Summer Dictionary)
I've been reading @achimdal.books's #SummerDictionary.
Not patbingsu, but with a similar bingsu-like feel, an approx. 465kcal #acaibowl — while eating it I thought about a friend to share it with, but I think acai bowls are probably better enjoyed alone.
아사이보울-을-먹으면서-같이-먹을-친구를-생각했는데-아무래도-아사이보울은.ingredients: (base) 1/2 cup Greek yogurt, 1T acai berry powder, 1 banana, 1t hemp seeds, 1t chia seeds, 1t walnuts, (toppings) granola, (frozen) blueberries and strawberries, shine muscat grapes, banana and peanut butter — top with whatever you like
아사이보울-을-먹으면서-같이-먹을-친구를-생각했는데-아무래도-아사이보울은.steps:
1. Blend 1/2 cup Greek yogurt, 1T acai berry powder, 1 banana, 1t hemp seeds, 1t chia seeds, and 1t walnuts, and pour into a bowl.
2. Top with granola, blueberries, strawberries, shine muscat, banana, and peanut butter.

구운-파프리카.title: Roasted Bell Peppers
구운-파프리카.intro:
20250919 #breakfastdiary day 1513, 19°C/cloudy
Usually, adding a bit of whole grain mustard to a vinaigrette boosts the umami, but today I used salted pollock roe instead. Not only does it add umami, its flavor is every bit as good as whole grain mustard.
An approx. 729kcal roasted bell pepper, served with fresh basil and burrata cheese and a pollock-roe vinaigrette
구운-파프리카.ingredients: 1/2 red bell pepper, 1/2 yellow bell pepper, a little basil leaves, 1 burrata cheese, (dressing) 3T olive oil, 1T red wine vinegar, 1t salted pollock roe
구운-파프리카.steps:
1. Cut the bell peppers into 2-3cm pieces lengthwise, toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper, and roast in a 200°C oven for 25 minutes.
2. Mix 3T olive oil, 1T red wine vinegar, and 1t salted pollock roe (instead of whole grain mustard) thoroughly.
3. Plate the roasted bell peppers with basil and burrata cheese, and pour the dressing from step 2 generously on top~

참치-토마토-국수.title: Tuna Tomato Noodles
참치-토마토-국수.intro:
20250918 #breakfastdiary day 1512, 19°C/cloudy, 20min/exercise (M)
An approx. 361kcal tuna tomato noodles, using Greek yogurt instead of mayo in the dressing for a healthier touch
참치-토마토-국수.ingredients: 1/2 serving somyeon (thin wheat noodles), 1t salted pollock roe, 5 cherry tomatoes, 1 can tuna, 10 perilla leaves, a little black sesame seeds, (dressing) 1T soy sauce, 1T lemon juice, 1T oligosaccharide syrup, 1T Greek yogurt
참치-토마토-국수.steps:
1. Mix 1T soy sauce, 1T lemon juice, 1T oligosaccharide syrup, and 1T Greek yogurt thoroughly to make the dressing.
2. Halve the cherry tomatoes and roll and slice the perilla leaves.
3. Boil the somyeon, adding cold water as it boils, then rinse in cold water.
4. Put the somyeon in a mixing bowl, add the canned tuna, cherry tomatoes, and perilla leaves, add the dressing from step 1, and mix thoroughly.
5. Plate and top with pollock roe and a little black sesame seeds.

그릭요거트-바나나-보울.title: Greek Yogurt Banana Bowl
그릭요거트-바나나-보울.intro:
20250917 #breakfastdiary day 1511, 22°C/rain
How does a feeling arrive?
Like a blossom's first bloom on a tree
Does a feeling arrive that way?
Like a blossom's first fall from a tree
Does a feeling fade that way?
A drop of water on paper
takes a long time to dry
and where the drop disappears
a stain forms, twisted,
a mark that will not erase
(Lee Seong-bok, 'Feeling')
Today too, after emptying a full plate, I head to work carrying the ingredients' indelible mark and lingering aftertaste.
Approx. 550kcal Greek yogurt banana bowl
그릭요거트-바나나-보울.ingredients: 1 banana, 2T Greek yogurt, strawberries, mango, blueberries or other frozen fruit of choice, granola, pistachios, etc.
그릭요거트-바나나-보울.steps: 1. Halve the banana and place on a plate. Add a generous amount of Greek yogurt, top with strawberries, mango, blueberries, granola, pistachios, and any other toppings you like, and finish with peanut butter.

말차-참치-오차즈케.title: Matcha Tuna Ochazuke
말차-참치-오차즈케.intro:
20250916 #breakfastdiary day 1510, 22°C/mostly cloudy, 20min/exercise (M)
Once you're used to stage 1, try venturing into the lighter stage 2 — solid food and salads. A boiled egg gives your muscles strength, and sourdough topped with ricotta cheese and a perfectly ripe avocado adds healthy fats and vitamins for glowing skin. For a stomach left sensitive after a day of stress, potato is the perfect fix — cut into rough chunks, brushed with olive oil, tossed with salt and pepper, air-fried for 10 minutes, and served with chimichurri sauce, it makes for a beautiful meal. If you don't mind vegetables, salad works well too. Pair a vinaigrette dressing — a kind of all-purpose 'universal soy sauce' that goes with any salad (3 tablespoons olive oil, 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar, 1 teaspoon whole grain mustard — I think this ratio is the golden ratio) — with tomato, cucumber, bell pepper, broccoli, asparagus, cauliflower, lettuce, and other vegetables of your choice.
(Najoshik, 'I've Been Drinking Breakfast Every Day')
If breakfast feels hard, try a staged approach: stage 1 liquid food, stage 2 solid food, stage 3 anything-goes food. From there, you might even reach the hidden stage beyond stage 3.
Curious what that hidden stage is? Read the fresh new episode of the Brunch Book via the profile link.
Steeped in matcha, but its essential nature as a solid meal remains unchanged — 191kcal matcha tuna ochazuke
말차-참치-오차즈케.ingredients: 1/2 bowl brown rice, 1/2 can tuna, 1/4t matcha, 2t tsuyu, 1/2t mirin, furikake, a little spinach
말차-참치-오차즈케.steps:
1. Mix 1/4t matcha into 300ml lukewarm water thoroughly, then add 2t tsuyu and 1/2t mirin and mix a bit more to prepare the base.
2. Drain the oil from the canned tuna and keep only the flesh.
3. Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 20 seconds, lightly squeeze out the water, and chop finely.
4. In a bowl, add the brown rice, furikake, tuna from step 2, and spinach from step 3.
5. Pour over the matcha broth from step 1.

사과-크리스프.title: Apple Crisp
사과-크리스프.intro:
20250915 #breakfastdiary day 1509, 22°C/partly cloudy
Since I made it in a hurry, it looks (on the surface) like a sugar bomb, but despite appearances it's actually fairly moderate in sugar. A generally well-balanced 350kcal apple crisp, served with Greek yogurt
사과-크리스프.ingredients: 1 apple, 1T oatmeal, 1T hemp seeds, 2t cinnamon, 2T Greek yogurt, 1T peanut butter
사과-크리스프.steps:
1. In a heated pan, add olive oil and 1 chopped apple and sauté to cook off moisture, then add 1T oatmeal, 1T hemp seeds, and 2t cinnamon, and cook until the oatmeal turns crisp.
2. Transfer to a bowl and top with 2T Greek yogurt and peanut butter.

구운-채소-바질페스토-슬랩-오픈샌드위치.title: Roasted Vegetable Basil Pesto Slab Open-Faced Sandwich
구운-채소-바질페스토-슬랩-오픈샌드위치.intro:
20250914 #breakfastdiary day 1508, 24°C/cloudy, 20min/exercise (M)
I was short on ricotta cheese so I mixed in half mascarpone cheese instead, and it tastes great (of course).
Approx. 530kcal roasted vegetable basil pesto slab open-faced sandwich
구운-채소-바질페스토-슬랩-오픈샌드위치.ingredients: 1 serving slab bread, 1/2 bell pepper, 1/2 zucchini, 0.5T each ricotta cheese and mascarpone cheese, olive oil, salt, pepper, 1T basil pesto
구운-채소-바질페스토-슬랩-오픈샌드위치.steps:
1. Thaw the slab bread, brush with olive oil, and toast both sides until crisp.
2. Wash the bell pepper, cut into quarters, drizzle with olive oil in a pan, sprinkle with salt and pepper, and grill both sides. Shave the zucchini thin with a grater and grill alongside.
3. Whip the ricotta and mascarpone cheese with a little olive oil.
4. Top the slab bread with the whipped cheese from step 3, the bell pepper and zucchini from step 2, and finish with basil pesto.

땅콩호박-시금치-프리타타.title: Butternut Squash and Spinach Frittata
땅콩호박-시금치-프리타타.intro:
20250913 #breakfastdiary day 1507, 24°C/mostly cloudy
A quite beautiful-looking approx. 530kcal butternut squash and spinach frittata
땅콩호박-시금치-프리타타.ingredients: 1 small onion, 100g butternut squash, a handful of spinach, 2 eggs, 1/3 cup milk, 2T cheddar cheese, 1/2t whole grain mustard, olive oil, salt, pepper
땅콩호박-시금치-프리타타.steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté the chopped onion. Add a little basil powder.
2. Add the butternut squash and cook for about 5 minutes until done. Add the spinach, sauté until wilted, then transfer to a pound cake mold.
3. Mix 2 eggs, 1/3 cup milk, 1T cheddar cheese, 1/2t whole grain mustard, salt, and pepper thoroughly. Pour over the mixture in step 2 and top with the remaining 1T cheddar cheese.
4. Bake at 180°C for 25 minutes.

망고-살사.title: Mango Salsa
망고-살사.intro:
20250912 #breakfastdiary day 1506, 21°C/cloudy
Something to wake up a sluggish Friday morning — ratios of each ingredient to taste (including rye crackers), approx. 180kcal mango salsa
망고-살사.ingredients: 3T apple mango, 1T red onion, 2T cucumber, 2T avocado, 2T cherry tomato, 1T mint plus 1T lime and salt, pepper
망고-살사.steps:
1. Mix 3T apple mango, 1T red onion, 2T cucumber, 2T avocado, 2T cherry tomato, 1T mint, 1T lime juice, salt, and pepper thoroughly. Done.
2. Serve on crackers, pita bread, or tortillas.

청무화과-리코타-까르파초.title: Green Fig and Ricotta Carpaccio
청무화과-리코타-까르파초.intro:
20250911 #breakfastdiary day 1505, 17°C/clear
I considered a wide range of candidates — young radish leaves, spinach, curly endive, seomcho (island spinach) — and over years of breakfasts I've clinically tested them all. Young radish leaves turned out too tough and pungent; baby spinach was too sweet and soft to replace arugula; curly endive, which I thought would be similar in taste and shape, turned out too bitter and overwhelmed everything around it; and seomcho was too thick and coarse. One day, walking down the street, I spotted dandelion leaves sprouting from the ground and thought — could this be the perfect arugula substitute? — but a stable supply would be hard, and eating dandelions that grew by the road could cause something far worse than an arugula allergy. I hear there are also arugula-lookalikes like sow thistle and Korean lettuce (gotgidaengi), but I haven't tried those yet.
(Najoshik, 'No Thanks to Arugula' from Everyday Breakfast)
☝️ This is the freshly published episode from a couple days ago (a bit out of season for this weather).
The original recipe calls for arugula, but since I have an allergy, I substituted sweet, soft baby spinach. Pretty good!
Approx. 380kcal green fig and ricotta carpaccio
청무화과-리코타-까르파초.ingredients: 5 green figs, 2T ricotta cheese (whipped with a little olive oil, salt, and pepper), baby spinach, pistachios, olive oil, salt
청무화과-리코타-까르파초.steps:
1. Wash the green figs thoroughly, place on a plate, and press flat.
2. Whip the ricotta cheese with a little olive oil, salt, and pepper, and spread over the figs. Add a little salt on top.
3. Top with baby spinach, chopped pistachios, and olive oil.

망고-패션후르츠-오버나이트-오츠.title: Mango #PassionFruit Overnight Oats
망고-패션후르츠-오버나이트-오츠.intro:
20250910 #breakfastdiary day 1504, 20°C/clear, 20min/exercise (M)
Managing my diet ahead of an upcoming health checkup. This week's breakfasts will mostly be liquid/soft foods. Making these, I've found that overnight oats — a 'breakfast made by the night before' — have the advantage of making the morning commute feel more spacious.
☝️Curious about 'breakfast made by the night'? Follow the ongoing Brunch Book series, Everyday Breakfast, via the profile link.
Passion fruit often gets an odd reaction because it looks like frog eggs, but it's actually a really charming fruit. There's a lot to say especially about its name — I'll save that for another time.
Today's passion fruit is domestic, from Jeju Island. Things have really come to that point now.
Because of its tart-sweet flavor, it pairs well with dairy like milk and yogurt — so I loaded it with milk and Greek yogurt and let it sit overnight: an approx. 376kcal mango #passionfruit overnight oats
망고-패션후르츠-오버나이트-오츠.ingredients: 1 cup oatmeal, 2t chia seeds, 1 cup milk, 1 cup Greek yogurt, 6T finely chopped mango, 1T maple syrup, 1t vanilla extract, a pinch of salt, 2 passion fruit
망고-패션후르츠-오버나이트-오츠.steps:
1. In a bowl, combine 1 cup oatmeal, 2t chia seeds, 1 cup milk, 1 cup Greek yogurt, 6T chopped mango, 1T maple syrup, 1t vanilla extract, and a pinch of salt, and mix thoroughly. Refrigerate overnight.
2. Put the flesh of 1 passion fruit into a bowl, pour the oatmeal from step 1 over it, and top with the flesh of the second passion fruit.

요새-한참-유행-중인-티라미수-치아-푸딩.title: The Currently Very-Trendy Tiramisu Chia Pudding
요새-한참-유행-중인-티라미수-치아-푸딩.intro:
20250909 #breakfastdiary day 1503, 21°C/cloudy
With the once-a-year health checkup coming up, I decided to manage my diet. I know breakfast probably doesn't matter all that much, but figured there might be at least a little placebo effect, so following yesterday, today is another #OvernightOats day.
Given all that, I went back and forth all morning over whether to add mascarpone cheese to this healthy #chiapudding breakfast — but in the end, mascarpone won.
Approx. 285kcal per serving of the currently very-trendy tiramisu chia pudding
요새-한참-유행-중인-티라미수-치아-푸딩.ingredients: 1.5 cups Greek yogurt, 1/4 cup milk, 4T chia seeds, 1/3 cup coffee, 1T maple syrup, 1t vanilla extract, 2T mascarpone cheese, a little cocoa powder and cacao nibs
요새-한참-유행-중인-티라미수-치아-푸딩.steps:
1. In a bowl, combine 1.5 cups Greek yogurt, 1/4 cup milk, 4T chia seeds, 1/3 cup coffee, 1T maple syrup, and 1t vanilla extract, and mix thoroughly. Refrigerate overnight.
2. Fill a bowl generously with the mixture from step 1, top with mascarpone cheese, dust with cocoa powder, and finish with a little cacao nibs.

말차-치아-라떼-푸딩.title: Matcha Chia Latte Pudding
말차-치아-라떼-푸딩.intro:
20250908 #breakfastdiary day 1502, 21°C/mostly cloudy, 20min/exercise (M)
So 'the first time making a breakfast' always comes with difficulty. Some days the taste and plating turn out exactly as I hoped, while other days it's bland and I have to grate in extra parmigiano reggiano to fix the seasoning, or the 'bomb' steamed egg doesn't explode the way I imagined, leaving me despairing in front of a deflated steamed egg. (omitted) Like the line from Between Calmness and Passion (2001) — not knowing 'when, and how much, to open your heart' — 'the first time making a breakfast' is always difficult, because I still don't quite know when and by how much to adjust the heat, the doneness of ingredients, and the seasoning.
(Najoshik, 'Lonely or Sad, I Still Have to Eat' from Everyday Breakfast)
☝️Full piece linked in the profile~
For the reasons above, a freshly invented recipe often goes through trial and error. I let it sit overnight, but it turned out a bit on the runny side, so next time I'll use only 300ml milk. I think 1t matcha and 2t syrup would taste even better. Whisking the matcha into lukewarm water (30ml) first and using only 250ml milk might also work well.
Approx. 280kcal per serving matcha chia latte pudding
말차-치아-라떼-푸딩.ingredients: 3T chia seeds, 2t matcha, 325ml milk, 1t maple syrup, 1/2t vanilla extract also, 2T Greek yogurt
말차-치아-라떼-푸딩.steps:
1. In a bowl, combine 3T chia seeds and 2t matcha, then pour in 325ml milk. Add 1t maple syrup and 1/2t vanilla extract, mix thoroughly, and refrigerate overnight.
2. Portion into a cup and top with 2T Greek yogurt and a little matcha.

딸기-아보카도-샐러드.title: Strawberry Avocado Salad
딸기-아보카도-샐러드.intro:
20250907 #breakfastdiary day 1501, 26°C/cloudy, 20min/exercise (M)
A tall Starbucks caffè latte costs $4.10 in Korea, $3.30 in the US, and $3.60 in Japan. In Deutsche Bank's global city price ranking, Seoul came in 8th, after Geneva, San Francisco, Zurich, and others.
(Slow News, Sept. 4)
Seoul is indeed a world-class city. Still, worth reflecting on whether its other metrics are equally world-class, and whether there are indicators to be less than proud of.
Would've been even better with mint, but nothing to complain about as-is — a 485kcal strawberry avocado salad, with hemp seeds added for extra nutrition
딸기-아보카도-샐러드.ingredients: 1 avocado, 1 cup frozen strawberries, 1T walnuts, (dressing) 3T olive oil, 2T lemon juice, 1T hemp seeds, honey and salt, pepper
딸기-아보카도-샐러드.steps:
1. Mix 3T olive oil, 2T lemon juice, 1T hemp seeds, a little honey, salt, and pepper thoroughly to make the dressing.
2. Slightly thaw the frozen strawberries, halve them, pour about half the dressing from step 1 over them, and let sit for about 10 minutes.
3. Peel the avocado, cut into long slices, plate, and top with the marinated strawberries from step 2, chopped walnuts, and the dressing from step 1.

베리-아보카도-스무디-볼.title: Berry Avocado Smoothie Bowl
베리-아보카도-스무디-볼.intro:
20250906 #breakfastdiary day 1500, 27°C/drizzle
For people who've made a habit of skipping breakfast, breakfast can feel like an unfamiliar, burdensome ritual. If so, just as a body waking from a long winter's sleep gradually starts moving again, breakfast too might be approached in stages. Stage 1 recommends liquids or soft, flowing foods. For a digestive system that's been resting all night, a gentle, flowing liquid feels more familiar than sudden solid food. A smoothie with fruits and vegetables in harmony will wake the body naturally, like morning sunlight. Breakfast made by pouring warm milk over oatmeal will bring the peaceful scenery of a rural morning; the tangy-sweetness of Greek yogurt will bring the vitality of the Mediterranean. A bowl of porridge will wrap the stomach warmly, like a mother's touch. Even something as simple as 200ml of hot water with 1t miso and a few small pieces of tofu can make the morning feel abundant.
(Najoshik, 'I've Been Drinking Breakfast Every Day')
Adding chia seeds, hemp seeds, and Greek yogurt to frozen fruit for texture, fullness, and nutrition all at once — approx. 277kcal per serving berry avocado smoothie bowl
베리-아보카도-스무디-볼.ingredients: 1.5 frozen bananas, 1 cup strawberries, 1T avocado, 2T Greek yogurt, 1T each chia seeds and hemp seeds, (toppings) 0.5 frozen banana, 1T blackberries, 1T each pistachios and granola
베리-아보카도-스무디-볼.steps:
1. In a blender, blend 1.5 frozen bananas, 1 cup frozen strawberries, 1T frozen avocado, 2T Greek yogurt, 1T chia seeds, and 1T hemp seeds into a thick smoothie.
2. Pour into a bowl and top with banana, blackberries, pistachios, and granola.

청경채-에그-또띠아-베이크.title: Bok Choy Egg Tortilla Bake
청경채-에그-또띠아-베이크.intro:
20250905 #breakfastdiary 1499, 24°C/mostly clear, 20 min/workout(M) 
Always racing the clock before work — making breakfast, photographing it, eating it — so I have this persistent wish to actually enjoy a leisurely breakfast in a sunlit kitchen someday. Photos especially depend so much on light, that the same breakfast at the same time can look like the last breakfast served from hell, or like a warm bowl of comfort straight from your mother's hands, depending on the weather and season. 
(My breakfast diary — not that I'm jealous of Rembrandt lighting or anything)
It had been a while since I got such nice sunlight streaming onto the table. It's that kind of season now. 
September 23rd is the autumn equinox, so the nights will start getting longer from here, and I figure there aren't many days left where I can lean on light like this to enjoy breakfast. 
A 310kcal (per serving) bok choy egg tortilla bake, made with bok choy instead of spinach
청경채-에그-또띠아-베이크.ingredients: 1 tortilla, 3 eggs, 2T ricotta cheese, a good handful of bok choy, 2T mozzarella cheese, salt, pepper, olive oil
청경채-에그-또띠아-베이크.steps:
1. Lay the tortilla in an oven-safe dish, crack in the 3 eggs, add a bit of salt and pepper, the ricotta, bok choy, and mozzarella, then drizzle with a little olive oil. 
2. Bake at 180°C for 20 minutes. 

Let it cool a bit, then eat with sriracha or ketchup on the side.

버터넛스쿼시-사워도우-토스트.title: Butternut Squash Sourdough Toast
버터넛스쿼시-사워도우-토스트.intro:
20250904 #breakfastdiary 1498, 23°C/rain
Sending my congratulations to #Golden for its 3rd straight week at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 — here's a roughly 600kcal butternut squash sourdough toast: nutty butternut squash pan-roasted until evenly golden, salty halloumi also pan-seared for extra flavor, all wrapped in whipped ricotta with olive oil, finished with a drizzle of honey.
버터넛스쿼시-사워도우-토스트.ingredients: 2 slices sourdough, 1/2 butternut squash, 2T (worth of) halloumi cheese, olive oil, salt, pepper, herbs, a little honey
버터넛스쿼시-사워도우-토스트.steps:
1. Brush the sourdough with olive oil and toast until crisp on both sides. 
2. Peel the butternut squash, cut into medium dice, and roast in a pan with olive oil, salt, pepper, and herbs until golden. 
3. Cut the halloumi into similar-sized pieces and pan-sear in olive oil until golden. 
4. Whip 2T ricotta with olive oil, salt, and pepper. 
5. Spread the whipped ricotta from step 4 onto the sourdough from step 1, then top with the butternut squash from step 2 and the halloumi from step 3. Finish today's version with a drizzle of honey.

고등어-오차즈케.title: Mackerel #Ochazuke
고등어-오차즈케.intro:
20250903 #breakfastdiary 1497, 23°C/mostly overcast, 20 min/workout(M)
I put 1/2t of matcha into 400ml of water and it turned way too green. Tastes fine, but it ended up looking like some sci-fi fantasy breakfast that Shrek, Loki, the Hulk, or maybe Doctor Doom would eat. 
A roughly 400kcal mackerel #ochazuke
고등어-오차즈케.ingredients: 1/2 bowl brown rice, 1 pack of store-bought mackerel, a bit of furikake, 1T chives, 1/4t matcha, 1T tsuyu
고등어-오차즈케.steps:
1. Mix 1/4t matcha and 1t tsuyu into 400ml of lukewarm water. 
2. Heat the store-bought mackerel in the microwave. 
3. Put the brown rice in a bowl, top with furikake, the mackerel from step 2, and chopped chives. 
4. Pour over the matcha mixture from step 1.

뢰스티-감자.title: Potato Rösti
뢰스티-감자.intro:
20250902 #breakfastdiary 1496, 22°C/mostly overcast
The 9th episode of my daily-breakfast series on Brunch just went up. After the episodes about planning and making breakfast, the next four episodes, running every Tuesday, will be about the experience of eating breakfast. This 9th episode carries the rather fitting subtitle 'The moment you savor breakfast,' and is titled 'Why I don't mix my bibimbap?' Curious? There's a link in my profile. 
#Rösti with a surprisingly high-calorie carrot rapée on the side, for a breakfast dish anyway
뢰스티-감자.ingredients: 3 small red potatoes, 2T butter, salt, 1 small carrot, a little Grana Padano cheese, (rapée dressing) 3T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard
뢰스티-감자.steps:
1. Peel 3 small red potatoes, shred with a mandoline, then wring them out hard in a cheesecloth to remove moisture. 
2. Put them in a mixing bowl, sprinkle with salt, and mix evenly. (Adding about 1t of starch makes it crispier.)
3. Melt butter in a pan, add the shredded potato from step 2, and cook slowly over low heat on both sides. (I melted 1T of butter and mixed it into the batter.) 
4. Meanwhile, shred one small carrot with a mandoline and mix with 3T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, and 1t whole grain mustard. 
5. Plate the rösti from step 3, top with the carrot rapée from step 4, and finish with a little Grana Padano cheese.

스파이시-코코넛-만두전골.title: Spicy Coconut Dumpling Hot Pot
스파이시-코코넛-만두전골.intro:
20250901 #breakfastdiary 1495, 24°C/rain, 20 min/workout(M)
The sauce has chili paste, tomato sauce, gochujang, soy sauce, miso, vinegar, and coconut milk in it. Before I made it, I figured mixing coconut milk and gochujang and simmering it briefly would get me close enough. But after tasting it, I realized there's a reason certain things need time and the full list of ingredients. 
A roughly 660kcal spicy coconut dumpling hot pot
스파이시-코코넛-만두전골.ingredients: 5 dumplings, a handful of bok choy, 3 cloves minced garlic, 1T chili paste, 2T tomato sauce, 3T gochujang, 2T soy sauce, 1T miso, 1T vinegar, and 400ml coconut milk
스파이시-코코넛-만두전골.steps:
1. In an oven-safe dish, pour in 1T chili paste, 2T tomato sauce, 3T gochujang, 2T soy sauce, 1T miso, 1T vinegar, and 400ml coconut milk, add a handful of bok choy and 3 cloves minced garlic, and mix well. 
2. Add the dumplings and heat in a 200°C oven for 20 minutes. 
3. Top with chopped scallions, sesame seeds, black sesame seeds, and fried shallots.

장어를-가장한-가지덮밥.title: #Eggplant Rice Bowl Playing at Eel
장어를-가장한-가지덮밥.intro:
20250831 #breakfastdiary 1494, 26°C/mostly clear, 20 min/workout(M)
Before organizing the recipe and posting it, I reread it and noticed I'd written 'minced thoughts' instead of 'minced ginger' (they're near-homophones in Korean). Making anything, whether writing or cooking, and putting it out for others to see takes real courage. It's still hard, and still a little embarrassing. 
Before getting up and making breakfast this morning, I've been putting together the new episodes of my daily-breakfast series to post next Tuesday. The 4 episodes on planning breakfast and the 4 on making breakfast are done, and starting next Tuesday I'll be running 4 more episodes over the next month, every Tuesday, on how I actually eat the breakfasts I've planned and made. I wrote at length about why I felt the need to 'mince' my thoughts down (pun very much intended). 
445kcal per serving #eggplant rice bowl playing at eel, made while mincing my thoughts
장어를-가장한-가지덮밥.ingredients: brown rice, 2 eggplants, oil, a little sesame oil and sesame seeds, (sauce) 2T dark soy sauce, 2T mirin, 1T sugar, 1t minced ginger, 4T water
장어를-가장한-가지덮밥.steps:
1. Wash 2 eggplants thoroughly, wrap in plastic wrap, and microwave for 2 minutes. (Don't peel — the skin is full of fiber.)
2. Mix 2T dark soy sauce, 2T mirin, 1T sugar, 1t minced ginger, and 4T water together to make the sauce. 
3. The eggplant fresh out of the microwave is very hot. Cut it in half, spread it open, score it so it soaks up the sauce well, then cook slowly in an oiled pan, brushing on the sauce from step 3 as it cooks.
5. Place the eggplant from step 3 over brown rice and keep it simple with a little sesame oil and sesame seeds on top.

레몬아스파라거스뇨끼-아스파라거스.title: Lemon Asparagus Gnocchi with Asparagus
레몬아스파라거스뇨끼-아스파라거스.intro:
20250830 #breakfastdiary 1493, 27°C/drizzle
Barring anything unusual, I make a different breakfast from yesterday's every day. After all the prepping, cooking, and enjoying comes the rough part — the dishes. Here's a one-pan #lemon asparagus gnocchi that lets you get through that rough part with just a single pan to wash.
레몬아스파라거스뇨끼-아스파라거스.ingredients: 1 cup gnocchi, 5 stalks asparagus, 1/2 lemon (zest + juice), Grana Padano cheese, salt, pepper
레몬아스파라거스뇨끼-아스파라거스.steps:
1. Melt butter in a pan, add salt and pepper, and sauté the trimmed asparagus for 2-3 minutes. 
2. Add 2 cups gnocchi and cook until golden on the outside. 
3. Add Grana Padano cheese and mix evenly. 
4. Turn off the heat, add lemon zest and lemon juice, and mix evenly. 
5. Plate the gnocchi and asparagus, then top with Grana Padano cheese.

무척-입체적인-아보카도-사워도우-토스트.title: A Wonderfully Dimensional Avocado Sourdough Toast
무척-입체적인-아보카도-사워도우-토스트.intro:
20250829 #breakfastdiary 1492, 27°C/cloudy
Just like a jolt of tension injected into a hip-hop scene that's gone a bit slack, let's give a plain avocado toast some life with a Gordon Ramsay-style recipe. The scent of lemon zest, the texture of black sesame, and the thrill and suspense delivered by crushed chili — romance and fantasy will linger in your mouth.
A roughly 390kcal wonderfully dimensional avocado sourdough toast with lemon and black sesame
무척-입체적인-아보카도-사워도우-토스트.ingredients: 1 slice sourdough, 1/2 avocado, (topping) 1T black sesame seeds, 1t crushed chili, 1t salt, 1t black pepper, lemon zest
무척-입체적인-아보카도-사워도우-토스트.steps:
1. Grind 1T black sesame, 1t crushed chili, 1t salt, and 1t black pepper together with a generous amount of lemon zest. Let's call this the black sesame lemon chili seasoning. 
2. Brush olive oil on the sourdough and toast until crisp. 
3. Peel the ripe avocado and slice it lengthwise. 
4. Top the sourdough with the avocado, douse it generously in lemon juice, then sprinkle on the black sesame lemon chili seasoning from step 1.

쉬림프보울.title: #ShrimpBowl
쉬림프보울.intro:
20250828 #breakfastdiary 1491, 26°C/cloudy, 20 min/workout(M)
That's why 'a breakfast made for the very first time' always comes with its own struggles. Some days the taste and the plating both come together just right; other days it's too bland and needs another grating of Parmigiano Reggiano to bring up the seasoning; and some days the exploding egg custard doesn't explode the way it's supposed to, leaving me staring in despair at a flat, deflated egg custard. Sometimes the texture of chickpea hummus, soaked overnight and blended, just doesn't sit right, and I end up blaming the blender — 'right, I should've bought that blender Starbucks supposedly uses.' And with the soufflé pancake I've never once gotten right, I blame the pan for not distributing heat evenly and go browsing for a pan with better heat conduction. Like that line from Between Calm and Passion (2001) — 'I don't really know when, or how much, to open my heart' — with 'a breakfast made for the first time,' I still don't really know when or how much to raise or lower the heat, how well-done to cook the ingredients, or how much seasoning to add or take away, so it's always difficult. 
(My breakfast diary — lonely or sad, I still eat, no matter what) 
Today was another first-time breakfast, so there was plenty of trial and error along the way. This is how I build up the know-how not to repeat the same mistakes next time. 
A poke-ish 472kcal #shrimp bowl with cucumber and edamame on the side
쉬림프보울.ingredients: 1/2 bowl brown rice, 2T edamame, 1/4 cucumber, (sriracha mayo) 2T mayonnaise, 1T sriracha sauce, 3T water, (optional) sesame seeds, furikake
쉬림프보울.steps:
1. Cook the brown rice. 
2. Score the shrimp lengthwise along the back, blanch in boiling water for 1-2 minutes, then dip in cold water and drain. 
3. Boil the edamame in salted water, then drain and shell them. 
4. Cut the cucumber into pieces about the same size as the edamame. 
5. In a bowl, arrange the brown rice, shrimp, edamame and cucumber, and the sriracha mayo. Meant to finish with sesame seeds but forgot. 

Probably would've been nice to season the rice with furikake too.

스파이시-허니-에그-아보카도-사워도우-토스트.title: Spicy Honey Egg Avocado Sourdough Toast
스파이시-허니-에그-아보카도-사워도우-토스트.intro:
20250827 #breakfastdiary 1490, 27°C/mostly cloudy, 20 min/workout(M)
So here are a few naming methods I've picked up — and currently use — after several years of running this breakfast diary. (omitted) Second, the ingredient-listing type. This just lists out the main ingredients in the breakfast, which is pretty intuitive — things like pistachio mushroom sourdough, cucumber mango feta toast, red cabbage orange mint salad. Of course, the downside is that the name gets long and only the main ingredients get any spotlight, while the supporting ones get sidelined. 
(My breakfast diary — Breakfast, what's your name?)
Eating a different breakfast every day is one thing, but naming a different breakfast every day is even trickier. It's no joke. So today's breakfast goes with the so-called ingredient-listing type: a roughly 530kcal spicy honey egg avocado sourdough toast
스파이시-허니-에그-아보카도-사워도우-토스트.ingredients: 1 slice sourdough, 1/2 avocado, olive oil, Maldon salt, 1T honey, 1 egg, 2T chili oil
스파이시-허니-에그-아보카도-사워도우-토스트.steps:
1. Brush the sourdough with olive oil and toast until crisp. 
2. Peel the ripe avocado and slice it thin. 
3. Pour chili oil into a pan, crack in 1 egg, and fry it up. 
4. Top the sourdough with the avocado (made a few days ago), then add Maldon salt, the fried egg from step 3, and a little honey.

피넛버터소스에-버무린-버미셀리샐러드.title: #Vermicelli Salad Tossed in Peanut Butter Sauce
피넛버터소스에-버무린-버미셀리샐러드.intro:
20250825 #breakfastdiary 1489, 28°C/localized torrential rain with thunder and lightning, 20 min/workout(M)
Somewhere out there a service has appeared (a kind of chatbot) that can bring back the dead based on their photos and social media posts. Given how fast AI is advancing lately, there's no real reason it couldn't be made. It's basically the real-life version of the movie Transcendence, starring Johnny Depp. The age of Digital Immortality is here. But I don't want to be summoned back like that after I die. I don't want to be remembered that way by the people who knew me. 
Vermicelli is a rice noodle thinner than somyeon, mostly enjoyed across Southeast Asia. Swap in just one kind of noodle and you can summon up memories of Vietnam or Thailand. That much summoning feels about right. 
Pairs well with whatever vegetables you have at home — a roughly 500kcal #vermicelli salad tossed in peanut butter sauce
피넛버터소스에-버무린-버미셀리샐러드.ingredients: red cabbage, cucumber, tomato, carrot, a moderate amount of bok choy, vermicelli for 2 servings, (dressing) 3T peanut butter, 1T soy sauce, 2T lime juice, 2T honey, 1T sesame oil, 1t minced garlic, 3T water
피넛버터소스에-버무린-버미셀리샐러드.steps:
1. Julienne the red cabbage, cucumber, tomato, and carrot thin. 
2. Mix 3T peanut butter, 1T soy sauce, 2T lime juice, 2T honey, 1T sesame oil, 1t minced garlic, and 3T water together to make the dressing. 
3. Soak the vermicelli in water for about 30 minutes, blanch in boiling water for 2-3 minutes, then rinse quickly in cold water and drain. 
4. Arrange the red cabbage, cucumber, tomato, carrot, and bok choy in a bowl, pile the vermicelli in the middle, pour over the dressing from step 2, and toss well. 

Adding chopped pistachios or peanuts would add a fun bit of texture too.

오이-망고-토스트.title: Cucumber Mango Toast
오이-망고-토스트.intro:
20250824 #breakfastdiary 1488, 26°C/mostly clear, 20 min/workout(M)
Visually this looks almost like mango kkakdugi tossed in chili powder broth. 
In Thailand they cut slightly underripe mango into long strips and dip it in prik gleur (พริกเกลือ) — a seasoning of chili powder, salt, and sugar. It's pretty addictive; before you know it you'll find yourself scraping the bottom and licking your fingers. 
South America has something similar called Tajín seasoning, which uses lime instead of sugar for a much brighter, tangier flavor. 
Since I don't have Tajín seasoning, I mixed chili powder and salt and brightened it up with lime juice — a love-it-or-hate-it roughly 552kcal cucumber mango toast
오이-망고-토스트.ingredients: 1 slice sourdough, 1/2 cucumber, 1/2 apple mango, 2T olive oil, 1T lime juice, a little feta cheese, (Tajín-style seasoning) 1t chili powder, 1t salt
오이-망고-토스트.steps:
1. Brush the sourdough with olive oil and toast until crisp. 
2. Slice the cucumber thin with a mandoline, and cut the apple mango flesh into long strips. 
3. In a mixing bowl, combine the cucumber and mango with 2T olive oil, 1T lime juice, 1t finely ground chili powder, and 1t salt, and mix well.
4. Plate the sourdough, top with the cucumber and mango mixture from step 3 and feta cheese, and pour over any liquid left in the bowl from step 3.

바나나토스트.title: Banana Toast
바나나토스트.intro:
20250823 #breakfastdiary 1487, 25°C/clear
Approx 550kcal banana toast, topped with banana air-fried for 10 minutes until crisp outside and soft inside, plus cacao nibs
바나나토스트.ingredients: 1 slice sourdough, 1 banana, 2T peanut butter, 1T cacao nibs, a little Maldon salt
바나나토스트.steps:
1. Brush the sourdough with olive oil and toast until crisp. 
2. Slice the banana thinly and air-fry at 200°C for 10 minutes. 
3. Spread the sourdough generously with peanut butter, then top with the banana from step 2 and cacao nibs. Finish with a little Maldon salt.

아호블랑코.title: Ajo Blanco
아호블랑코.intro:
20250822 #breakfastdiary 1486, 27°C/clear
Unlike its name suggests, tracing its roots back to Greek and Roman times, this cold almond soup from Andalusia, Spain — Ajo Blanco (Ajo meaning garlic, Blanco meaning white) — becomes Salmorejo if you swap the almonds for tomato, and Gazpacho if you then leave out the bread on top of that.
It's supposed to be eaten cold, but rushed for work, I had it lukewarm instead — approx 700kcal Ajo Blanco
아호블랑코.ingredients: 150g almonds, 60ml olive oil, 30ml balsamic vinegar, 400ml water, 1 clove garlic, 60g bread, 1t salt, (optional) grapes
아호블랑코.steps:
1. In a blender, combine the almonds, olive oil, balsamic vinegar, water, garlic, a piece of bread, and 1t salt, and blend until smooth. 
2. Pour into a bowl and top with olive oil, grapes, and almonds.

푸실리-애호박-주키니.title: Fusilli with Zucchini and Summer Squash
푸실리-애호박-주키니.intro:
20250821 #breakfastdiary 1485, 27°C/mostly cloudy, 20 min/workout(M) 
Green bananas are unripe bananas — low in sugar and high in starch, which is why they're often used as a cooking ingredient abroad. (Not sure why we even have one at home, but,) I had fusilli made from green banana, so I used it to make pasta with the leftover summer squash and zucchini from making breakfast.
Banana cultivation areas are gradually expanding in Korea too, so I imagine ingredients like this will only become more common — though that's not exactly good news, since it's presumably a result of global warming.
Green banana (100%, gluten-free, vegan, and high in potassium and iron) #fusilli with summer squash and zucchini
푸실리-애호박-주키니.ingredients: 1/2 summer squash, 1/4 zucchini, 2 cups fusilli, Grana Padano cheese, olive oil, salt, pepper, herbs, (optional) truffle oil
푸실리-애호박-주키니.steps:
1. Cut the summer squash and zucchini into quarters and roast in a pan with olive oil, salt, pepper, and herbs. 
2. Boil the fusilli in salted water. 
3. Pour the fusilli and 1/2 cup of the pasta water into the pan from step 1, add Grana Padano cheese, and mix well. Adding 1T of lemon juice would round out the balance nicely. Mix thoroughly. 
4. Plate and finish with more Grana Padano cheese and a little truffle oil.

또띠아.title: Zucchini Nest Tortilla
또띠아.intro:
20250820 #breakfastdiary 1484, 26°C/cloudy
"As long as nothing comes up, I make a different breakfast every day from the one before." That statement comes with a catch: "as long as nothing comes up." Something coming up means being too sick to eat breakfast, or having to be away from the kitchen for a business trip or travel.
(Najosik, Lonely or Sad, I Always Eat)
Something came up. A long business trip and its aftermath kept me off breakfast until yesterday, and today I'm starting it back up. A zucchini nest on top, approx 220kcal per serving #tortilla
또띠아.ingredients: 2 tortillas, 1/2 zucchini, 2 eggs, feta cheese, olive oil, salt, pepper
또띠아.steps:
1. Wash the zucchini under running water, then spiralize it. 
2. Heat olive oil in a pan, arrange the spiralized zucchini in a nest shape leaving the center open, and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Crack 1 egg into the center and scatter feta cheese around the edge. Cover with a lid and let sit until the egg is cooked through. 
3. Toast the tortilla in a pan and top with the zucchini nest from step 2.

라임-곤약면.title: Lime Konjac Noodles
라임-곤약면.intro:
20250814 #breakfastdiary 1483, 24°C/rain
This is the lime noodle dish I make once every summer. Use somyeon and it's lime somyeon; use udon noodles and it's lime udon; use buckwheat noodles and it's lime buckwheat — today it's lime konjac. Simmering kelp and bonito flakes for stock, or using a premade stock, would give a deeper broth flavor, but even just water and tsuyu alone make a perfectly deep-tasting broth. Perfect for an early morning breakfast on my way out for a long business trip. 
Only! 45kcal lime konjac noodles
라임-곤약면.ingredients: 1 pack konjac noodles, 1 lime, (broth) water and tsuyu in a 3:1 ratio
라임-곤약면.steps:
1. Rinse the konjac noodles lightly under running water and place them in a bowl. 
2. Slice half the lime thin. (Squeeze the juice from the other half into the broth.) 
3. Mix water and tsuyu in a 3:1 ratio and pour over the noodles from step 1. Squeeze in the juice of half the lime from step 2. 
4. Arrange the lime slices set aside from step 2 nicely on top.

전두부-명란-아보카도-샐러드.title: Whole Soybean Tofu Salad with Salted Pollock Roe and Avocado
전두부-명란-아보카도-샐러드.intro:
20250813 #breakfastdiary 1482, 24°C/rain, 20 min/workout(M)
Infused sesame oil with saffron and poured it over the salted pollock roe, boosting the flavor about a million times — a roughly 485kcal whole soybean tofu salad with salted pollock roe and avocado
전두부-명란-아보카도-샐러드.ingredients: 1 block whole soybean tofu, 1/2 avocado, 1 salted pollock roe, 1T chopped sesame seeds, 1T sesame oil, a little saffron
전두부-명란-아보카도-샐러드.steps:
1. Place the whole soybean tofu in a bowl. 
2. Cut 1/2 a ripe avocado and place it on top of the tofu. 
3. Cut the salted pollock roe in half, scrape out the eggs, and place them on top of the avocado. Drizzle with a little lemon juice. 
4. Add saffron to the sesame oil and microwave for about 20 seconds to infuse the saffron flavor. 
5. Pour over 1T chopped sesame seeds and the saffron sesame oil from step 4.

썬드라이드-토마토를-곁들인-바질페스토-뇨끼.title: Basil Pesto Gnocchi with Sun-Dried Tomato
썬드라이드-토마토를-곁들인-바질페스토-뇨끼.intro:
20250812 #breakfastdiary 1481, 25°C/mostly clear
I'm always racing the clock making breakfast, but I still put a lot of effort into plating. Of course, that's partly out of consideration for the many followers who essentially have to eat this breakfast with their eyes, and it's practically a basic virtue of running a food account online. Thanks to that, I've picked up a few plating principles over the past several years. (omitted) 
Third, odd numbers rule plating. The human brain finds slight asymmetry more appealing than perfect symmetry, so perfectly even numbers can actually feel unnatural and off-putting. So every ingredient that appears in a breakfast gets plated in odd numbers unless there's a special reason not to. But do I really have to follow that rule every single time?
(My breakfast diary — to you, obsessed with plating) 
Breakfast and plating — sounds like an odd pairing, but a new episode of my daily-breakfast series covering something I'd always wanted to talk about just went up. 
Still couldn't let go of my plating obsession though — a roughly 445kcal basil pesto gnocchi with sun-dried tomato
썬드라이드-토마토를-곁들인-바질페스토-뇨끼.ingredients: 2 cups store-bought gnocchi, 2T basil pesto, 1 sun-dried tomato, 1t lemon juice, Grana Padano cheese, pepper, olive oil
썬드라이드-토마토를-곁들인-바질페스토-뇨끼.steps:
1. Blanch the (frozen) gnocchi in boiling water, drain, and toss with olive oil so they don't stick together.
2. Heat olive oil in a pan and cook the gnocchi until golden, then turn off the heat, add 10g butter, and coat it in the buttery flavor. 
3. Spread basil pesto on a plate and top with the gnocchi. 
4. Sprinkle over sun-dried tomato and a little lemon juice, then pile on plenty of Grana Padano cheese. Finish with pepper.

사과-브리치즈-샌드위치.title: Apple Brie Sandwich
사과-브리치즈-샌드위치.intro:
20250811 #breakfastdiary 1480, 24°C/cloudy, 20 min/workout(M) 
There are all kinds of allergies in this world. Some people probably think it should be pronounced 'al-ler-jee' the English way, and while 'allergy' is indeed correct in English, the official Korean term set by the Korean Academy of Asthma, Allergy and Clinical Immunology is 'allergie' (from German). Energy isn't pronounced 'energie' in Korean, and synergy isn't 'synergie' either — allergy is the one exception. (omitted) 
I only found out I have a rocket (arugula) allergy as an adult. This Mediterranean-native herb goes by rucola in addition to rocket (or roquette) and arugula. After a few unexplained episodes of my mouth swelling up, I traced back everything I'd eaten that day and searched around online before I finally accepted that I have an arugula allergy.  
(My breakfast diary — I'll pass on the arugula, thanks) 
Most apple brie sandwich recipes call for arugula, but since I'm allergic, I swapped in lettuce (for today anyway). Anyway, I put the apple and lettuce on top for extra crunch — a roughly 522kcal apple brie sandwich
사과-브리치즈-샌드위치.ingredients: 1/3 loaf (Tartine Bakery) slab bread, 1T each mayonnaise, whole grain mustard, and honey, 3 slices plant-based ham, a little lettuce, 1/2 wheel brie, 1/2 apple
사과-브리치즈-샌드위치.steps:
1. Cut the slab bread in half and toast with olive oil until crisp. 
2. Mix mayonnaise, whole grain mustard, and honey in a 1:1:1 ratio and spread on the bread. 
3. Layer the plant-based ham, brie, sliced apple, and lettuce on top of the bread, in that order, then cover with the other piece of bread. 
4. Wrap in parchment paper, cut in half, and eat.

복숭아-콩포트를-곁들인-복숭아토스트.title: #PeachToast with Peach Compote
복숭아-콩포트를-곁들인-복숭아토스트.intro:
20250810 #breakfastdiary 1479, 21°C/mostly clear, 20 min/workout(M) 
A peach compote made with honey and butter seems like it would send the sugar count through the roof, but since the WHO's recommended free sugar limit for adults is 25g, it actually stays within range. A roughly 308kcal #peach toast with peach compote
복숭아-콩포트를-곁들인-복숭아토스트.ingredients: 1 peach, 10g butter, 1T pistachios, 1T honey, 1T olive oil, a little basil, (dip) 2T ricotta cheese, 1T honey, a pinch of salt, 1T olive oil
복숭아-콩포트를-곁들인-복숭아토스트.steps:
1. Melt butter in a pan, add honey, then add thinly sliced peach and simmer down. 
2. Mix 2T ricotta cheese, 1T honey, a pinch of salt, and 1T olive oil together to make the dip. 
3. Spread the ricotta dip from step 2 on a plate, then add honey and olive oil, the peach from step 1, and chopped pistachios. 
 
Goes great on sourdough 👍

양파샐러드.title: #OnionSalad
양파샐러드.intro:
20250809 #breakfastdiary 1478, 25°C/cloudy, 20 min/workout(M) 
'Do your best at what you can control, and let the rest go.' 
Something I read somewhere once. So, as usual, today's breakfast made with my best effort: a 219kcal #onion salad roasted in a butter and soy sauce dressing
양파샐러드.ingredients: 2 onions, 10g butter, a little chives and parsley, (dressing) 3T soy sauce, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t minced garlic
양파샐러드.steps:
1. Cut medium onions into wedges and microwave twice, 2 minutes each time. 
2. Put the onion from step 1 in a pan with butter, roast until golden, then pour over the prepared soy sauce dressing and roast a bit more. 
3. Plate and layer with chives and chopped parsley. 

🫓 Spread whole grain mustard on some bread and top with the onions for a nice, well-rounded carb boost.

아보카도-2.title: Avocado
아보카도-2.intro:
20250808 #breakfastdiary 1477, 22°C/mostly overcast
Mariage in French translates to 'pairing' in English, but 'pairing' is a broader term than mariage. It covers not just wine-and-food matches, but ingredient-to-ingredient combos like tomato and basil or cheese and apple, aroma-to-aroma harmonies like vanilla and cardamom, and texture pairings like creamy avocado with crispy sourdough.  
(My breakfast diary — I tend to aim for breakfast pairings) 
Tofu and avocado — a textbook example of Congruent Pairing straight out of chapter one of any pairing intro book. Even without much chewing, the soft, creamy texture spreading through your mouth and the clean, nutty flavor are almost eerily alike between the two. 
And whole soybean tofu is made by grinding the entire soybean without removing the pulp, so it retains 100% of the bean's nutrients compared to regular tofu — a high-protein, low-calorie tofu. Good for you, but more importantly, it's firm and easy to cook with. 
340kcal
아보카도-2.ingredients: 1 block whole soybean tofu, 1 avocado, (dressing) 2T fried shallots, 1T chives, 1T soy sauce, 1T white wine vinegar, 1T water, 1/2t sesame seeds, 2t minced garlic
아보카도-2.steps:
1. Mix 2T fried shallots, 1T chives, 1T soy sauce, 1T white wine vinegar, 1T water, 1/2t sesame seeds, and 2t minced garlic together to make the dressing. 
2. Slice the avocado and tofu and layer them together. 
3. Plate the avocado and tofu and top with the dressing from step 1. Finish with sesame oil.

육회.title: Yukhoe (Korean Beef Tartare)
육회.intro:
20250807 #breakfastdiary 1476, 25°C/mostly clear
The same goes for cream tea. Follow the Devon method and spread cream then jam on your scone, and you get the harmonized taste of cream and jam soaking into the scone; follow Cornwall's order — jam then cream — and you get the full, distinct flavors of each on their own. 
(My breakfast diary — how to enjoy breakfast 8 times better) 
I paused for a second wondering whether to put the yukhoe on the bottom or the zucchini on the bottom. It was a lot like the cream tea debate over whether to spread jam and cream, or cream and jam, on a scone first. But really, you just eat it however brings out the flavor best for you. 
So today I settled on putting the denser yukhoe on the bottom and mixing everything together fairly evenly. 
A roughly 352kcal yukhoe with zucchini tossed in basil pesto on the side
육회.ingredients: 1/5 zucchini, 1T basil pesto, (yukhoe) 150g eye of round beef, salt, sesame oil, minced garlic, a pinch each
육회.steps:
1. Cut the zucchini into 0.5-1cm dice, add basil pesto, and mix well. There are many kinds of basil pesto, so adjust the seasoning and texture with salt or olive oil as needed.
2. Finely chop the eye of round beef and mix with seasoned salt, sesame oil, and minced garlic. 
3. Pack the yukhoe from step 2 and the zucchini from step 1 into a ring mold. Finish with pepper.

콩물에-잠긴-얼린-무화과-볼.title: Frozen #Fig Balls Sunk in Soy Milk
콩물에-잠긴-얼린-무화과-볼.intro:
20250806 #breakfastdiary 1475, 26°C/rain, 20 min/workout(M)
The kind of weather where you just want to sit under a hanok eave and stare blankly at the raindrops falling. 
A roughly 320kcal frozen #fig balls sunk in soy milk, made to wake up the body and mind
콩물에-잠긴-얼린-무화과-볼.ingredients: frozen figs (about 2 figs' worth), 2 cups soy milk, 1T walnuts
콩물에-잠긴-얼린-무화과-볼.steps:
1. Lay down parchment paper, mash the figs, and freeze them as is. 
2. Pour soy milk into a bowl and drop in the frozen figs. Top with chopped walnuts.

토마토-까르파초.title: Tomato Carpaccio
토마토-까르파초.intro:
20250805 #breakfastdiary 1474, 25°C/clear
(Breaking) The 5th episode of my daily-breakfast series, 'The Night Makes a Better Breakfast,' just went up
Slicing tomato really thin turned out to be harder than I expected, but let's just say I sliced it moderately thin on purpose, for the texture. A roughly 400kcal tomato carpaccio
토마토-까르파초.ingredients: 1 tomato, red onion, blue cheese, a little basil, (dressing) 3T olive oil, 1T balsamic vinegar, a pinch of salt
토마토-까르파초.steps:
1. Sharpen the knife. 
2. Slice the tomato thin crosswise (like you're filleting it). 
3. On a plate, mix 3T olive oil, 1T balsamic vinegar, a pinch of salt, and chopped basil together well. 
4. Lay the thin tomato slices over the dressing and top with red onion, blue cheese, and basil. Finish with olive oil and pepper.

퀴노아-샐러드.title: Quinoa Salad
퀴노아-샐러드.intro:
20250804 #breakfastdiary 1473, 25°C/clear, 20 min/workout(M)
'You could tell what the seasons do and what time takes on.' I love this line from 'Ipdong' in Kim Ae-ran's short story collection 'Outside Is Summer.' I liked it so much that the year I read the collection, I quoted it in every single year-end message I sent to people around me, and I still think of it and quote it whenever I get the chance, whether writing or just telling a story. 
(My breakfast diary — the night makes a better breakfast) 
I'm polishing tomorrow's Brunch post. I like how this episode turned out. 
A roughly 900kcal quinoa salad with king oyster mushroom, walnuts, and avocado on the side
퀴노아-샐러드.ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, king oyster mushroom, 2T raisins, a little basil, 2T walnuts, (dressing) 2T white wine vinegar, 1T Dijon mustard, 3T olive oil, a pinch of salt and pepper
퀴노아-샐러드.steps:
1. Fill a pot with plenty of water, add a pinch of salt and 1 cup quinoa, and boil. 
2. In a mixing bowl, stir together 2T white wine vinegar, 1T Dijon mustard, 3T olive oil, and a pinch of salt and pepper to make the dressing. 
3. Heat olive oil in a pan, add salt and pepper, and sauté the king oyster mushroom. 
4. Drain the quinoa from step 1 and add to the mixing bowl from step 2, along with the mushroom from step 3, 2T raisins, and chopped basil, and mix well. Taste and add salt if needed. 
5. Plate it, peel and slice 1/2 an avocado lengthwise on top, and add walnuts lightly toasted in a pan and crushed.

퀴노아-샐러드-2.intro:

주키니-하몽-샐러드.title: Zucchini Jamón Salad
주키니-하몽-샐러드.intro:
20250803 #breakfastdiary 1472, 29°C/cloudy, 20 min/workout(M)
A lot of people mistake 'keeping something up' for 'always staying at 100%.' But in reality, sometimes it's only 70%, sometimes 50%, sometimes even just 10%. Still doing it anyway — that's what 'keeping up' really means.
A roughly 200kcal zucchini jamón salad
주키니-하몽-샐러드.ingredients: 1/2 zucchini, 3 slices jamón, pepper, (dressing) 2t olive oil, 2t Dijon mustard, 2t white wine vinegar, a pinch of salt and sugar
주키니-하몽-샐러드.steps:
1. Wash the zucchini thoroughly, slice with a mandoline, sprinkle with salt, and let it sit for a moment. 
2. Mix 2t olive oil, 2t salt (note: likely meant as part of dressing), 2t Dijon mustard, 2t white wine vinegar, and a pinch of sugar together to make the dressing.  
3. Squeeze out the zucchini from step 1 and put it in a mixing bowl. Add the 3 slices of jamón and the dressing, and mix well. 
4. Plate it and add a bit of pepper on top. 
5. Good eaten on its own, or piled onto crackers or bread.

사과-브리치즈-파이.title: Apple Brie Pie
사과-브리치즈-파이.intro:
20250803 #breakfastdiary 1471, 30°C/mostly clear, 20 min/workout(M)
Stretch out my foot like this and maybe I could reach you, since you're always right there.
I stretch it out once and tell myself never again,
since it would startle you.
But if I never stretch it out, how disappointed would you be too?
Several times a day I go to stretch it out, then stop myself.
(Lee Seong-bok, 'Foot')
425kcal apple brie pie
사과-브리치즈-파이.ingredients: 2 sheets phyllo dough, 1/2 apple, 1/2 wheel brie, 2T Greek yogurt, 1 egg, Maldon salt, honey
사과-브리치즈-파이.steps:
1. Brush olive oil in a mini pound cake mold and fold in 2 sheets of phyllo dough. 
2. Slice 1/2 an apple and the brie thin and tuck them in between the layers of phyllo dough. 
3. Mix 2T Greek yogurt with 1 egg in a bowl, pour over the phyllo dough, and bake at 180°C for 30 minutes. 
4. Plate it, sprinkle with a little Maldon salt, cut into servable pieces, and drizzle with honey to eat.

블루베리-오버나이트-오트밀.title: Blueberry Overnight Oatmeal
블루베리-오버나이트-오트밀.intro:
20250802 #breakfastdiary 1470, 25°C/cloudy
That's why 'a breakfast made for the very first time' always comes with its own struggles. Some days the taste and the plating both come together just right; other days it's too bland and needs another grating of Parmigiano Reggiano to bring up the seasoning; and some days the exploding egg custard doesn't explode the way it's supposed to, leaving me staring in despair at a flat, deflated egg custard. Sometimes the texture of chickpea hummus, soaked overnight and blended, just doesn't sit right, and I end up blaming the blender — 'right, I should've bought that blender Starbucks supposedly uses.' And with the soufflé pancake I've never once gotten right, I blame the pan for not distributing heat evenly and go browsing for a pan with better heat conduction. Like that line from Between Calm and Passion (2001) — 'I don't really know when, or how much, to open my heart' — with 'a breakfast made for the first time,' I still don't really know when or how much to raise or lower the heat, how well-done to cook the ingredients, or how much seasoning to add or take away, so it's always difficult. 
(My breakfast diary — lonely or sad, I still eat, no matter what) 
I swapped last week's grape overnight oatmeal recipe for blueberry, so this is getting closer to being 'a breakfast I've actually made before.' Prepping the ingredients and cooking it were both much easier this time. Even the peanut butter topping I wasn't happy with last time, I adjusted the consistency just right and topped it the way I wanted. Even so, barring anything unusual, I plan to keep making a different breakfast from yesterday's every day. Because that ritual, however lofty it sounds, is still nothing short of thrilling. 
(Same as last week) On a day I have to leave home early for a business trip, a roughly 400kcal blueberry overnight oatmeal that last night made for me
블루베리-오버나이트-오트밀.ingredients: 1 cup blueberries, 2T Greek yogurt, 1T honey, 1t vanilla extract, 1T lemon juice, 1t salt, plus 2 cups oatmeal, 2T chia seeds, (topping) a little blueberries, pistachios, peanut butter, Maldon salt
블루베리-오버나이트-오트밀.steps:
1. In a blender, combine 1 cup blueberries, 2T Greek yogurt, 1T honey, 1t vanilla extract, 1T lemon juice, and 1t salt, and blend. 
2. Put 2 cups oatmeal and 2T chia seeds in a bowl, pour in the mixture from step 1, and let it sit in the fridge overnight. 
3. Top with blueberries, chopped pistachios, and peanut butter. Add a little Maldon salt.

새우볼.title: Shrimp Balls
새우볼.ingredients: 5 shrimp fish balls, 1t minced garlic, 4T tomato sauce, 1/4 cup green peas, a little Grana Padano cheese, olive oil, pepper

스페인-토마토-수프-살모레호.title: Spanish Tomato Soup #Salmorejo
스페인-토마토-수프-살모레호.intro:
20250801 #breakfastdiary 1469, 28°C/cloudy
Southern Spain's Andalusia region is famous for two tomato soups: gazpacho and salmorejo. Gazpacho is a lighter, clearer tomato soup, while salmorejo is blended with bread for a thicker, creamier texture. 
Roughly 700kcal per serving Spanish tomato soup #salmorejo
스페인-토마토-수프-살모레호.ingredients: 3 tomatoes, 100g baguette, 1t minced garlic, a pinch of salt, 1 (tablespoon) white wine vinegar, 1/2 cup olive oil, 1/2 egg, a little jamón
스페인-토마토-수프-살모레호.steps:
1. Score the tomatoes, blanch in boiling water, then dip in cold water and peel. Cut roughly into chunks. 
2. In a blender, combine the tomato from step 1 with the baguette, 1t minced garlic, a pinch of salt, and 1t white wine vinegar, and blend while streaming in the olive oil. 
3. Plate it and top with chopped jamón and boiled egg.

토마토-쉬림프-피시-볼.title: Tomato Shrimp Fish Balls
토마토-쉬림프-피시-볼.intro:
20250730 #breakfastdiary 1468, 27°C/cloudy, 20 min/workout(M)
You could call it a kind of supply chain management. Tim Cook was able to succeed Steve Jobs as CEO of Apple partly thanks to his inclusive leadership and strategic mind, but above all because he consistently delivered outstanding results in his core job — supply chain management. Professional chefs package ingredients nearing their expiration date as the chef's special and sell them off. Anthony Bourdain, in Kitchen Confidential: Adventures in the Culinary Underbelly, warned never to order the Monday special, since it's almost certainly a way of using up leftover ingredients from the weekend. 
(My breakfast diary — I went and ordered dawn delivery again)
My daily-breakfast series is running strong!
Dug deep into the back of the freezer to hold off on another dawn delivery order — a roughly 325kcal tomato shrimp fish balls
토마토-쉬림프-피시-볼.ingredients: 5 shrimp fish balls, 1t minced garlic, 4T tomato sauce, 1/4 cup green peas, a little Grana Padano cheese, olive oil, pepper
토마토-쉬림프-피시-볼.steps:
1. Boil the shrimp fish balls and green peas in boiling water. 
2. Heat olive oil in a pan, sauté the garlic, then pour in the tomato sauce and warm it through. Add the shrimp fish balls from step 1 and mix well. 
3. Plate it and top with green peas and chopped scallions. Finish with Grana Padano cheese, pepper, and truffle oil~

마치-에그-타르트처럼-생긴-필로-도우-감자그라탱.title: Phyllo Dough Potato Gratin (Looks Just Like an Egg Tart)
마치-에그-타르트처럼-생긴-필로-도우-감자그라탱.intro:
20250729 #breakfastdiary 1467, 28°C/clear
Phyllo is a paper-thin dough often used in Middle Eastern desserts like baklava or Greek feta cheese pies. Once baked, the texture is genuinely fun. Today it's paired with potato gratin — a roughly 1,110kcal phyllo dough potato gratin (looks just like an egg tart)
마치-에그-타르트처럼-생긴-필로-도우-감자그라탱.ingredients: 150g potatoes (about 2), 2 cups milk, 1T butter, 2 eggs, 50g mozzarella cheese, minced garlic, salt, pepper, phyllo dough
마치-에그-타르트처럼-생긴-필로-도우-감자그라탱.steps:
1. Wash the potatoes thoroughly, cut into cubes, and boil in salted water. 
2. In a mixing bowl, combine 2 cups milk, 1T melted butter, 2 eggs, 50g mozzarella cheese, minced garlic, salt, pepper, and the boiled potato from step 1, and mix well. 
3. Cut the phyllo dough into 10cm x 10cm sheets. 
4. Brush a muffin tin with olive oil, layer in 3 sheets of phyllo dough pressed together, add the potato mixture from step 2, and top with Parmesan cheese. (Forgot the Parmesan today.)
5. Bake at 180°C for 25 minutes.

토마토누들이-토마토누들-토마토.title: Tomato Noodles, Tomato Noodles, Tomato

20250728 #breakfastdiary 1466, 28°C/clear, 30 min/workout(S)
The #tomato noodles from Sing Heung Yuen (勝香園) on Street Food Fighter Hong Kong made quite an impression. It wasn't just the shop tucked into a Central hillside alley that felt like real street food — the toppings did too, from ground tomato and egg to beef, ham, and sausage, more than enough to spark curiosity. If you ask for their most popular dish, you usually get the tomato instant noodles topped with beef. 
Today I used king oyster mushroom instead of beef, since it seemed like it'd give a similar texture and taste, and added a bit of vinegar to bring back to mind that faint tanginess in the broth. 
Sing Heung Yuen #tomato noodles
Don't expect things like air conditioning at Sing Heung Yuen. Now that I think about it, maybe that tang in the broth was actually my own sweat,
토마토누들이-토마토누들-토마토.ingredients: a little king oyster mushroom, 50g egg noodles, 1 tomato, 1t minced garlic, 5T tomato sauce, olive oil, salt, pepper, 1t vinegar
토마토누들이-토마토누들-토마토.steps:
1. Roast the king oyster mushroom in a pan with olive oil, salt, and pepper. 
2. Boil the egg noodles in boiling water.
3. In a pan with olive oil, add the peeled tomato, cut into rough chunks, and sauté. 
4. In a pan with olive oil, sauté minced garlic, then pour in 5T tomato sauce and 500ml water. Once it boils, add the egg noodles from step 2 and the king oyster mushroom from step 1. Taste and season with salt. 
5. Place the egg noodles from step 4 in a bowl and top with the tomato from step 3. Finish with pepper and vinegar.

청포도-오버나이트-오트밀.title: Green Grape Overnight Oatmeal

20250726 #breakfastdiary 1464, 25°C/mostly cloudy
There's a breakfast that finishes itself all alone overnight, standing proudly on its own, a testament to a night well spent maturing. Overnight Oats, or 'ONO' for short. Pour milk, yogurt, etc. in the right ratio over oatmeal the night before, tuck it in the fridge, and the next morning the dry, papery texture is gone entirely, replaced by a wonderful breakfast where the oats, milk, and yogurt have become one, melting away in your mouth like cotton candy, whispering 'it's me, oatmeal.' Adding fresh fruit on top would be even better, but if circumstances aren't ideal and all you've got lying around is wilting fruit, cook it down into a compote and add a bit on top. It's shockingly delicious. 
(My breakfast diary — the night makes a better breakfast) 
On my way out the door early for a business trip, a roughly 750kcal green grape overnight oatmeal that last night made for me
청포도-오버나이트-오트밀.ingredients: 1 cup (seedless) green grapes, 2 cups milk, 1T maple syrup, 1t vanilla extract, 1T lemon juice, 1t salt, plus 2 cups oatmeal, 2T chia seeds, (topping) a little green grapes, pistachios, peanut butter, Maldon salt
청포도-오버나이트-오트밀.steps:
1. In a blender, combine 1 cup green grapes, 2 cups milk, 1T maple syrup, 1t vanilla extract, 1T lemon juice, and 1t salt, and blend. 
2. Put 2 cups oatmeal and 2T chia seeds in a bowl, pour in the mixture from step 1, and let it sit in the fridge overnight. 
3. Top with green grapes, chopped pistachios, and peanut butter. Add a little Maldon salt.

On the other hand, eggs are different when eaten with tomato — the soft, nutty egg and the bright, refreshing tomato create harmony through contrast. Sprinkling cinnamon over vanilla ice cream to contrast soft sweetness with a spicy aroma, or serving a well-seared steak with a sweet cherry sauce — it's a journey to find the appeal that unexpected combinations can create.

That's why 'a breakfast made for the very first time' always comes with its own struggles. Some days the taste and the plating both come together just right; other days it's too bland and needs another grating of Parmigiano Reggiano to bring up the seasoning; and some days the exploding egg custard doesn't explode the way it's supposed to, leaving me staring in despair at a flat, deflated egg custard. Sometimes the texture of chickpea hummus, soaked overnight and blended, just doesn't sit right, and I end up blaming the blender — 'right, I should've bought that blender Starbucks supposedly uses.' And with the soufflé pancake I've never once gotten right, I blame the pan for not distributing heat evenly and go browsing for a pan with better heat conduction. Like that line from Between Calm and Passion (2001) — 'I don't really know when, or how much, to open my heart' — with 'a breakfast made for the first time,' I still don't really know when or how much to raise or lower the heat, how well-done to cook the ingredients, or how much seasoning to add or take away, so it's always difficult.
(My breakfast diary — Daily Breakfast: lonely or sad, I still eat, no matter what)

Make today's breakfast with ingredients A, B, and C, and if C is left over, tomorrow's breakfast centers around C with D and E added in. The day after that, use whichever of C, D, or E makes sense. Isn't that a genuinely practical and productive way to plan a menu? So instead of settling for the same breakfast as yesterday, this approach keeps me energized with new experiences and expectations, adds a bit of fun and anticipation to daily life, and above all minimizes wasted ingredients — it's both the plan and the idea behind making a breakfast that's 'different from yesterday's.' I've decided to call this the 'chain-link breakfast planning method.' When I went on at length explaining this brilliant discovery to my coworker M, she blew her nose and said, unimpressed, 'Every housewife does that.'
My breakfast diary — chain-link breakfast
👆Full piece linked in my profile.
#Beet hummus made loaded with feta cheese, using the leftover beet from yesterday's breakfast
비트후무스-비트.ingredients: 50g (boiled) beet, 100g feta cheese, 50g yogurt, pepper, 1T lemon juice, 1T olive oil, 1t tahini, 1t minced garlic, plus pistachios, chives, and something starchy to go with it

2. Plate it and top with chopped pistachios and dill.

썸머-가스파초-밸런스를-위해-사워도우나-바게트를-곁들여-먹는-것을-권장한.steps:
1. In a blender, combine the chopped tomato, the seeded bell pepper, the peeled cucumber, 1/2 onion, and 1 clove minced garlic, and blend. Add 2t white wine vinegar, 1/2 cup olive oil, and a little salt, and mix well. 
2. Strain once through a sieve, then it would taste even better if left to sit in the fridge for about 6 hours, but there's no time, so I just eat it as is. 
3. Ladle into a bowl, top with finely chopped cucumber, and drizzle with olive oil. Oh! Forgot the pepper.

화이트-강낭콩-카프레제-샐러드.title: White Bean Caprese Salad
화이트-강낭콩-카프레제-샐러드.intro:
20250709 #breakfastdiary 1446, 28°C/mostly clear
'We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.'
Often credited to Aristotle, but it's actually Will Durant's summary of Aristotle's philosophy. Not exactly excellent, and not really aiming for excellence either, but made out of habit anyway — a roughly 298kcal white bean caprese salad
화이트-강낭콩-카프레제-샐러드.ingredients: 1/2 (can) white kidney beans, 10 cherry tomatoes, basil, (dressing) 2T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t Dijon mustard
화이트-강낭콩-카프레제-샐러드.steps:
1. Place the white kidney beans and cherry tomatoes in a bowl and top with ricotta cheese. 
2. Drizzle with the vinaigrette dressing and, if you have basil or parsley on hand, toss it in lightly~

구운-래디시를-얹은-크로스티니.title: #Crostini with Roasted Radish
구운-래디시를-얹은-크로스티니.intro:
20250708 #breakfastdiary 1445, 28°C/clear, 20 min/workout(M)
(In Korean, 'saelleori' becomes 'celery' but 'raedisi' becomes 'radish' — funny how transliteration works out.) More than the subtle, nutty sweetness of roasted radish, it's the overwhelming umami of the butter-and-anchovy sauce that steals the show here — a roughly 650kcal #crostini with roasted radish
구운-래디시를-얹은-크로스티니.ingredients: 3 slices baguette, 3 large radishes, (sauce) 2T butter, 2 anchovies, 2t garlic, a little red pepper flakes
구운-래디시를-얹은-크로스티니.steps:
1. Brush the baguette with olive oil and toast until crisp. 
2. Trim the greens off the radishes, cut into small pieces, season with salt and pepper, and roast in olive oil.  
3. Melt 2T butter in the microwave for 1 minute, then mix in 2 anchovies, 2t garlic, a little red pepper flakes, and the leftover oil from roasting the radish in step 2, to make the sauce. 
4. Spread the sauce from step 3 on the baguette, top with the radish, spoon over more sauce, and finish with a little chopped basil.

파르팔레.title: #Farfalle
파르팔레.intro:
20250707 #breakfastdiary 1444, 25°C/mostly clear
Calabria is a coastal region in southern Italy (the 'toe' of the boot on the map). Being a coastal region, it has plenty to offer — spicy chilies, cheese, fresh seafood, and more. Calabrese sauce refers to a Calabrian-style sauce built around red bell pepper. 
#Farfalle tossed in Calabrese sauce, a whopping 800kcal first thing in the morning
파르팔레.ingredients: 2 cups farfalle, 1t minced garlic, 2T Calabrese sauce, mozzarella cheese and basil, a little
파르팔레.steps:
1. Boil the farfalle in salted water. Once cooked through, drain and toss with olive oil. 
2. Heat olive oil in a pan, sauté minced garlic, then add the farfalle from step 1 along with the Calabrese sauce, and mix well. Add about 1/2 cup of the pasta water. 
3. Plate the farfalle and top with mozzarella cheese and basil.
