양배추수프-양배추.title: Cabbage Soup, Cabbage
양배추수프-양배추.intro:
20250706 #breakfastdiary 1443, 27°C/cloudy, 20 min/workout(M)
Using stock instead of water would give a much richer flavor, but tomato sauce alone brings plenty of umami without needing stock at all. #Cabbage soup with cabbage cut into rough chunks for extra bite
양배추수프-양배추.ingredients: 1/2 onion, 1/2 carrot, 2 stalks celery, 1t minced garlic, tomato sauce, 1/4 cabbage, herbs, salt, pepper
양배추수프-양배추.steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a heavy pot and sauté the chopped onion, carrot, and celery. Once the onion turns translucent, add minced garlic and sauté a bit more. Add 3T tomato sauce, pour in 500ml water, and bring to a boil. Add herbs and season with salt and pepper. 
2. Add the cabbage, cut into rough chunks, and simmer a bit more. 
3. Ladle into a bowl and top with chopped parsley.

버섯토스트.title: #MushroomToast
버섯토스트.intro:
20250705 #breakfastdiary 1442, 27°C/cloudy
Mariage is French for 'marriage,' but it also carries the meaning of 'combination' or 'blend.' So whenever you hear the word 'mariage' used, it's almost always in the sense of wine-and-food pairing rather than actual marriage — red wine goes with meat, white wine goes well with fish, that sort of thing. 
In English, mariage becomes 'pairing,' a term used more broadly than mariage. It covers not just wine-and-food matches, but ingredient-to-ingredient combos like tomato and basil or cheese and apple, aroma-to-aroma harmonies like vanilla and cardamom, and texture pairings like creamy avocado with crispy sourdough. 
Pairing becomes the guiding principle for deciding which ingredients to use, how to cook them, and what kind of kick to add, in order to make and enjoy a given dish. Through pairing, the breakfast I make the next morning gains depth and actually becomes something cookable. And within that, principles straight out of chapter one of any pairing intro book come into play: Congruent Pairing and Contrasting Pairing. 
Heat a pan, swirl in a ring of olive oil, then sauté mushrooms with salt, pepper, and herbs — the deep umami and aroma pairs beautifully with the soft, nutty flavor of egg. Put both in your mouth at once and the flavor multiplies. That's Congruent Pairing — combining ingredients with similar tastes and aromas to make the flavor even richer. Like roasted potatoes with roasted garlic and rosemary, where similarly-scented ingredients come together for a deeper flavor. 
(My breakfast diary — I tend to aim for breakfast pairings)
Button mushrooms and a fried egg are a great pairing. Of course, any mushroom works, not just button mushrooms. A 400kcal #mushroom toast with crispy toasted sourdough, butter-sautéed button mushrooms, and a fried egg
버섯토스트.ingredients: 1 slice sourdough, 5-6 button mushrooms, 1 egg, 2T basil pesto, salt, pepper, olive oil, a little parsley
버섯토스트.steps:
1. Brush off any dust from the button mushrooms and slice thin. For more chew, slice them thicker instead. Add butter to a pan and sauté the mushrooms. Season with salt and pepper. 
2. Fry 1 egg sunny-side up.
3. Drizzle olive oil on the sourdough and toast until crisp on both sides. 
4. Place the sourdough on a plate, spread with basil pesto, then top with the mushrooms, fried egg, and a little chopped parsley.

토마토수프-토마토.title: Tomato Soup Tomato
토마토수프-토마토.intro:
20250704 #breakfastdiary 1441, 25°C/cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M) 
I could've sworn I had a tomato, but nope, none. Then I remembered the plain crushed tomato my mom gave me a while back, so I poured it in and simmered it into this #tomatosoup
토마토수프-토마토.ingredients: 10 cherry tomatoes, 1 bottle crushed tomato (about 600ml), a little broccoli, salt, pepper, olive oil
토마토수프-토마토.steps:
1. Drizzle olive oil in a nonstick pot and sauté the cherry tomatoes for 2-3 minutes. Pour in a bottle of plain crushed tomato (the one from my mom) and bring to a boil. Season with salt and pepper, add herbs, and simmer a bit longer. 
2. Blanch a little broccoli in boiling water. 
3. Ladle the tomato soup from step 1 into a bowl, top with the broccoli. Finish with a drizzle of olive oil.

포도샐러드-포도.title: Grape Salad Grapes
포도샐러드-포도.intro:
20250703 #breakfastdiary 1440, 25°C/drizzle
High in calories and sugar, so eating it as a fasting breakfast takes some real preparation — but it's delicious. #grapesalad
포도샐러드-포도.ingredients: 2 cups each green and red grapes, 20cm celery stalk, 1/2 cup raisins, a little basil, olive oil, salt, pepper
포도샐러드-포도.steps:
1. Wash the green and red grapes thoroughly under running water and cut them in half. 
2. Finely chop the celery stalk and basil as well. 
3. In a mixing bowl, combine 3T olive oil, salt, pepper, lemon zest, and lemon juice, then add the grapes, chopped celery, basil, and raisins from step 1 and mix evenly. 
4. Plate it up and finish with a little olive oil~

감자샐러드-감자.title: Potato Salad Potatoes
감자샐러드-감자.intro:
20250702 #breakfastdiary 1439, 25°C/cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M) 
Four kinds of potatoes I bought at Marché @marchefriends last weekend — dubaek, red potato, hongyeong, and jayeong — tossed in a nose-tingling horseradish dressing. #potatosalad
감자샐러드-감자.ingredients: 4 potatoes, salt, pepper, chives, (dressing) 2T mayonnaise, 2T Greek yogurt and milk mixed 2:1, 2t horseradish
감자샐러드-감자.steps:
1. Wash the four kinds of potatoes clean, put them in a pot with water and a little salt, and boil. Drain and chill in the fridge. Cut each potato into 4 pieces. 
2. Meanwhile, make the dressing. Mix 2T mayonnaise, 2T of Greek yogurt and milk combined 2:1, and 2t horseradish until smooth. It's a fairly thick dressing. Add 1t lemon juice to balance the flavor. 
3. Put the potatoes in a mixing bowl, add the dressing from step 2, and mix evenly. 
4. Plate the potatoes and top with chives and pepper.

가지-토마토-토스트.title: Eggplant Tomato Toast
가지-토마토-토스트.intro:
20250701 #breakfastdiary 1438, 25°C/mostly cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M) 
They say the older you get, the more fiber you need — so I peeled off the fiber-rich skin, focused on the flavor instead, and turned the creamy eggplant flesh into an eggplant mix to pile on sourdough. About 500kcal eggplant tomato toast
가지-토마토-토스트.ingredients: 1 eggplant, 10 cherry tomatoes, 3-4 sprigs parsley, olive oil, red wine vinegar, herbs, salt, pepper, a little chives
가지-토마토-토스트.steps:
1. Peel the eggplant with a peeler, microwave for 1:30, then cut into 1cm cubes. 
2. Cut the cherry tomatoes into the same size and squeeze out the moisture. 
3. Chop 3-4 stems of parsley. 
4. Put 1-3 in a mixing bowl, add 3T olive oil, 1t red wine vinegar, herbs, salt, and pepper, and mix evenly. 
5. Brush olive oil on the sourdough and toast both sides until crisp. 
6. Top the sourdough with the eggplant mix from step 4 and a little chives.

복숭아샌드위치-복숭아.title: Peach Sandwich Peaches
복숭아샌드위치-복숭아.intro:
20250630 #breakfastdiary 1437, 25°C/partly cloudy
On mornings when my mind is busier than my body, a sandwich you just assemble from simple ingredients is just right. #peachsandwich made with in-season shinbi peaches
복숭아샌드위치-복숭아.ingredients: 1/2 baguette, 2 shinbi peaches, fresh mozzarella cheese, a little basil, olive oil, salt
복숭아샌드위치-복숭아.steps:
1. Brush olive oil on the baguette and toast both sides until crisp. 
2. Layer mozzarella cheese on the baguette, add basil and thinly sliced shinbi peaches, then finish with a little Maldon salt and olive oil.

당근샐러드-2.title: #carrotsalad
당근샐러드-2.intro:
20250629 #breakfastdiary 1436, 24°C/cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
Fragrant carrot greens wilt so fast after harvest that they're hard to find in the city. I went to Marché @marche_friends and picked up a few carrots that had just been harvested, still leafy and fresh. #carrotsalad, about 200kcal, using both the greens and the roots.
당근샐러드-2.ingredients:
5-6 carrots with greens attached, 1/2 cup peas, salt, pepper, olive oil, (dressing) 2T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard
* The stems are tougher than they look. Use only the leaves and roots in the salad.
당근샐러드-2.steps:
1. Rinse the carrot greens under running water and cut into bite-sized pieces. 
2. Blanch the peas in boiling water with a little salt. 
3. Heat oil in a pan, drizzle olive oil, and sauté the carrots. Season with salt and pepper. 
4. Pile the greens on a plate, top with the carrots from step 3, add the peas, and finish with the dressing.

컬리콜리니-샐러드.title: #Romanesco Salad
컬리콜리니-샐러드.intro:
20250628 #breakfastdiary 1435, 27°C/drizzle
There's a vegetable called romanesco, a cross between broccoli and cauliflower. It's said to be sweet and juicy enough to eat raw. Lightly seared in a pan and topped with basil pesto, this 257kcal #romanesco salad
컬리콜리니-샐러드.ingredients: 150g white romanesco, 1T basil pesto, olive oil, salt, pepper, grana padano cheese
컬리콜리니-샐러드.steps:
1. Rinse the white romanesco under running water, pat dry, cut into bite-sized pieces, and sear in a pan with olive oil. Season with salt and pepper. 
2. Plate it up and top with basil pesto and grana padano cheese.

폴렌타.title: Polenta
폴렌타.intro:
20250627 #breakfastdiary 1434, 20°C/cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M) 
When you're stuck with leftover odds-and-ends vegetables, this is the move — any vegetable works! 690kcal polenta
폴렌타.ingredients: 1 cup polenta, 4-5 button mushrooms, a little zucchini, 4-5 cherry tomatoes, salt, pepper, olive oil
폴렌타.steps:
1. In a pot, combine 1 cup polenta, 2 cups boiling water, salt, and pepper, mix evenly, add a knob of butter, cover, and let sit for about 10 minutes. 
2. Finely chop the button mushrooms, zucchini, and cherry tomatoes. Squeeze out the moisture from the cherry tomatoes. Heat olive oil in a pan, season with salt and pepper, and sauté the zucchini, mushrooms, and cherry tomatoes. 
3. Spoon the polenta onto a plate and top with the sautéed vegetables from step 2.

콘양배추구이-콘양배추.title: Roasted Cone Cabbage Cone Cabbage
콘양배추구이-콘양배추.intro:
20250626 #breakfastdiary 1433, 20°C/cloudy
Cone cabbage, pointed like a party hat, roasted and flavored with a savory anchovy dressing. #roastedconecabbage
콘양배추구이-콘양배추.ingredients: 1/2 cone cabbage, 1/4 cup walnuts, a little cilantro, (dressing) 4-5 anchovies, 4T olive oil, 1T parmesan cheese, 1t minced garlic, pepper
콘양배추구이-콘양배추.steps:
1. Combine 4-5 anchovies, 4T olive oil, 1T parmesan cheese, 1t minced garlic, and pepper and mix evenly. (Adjust the consistency with olive oil — a bit thinner is probably better.) 
2. Trim the outer leaves of the cone cabbage, cut into quarters, and brush evenly with the dressing from step 1. 
3. Roast in a 230°C oven for 20 minutes. 
4. Plate it up and top with crushed walnuts and a little cilantro.

타코터브-Tacotub.title: #Tacotub #Tacotub
타코터브-Tacotub.intro:
20250625 #breakfastdiary 1432, 20°C/drizzle, 20 min/exercise (M)
I wanted to soak in a warm (not hot 🙅) bathtub, but there was no time for that — so instead I decided to soak some delicious ingredients in a taco tub. 
A 350kcal #tacotub #Tacotub loaded with mushrooms, avocado, and tomato
타코터브-Tacotub.ingredients: 2 taco tubs (shells), 5-6 button mushrooms, 1/2 avocado's worth, lime juice, 4-5 cherry tomatoes, cilantro, salt, pepper, olive oil
타코터브-Tacotub.steps:
1. Warm the taco tubs in a 120°C oven for 10 minutes. 
2. Roughly chop 5-6 button mushrooms so you get some bite, and sauté in a pan with olive oil, salt, and pepper. 
3. Thaw the frozen avocado in the microwave for 1 minute, add salt, pepper, and 1t lime juice, mash, and mix evenly. 
4. Cut the cherry tomatoes in half. 
5. Now just assemble. Fill the taco tubs with the mushrooms from step 2, and tuck the avocado and cherry tomatoes to one side. (The tubs are smaller than expected, so the filling might overflow.) Mix mayonnaise with lime juice and drizzle on top, then add pepper and a little cilantro.

양파수프-양파.title: Onion Soup Onions
양파수프-양파.intro:
20250624 #breakfastdiary 1431, 23°C/cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
#onionsoup from "A Walk Through Ingredients," a column I've loved since issue one of Still Life @stilllife.audio_magazine.
Feeling low on serotonin and worried I'd get cranky, I threw in some acini di pepe for carbs and simmered it all together.
양파수프-양파.ingredients: 3 onions, 1/4 cup acini di pepe, 1 piece vegetable stock, a little salami, a little chopped chives
양파수프-양파.steps:
1. Boil the acini di pepe (1/4 cup) in salted boiling water. 
2. Peel the onions, trim just the long root ends at the bottom, wash well, and prep. Trim just a little off the top too. 
3. Chop a little salami and lightly sauté in a nonstick pot with olive oil. Pour in 900ml water, add a piece of vegetable stock and the onions from step 2, and simmer for 20-30 minutes. (Microwaving the onions for about 2 minutes first could cut the time down.) 
4. Once the onions are fully cooked, take them out, add the acini di pepe from step 1, and simmer for 1-2 minutes. 
5. Put the onions in a bowl, pour in the broth, and top with the chopped chives.

계란과-시금치를-곁들인-폴렌타.title: #Polenta with Egg and Spinach
계란과-시금치를-곁들인-폴렌타.intro:
20250623 #breakfastdiary 1430, 20°C/clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
Italian corn porridge, polenta, is done in just 5-10 minutes of boiling water. You can pair it with whatever vegetable you like, quickly cooked, which makes it perfect for a mentally busy Monday morning like today, where the start of a new week crosses paths with the end of a month. About 250kcal per serving, #polenta with egg and spinach
계란과-시금치를-곁들인-폴렌타.ingredients: 1 cup polenta, 5g butter, 1 egg, a little spinach, 2T parmesan cheese, salt, pepper, olive oil
계란과-시금치를-곁들인-폴렌타.steps:
1. In a pot, combine 1 cup polenta, 2 cups boiling water, salt, and pepper, mix evenly, add a knob of butter, cover, and let sit for about 10 minutes. 
2. Heat olive oil in a pan, fry an egg, season with salt and pepper, and blanch a little spinach. 
3. Spoon the polenta into a bowl and add the parmesan cheese, egg, spinach, and a little more olive oil.

복숭아샐러드-복숭아-2.title: Peach Salad Peaches
복숭아샐러드-복숭아-2.intro:
20250622 #breakfastdiary 1429, 22°C/clear
I called it peach salad, but the peach is really just a supporting act — this is more of a clean-out-the-fridge salad. Still, the name stands: #peachsalad
복숭아샐러드-복숭아-2.ingredients: Peaches and literally whatever vegetables catch my eye when I open the fridge right now, (dressing) 3T olive oil, 1T lemon juice, 1t Dijon mustard
복숭아샐러드-복숭아-2.steps:
1. Spinach that arrived yesterday, leftover crown daisy and shallot, shinbi peaches bought at the market a couple days ago, frozen blueberries, a bit of leftover bread, and ricotta cheese
2. Mix 3T olive oil, 1T lemon juice, and 1t Dijon mustard to make a dressing, and pour it over.

주키니.title: Zucchini
주키니.intro:
20250621 #breakfastdiary 1428, 22°C/cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
Your holidays, my misery
I was skimming my inbox when a line caught my eye, so I ended up reading the whole newsletter. It was about how the travel industry, having nearly starved during the global pandemic, has now fully recovered (or more) — but in some places, that also means overtourism and its harms are back in full force, just like before. 
We've already been through this once, so you'd think we could handle it more wisely, but overtourism still isn't getting the attention it deserves. We already learned once that this isn't a matter of gracious altruism — it's a matter of risk. 
So today's breakfast is something to cool down a mind overheated with these worries and concerns: ice cubes bobbing in cold zucchini noodles
주키니.ingredients: 100g egg noodles, 1 zucchini, ice, 1/2 lemon, chopped chives, (dressing) 2t maple syrup, 2t soy sauce, 1t fish sauce, 1t garlic powder
주키니.steps:
1. Cut the zucchini into half-moons, sprinkle with salt, let sit a bit, then squeeze out the moisture by hand. Heat olive oil in a pan, sprinkle with salt and pepper, and sear until golden. 
2. Boil the egg noodles in salted water and rinse in cold water. Chewiness 10+ 
3. Mix 2t maple syrup, 2t soy sauce, 1t fish sauce, and 1t garlic powder, pour into a mixing bowl, add the seared zucchini from step 2 and ice, and mix evenly. 
4. Put the zucchini and ice from step 3 into a bowl, add the egg noodles, and mix evenly. Top with chopped chives and squeeze in the juice of 1/2 lemon.

파스타.title: Pasta
파스타.intro:
20250620 #breakfastdiary 1427, 23°C/rain
According to British psychologist Cliff Arnall, the third Friday of June is supposedly the happiest day of the year — good weather, vacation just around the corner, low stress. But that sounds like someone else's story, some other country's story. 
With my mind scattered every which way, here's a One Plate Pasta, about 800kcal, that dramatically cuts down on dishwashing while still keeping all the flavor — and above all, showing off some very Instagrammable, colorful noodles!
파스타.ingredients: Pasta (a generous single serving), 1 egg yolk, 1t minced garlic, chopped parsley, 3T olive oil, salt, pepper, a little grana padano cheese
파스타.steps:
1. Boil the pasta in salted water. 
2. On a plate, combine 1 egg yolk, 1t minced garlic, chopped parsley, 3T olive oil, salt, pepper, and a splash of pasta water, and mix evenly. Grate some grana padano cheese on top. 
3. Add the cooked pasta and toss well. Top with a little more cheese.

황태보푸라기.title: Fluffy Dried Pollack Floss
황태보푸라기.intro:
20250619 #breakfastdiary 1426, 24°C/mostly clear, 20 min/exercise (M) 
I was given some dried pollack strips as a gift about a month or two ago, and while figuring out what to do with them, I made this Korean-style dried pollack floss to celebrate coming back from a business trip, and topped it over rice. There's a scene in Midnight Diner about "cat rice" — rice topped with bonito flakes — this is a similar but different kind of fun, one-bowl breakfast.
황태보푸라기.ingredients: 2 bowls rice, 20g dried pollack shreds, 1/2t salt, 1/2t sugar, 1T tsuyu, 1T sesame oil
황태보푸라기.steps:
1. Dampen 20g dried pollack shreds with a bit of water, then blend. No need to blend too fine, since it needs to clump. 
2. Add salt, 1/2t sugar, and 1t sesame seeds, mix well, and shape into balls. 
3. Put rice in a bowl, drizzle with 1T tsuyu and 1T sesame oil, top with the fluffy pollack floss, and add a bit more sesame seeds.

당근구이-당근.title: Roasted Carrots Carrots
당근구이-당근.intro:
20250618 #breakfastdiary 1425, 20°C/mostly clear
Good news,
Maybe life is just repeating the effort and the waiting for good news that could arrive at any time, or never. 
On the other hand, roast some carrots, add a bit of orange and balsamic, and you can get your good news in just 5 minutes. #roastedcarrots
당근구이-당근.ingredients: 2 regular carrots, 2 purple carrots, 1 orange, 2T balsamic vinegar, olive oil, salt, pepper
당근구이-당근.steps:
1. Peel the carrots with a peeler and cut lengthwise into quarters. 
2. Heat olive oil in a pan, add the carrots, season with salt and pepper, and cook until the beta-carotene starts seeping out. About 5 minutes on low heat does it. 
3. Plate it up, grate a little orange zest on top, squeeze in the juice of 1/2 an orange by hand, and add 2T balsamic vinegar.

아스파라거스.title: Asparagus
아스파라거스.intro:
20250617 #breakfastdiary 1424, 21°C/cloudy
Business trip's over, breakfast's back on! 
White asparagus with a green hollandaise sauce (not sure this is an actual recipe, but here we are)
아스파라거스.ingredients: 5-6 white asparagus spears, 1T walnuts, (green hollandaise sauce) 100g butter, 2 egg yolks, 1T lemon juice, salt, pepper, and a little spinach
아스파라거스.steps:
1. Peel the white asparagus with a peeler, trim the root ends, and blanch in boiling water for 2-3 minutes. 
2. Melt 100g butter in the microwave for 1-2 minutes, then let cool. 
3. In a blender, combine 2 egg yolks, 1T lemon juice, salt, and a little pepper, then gradually add the melted butter to make a hollandaise sauce. Pull the leaves off the spinach, add them in, and blend a bit more. 
4. Pat the white asparagus from step 1 dry, add olive oil in a pan, and sear briefly. 
5. Plate the asparagus, pour over the green hollandaise sauce, and top with crushed walnuts.

두부카레.title: #Tofu Curry
두부카레.intro:
20250610 #breakfastdiary 1423, 20°C/cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M) 
There's a saying: save someone from drowning and they'll demand their bundle back — in English, "bite the hand that feeds you." I had a nice breakfast and headed out feeling good, but the day ended on a sour note. 
Cloud-soft tofu curry topped with chewy king oyster mushrooms, about 550kcal #tofucurry
두부카레.ingredients: 1 block tofu, 1/4 onion, 1 cube curry roux, king oyster mushrooms, olive oil, salt, pepper
두부카레.steps:
1. In a nonstick pan, sauté 1/4 onion in olive oil, then add 300ml water and the block of tofu, and blend with a hand blender. 
2. Add a cube of curry roux and simmer slowly on low heat. 
3. Heat olive oil in a pan, add salt and pepper, and sauté the king oyster mushrooms. 
4. Put the tofu curry from step 2 into a bowl, and top with the king oyster mushrooms from step 3 and some crown daisy.

아게비타시.title: Agebitashi
아게비타시.intro:
20250609 #breakfastdiary 1422, 22°C/mostly cloudy, 20 min/exercise (S) 
"La nuit porte conseil" — the night brings counsel — is a French proverb the late critic Hwang Hyun-san beautifully translated as "the night is a teacher." The idea is that no matter how hard the problem, sleeping on it brings a good solution. And it's true — a tangled, hopeless-seeming problem often becomes crystal clear once you clear your head and look at it again. But amazingly, a single night doesn't just solve problems — it can also make its own breakfast. 
Agebitashi (揚げ浸し) is fried vegetables marinated in a soy-based sauce. ("age" means fried, "bitashi" means soaked.) All sorts of vegetables fried in oil, then marinated overnight in a soy-based sauce — agebitashi, too, comes together on its own; a breakfast made by the night. 
Late at night before bed, I fried up some vegetables, let them marinate overnight, and served them with boiled somen noodles: #agebitashi somen
아게비타시.ingredients: A bit of somen noodles, assorted vegetables, one piece for topping plus wasabi, (broth) 300ml water, 100ml mirin, 50ml soy sauce, 50ml tsuyu, 1t ginger
아게비타시.steps:
1. Bring 300ml water, 100ml mirin, 50ml soy sauce, 50ml tsuyu, and 1t ginger to a boil. 
2. While it cools, heat plenty of oil in a pan and fry the vegetables — eggplant, zucchini, tomato, mushroom, kabocha squash, whatever you like. 
3. Layer the fried vegetables in a bowl, pour over the broth from step 1, and refrigerate. (At least 30 minutes, but overnight is recommended.) 
4. Boil the somen, adding cold water as it boils, then rinse in cold water. 
5. Put the somen in a bowl, add the marinated vegetables from step 3. Mix the broth from step 1 with cold water in a 1:1 ratio and pour it over. (If you like it strong, you can skip diluting it with water — since this is breakfast, I diluted it to keep it light.)
6. Top with grated radish and wasabi.

올리브-호두-파스타-고소한-호두와-새콤한-그린올리브의-조화가-이색적인-맛.title: Olive Walnut Pasta. The pairing of nutty walnuts and tangy green olives makes for an unusual, distinctive flavor.
올리브-호두-파스타-고소한-호두와-새콤한-그린올리브의-조화가-이색적인-맛.intro:
20250608 #breakfastdiary 1421, 21°C/cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M) 
On the difficulty of making a different breakfast every day, as I wrote in my profile, barring anything unusual, 
The ancient Greek philosopher Heraclitus of Ephesus said that everything is in motion, nothing stays still, and so no one can step into the same river twice. Breakfast is really no different, when you think about it. Even a breakfast that looks identical — made with eggplant and shiitake mushrooms bought from the same place, using the same recipe — can never truly be the same breakfast twice. So this is, in a sense, the spirit running through "a breakfast different from yesterday's." In practice, "a breakfast different from yesterday's" really means something closer to "a breakfast made for the first time" — same ingredients, but a different cooking method and a fresh plating. 

And a "first-time breakfast" always comes with its own struggles. Some days both the taste and the plating come out exactly as I hoped; other days it's too bland and I have to grate in extra Parmigiano Reggiano to fix the seasoning; and some days the exploding egg custard doesn't explode the way I imagined, leaving me staring in despair at a deflated egg custard. When the texture of hummus — made from chickpeas soaked overnight and blended — doesn't turn out right, I sometimes blame the blender, thinking "right, I really should've bought that blender Starbucks uses." And with soufflé pancakes, which I've never once gotten right, I blame this pan for not distributing heat evenly and go searching online for one with better heat conduction. Like that line from Between Calmness and Passion (2001) — not quite sure "when, and how much, to open my heart" — a "first-time breakfast" is always difficult, because I still don't really know when and how much to adjust the heat, the doneness of the ingredients, or the seasoning. 
(Me, breakfast: lonely or sad, I always eat) 

Ah, I should have bought pitted olives — cue "should have + PP" (regret over something not done in the past). But it's the weekend, so there's plenty of time. Without panicking, I calmly picked out just the olive flesh while the pasta boiled. (If only I'd had a thick plastic straw, it would've been one shot, one kill.) Anyway, that's the story behind today's 600kcal olive walnut pasta. The pairing of nutty walnuts and tangy green olives makes for an unusual, distinctive flavor.
올리브-호두-파스타-고소한-호두와-새콤한-그린올리브의-조화가-이색적인-맛.ingredients: 2.5 cups penne (any short pasta works), 1 cup walnuts, 1 cup green olives, 1 lemon, olive oil, salt, pepper, 1 clove garlic
올리브-호두-파스타-고소한-호두와-새콤한-그린올리브의-조화가-이색적인-맛.steps:
1. Boil the penne in salted water. 
2. Heat olive oil in a pan and cook the walnuts and green olives for 3-4 minutes. Once the pan is filled with a fragrant aroma, turn off the heat and add minced garlic, salt, and pepper, mixing evenly. 
3. Add the penne and 1/2 cup pasta water, and mix evenly. Adjust the seasoning with salt and pasta water. 
4. Turn off the heat and add lemon zest and the juice of 1/2 a lemon. 
5. Plate it up and top with a little grana padano cheese.

도-안-되는-바나나-아보카도-so-called-바나카도콘.title: Not-Quite-There Banana + Avocado = So-Called Banacado Cones
도-안-되는-바나나-아보카도-so-called-바나카도콘.intro:
20250607 #breakfastdiary 1420, 20°C/cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M) 
Even had a rain shower — starting to feel like real summer. 
Guacamole with banana mixed in for a slightly more finger-food-like flavor, scooped into tortilla cones for bite-sized eating — all together under 550kcal, banana + avocado = so-called banacado cones
도-안-되는-바나나-아보카도-so-called-바나카도콘.ingredients: 2 tortillas, (toppings) Greek yogurt, peas, shredded cheese, (guacamole) 1 avocado, 1/4 onion, 5 cherry tomatoes, 1 clove garlic, salt, pepper
도-안-되는-바나나-아보카도-so-called-바나카도콘.steps:
1. Cut the tortillas in half, shape into cones, hold the shape with skewers, brush with olive oil, and bake in a 180°C oven for 10 minutes (bake standing up).
2. Mash the avocado, mix in 1/2 a banana, 1/4 chopped onion, chopped seeded tomato, 1t lime juice, 1t minced garlic, salt, and pepper to make the guacamole. 
3. Fill the tortilla cones from step 1 with the avocado mixture, and top with Greek yogurt, peas, and shredded cheese. I had mint on hand but forgot to use it.

대파샐러드.title: Green Onion Salad
대파샐러드.intro:
20250606 #breakfastdiary 1419, 18°C/mostly clear
June 9, 2015, 9:32 AM
"Korean men ask each other's age in any gathering, in order to establish a hierarchy. An 'equal relationship' makes both sides uncomfortable. In moments like this, nothing is as convenient as a strong, dictatorial power. It's the sensibility of getting used to equality that builds democracy."
Hwang Hyun-san, There Is So Much I Don't Know
I keep Hwang Hyun-san's book close by and flip through it now and then. Even a tweet from a full 10 years ago still feels fresh. 
A familiar recipe, but plated in a new way — 385kcal green onion salad
대파샐러드.ingredients: 2-3 stalks green onion (white part only), 1 egg, salami, (dressing) 2T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard
대파샐러드.steps:
1. Wash the green onions thoroughly, pat dry, and cut the white part into 10cm lengths. 
2. Heat olive oil in a pan, add the green onions, sprinkle with salt and pepper, and cook slowly over low heat. 
3. Meanwhile, boil the egg. 
4. Arrange the green onions neatly on a plate, top with the soft-boiled egg, and drizzle with vinaigrette dressing. 
5. Finish with grated Meat Lokaal @meatlokaal salami and pepper~

땅콩버터들기름국수-Egg-Noodles-with-Peanut-Butter.title: Egg Noodles with Peanut Butter and Perilla Oil
땅콩버터들기름국수-Egg-Noodles-with-Peanut-Butter.intro:
20250605 #breakfastdiary 1418, 14°C/clear
Chef Lee Yeon-bok's, about 500kcal, egg noodles with peanut butter and perilla oil
A bit different from perilla oil noodles
땅콩버터들기름국수-Egg-Noodles-with-Peanut-Butter.ingredients: 50g egg noodles, 1/2 cucumber, 1 sheet seasoned laver, a little peanuts for topping, (sauce) 2T seasoned soy sauce, 3T perilla oil, 1T sesame oil, 1T peanut butter, 1T plum extract
땅콩버터들기름국수-Egg-Noodles-with-Peanut-Butter.steps:
1. Boil the egg noodles in boiling water. About 50g per serving. Once cooked, drain and rinse in cold water. 
2. While the noodles cook, mix 2T seasoned soy sauce, 3T perilla oil, 1T sesame oil, 1T peanut butter, and 1T plum extract evenly to make the sauce. 
3. Thinly slice the cucumber. 
4. Cut the seasoned laver into thin strips with scissors as well. 
5. In a mixing bowl, combine the egg noodles with the sauce from step 2 and mix evenly. 
6. Plate the tossed egg noodles, seasoned laver, and cucumber, and top with finely ground peanuts.

적양배추오븐구이.title: #OvenRoastedRedCabbage
적양배추오븐구이.intro:
20250604 #breakfastdiary 1417, 18°C/mostly clear, 20 min/exercise (M) 
Day 2 of my fasting olive oil shot. What matters more is what I eat after that shot. I need a diet centered on fiber and protein with fewer carbs. 
For example, this nutrient-packed, about 400kcal, #ovenroastedredcabbage, with a dressing made of wild garlic spread from Bream Farm @bream_farm mixed with olive oil and lemon juice.
적양배추오븐구이.ingredients: Red cabbage, grana padano cheese, mint, (dressing) 2T wild garlic spread, olive oil, 2T lemon juice (if you don't have wild garlic spread, basil pesto works well too)
적양배추오븐구이.steps:
1. Cut the red cabbage in half, then into wedges, place on a baking pan, drizzle with olive oil, salt, and pepper, and roast in a 200°C oven for 30 minutes, flipping once halfway through. 
2. Mix 2T wild garlic spread with olive oil and 2T lemon juice to make the dressing. 
3. Plate the red cabbage from step 1 and drizzle with the dressing from step 2. Finish with a little grana padano cheese and mint~

파바빈-샐러드.title: Fava Bean Salad
파바빈-샐러드.intro:
20250603 #breakfastdiary 1416, 22°C/clear, 20 min/exercise (M) 
Fava beans, also known as broad beans. They're rich in an antioxidant called apigenin, which is said to help improve insulin resistance and ease blood sugar spikes. Plenty of fiber and high protein come as a bonus. 
The dressing is missing sumac (didn't have any) — adding it would make it tangier. 
With this week's fasting olive oil intake in mind, about 445kcal fava bean salad
파바빈-샐러드.ingredients: 2 cups fava beans, 2T ricotta cheese, (dressing) 3T olive oil, 2T red wine vinegar, 1t sesame seeds, 2T chopped roasted pistachios, 1T chopped mint, salt, pepper
파바빈-샐러드.steps:
1. Soak the fava beans in water for about 30 minutes. Add a pinch of salt to boiling water and boil the fava beans for 20-30 minutes. 
2. Meanwhile, combine 3T olive oil, 2T red wine vinegar, 1t sesame seeds, 2T chopped roasted pistachios, 1T chopped mint, salt, and pepper, mixing evenly to make the dressing. 
3. Drain the fava beans, remove excess moisture, put in a bowl, pour over the dressing, and mix evenly. 
4. Put ricotta cheese on a plate and top with the fava beans. A little lemon juice~

오디-토스트.title: Mulberry Toast
오디-토스트.intro:
20250602 #breakfastdiary 1415, 17°C/cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M) 
There's a saying about mulberry fields turning into blue seas, meaning so much time has passed and so much has changed. I looked into why mulberry trees specifically get used in that phrase — apparently mulberry trees used to be planted a lot on useless land, near wetlands or marshes. Anyway, mulberries have a subtle sweetness that's really charming. 
About 315kcal mulberry toast
오디-토스트.ingredients: 1 slice sourdough, 2T ricotta cheese, 1 cup mulberries, a little pistachio, mint (nice to have, but fine without)
오디-토스트.steps:
1. Brush olive oil on the sourdough and toast both sides until crisp. 
2. Let the sourdough cool slightly, spread ricotta cheese, and top with mulberries and chopped pistachios. A drizzle of honey would make it even better, but that's it for today~

닭안심-미나리-덮밥.title: Chicken Tenderloin and Water Dropwort Rice Bowl
닭안심-미나리-덮밥.intro:
20250601 #breakfastdiary 1414, 21°C/mostly clear, 20 min/exercise (M) 
There's a saying: a flower's scent travels a hundred li, wine's scent travels a thousand li, but a person's character travels ten thousand li — a metaphor for the reach of someone's good character. Water dropwort's scent barely lingers past your nose, but it's worth wondering whether I carry even that much of a scent myself. 
I thought about turning the leftover chicken tenderloin from a couple days ago into a curry, but then I spotted some water dropwort wilting away lonely in the corner of the fridge, so I switched to a rice bowl instead (the leaves had wilted too much to eat, so I just chopped up the stems and piled them on rice). Fragrant. 625kcal chicken tenderloin and water dropwort rice bowl
닭안심-미나리-덮밥.ingredients: Rice, 5 pieces chicken tenderloin, water dropwort (stems only), (for marinating) 100g plain yogurt, whole grain mustard, mayonnaise, soy sauce, honey, olive oil, sake (or cooking wine, or rum in a pinch), (sauce) 3T soy sauce, 2T sugar, 1T plum extract, 1t minced ginger, 1t oyster sauce, 6T water
닭안심-미나리-덮밥.steps:
1. To leftover yogurt (about 100g), add 2T whole grain mustard, 1T mayonnaise, 2t soy sauce, 2t honey, 1T olive oil, and (I meant to use cooking wine instead of the original recipe's sake, but I was out) 1T rum, and mix evenly.
2. Trim the connective tissue and tendons off the chicken tenderloin and soak in the yogurt from step 1. Let it marinate for about an hour — just enough time for a quick workout and a shower. 
3. Sear the marinated chicken tenderloin from step 2 in a hot pan until golden. 
4. Finely chop just the water dropwort stems. 
5. Combine 3T soy sauce, 2T sugar, 1T plum extract, 1t minced ginger, 1t oyster sauce, and 6T water, mixing evenly. Adjust the water to taste. 
6. Put rice in a bowl, pour over the sauce from step 5, and cover the rice with the water dropwort from step 4. Top with the chicken tenderloin from step 3 and a bit more of the sauce from step 5.

그리스식-스크램블-에그-스트라파차다-Στραπατσάδα-Strapats.title: Greek Scrambled Eggs, Strapatsada (Στραπατσάδα) Very Moist #ScrambledEggs
그리스식-스크램블-에그-스트라파차다-Στραπατσάδα-Strapats.intro:
20250531 #breakfastdiary 1413, 19°C/cloudy
About 500kcal Greek scrambled eggs made by mixing grated tomato into eggs, strapatsada (Στραπατσάδα, Strapatsada), very moist #scrambledeggs. 
I was happy to spot #mulberries at the fruit shop, so I bought a pack. It's summer.
그리스식-스크램블-에그-스트라파차다-Στραπατσάδα-Strapats.ingredients: 2 tomatoes, 4 eggs, salt, pepper, olive oil, a little feta cheese
그리스식-스크램블-에그-스트라파차다-Στραπατσάδα-Strapats.steps:
1. Cut off the tomato stems and grate the tomatoes. 
2. Heat olive oil in a pan, lightly sauté 1t garlic, add the grated tomato from step 1 and herbs, and cook a bit longer until the moisture evaporates. 
3. Add 4 eggs, salt, and pepper, pour into the pan from step 2, and cook. 
4. Plate it up and top with feta cheese and mint.

요거트에-마리네이드한-닭안심-샐러드.title: Yogurt-Marinated Chicken Tenderloin Salad
요거트에-마리네이드한-닭안심-샐러드.intro:
20250530 #breakfastdiary 1412, 19°C/clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
The Korean phrase "gud-i" ("why bother") carries a hint of some inner standard, will, or stubbornness. "You followed me all this way for no reason" is said when you'd rather they hadn't come. It's the feeling of "you didn't have to..." So when you say "why bother?" to someone putting in real effort, it deflates them. Like when someone who came a long way is met with "why did you even bother coming?" — the energy just drains out.
Some people refuse to lose to the phrase "why bother." People who talk back with "of course I need to!" People who defy gravity and leap up anyway. People who won't let emptiness and cynicism drag their body down. In those moments, words like "anyway, without fail, gladly, no matter what" stand right next to "why bother."
Kim Jin-hae
There are plenty of other cuts of chicken, but choosing the tenderloin anyway, and marinating it in yogurt when it would taste fine just grilled plain — that's a quiet vow to enjoy, no matter what, the single most delicious breakfast in the world. About 600kcal yogurt-marinated chicken tenderloin salad
요거트에-마리네이드한-닭안심-샐러드.ingredients: 5 pieces chicken tenderloin, crown daisy, cherry tomatoes, (for marinating) 100g plain yogurt, whole grain mustard, mayonnaise, soy sauce, honey, olive oil, sake (or cooking wine, or rum in a pinch)
요거트에-마리네이드한-닭안심-샐러드.steps:
1. To leftover yogurt (about 100g), add 2T whole grain mustard, 1T mayonnaise, 2t soy sauce, 2t honey, 1T olive oil, and (I meant to use cooking wine instead of the original recipe's sake, but I was out) 1T rum, and mix evenly. Set a little aside for the dressing. 
2. Trim the connective tissue and tendons off the chicken tenderloin and soak in the yogurt from step 1. It should marinate for about an hour, but there's no time, so just 30 minutes. 
3. Sear the marinated chicken tenderloin from step 2 in a hot pan until golden. 
4. On a plate, arrange the crown daisy (arugula-esque), cherry tomatoes, and seared chicken tenderloin, then drizzle with the dressing set aside from step 1.

별로-망고.title: Meh Mango
별로-망고.intro:
20250529 #breakfastdiary 1411, 18°C/clear, 15 min/exercise (S)
I'd been waiting several days for the avocado to ripen, but I couldn't wait any longer and just made it. Turns out the mango wasn't quite ripe either, so the flavor's pretty meh overall. I tweaked the original recipe a little, and the dressing ended up kind of in-between too. Anyway, overall #meh avocado mango salad
별로-망고.ingredients: 5 stalks crown daisy (use only the leaves, chew on the stems as you cook), 1 avocado, 1 mango, (dressing) 4T olive oil, 2T lime juice, 1t fish sauce, 1t sugar, salt, pepper, 1t minced garlic, 1t minced shallot
별로-망고.steps:
1. Wash the crown daisy under running water and pick off just the leaves. 
2. The avocado still seems a bit underripe, but there's no helping it. Cut in half, remove the pit, and cut into bite-sized pieces. 
3. Peel the mango with a grater and cut into pieces similar in size to the avocado. 
4. Mix 4T olive oil, 2T lime juice, 1t fish sauce, 1t sugar, salt, pepper, 1t minced garlic, and 1t minced shallot evenly. 
5. In a mixing bowl, combine the crown daisy, avocado, and mango with the dressing from step 4 and mix evenly. 
6. Plate it up and top with fried shallots. Finish with pepper~

푸실리샐러드.title: #FusilliSalad
푸실리샐러드.intro:
20250528 #breakfastdiary 1410, 20°C/mostly cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
I figured the avocado would ripen nicely after a night, but it's still hard, not quite there. Guess it'll have to wait until tomorrow. While pondering that for a moment, I tossed this 430kcal #fusillisalad in taco salsa by @chang_seoryeong apunto.seo, bought recently at Duomo's @hyojadongduomo 17th anniversary market. 
Would've been even better served alongside tacos, of course~🌮🌮🌮
푸실리샐러드.ingredients: 2 cups fusilli, salsa, grana padano cheese, 1/2 chwicheong cucumber, 2 cups cherry tomatoes, 1/4 cup peas, a little spinach, (store-bought) 3 shrimp balls
푸실리샐러드.steps:
1. Boil the fusilli in salted water. 
2. Meanwhile, wash the cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and spinach thoroughly and cut into bite-sized pieces. 
3. Briefly blanch the peas and shrimp balls in boiling water. 
4. Put the prepared ingredients in a bowl, add 2T salsa, and toss well. 
5. Portion into a bowl and top with grated grana padano cheese.

무샐러드.title: #RadishSalad
무샐러드.intro:
20250527 #breakfastdiary 1409, 17°C/mostly clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
O Pepper @o.pepper_official recommends pairing their Madagascar green pepper with tofu, pork, and chicken. It has a slight saltiness, so it's also great in a salad for boosting umami. About 390kcal #radishsalad
무샐러드.ingredients: 1/2 radish, a handful of pine nuts, a little parsley, balsamic, green pepper (regular pepper works too), (dressing) 2T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard
무샐러드.steps:
1. Wash the radish thoroughly and cut into 2cm-thick slices. The top part of the radish (near the greens) is sweeter, so it's better for salads. 
2. Toast a handful of pine nuts in a hot pan until golden and fragrant. 
3. Remove the pine nuts, add olive oil to the pan, and sear the radish, browning all four sides evenly. 
4. Plate the radish, top with the pine nuts, drizzle with vinaigrette dressing, and add chopped parsley. Finish with a little balsamic vinegar and green pepper.

토마토토스트.title: #TomatoToast
토마토토스트.intro:
20250526 #breakfastdiary 1408, 15°C/partly cloudy
Spread with wild garlic spread from Bream Farm @bream_farm, bought recently at Marché @marchefriends, and flavored with green pepper from O Pepper @o.pepper_official. About 207kcal #tomatotoast
토마토토스트.ingredients: 1 slice whole grain bread, 1/2 tomato, wild garlic spread, green pepper
토마토토스트.steps:
1. Brush olive oil on the whole grain bread and toast both sides until crisp. 
2. Spread wild garlic spread on the bread, top with tomato, and add a little green pepper.

시금치-블렌드를-곁들인-바삭하게-구운-콜리플라워-Crispy-cauli-.title: Crispy Roasted Cauliflower with Spinach Blend, Crispy Cauli & Creamed Spinach
시금치-블렌드를-곁들인-바삭하게-구운-콜리플라워-Crispy-cauli-.intro:
20250522 #breakfastdiary 1407, 18°C/mostly clear
Instead of the butter beans in the original recipe, I used firm tofu meant for pan-frying, but it came out a bit runny. If you don't want to give up that nutty flavor, better to use only about 1/4 firm tofu.
Overwhelmed by the bold Seoul Goods plate by artist @art_nom, this is a roughly 647kcal crispy roasted cauliflower with spinach blend, crispy cauli & creamed spinach
시금치-블렌드를-곁들인-바삭하게-구운-콜리플라워-Crispy-cauli-.ingredients: 1/2 cauliflower, 1T paprika powder, 1T garlic powder, 2T olive oil, (spinach blend) 5-6 stalks spinach, 1t garlic powder, 1/2 block (firm) tofu, 2T olive oil, 1T maple syrup, salt, pepper
시금치-블렌드를-곁들인-바삭하게-구운-콜리플라워-Crispy-cauli-.steps:
1. Cut 1/2 a cauliflower, put in a mixing bowl with 1T paprika powder, 1T garlic powder, and 2T olive oil, and mix evenly. Roast in a 200°C oven for 30 minutes. 
2. Meanwhile, blend 5-6 stalks of spinach, 1t garlic powder, 1/2 block of firm tofu, 2T olive oil, and 1T maple syrup until smooth in a blender. Season to taste with salt and pepper. A slightly salty flavor works well. 
3. Spread the spinach blend from step 2 on a plate and top with the cauliflower from step 1. Finish with a crunchy sprinkle of fried shallots.

새우-완탕으로-속을-달랜다.title: Shrimp Wonton Soup to Soothe the Stomach.
새우-완탕으로-속을-달랜다.intro:
20250521 #breakfastdiary 1406, 20°C/cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
No wonder the bus felt so warm — turns out it's 20°C on the commute. Tasty, but somehow feels like it's packed with cholesterol — about 720kcal shrimp wonton soup to soothe the stomach.
새우-완탕으로-속을-달랜다.ingredients: (store-bought) shrimp dumplings, shrimp balls, 1 serving egg noodles, 1 stalk bok choy, chives
새우-완탕으로-속을-달랜다.steps:
1. Boil 600ml water with 1t oyster sauce, seafood powder, and 1t minced ginger to make the broth. 
2. Blanch the shrimp dumplings and shrimp balls in boiling water. Drain, then boil the egg noodles. Rinse the egg noodles in cold water. 
4. Put the shrimp dumplings, shrimp balls, and bok choy in a bowl and pour in the broth from step 1. (Forgot to add the chives.) Finish with a little white pepper~

시오콘부-염장다시마-를-곁들인-레터스-샐러드.title: Lettuce Salad with Shio Konbu (Salted Kelp)
시오콘부-염장다시마-를-곁들인-레터스-샐러드.intro:
20250520 #breakfastdiary 1405, 17°C/mostly clear
"Don't rush your heart though it aches
like light falling on a river
Don't long for a grand achievement
Even if the dog barks, the bell rings, the moon rises
Don't panic even a little
O heavy body freed from drink
Oh, spring"
A passage from Kim Su-young's poem "Spring Night." "Don't rush your heart though it aches" — quoting a line from Shin Hyung-cheol's The History of Life that I read yesterday — isn't exactly natural as a Korean sentence, yet it somehow sticks in the mind and keeps repeating itself. 
Ironically, on a morning where I had no choice but to rush with an aching heart — 391kcal lettuce salad with shio konbu (salted kelp)
시오콘부-염장다시마-를-곁들인-레터스-샐러드.ingredients: Lettuce, 2 eggs, shio konbu (salted kelp), mayonnaise, olive oil
시오콘부-염장다시마-를-곁들인-레터스-샐러드.steps:
1. Wash a head of (oakleaf) lettuce under running water and roughly chop. 
2. Boil 2 eggs. Hard-boiled is best. 
3. In a mixing bowl, combine the lettuce, eggs, 1T shio konbu, and 1T mayonnaise, and mix evenly. 
4. Plate it up and drizzle with olive oil.

크림우동.title: #CreamUdon
크림우동.intro:
20250519 #breakfastdiary 1404, 14°C/partly cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
Ever since starting this account, I sometimes get gifted bowls or various ingredients from people who know my real identity. It's a genuinely nice feeling when something reminds people of me, and I in turn become associated with something in their mind. Doesn't that mean I have a distinct sense of taste? 
Using eoran (salted mullet roe) instead of mentaiko, and water dropwort instead of chives — a reflection of that distinct taste, a slightly 🤏 fancier 450kcal #creamudon
크림우동.ingredients: 30g eoran (salted mullet roe), 5 stalks water dropwort, 1 serving udon noodles, 100ml milk, 2 slices cheese, 1t tuna extract, 10g butter, pepper
크림우동.steps:
1. Grate the eoran to prepare it. Blending it would be easier, but it wastes too much, so grate it by hand with some elbow grease. 
2. Wash the water dropwort under running water and finely chop just the stems. 
3. In a microwave-safe bowl, add 1 serving udon noodles, 100ml milk, cheese, and 1t tuna extract, and microwave for 2 minutes. 
4. Add 10g butter and microwave for 3 more minutes. 
5. Plate it up and pile on the water dropwort and eoran from step 1. Finish with pepper~

살라미를-얹은-판-콘-토마테-Pan-con-tomate-con-salam.title: Pan con Tomate con Salami with Salami
살라미를-얹은-판-콘-토마테-Pan-con-tomate-con-salam.intro:
20250518 #breakfastdiary 1403, 15°C/clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
Finally made it back to Marché @marchefriends. It was full of lovely ingredients and food, with sunny weather as a bonus. The pan con tomate topped with cured ham from Meat Lokaal @meatlokaal looked so good that I had a plate, then bought some salami for breakfast. That's the story behind this 240kcal pan con tomate con salami with salami
살라미를-얹은-판-콘-토마테-Pan-con-tomate-con-salam.ingredients: 1 slice campagne bread, 1 tomato, olive oil, salt, pepper, a little salami
살라미를-얹은-판-콘-토마테-Pan-con-tomate-con-salam.steps:
1. Brush olive oil on the campagne bread and toast in a hot pan. 
2. Wash the tomato thoroughly, grate it, and add a pinch of salt and a little olive oil. 
3. Top the campagne bread with the grated tomato from step 2, and sliced Meat Lokaal @meatlokaal salami.

쪽파-머스타드-비네그레트를-곁들인-오븐-양배추구이.title: Oven-Roasted #Cabbage with Chive Mustard Vinaigrette
쪽파-머스타드-비네그레트를-곁들인-오븐-양배추구이.intro:
20250517 #breakfastdiary 1402, 21°C/mostly cloudy
Last week, a few reels I genuinely wasn't fond of got picked up by the algorithm and racked up a ton of views. I was just doing what I always do, so there's no explanation other than the algorithm's own selection, its own favor. Then again, how could any human hope to understand the workings of god? 
Today's breakfast might just crack the top 5 out of the thousands of cabbage recipes out there — about 338kcal oven-roasted #cabbage with chive mustard vinaigrette
쪽파-머스타드-비네그레트를-곁들인-오븐-양배추구이.ingredients: 1/4 cabbage, (dressing) 2t Dijon mustard, 2t white wine vinegar, 1t lemon juice, 2T olive oil, salt and pepper, and 3T chives
쪽파-머스타드-비네그레트를-곁들인-오븐-양배추구이.steps:
1. Cut the cabbage into wedges, brush evenly with olive oil, salt, and pepper, and roast in a 220°C oven for 10 minutes, then another 10, for 20 minutes total. 
2. Meanwhile, combine 2t Dijon mustard, 2t white wine vinegar, 1t lemon juice, 2T olive oil, salt, pepper, and 1T chives, mixing evenly to make the dressing. 
3. Plate the cabbage and drizzle with the dressing from step 2 — that's it. This one's genuinely delicious.

오이소면.title: #ColdCucumberSomen
오이소면.intro:
20250516 #breakfastdiary 1401, 18°C/cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
I'd made something in the style of cucumber tataki + capellini before (see the June 2, 2024 breakfast), and that had the taste of summer. Today's cold cucumber somen has a different kind of charm. If I had to put it into words, maybe it's the taste of early summer? Anyway 👍
About 370kcal #coldcucumbersomen
오이소면.ingredients: 1 cucumber, 1 serving somen, 1T sesame seeds, (dressing) 1t minced garlic, 1T honey, 1T vinegar, 1T lemon juice, 1T plum extract, 3T perilla oil
오이소면.steps:
1. Wash the cucumber thoroughly, slice thin, put in a mixing bowl, and salt-cure with a pinch of salt and a little sugar. After 20-30 minutes, squeeze out the moisture. 
2. Mix 1t minced garlic, 1t honey, 1T vinegar, 1T lemon juice, 1T plum extract, 1T fish sauce, and 3T perilla oil to make the dressing. 
3. Boil the somen in salted water, adding cold water as it boils. 
4. Put the somen in a bowl, top with the cucumber from step 1 and 1T ground sesame seeds, and drizzle with the dressing from step 2. Finish with bonito flakes.

콩과-아보카도를-넣은-비교적-비건-타코.title: Fairly #Vegan Tacos with Beans and Avocado
콩과-아보카도를-넣은-비교적-비건-타코.intro:
20250515 #breakfastdiary 1400, 15°C/drizzle
Checked in (🐽) on the state of the bean mix left over from making bean tacos on 5/6, and it seems fine. A little more time and it might genuinely turn into #tempeh, but I've decided to sacrifice it to today's breakfast instead. 
About 550kcal per serving, fairly #vegan tacos with beans and avocado
콩과-아보카도를-넣은-비교적-비건-타코.ingredients: 2 tortillas, parsley, pepper, 🫘bean mix (below), 1 avocado, 1/4 onion, (dressing) 2T Greek yogurt, 1t lime juice, a little parsley
콩과-아보카도를-넣은-비교적-비건-타코.steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a pan, add 1T tomato sauce, 1t paprika powder, and the bean mix, and lightly sauté. If making the bean mix from scratch feels like too much trouble, tempeh works as a substitute. 
🫘Bean mix - 3 cups beans, 1/2 onion, 1/4 cup oats, 1T soy sauce, 1T maple syrup, 1t mustard, 1t tomato paste, 1t paprika powder 
2. Blend 2T Greek yogurt, 1t lime juice, and a little parsley to make the dressing. 
3. Top the tortilla with the bean mix from step 1, avocado, and onion, then drizzle with the dressing from step 2 and (no cilantro on hand, unfortunately, so) parsley and a little pepper.

오븐에-구운-단호박샐러드.title: Oven-Roasted #KabochaSalad
오븐에-구운-단호박샐러드.intro:
20250515 #breakfastdiary 1399, 18°C/clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
"Now
as I lay wondering
what it means to be alive,
sunlight fell
upon my face.
I kept my eyes closed
until the light passed.
Just like that."
(Han Kang, Convalescence Songs)
That's how this morning felt. 
231kcal oven-roasted #kabochasalad
오븐에-구운-단호박샐러드.ingredients: 1/2 kabocha squash, mint, (ricotta cheese dip) 2T ricotta cheese, 1T olive oil, 1T lemon juice, 1t garlic, salt, pepper, chopped parsley
오븐에-구운-단호박샐러드.steps:
1. Wash the kabocha squash under running water and cut into bite-sized pieces.
2. Place the kabocha on a baking pan, sprinkle with olive oil and salt, and roast in a 200°C oven for 30 minutes. 
3. Combine 2T ricotta cheese, 1T olive oil, 1T lemon juice, 1t garlic, salt, pepper, and chopped parsley, mixing evenly. It ends up almost like blue cheese. 
4. Plate the kabocha with the ricotta cheese from step 3, and finish with olive oil and a little mint, like the little star candy in a hardtack pack.

토마토에그누들.title: #TomatoEggNoodles
토마토에그누들.intro:
20250514 #breakfastdiary 1398, 13°C/mostly cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
Originally, you're supposed to stir-fry the tomato-egg mix together with the egg noodles, but the pan was too full, so I just piled the tomato-egg mix on top of the noodles instead. If I'd actually stir-fried them together, it probably would've been a million times better. 495kcal #tomatoeggnoodles
토마토에그누들.ingredients: Egg noodles (as needed), 3 tomatoes, 2 cloves garlic, 1/2 onion, chives, (sauce) 1T ketchup, 1T soy sauce, 1T oyster sauce, 1T sugar
토마토에그누들.steps:
1. Boil the egg noodles in water with a pinch of salt. 
2. Beat 3 eggs with a pinch of salt and make somewhat moist scrambled eggs in an oiled, hot pan. Set aside. 
3. Heat oil in a pan, sauté minced garlic and onion, add 4 roughly chopped tomatoes and the sauce, and cook a bit longer. (Around this point you'd normally add a cornstarch slurry to thicken it, but since I'm adding egg noodles today, I'll skip that.) Add the egg noodles from step 1 and the scrambled eggs from step 2, and stir-fry a bit more. 
4. Plate it up and top with chives and a little chopped peanuts.

오징어-오렌지-샐러드.title: Squid and Orange Salad
오징어-오렌지-샐러드.intro:
20250513 #breakfastdiary 1397, 13°C/clear
"Sumbisori" is the whistling sound haenyeo (women divers) make when they surface after diving and catch their breath. It sounds almost like whistling, and it's the natural sound that comes from expelling a lungful of carbon dioxide all at once while gasping in oxygen. On my commute this morning, after a while away from it, I let out a light breath and it almost sounded like a whistle too. 
470kcal squid and orange salad
오징어-오렌지-샐러드.ingredients: 1 squid, 1 orange, a little fried shallot and crown daisy, (dressing) 2T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, lemon juice
오징어-오렌지-샐러드.steps:
1. Peel the orange with a knife and remove just the flesh. 
2. Pick off only the leaves of the crown daisy and chop with a knife. 
3. Clean the squid thoroughly, blanch in boiling water, and cut into bite-sized pieces. 
4. Heat olive oil in a pan, add the squid, and sear for 2-3 minutes. Pressing it down with a grill press works well too. 
5. In a mixing bowl, combine the seared squid, fried shallot, orange flesh, and chopped crown daisy, and mix evenly. Add vinaigrette dressing and a little lemon juice.

나시다강-아보카도-남이만들어준조식.title: Nasi Dagang Avocado Someone Else Made My Breakfast
나시다강-아보카도-남이만들어준조식.intro:
20250510 #breakfastdiary 1396, 29°C/mostly cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
#NasiDagang is a traditional dish and iconic breakfast from eastern Malaysia. 
The rice is steamed with coconut milk, fenugreek seeds, ginger, shallots, and more. It's typically soaked in water overnight, then steamed twice with coconut milk and spices, giving it a nutty flavor with a slightly sticky texture. 
The fish curry is usually made with tuna or mackerel, flavored with coconut milk, lemongrass, galangal, chili, turmeric, and various other spices. 
It's served alongside a refreshing pickle of vegetables like cucumber and carrot, cured in vinegar and sugar. 
A spicy shrimp paste sauce is served on the side too, for an extra hit of umami! 
In some regions or restaurants, boiled eggs and toasted coconut are also served. 
-
나시다강-아보카도-남이만들어준조식.ingredients: 1 avocado, 1/2 onion, salt, pepper, red wine vinegar (glug glug glug glug glug), olive oil (glug glug)
나시다강-아보카도-남이만들어준조식.steps:
1. The avocado is perfectly ripe. Peel and slice into long pieces. 
2. Peel the onion and slice into rounds. 
3. Arrange the avocado and onion on a plate and sprinkle with a little salt and pepper. 
4. Pour on red wine vinegar — glug glug glug glug glug — and olive oil — glug glug. 

Regional differences 
• The Kelantan style uses a reddish long-grain rice, while the Terengganu style mixes white glutinous rice with fragrant rice. Terengganu style rice is whiter and glossier. 
• The spice blend and accompaniments for the fish curry also vary slightly by region. 

Cultural meaning: Nasi Dagang is a dish that draws on the rich rice, seafood, and spices of Malaysia's east coast, symbolizing the country's diverse and abundant food culture. It's simple yet highly nutritious, and fits equally well for special occasions or everyday meals. 
Summary: 
Nasi Dagang is an iconic traditional dish from Malaysia's east coast, made up of rice steamed with coconut milk and spices, tuna or mackerel curry, pickled vegetables, and shrimp paste. It's a well-rounded one-bowl meal that harmoniously combines nuttiness, spiciness, and tang.

양파-아보카도-샐러드-를-몸과-마음에-우겨-넣었다.title: Force-Fed Myself This Onion Avocado Salad, Body and Mind
양파-아보카도-샐러드-를-몸과-마음에-우겨-넣었다.intro:
20250508 #breakfastdiary 1395, 7°C/clear
Couldn't sleep with one thing and another on my mind, and my body and mind feel like they're floating in midair. This avocado salad has long been enjoyed in the Caribbean and the Andes region — the creaminess of the avocado, the crunch of the onion, and the brightness of vinegar and oil coming together in harmony. I force-fed myself this roughly 400kcal onion avocado salad, body and mind.
양파-아보카도-샐러드-를-몸과-마음에-우겨-넣었다.ingredients: 1 avocado, 1/2 onion, salt, pepper, red wine vinegar (glug glug glug glug glug), olive oil (glug glug)
양파-아보카도-샐러드-를-몸과-마음에-우겨-넣었다.steps:
1. The avocado is perfectly ripe. Peel and slice into long pieces. 
2. Peel the onion and slice into rounds. 
3. Arrange the avocado and onion on a plate and sprinkle with a little salt and pepper. 
4. Pour on red wine vinegar — glug glug glug glug glug — and olive oil — glug glug.

허니-진저-당근-메달리온이다.title: Honey Ginger Carrot Medallions
허니-진저-당근-메달리온이다.intro:
20250507 #breakfastdiary 1394, 11°C/mostly cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
A crepe cake, made by stacking many thin crepes layer upon layer, is said to symbolize longevity and wealth abroad, thanks to all the care that goes into each individual layer. A croissant, too, reveals hundreds of layers when you cut into it, made possible only through the labor of repeatedly rolling and folding the dough over and over. And so today's breakfast, rolled and coiled with just as much care as a crepe cake or croissant into dozens of layers, is this roughly 400kcal honey ginger carrot medallions.
허니-진저-당근-메달리온이다.ingredients: 2 carrots, 2T butter, 1t toasted sesame salt, (sauce) 1T soy sauce, 1T lemon juice, 1T white wine vinegar, 2T honey, 1t ginger
허니-진저-당근-메달리온이다.steps:
1. Shave the carrot into ribbons with a grater and coil into rounds about 5cm across. Tie with kitchen twine so they don't come apart. (Microwaving them like this for about 3 minutes first makes cooking easier.)
2. Add butter to a hot pan and cook the carrots slowly over low heat. 
3. Mix 1T soy sauce, 1T lemon juice, 1T white wine vinegar, 2T honey, and 1t ginger, pour over the carrots, and cook until reduced. 
4. Plate it up and top with parsley.

에디터의기록법-또띠아.title: Editor's Way of Recording Tortillas
에디터의기록법-또띠아.intro:
20250506 #breakfastdiary 1393, 12°C/mostly clear
Started reading "An Editor's Way of Recording." It's amazing that there's a way to soak up other people's hard-earned know-how this effortlessly. 
Unfortunately, there's no way to eat beans raw. On the last day of the holiday, instead of meat, here's #beantaco for vegans, made with beans boiled down soft and blended in.
에디터의기록법-또띠아.ingredients:
Tortillas (about 6 servings' worth), 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese, 1/4 cabbage, (bean mix) 3 cups beans, 1/2 onion, 1/4 cup oats, 1T soy sauce, 1T maple syrup, 1t mustard, 1t tomato paste, 1t paprika powder, (dressing) 3T mayonnaise, 1T ketchup, 1t mustard, 1t maple syrup, 1/4 chopped onion, 1 chopped pickle
*The original recipe used only purple kidney beans.
에디터의기록법-또띠아.steps:
1. Soak the beans in water the night before. About 3 cups. Boil the beans in salted water. 
2. Mash the beans in a mixing bowl, then add 1/2 onion, 1/4 cup oats, 1T soy sauce, 1T maple syrup, 1t mustard, 1t tomato paste, and 1t paprika powder to make a dough. 
3. Spread the bean dough thinly over a tortilla, then place it dough-side-down in a pan with olive oil to sear. 
4. Flip, add mozzarella cheese on top, cover until the cheese melts, and plate it up. 
5. Top the tortilla with long-cut cabbage and mayonnaise dressing (3T mayonnaise, 1T ketchup, 1t mustard, 1t maple syrup, 1/4 chopped onion, 1 chopped pickle). For a spicy kick, add a little paprika powder.

유부-도우-토마토-피자.title: Fried Tofu Skin Dough Tomato Pizza
유부-도우-토마토-피자.intro:
20250505 #breakfastdiary 1392, 12°C/cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
I'd had fried tofu (yubu) taking up a corner of my fridge for a while, and while figuring out what to do with it, I made a fried tofu dough pizza. Yubu is called "fried tofu" in English, literally fried tofu, so naturally it's fairly high in calories. That's just how it goes — the world's delicious things tend to be calorie-heavy. 
About 600kcal fried tofu skin dough tomato pizza
유부-도우-토마토-피자.ingredients: 12 sheets fried tofu (yubu), 1 egg (for the egg wash), 5 cherry tomatoes, 1 cup okra, 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese, olive oil, a little crown daisy
유부-도우-토마토-피자.steps:
1. Spread the fried tofu sheets flat in a tray and pour boiling water over them to rinse off the seasoning. 
2. Squeeze out the moisture from the tofu, brush with egg wash, layer 4 sheets together into a square dough shape, and sear both sides in a hot pan.
3. Place the tofu dough from step 2 on a baking pan, top with basil pesto, cherry tomatoes, okra, and mozzarella cheese, and bake in a 200°C oven for 15 minutes. (Bake until the mozzarella cheese melts.) 
4. Plate it up and top with olive oil and crown daisy.

토마토-갈릭-스프레드를-얹은-치아바타.title: #Ciabatta with Tomato Garlic Spread
토마토-갈릭-스프레드를-얹은-치아바타.intro:
20250504 #breakfastdiary 1391, 11°C/mostly clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
I figured the tomato garlic spread would take about 20 minutes, but I ended up adding two more 10-minute rounds, roasting it for 40 minutes total. The flavor payoff was worth every one of those 40 minutes. 
About 591kcal #ciabatta with tomato garlic spread
토마토-갈릭-스프레드를-얹은-치아바타.ingredients: 1 ciabatta, basil pesto, 1/2 burrata cheese, pine nuts, balsamic glaze, (tomato garlic spread) 10 cherry tomatoes, 10 cloves garlic, rosemary (optional), salt, pepper, olive oil (enough to submerge the tomatoes and garlic)
토마토-갈릭-스프레드를-얹은-치아바타.steps:
1. In an oven-safe dish, combine cherry tomatoes, garlic, rosemary for fragrance, salt, and pepper, and pour in enough olive oil to submerge everything. Roast in a 200°C oven for 40 minutes. 
2. Slice the ciabatta horizontally and lightly toast the cut sides. 
3. Spread basil pesto on the ciabatta, then top with burrata cheese and the roasted cherry tomatoes and garlic from step 1. 
4. Add pan-toasted pine nuts and a drizzle of balsamic glaze, cover with the other half of ciabatta, and cut in half to eat.

간장-드레싱-죽순샐러드.title: Soy Sauce Dressing #BambooShootSalad
간장-드레싱-죽순샐러드.intro:
20250503 #breakfastdiary 1390, 12°C/cloudy
Start of the holiday, about 259kcal soy sauce dressing #bambooshootsalad 
Delicious as is, but if you also boil somen, rinse in cold water, and toss it with 1T tsuyu and 1T sesame oil to eat alongside — that's next-level good
간장-드레싱-죽순샐러드.ingredients: 1 can bamboo shoots, 1 sheet gamtae (sea lettuce), dried shrimp, (dressing) 1T chili oil, 2T ponzu, 1T honey, a pinch of salt
간장-드레싱-죽순샐러드.steps:
1. Mix 1T chili oil, 2T ponzu, 1T honey, and a pinch of salt evenly. 
2. Rinse the canned bamboo shoots under running water, cut into bite-sized pieces, sear in an oiled pan until golden, pour over the dressing from step 1, mix evenly, and let sit for about 10 minutes so the dressing soaks in. 
3. Plate it up and top with the gim (seaweed) and dried baby shrimp.

토마토-리코타치즈-토스트.title: Tomato Ricotta Cheese Toast
토마토-리코타치즈-토스트.intro:
20250502 #breakfastdiary 1389, 11°C/clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
I'm always racing against the clock making breakfast, but I still put a fair amount of effort into the plating. Of course, that's partly a courtesy to all the followers who can only experience it through their eyes, and partly just a basic virtue of running a food account online. Thanks to that, over the past few years I've picked up a few plating principles. (omitted)
Third: odd numbers rule breakfast. The human brain finds slight asymmetry more appealing than perfect symmetry, so a perfectly even number can actually come across as unnatural and off-putting. That's why every ingredient that appears in a breakfast gets plated in odd numbers. But do I really have to follow this rule every single time?
(Me, breakfast: to those of you obsessed with plating)
And that's why this about 328kcal tomato ricotta cheese toast is plated in odd numbers
토마토-리코타치즈-토스트.ingredients: 1 sourdough from @honest_meallo, ricotta cheese, 7 cherry tomatoes, Maldon salt, olive oil, mint
토마토-리코타치즈-토스트.steps:
1. Brush olive oil on the sourdough and toast until crisp. Pressing it with a grill press makes it about 8 times crispier. 
2. Alternate dollops of ricotta cheese and halved cherry tomatoes on top, then finish with Maldon salt, olive oil, and mint leaves.

두부피-파스타-페스토-샐러드.title: Tofu Skin Pasta Pesto Salad
두부피-파스타-페스토-샐러드.intro:
20250501 #breakfastdiary 1388, 16°C/rain
According to Wikipedia, fuzhu (Chinese: 腐竹, pinyin: fǔzhú) — in Cantonese fu6 zuk1, and read as "bujuk" in Korean hanja — is a dried tofu skin used in Chinese cuisine, made by gathering the thin film that forms on the surface when making tofu, rolling it into a long stick shape, pressing it, and drying it. 
(Source: Wikipedia) 
It's called fuzhu in Chinese, yuba in Japanese, and dubupi (tofu skin) in Korean. Instead of a short pasta like fusilli or penne, I used this similarly shaped tofu skin, tossed in basil pesto — about 563kcal tofu skin pasta pesto salad
두부피-파스타-페스토-샐러드.ingredients: Tofu skin (as needed), cherry tomatoes, olives, olive oil, (dressing) 2T basil pesto, a little lemon zest, half a lemon (about 1T)
두부피-파스타-페스토-샐러드.steps:
1. Soak the tofu skin in water the night before bed. Cut into short-pasta-sized pieces and boil for 2-3 minutes in boiling water. 
2. Put the still-steaming tofu skin in a mixing bowl, add 2T basil pesto, a little lemon zest, and the juice of half a lemon (about 1T), and mix thoroughly like you're finishing a risotto (mantecare). 
3. Add 5 olives and 5 halved cherry tomatoes, mix evenly, then add crown daisy (leaves only) and mix a bit more. 
4. Plate it up and pile on olive oil and a generous amount of grana padano cheese.

가지구이.title: #RoastedEggplant
가지구이.intro:
20250430 #breakfastdiary 1387, 14°C/partly cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
"Savory" is a word often used to describe food flavor, translated into Korean as "salty," "nutty," or "rich in flavor." None of those translations quite land perfectly, though. 
While trying to figure out how to describe the incredible flavor of capers roasted in olive oil, it hit me — this is exactly when you'd use "savory." Crispy and savory fried capers. 
So today's breakfast — roasted, or should I say fried — today's twist is this about 793kcal #roastedeggplant, served with these capers and creamy burrata cheese
가지구이.ingredients: 2 eggplants, 1/4 cup capers, olive oil, burrata cheese, (dressing) parsley, basil, minced garlic, red pepper flakes, lemon juice, salt, pepper
가지구이.steps:
1. Pat the capers (1/4 cup) dry so they don't splatter when cooking. Heat olive oil in a pan, and once the oil is hot, fry the capers slowly over low heat. Remove the capers and let the oil cool — it'll go into the dressing. 
2. Cut the eggplant into 1.5cm-thick slices, brush with olive oil, and sear in a pan for about 5 minutes. 
3. To the oil from step 1, add parsley, basil, minced garlic, red pepper flakes, lemon juice, salt, and pepper, and mix. 
4. Add the seared eggplant, pour over the dressing from step 3, and let marinate for at least 5 minutes. 
5. Plate the marinated eggplant with burrata cheese, olive oil, and pepper pepper pepper

Warm-Bread-Salsd.title: Warm Bread Salad
Warm-Bread-Salsd.intro:
20250429 #breakfastdiary 1386, 12°C/clear
Queen's "Love of My Life" has a great piano and guitar intro, but I think the real high point is the harp at the very end of that intro. It'll be a warm comfort for a day that felt like it went pretty poorly. The same goes for a warm bread salad. 847kcal Warm Bread Salad
Warm-Bread-Salsd.ingredients: 1 small ciabatta, raisins, almonds, olive oil, red wine vinegar, chives, garlic, salt, pepper, crown daisy, (dressing) 2T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar
Warm-Bread-Salsd.steps:
1. Add 1T red wine vinegar to 1T warm water, then add 1T raisins and let them soak briefly. 
2. Chop the almonds with a knife and lightly toast in a pan. 
3. Mix 2T olive oil and 1T white wine vinegar to make a vinaigrette dressing. 
4. Tear the ciabatta by hand into a mixing bowl, drizzle with olive oil, mix evenly, and roast in a 220°C oven for 15 minutes. 
5. Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté chopped chives and thinly sliced garlic. 
6. In a mixing bowl, combine the bread from step 4, the drained raisins from step 1, and the almonds from step 2, add red wine vinegar, salt, and pepper, cover with foil, and bake in a 220°C oven for 15 minutes. 
7. Put the mixture from step 6 in a bowl, add crown daisy, and mix evenly. Drizzle with vinaigrette dressing.

케일병아리콩샐러드.title: #KaleChickpeaSalad
케일병아리콩샐러드.intro:
20250428 #breakfastdiary 1385, 12°C/clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
"So when I cook for you, it means I've already confirmed that this is something the world can safely absorb, before I hand it to you. And so, when we eat together like this, we're really eating our shared safety. Come to think of it, the title of his first poetry collection, 'I Ate Your Name for a Few Days,' might hint that his first collection was itself a byproduct of the unavoidable stage of caring for 'oneself.' Now he has become someone who cares for 'you.'"
(Shin Hyung-cheol, Care: On Living a Little Ahead of Others)
I've been reading Shin Hyung-cheol's writing bit by bit. 
Sweet and tangy with balsamic glaze mixed in, 389kcal #kalechickpeasalad
케일병아리콩샐러드.ingredients: 1 cup chickpeas, 1/4 onion, 5 cloves garlic, 5 leaves kale, 2T white wine vinegar, 1T lemon juice, 1T balsamic glaze, a little grana padano cheese
케일병아리콩샐러드.steps:
1. Soak the chickpeas in water the night before, then boil in salted water. 
2. Heat olive oil in a pan, add salt and pepper, sauté chopped onion and sliced garlic, then add the chickpeas from step 1 and sauté. 
3. Add roughly chopped kale and white wine vinegar, cover, and cook for 2-3 minutes. 
4. Remove the lid, mix evenly, then add lemon juice and balsamic glaze and mix. 
5. Plate it up and top with grated grana padano cheese.

양배추근대사과샐러드.title: #CabbageChardAppleSalad
양배추근대사과샐러드.intro:
20250427 #breakfastdiary 1384, 15°C/cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
"It might seem like I can decide my own success or failure, but there's so much in this world beyond my control. If that weren't true, why would there be superstition woven into fermented foods? 
You put soybean paste in a jar and tie a straw rope woven with things twisted into it, right? Making that kind of wish is entrusting the part that a person simply cannot handle. Because the rest belongs to the domain of microbes and environment. I can't control everything. All I can do is accept that, let go, and wait."
(Cho Hee-sook, Cho Hee-sook: The Teacher of Chefs, "It's still Korean food even if you put shaved ice on sikhye or abalone on pine nut porridge," @longblack.co)
There's always so much beyond our control in life. We try our best, but often all we can do is hope it turns out well. About 442kcal #cabbagechardapplesalad
양배추근대사과샐러드.ingredients: 1/4 cabbage, 4 leaves chard, 1 apple, 1T lemon juice, (toasted sesame salt) 3T sesame seeds, 1t salt
양배추근대사과샐러드.steps:
1. Julienne 1/4 cabbage, 4 leaves of chard, and 1 apple. 
2. Grind 3T sesame seeds with 1t salt until fine. 
3. In a mixing bowl, combine the ingredients from step 1 with 1T lemon juice and mix evenly. Add the toasted sesame salt from step 2, mix evenly, and enjoy.

아보카도-두부-샐러드.title: Avocado Tofu Salad
아보카도-두부-샐러드.intro:
20250426 #breakfastdiary 1383, 14°C/clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
Sleep No More — a piece of performance art that expanded the possibilities of the medium and the role of the audience. I hear a dedicated venue is opening in Korea in August, and I'm already excited to see it. 
A meeting of two creamy-textured ingredients, tofu and avocado — 443kcal avocado tofu salad
아보카도-두부-샐러드.ingredients: 1/2 block tofu, 1/2 avocado, chives, black sesame seeds, (dressing) 2T soy sauce, 1t minced garlic, 1T plum extract, 1t balsamic, 1t sesame oil, 1T water
아보카도-두부-샐러드.steps:
1. Mix 2T soy sauce, 1t minced garlic, 1T plum extract, 1t balsamic, 1t sesame oil, and 1T water.
2. Slice 1/2 block of tofu and plate it, top with sliced avocado, then add the soy sauce dressing from step 1, chives, and black sesame seeds.

블루베리두부스무디.title: #BlueberryTofuSmoothie
블루베리두부스무디.intro:
20250425 #breakfastdiary 1382, 10°C/clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
For people used to skipping breakfast, the whole idea of it can feel unfamiliar and like a burden. So maybe, just like a body slowly stirring after a long winter's sleep, breakfast can be eased into in stages too. In stage one of starting breakfast, you can begin with liquids or something soft. Our digestive system, having rested all night, feels more at home with something gently liquid than with sudden solid food. A smoothie where fruit and vegetables come together in harmony can wake up the body like the first rays of morning sunlight. 
(Me, breakfast: drinking breakfast every day)
So today it's blueberries and tofu blended together, 584kcal #blueberrytofusmoothie
블루베리두부스무디.ingredients: 1/2 block tofu, 60g blueberries, 30g almonds, 2T oligosaccharide syrup, 300ml soy milk
블루베리두부스무디.steps:
1. In a blender, combine 1/2 block tofu, 60g blueberries, 30g almonds, 2T oligosaccharide syrup, and 300ml soy milk, and blend until smooth. 
2. Pour into a cup and top with a little chopped almond.

아보카도-3.title: Avocado
아보카도-3.ingredients: 1 slice sourdough, 1T mayonnaise, 1 tomato, 1/2 avocado, olive oil, salt, pepper, a little lemon juice
아보카도-3.steps:
1. Slice 1 tomato into round horizontal slices, arrange on a plate, mix 1T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard, pour over, and let marinate.
2. Toast sourdough brushed with olive oil, then top with mayonnaise, the marinated tomato from step 1, and avocado. Finish with Maldon salt, pepper, lemon juice, and olive oil.

아보카도-크로스티니.title: Avocado #crostini
아보카도-크로스티니.intro:
20250424 #breakfastdiary 1381, 12°C/mostly cloudy, 15 min/exercise (S)
So we don't forget the memory of the square, we won't cast our vote for just anyone. A society where people aren't targeted with violence because of identity or nationality, where no worker dies from inhumane labor, where no one is exploited on the cheap in the name of "care," where poverty doesn't make you a victim of disasters and calamities. Does anyone who says we'll build that society "later" deserve the square's support?
(Kim Jung-hee-won, professor at Arizona State University)
The avocado I bought a few days ago has finally ripened. If I put it off any longer it'll rot away. Approx. 591kcal avocado #crostini
아보카도-크로스티니.ingredients: 1 slice sourdough, 1T mayonnaise, 1 tomato, 1/2 avocado, olive oil, salt, pepper, a little lemon juice
아보카도-크로스티니.steps:
1. Slice 1 tomato into round horizontal slices, arrange on a plate, mix 1T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard, pour over, and let marinate.
2. Toast sourdough brushed with olive oil, then top with mayonnaise, the marinated tomato from step 1, and avocado. Finish with Maldon salt, pepper, lemon juice, and olive oil.

에너지볼-채소도시락-돌나물.title: Energy balls veggie lunchbox with stonecrop
에너지볼-채소도시락-돌나물.intro:
20250423 #breakfastdiary 1380, 13°C/mostly cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
Made with super grains like peanut butter, hemp seeds, and chia seeds, these #energyballs are technically not something you should eat if you're thinking about calories, but here's a #veggielunchbox made with them plus various leftover vegetable scraps.
The stonecrop's flavor sticks out a bit, kind of like a villain — but without a villain there'd be no Marvel movie either.
에너지볼-채소도시락-돌나물.ingredients: 1/4 cucumber, 1/4 each red and yellow bell pepper, a little red cabbage, a little stonecrop (dolnamul), (energy balls) 1/2 cup peanut butter, 1/4 cup maple syrup, 1 cup oatmeal, 4T hemp seeds, 2T chia seeds
에너지볼-채소도시락-돌나물.steps:
1. In a mixing bowl combine 1/2 cup peanut butter, 1/4 cup maple syrup, 1 cup oatmeal, 4T hemp seeds, and 2T chia seeds, mix evenly, and shape into round balls.
2. Trim the red cabbage, cucumber, and bell peppers, and wash the stonecrop too.
3. Line one lunchbox compartment with red cabbage and add the energy balls; put the rest of the vegetables in the other. Drizzle the veggies with olive oil, lemon juice, and a little salt before eating.

베지롤.title: #veggieroll
베지롤.intro:
20250422 #breakfastdiary 1379, 16°C/rain, 10 min/exercise (M)
It's clearly just a veggie roll, so I was surprised how many calories it came out to — turns out half the calorie count belongs to the tahini sauce. I have new respect for tahini sauce.
Approx. 864kcal #veggieroll, stuffed to bursting with hummus spread
베지롤.ingredients: Lettuce or romaine or other broad-leaf greens, 1/2 bell pepper, 1/4 red cabbage, 1/2 carrot, (hummus spread) 125g (about 1.5 cups) chickpeas, 5T tahini sauce, 1 clove garlic, 1T lemon juice, 1/2T salt and 2T olive oil
베지롤.steps:
1. In a blender, combine 125g (about 1.5 cups) boiled chickpeas, 5T tahini sauce, 1 clove garlic, 1T lemon juice, 1/2T salt and 2T olive oil, and blend smooth. Add the olive oil in two batches. It's supposed to be hummus-style but I don't think I nailed the consistency. Anyway,
2. Pat dry broad-leaf greens like lettuce or romaine and lay them down as a base, then top with the hummus spread from step 1, red cabbage, and bell pepper, and roll it up — but the hummus spread keeps squeezing out. Fix it by laying everything onto rice paper and rolling that around it instead.

냉장고-속-남은-야채를-곁들인-아치니디페페.title: #acinidipepe with leftover vegetables from the fridge
냉장고-속-남은-야채를-곁들인-아치니디페페.intro:
20250421 #breakfastdiary 1378, 16°C/mostly clear, 10 min/exercise (M)
Acini di pepe is a tiny bead-shaped pasta. In Italy it's apparently served as a wedding soup, so maybe it's kind of like our Korean banquet noodles (janchi guksu).
Approx. 584kcal #acinidipepe with leftover vegetables from the fridge
냉장고-속-남은-야채를-곁들인-아치니디페페.ingredients: 1/2 cup acini di pepe, 1/4 zucchini, 1/2 carrot, 1/2 onion, 1 tomato, salt, pepper, olive oil, parsley, (dressing) 2T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard
냉장고-속-남은-야채를-곁들인-아치니디페페.steps:
1. Add salt to boiling water and cook the acini di pepe until fully done.
2. Cut the zucchini into half-moons and then in half again. Cut the carrot, onion, and tomato into bite-sized pieces.
3. Heat a pan with olive oil and sauté the carrot, onion, zucchini, then tomato in that order. Season with salt and pepper.
4. Plate the vegetables from step 3 with the acini di pepe from step 1, then drizzle with the dressing and sprinkle parsley.

토마토-엔초비-사워도우.title: Tomato anchovy sourdough
토마토-엔초비-사워도우.intro:
20250419 #breakfastdiary 1377, 14°C/drizzle
I had one unripe avocado that I'd been checking on for days, and today was finally the day.
