I figured it looked ripe enough to spread on sourdough like a paste, but when I cut it open it turned out to be way past ripe — spoiled. After thinking it over for a second, I pivoted to an anchovy bruschetta-style instead. Confucius said excess is as bad as falling short.
Approx. 350kcal tomato anchovy sourdough, a lesson in #moderationisbest
토마토-엔초비-사워도우.ingredients: 1 slice sourdough, 1 tomato, a little anchovy, 1T basil pesto, a little basil, pepper, olive oil
토마토-엔초비-사워도우.steps:
1. Brush sourdough with olive oil and toast crisp in a hot pan.
2. Finely chop the tomato.
3. Plate the sourdough, spread with basil pesto, then top with tomato, anchovy, and basil in that order. Finish with pepper and olive oil.

밖에-안되는-표고버섯을-곁들인-작고-귀여운-세발나물-샐러드.title: Only 278kcal, a small and cute glasswort salad with shiitake
밖에-안되는-표고버섯을-곁들인-작고-귀여운-세발나물-샐러드.intro:
20250418 #breakfastdiary 1376, 13°C/cloudy
Glasswort (sebal-namul) is a sea vegetable that grows in salt marshes and has an unusually salty taste. Squint at it just right and it almost looks like pine needles. Only 278kcal, a small and cute glasswort salad with shiitake
밖에-안되는-표고버섯을-곁들인-작고-귀여운-세발나물-샐러드.ingredients: A little glasswort (honestly, how do you even quantify this), 3 shiitake mushrooms, 1T olive oil, (dressing) 1T each of sesame oil, soy sauce, white wine vinegar, plum syrup, and sesame seeds
밖에-안되는-표고버섯을-곁들인-작고-귀여운-세발나물-샐러드.steps:
1. Rinse the glasswort under running water and shake off the excess water.
2. Mix 1T each of sesame oil, soy sauce, white wine vinegar, plum syrup, and sesame seeds to make the dressing.
3. Slice the shiitake mushrooms thick for a chewy bite, and sauté in a hot pan with just olive oil.
4. In a mixing bowl combine the glasswort and shiitake, pour over the dressing from step 2, and mix evenly.
5. Plate and top with a bit more sesame oil and sesame seeds.

블랙베리-바나나-토스트.title: Blackberry banana toast
블랙베리-바나나-토스트.intro:
20250417 #breakfastdiary 1375, 13°C/mostly clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
Even frozen, blackberries bring a huge presence — earthy notes, fruity aroma, all of it. Approx. 326kcal blackberry banana toast
블랙베리-바나나-토스트.ingredients: 1 slice sourdough, olive oil, 1T peanut butter, a little (frozen) blackberry, 1/2 banana, 1t cinnamon powder, 1T maple syrup, 1T granola
블랙베리-바나나-토스트.steps:
1. Brush sourdough with olive oil and toast until crisp.
2. Plate the sourdough, top with peanut butter, blackberries, banana, a few taps of cinnamon powder on top, a drizzle of maple syrup, and a little granola for a crunchy finish.

토마토소면.title: #tomatosomyeon
토마토소면.intro:
20250416 #breakfastdiary 1374, 8°C/partly cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
Blanching the tomatoes and peeling them would've been ideal, but since I didn't have time I just grated them raw, and instead of kelp stock for umami I used noodle broth base. Thanks to that, this came out much easier to make than my earlier #coldtomatonoodles. Approx. 463kcal #tomatosomyeon
토마토소면.ingredients: 1 serving somyeon (thin noodles), olive oil, (broth) 2 tomatoes, 1t minced garlic, 3t noodle broth base, 1t soy sauce, 1t mirin, 1t lemon juice, 1t plum extract, a pinch of salt
토마토소면.steps:
1. Wash the tomatoes well and grate them on a large-holed grater (a potato slicer/grater works fine). Up to here it's the same as yesterday's breakfast, pan con tomate. Add 1t minced garlic, 2t noodle broth base, 1t soy sauce, 1t mirin, 1t lemon juice, 1t plum extract to make the broth. Add a pinch of salt.
2. Add salt to boiling water and cook the somyeon noodles.
3. Put the noodles in a bowl, pour over the broth, and top with a little glasswort. Finish with a drizzle of olive oil.

토마토.title: Tomato
토마토.intro:
20250415 #breakfastdiary 1373, 4°C/mostly clear, 27 min/exercise (S)
Pan con tomate — literally, bread with tomato. You'd think rubbing raw garlic onto toasted bread wouldn't do much, but it does something dramatic. Add salt paired with tomato, and basil paired with tomato, and you get the best flavor there is. Approx. 345kcal
토마토.ingredients:
1 slice sourdough, 1 tomato, Maldon salt, olive oil, pepper

👉 steps
1. Brush sourdough with olive oil, toast until golden, plate it, and rub with garlic.
2. Wash the tomato well and grate it on a large-holed grater (a potato slicer/grater works fine). Drizzle with a swirl of olive oil and a pinch of Maldon salt and mix.
3. Place the sourdough on a plate, top with the tomato from step 2, another swirl of olive oil, and basil.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #tomato

정도-되는-간장-드레싱으로-맛을-낸-채소-듬뿍-샐러드-파스타.title: Roughly 500kcal veggie-packed salad pasta finished with a soy sauce dressing
정도-되는-간장-드레싱으로-맛을-낸-채소-듬뿍-샐러드-파스타.intro:
20250414 #breakfastdiary 1372, 3°C/cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
If I'd added a boiled egg or some chicken breast, it would've had the perfect protein-fiber-carb triple combo on top of the color — but as is, this is roughly 500kcal of veggie-packed salad pasta finished with a soy sauce dressing
정도-되는-간장-드레싱으로-맛을-낸-채소-듬뿍-샐러드-파스타.ingredients:
A little spaghetti, salt, whatever vegetables are in the fridge work fine, (dressing) 4T soy sauce, 3T cooking wine (mirin), 1T sugar, 1T sesame oil, 1T balsamic vinegar, a little sesame seeds

👉 steps
1. Let's make the soy sauce dressing. Mix 4T soy sauce, 3T cooking wine, 1T sugar, 1T sesame oil, 1T balsamic vinegar, with a sprinkle of sesame seeds, evenly.
2. Prep tomato, red onion, purple carrot, broccoli, cucumber, etc. Whatever vegetables you have at home work — each brings its own charm.
3. Add salt to boiling water and cook the spaghetti. Once done, rinse in cold water.
4. In a bowl, combine the spaghetti with the prepared vegetables, pour over the dressing, mix evenly, and eat.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #salad

honest_meallo-치아바타로-만든-550kcal-주키니치아바타.title: 550kcal #zucchiniciabatta made with @honest_meallo ciabatta
honest_meallo-치아바타로-만든-550kcal-주키니치아바타.intro:
20250413 #breakfastdiary 1371, 5°C/mostly clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
I loaded up the sautéed zucchini with lemon zest and lemon juice, and the side effect is my mouth is still watering even after finishing it all. 550kcal #zucchiniciabatta made with @honest_meallo ciabatta
honest_meallo-치아바타로-만든-550kcal-주키니치아바타.ingredients:
1 ciabatta, 1/2 zucchini, 1/2 lemon (for zest and juice), 1t garlic, salt, pepper, vegan sliced ham (Earth Diet brand), a little basil pesto, 1 burrata cheese

👉 steps
1. Cut the ciabatta in half and toast in the air fryer for 5 minutes.
2. Heat a pan with olive oil, julienne 1/2 zucchini and sauté with 1t garlic, a little salt and pepper, and grated lemon zest. Set aside on a plate and squeeze in the juice of 1/2 lemon.
3. Spread olive oil and basil pesto on the ciabatta, top with burrata cheese, salt, pepper, the zucchini and ham from step 2, and basil, then close with the other ciabatta half.

Inspired by @juliusroberts

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #ciabatta

칠리-비네그레트로-매콤하게-만두-토마토-샐러드.title: Dumpling tomato salad spiced up with chili vinaigrette
칠리-비네그레트로-매콤하게-만두-토마토-샐러드.intro:
20250412 #breakfastdiary 1370, 19°C/cloudy
1410kcal dumpling tomato salad with chili vinaigrette, to fill up a sluggish, hungry morning
칠리-비네그레트로-매콤하게-만두-토마토-샐러드.ingredients:
5 Bibigo veggie dumplings, 2 tomatoes, 1/2 red onion, a little basil, fried shallots, (dressing) 4T chili oil, 2T white wine vinegar, 1T olive oil, a pinch of sesame seeds, crushed pepper, salt, pepper

👉 steps
1. Pour a shallow layer of water into a pan, add the dumplings, cover with a lid, and steam-cook.
2. Slice the tomato and red onion. Wash the basil and set aside.
3. Mix 4T chili oil, 2T white wine vinegar, 1T olive oil, a pinch of sesame seeds, salt, and pepper to make the chili vinaigrette.
4. In a mixing bowl, combine the dumplings, tomato, red onion, and basil, pour over the dressing from step 3, and mix evenly.
5. Plate and top with fried shallots.

Inspired by @nytcooking

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #dumpling

아보카도-에그-탕탕이-물론-2인분-기준입니다.title: Smashed avocado egg toast — obviously this is a 2-serving recipe
아보카도-에그-탕탕이-물론-2인분-기준입니다.intro:
20250411 #breakfastdiary 1369, 11°C/clear
744kcal smashed avocado egg toast, made by putting every ingredient on the cutting board and smashing, chopping, and mincing away — obviously this is a 2-serving recipe
아보카도-에그-탕탕이-물론-2인분-기준입니다.ingredients:
2 slices sourdough, 3 eggs, 1 avocado, 2T Greek yogurt, 4-5 sprigs parsley, salt, pepper

👉 steps
1. Brush sourdough with olive oil and toast golden in a hot pan.
2. On a cutting board, put 3 boiled eggs, 1 avocado, 2T Greek yogurt, and 4-5 sprigs of parsley, season with salt, and smash-chop it all together.
3. Pile the smashed avocado egg mixture from step 2 onto the sourdough and finish with pepper, pepper, pepper.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #avocado

아보카도-오이-샐러드.title: Avocado cucumber salad
아보카도-오이-샐러드.intro:
20250410 #breakfastdiary 1368, 9°C/mostly clear, 10 min/exercise (M)
I thought the avocado cucumber salad could use a fun texture, so I threw in coconut flakes. It looks like I dumped in a pile of minced garlic, but trust me, it tastes way better than it photographs. 585kcal avocado cucumber salad
아보카도-오이-샐러드.ingredients:
1 avocado, 1 cucumber, 3-4 sprigs parsley, 1T coconut flakes, pepper, (dressing) 2T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard

👉 steps
1. Cut the cucumber into half-moons, cube the avocado, and finely chop the parsley.
2. In a mixing bowl, combine everything from step 1 and mix evenly, then add the coconut flakes for a crisp texture and mix a bit more.
3. Plate and finish with pepper, pepper~

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #avocado

미소글레이즈드-주키니.title: #misoglazed zucchini
미소글레이즈드-주키니.intro:
20250409 #breakfastdiary 1367, 8°C/mostly cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
I used zucchini but regular Korean squash works just as well — 283kcal #misoglazed zucchini, tastier than it looks in the photo
미소글레이즈드-주키니.ingredients:
1 zucchini, sesame seeds, green onion, (sauce) 3T miso, 2T mirin, 2t sugar, 1t soy sauce

👉 steps
1. Mix 3T miso, 2T mirin, 2t sugar, and 1t soy sauce to make the glaze.
2. Wash the zucchini under running water, cut in half, score a crosshatch pattern, then brush with the glaze.
3. Heat a pan with a little olive oil and slowly cook over medium heat starting with the glazed side down. Check the cut side to see if it's cooked through, then flip. (When you press the side of the zucchini and it's soft and releasing moisture, it's done.)
4. Plate the zucchini, brush with a bit more glaze, and top with sesame seeds and green onion.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #zucchini

브로콜리니샐러드.title: #broccolinisalad
브로콜리니샐러드.ingredients:
Broccolini, 1T almonds, a few slices red onion, salt, pepper, (dressing) 2T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard

👉 steps
1. Pour a shallow layer of water into a pan with a little salt, add the broccolini, cover with a lid, and cook low-moisture style. Rinse in cold water and pat dry.
2. Heat a pan with olive oil, add salt and pepper, and sear the broccolini.
3. Plate the broccolini, top with red onion, almonds, pour over the vinaigrette dressing, and shave Grana Padano cheese on top.

Inspired by #myfrenchstylesalad

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #broccolini

반으로-나눠도-무려-650kcal-연어페투치네-월요일이니-이-정도-칼로리.title: Even split in half it's still 650kcal #salmonfettuccine — it's Monday, so we need this many calories
반으로-나눠도-무려-650kcal-연어페투치네-월요일이니-이-정도-칼로리.intro:
20250407 #breakfastdiary 1365, 7°C/clear
While grating a lemon I accidentally grated my right pinky finger a bit too. Not enough for a band-aid, and I figured it wasn't a part that touches much, so I just put on some ointment and headed out — turns out it touches way more things than I thought. I've been holding my pinky out stiffly all day trying to avoid contact, like I'm making a pinky-promise with everyone I meet on my commute.
2 servings, about 1,300kcal total, so even split in half it's 650kcal #salmonfettuccine — it's Monday, so we need this many calories
반으로-나눠도-무려-650kcal-연어페투치네-월요일이니-이-정도-칼로리.ingredients:
250g salmon, 2 servings fettuccine, 1T butter, 200ml milk, 1 lemon, a little parsley, salt, pepper, crushed pepper

👉 steps
1. Pour water into a pot, add salt, and cook the fettuccine until it's on the salty side.
2. Melt 1T butter in a hot pan and sear the diced salmon.
3. Once the salmon is cooked, add 200ml milk, lemon zest, and the fettuccine, and mantecare (emulsify) it together.
4. Turn off the heat, add chopped parsley, salt, pepper, and crushed pepper, and mix evenly. (Adjust the salt to taste as you go.)
5. Plate the fettuccine, top with Grana Padano cheese, and done.

Squeeze in half a lemon before eating for JMT (crazy good)

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #salmon

감자참치그라탕.title: #potatotunagratin
감자참치그라탕.intro:
20250406 #breakfastdiary 1364, 5°C/cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
I was supposed to layer the dish potato-canned tuna-onion-potato-egg mixture-mozzarella, but after finishing everything and putting it in the dish to go into the oven, I noticed the sautéed onions were just sitting there alone, forgotten. Panicked for a second, but ended up scattering them on top of the gratin instead — and honestly it looks even better that way.
Approx. 603kcal #potatotunagratin
감자참치그라탕.ingredients:
3 potatoes, 1 onion, 3 eggs, milk, canned tuna, 2T mozzarella cheese, olive oil, salt, pepper, parsley

👉 steps
1. Peel 3 potatoes, slice 0.5cm thick, then boil in a pot of water with a pinch of salt.
2. Slice 1 onion and sauté in a hot pan with olive oil, salt, and pepper until translucent.
3. Mix 3 eggs, 100ml milk, salt, and pepper evenly.
4. In an oven-safe dish, layer the potatoes from step 1, canned tuna (drain the oil), more potatoes, pour the egg mixture from step 3 over generously, and top with mozzarella cheese. Bake at 200°C for 30 minutes. (The mozzarella turns golden and then burns in the blink of an eye, so keep a close eye on it after 20 minutes.)
5. Plate and sprinkle a little parsley.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #potato

볶음밥.title: #friedrice
볶음밥.intro:
20250405 #breakfastdiary 1363, 5°C/cloudy
Today is #hansik (Korean folk holiday) — once considered one of the four major traditional holidays alongside Seollal, Dano, and Chuseok, though its significance has largely been forgotten these days.
368kcal #friedrice with crispy-outside-soft-inside pan-fried tofu and a peanut butter dressing
볶음밥.ingredients:
1/2 bowl rice, 1 block tofu, 1 clove minced garlic, 1/2 minced onion, 1/2 minced bell pepper, 1 cup edamame, salt, oyster sauce, green onion, (dressing) 3T peanut butter, 1T vinegar, 2t soy sauce, 1t sugar, 1t ginger juice, 6T water

👉 steps
1. Microwave the tofu for 2 minutes to remove moisture, cube it, then pan-fry in oil until golden.
2. Sauté 1 clove minced garlic, 1/2 minced onion, 1/2 minced bell pepper, then add the edamame and sauté further.
3. Add the rice, a pinch of salt, 1t oyster sauce, and sauté a bit more. Add the tofu from step 1 and sauté together.
4. Mix 3T peanut butter, 1T vinegar, 2t soy sauce, 1t sugar, 1t ginger juice, and 6T water evenly to make the peanut butter dressing.
5. Plate the fried rice, pour over the peanut butter dressing from step 4, and top with a bit of chopped green onion.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #tofu

마파두부스파게티.title: #mapotofuspaghetti
마파두부스파게티.intro:
20250404 #breakfastdiary 1362, 6°C/mostly cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
Mapo tofu this intense first thing in the morning might sound unhinged, but here's a fact: add coconut milk to mapo sauce, or blend up tofu like I did today, and it transforms into a silky, killer pasta sauce.
Tofu — only visible to the good-hearted 528kcal #mapotofuspaghetti
마파두부스파게티.ingredients:
Spaghetti, 1 morning tofu (or substitute regular soft tofu, works fine), a little chives, (mapo sauce) 1/2 green onion, 2 cloves garlic, 1t ginger, 1T soy sauce, 0.5T oyster sauce, 3T doubanjiang, 1T sugar, 200ml water, starch slurry (starch and water 1:1) to taste for thickness

👉 steps
1. Since I happened to have some morning tofu on hand, blend 1 block in a blender.
2. Add salt to boiling water and cook the spaghetti.
3. Heat oil in a pan, add chopped 1/2 green onion, 2 cloves minced garlic, about 1t ginger, then 1T soy sauce, 0.5T oyster sauce, 3T doubanjiang, 0.5T sugar, sauté, then add 200ml water and bring to a boil. Mix starch and water 1:1 and add about 3T, boil a bit longer.
4. Add the spaghetti to the pan, turn off the heat, and mantecare (emulsify). Plate and top with the tofu sauce from step 1 and a little chives.

Inspired by @nytcooking

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #mapotofu

문어샐러드.title: #octopussalad
문어샐러드.intro:
20250403 #breakfastdiary 1361, 4°C/clear
I wanted to simmer the octopus longer for a more tender bite, but I was short on time, so today it's just chewy as-is — 695kcal #octopussalad with chickpeas
문어샐러드.ingredients:
250g octopus, 1T basil pesto, (garnish) 1 cup chickpeas, 1/2 onion, 2 cloves garlic, 1T sun-dried tomato, 2t paprika powder, salt, pepper, (for boiling the octopus) 1 clove garlic, 1 onion, parsley stems, 2T lemon juice

👉 steps
1. Fill a pot with water, add garlic, onion, parsley stems, and lemon juice (instead of whole lemon), and boil the octopus for over 20 minutes.
2. Once fully cooked, cut the octopus into bite-sized pieces and sear in a pan with butter and paprika powder.
3. Heat a pan with olive oil, sauté minced onion and garlic with sun-dried tomato, then add the boiled chickpeas and season with paprika powder, salt, and pepper. Add the octopus and sear a bit more, then add chopped parsley.
4. Plate and top with basil pesto.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #zucchini #octopus

참치포케.title: #tunapoke
참치포케.intro:
20250402 #breakfastdiary 1360, 4°C/partly cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
A New York Long Island style approx. 700kcal #tunapoke based on Sam Sifton's NYT recipe.
Thinking back on it after eating, adding about 1t lemon juice probably would've balanced it out.
참치포케.ingredients:
300g tuna, 1/4 red onion, a little chives, 1T macadamia nuts, (dressing) 3T soy sauce, 1T sesame oil, 1t mirin, 1t sriracha sauce (substitute for chili garlic sauce)
*makes 2-3 servings

👉 steps
1. Cut the tuna into roughly 2cm thick cubes. Thinly slice the red onion and chives.
2. Mix 3T soy sauce, 1T sesame oil, 1t mirin, and 1t sriracha sauce (as a chili garlic sauce substitute) to make the dressing.
3. In a mixing bowl, combine the tuna, red onion, and chives, pour over the dressing, and mix evenly.
4. Sprinkle sesame seeds and mix once more. If you have time, refrigerate for 1-2 hours to let it marinate. Before eating, crush macadamia nuts on top.

Inspired by @nycooking

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #zucchini #tuna

애호박둥지-덮밥.title: #zucchininest rice bowl
애호박둥지-덮밥.intro:
20250401 #breakfastdiary 1359, 4°C/clear
Following #carrotnest (3.1) and #redcabbagenest (3.12), today it's #zucchininest as a rice bowl. I originally planned to quietly bake it in the oven, but for a bit more dramatic footage to farm engagement, I pan-fried one instead.
Even for a breakfast, the video came out pretty intense, and posting it to my story got roughly double the usual likes. So here it is: approx. 304kcal #zucchininest rice bowl
Flavored with sriracha sauce — the gold medal (allegedly) among the six sauces used in Thai cuisine, a gift from a friend who'd just been to Bangkok Design Week.
애호박둥지-덮밥.ingredients:
1/2 bowl rice, 1 zucchini, salt, pepper, a little shredded cheese, 1 egg, sriracha sauce
*1 zucchini yields about 3-4 nests

👉 like this
1. Wash the zucchini under running water and spiralize it.
2. Heat a pan with oil, lay down the zucchini, shape it into a nest, and top with salt, pepper, shredded cheese and an egg, then cook. (If you'd rather do it quietly and calmly, bake at 180°C for 10-15 minutes instead.)
3. Serve over rice and finish with sriracha sauce.

Inspired by @neighbourmart

Got a gift from a friend who'd been to Bangkok Design Week — a package with the 6 sauces used in Thai cuisine, gorgeous packaging befitting a design week. Opened up one of them, the black soy sauce. Approx. 400kcal #padseeew

Let's all agree to make pad see ew with rice noodles whenever possible. Glass noodles, not recommended 🥲🙃🤫

👉 A reasonable amount of glass noodles, 2 cloves garlic, 10 leaves kale, 1 stalk chives, 5 shiitake mushrooms, salt, white pepper, 1 egg, (sauce) 0.5T soy sauce, 0.5T sugar, 0.5T fish sauce, 1T oyster sauce, 1.5T dark soy sauce
(add 2-3T of sauce, taste, then add more)

👉 like this
1. Using glass noodles instead of rice noodles today. Soak wide glass noodles in warm water.
2. Mince 2 cloves garlic, cut 10 leaves of kale into bite-sized pieces, finely chop 1 stalk of chives. Cut the 5 shiitake mushrooms (standing in for meat) into big chunks.
3. Heat a pan with oil, sauté the shiitake with salt and pepper, and set aside. (used in place of meat)
4. In the same pan, add a bit more oil, sauté the minced garlic, add the kale, and once wilted, add the glass noodles and sauce and stir-fry.
5. Push everything to one side of the pan, add oil, crack in 1 egg, scramble, then mix it all together. Add the shiitake back in and stir-fry together.
6. Plate and top with white pepper and chives.

Inspired by @neighbourmart

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #padseeew #BKKDW2025 #CEA #TravelSizedSavory

으깬감자구이-Smashedpotato.title: #smashedpotato
으깬감자구이-Smashedpotato.intro:
20250331 #breakfastdiary 1358, 0°C/mostly clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
I originally planned to elegantly top the potatoes with smoked salmon, but once I saw the crispy toasted mozzarella cheese, it didn't seem like it would go together, so I skipped it.
Might end up remembered mostly for the crispy toasted mozzarella cheese — approx. 250kcal #smashedpotato
으깬감자구이-Smashedpotato.ingredients:
3 potatoes, 5T mozzarella cheese, salt, pepper, herbs, 3 slices smoked salmon, a little dill, (dressing) 1T Greek yogurt, 1T lemon juice, 1T olive oil

👉 like this
1. (The night before) Fill a pot with water, cut the potatoes in half with skin on, add 2t salt, and boil for about 30 minutes until cooked.
2. Lay mozzarella cheese in an oven pan, place the potatoes on top, press down firmly, then drizzle with olive oil, salt, pepper, and herbs. Top with more mozzarella cheese and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.
3. Mix 1T Greek yogurt, 1T lemon juice, and 1T olive oil evenly.
4. Top the potatoes with the dressing from step 3 and dill.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #potato

20250330 #breakfastdiary 1357, -1°C/cloudy
Apparently red cabbage has 13 times the vitamin A of regular cabbage, so it's not like you should only ever go for red cabbage. Sure, overall red cabbage is more nutrient-dense than regular cabbage, but regular cabbage actually has more fiber, vitamin K, and folate.
That's the reason we need to collaborate, the reason media mix matters, and the reason my mom always told me as a kid to eat a variety of foods.
Total for about 2 servings is roughly 600kcal, so 300kcal if you only eat half, #lotsofcabbagesalad
반만-먹으면-300kcal-양배추많이샐러드.ingredients:
1 carrot, red cabbage equal in volume to 1 carrot, cabbage, 1/2 apple, (dressing) 2T peanut butter, 2T lemon juice, 1T sesame seeds, 1 clove minced garlic, 1T soy sauce, 1t salt, 4-5T water

👉 like this
1. Slice the cabbage, red cabbage, carrot, and apple with a mandoline or knife.
2. Mix 2T peanut butter, 2T lemon juice, 1T sesame seeds, 1 clove minced garlic, 1T soy sauce, and 1t salt, then add 4-5T water to adjust the consistency.
3. In a mixing bowl, combine everything from step 1, pour over the sauce from step 2, and toss evenly.
4. Plate and finish with parsley and olive oil.

20250329 #breakfastdiary 1356, -2°C/cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
Turned today's breakfast into images in five different styles — 1. Ghibli, 2. Pixar, 3. Simpsons, 4. Dragon Ball, 5. 8-bit — with just a few lines of prompting. Did Walter Benjamin foresee a world like this when he wrote "The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction"?
Approx. 250kcal roasted red cabbage salad
구운적양배추샐러드.ingredients:
1/2 red cabbage, 1 red onion, (dressing) 3T olive oil, 1T wine vinegar, 1T garlic powder, 1t Dijon mustard, 1t salt, 1t pepper

👉 like this
1. Mix 3T olive oil, 1T wine vinegar, 1T garlic powder, 1t Dijon mustard, 1t salt, and 1t pepper evenly.
2. Cut the red cabbage and red onion into wedges, brush with the dressing from step 1, and roast at 200°C for 20 minutes.
3. Add 1T balsamic vinegar to the remaining dressing from step 1 and mix. Brush it onto the roasted red cabbage and onion and roast at 200°C for another 15 minutes.
4. Plate the red cabbage and onion, and top with chopped pistachios, feta cheese, and Italian parsley. Finish with olive oil~

그래서-절반만-먹은-535kcal-할루미이사벨토마토샌드위치.title: So I only ate half, 535kcal #haloumiisabelletomatosandwich
그래서-절반만-먹은-535kcal-할루미이사벨토마토샌드위치.intro:
20250328 #breakfastdiary 1355, 3°C/cloudy, 15 min/exercise (S)
Adding grilled haloumi cheese made this much more savory, but also drove the calories up to a wicked 1070kcal — so I only ate half, 535kcal #haloumiisabelletomatosandwich
그래서-절반만-먹은-535kcal-할루미이사벨토마토샌드위치.ingredients:
2 slices sourdough, 2 pieces haloumi cheese, 1/2 tomato, a few slices red onion and Isabelle grapes, olive oil, (dressing) 2T mayonnaise with 1t garlic powder, 1T lemon juice

👉 like this
1. Sear the haloumi cheese in a hot pan. (Haloumi normally doesn't melt, so I'm not sure why this batch did.)
2. Mix 2T mayonnaise with 1t garlic powder and 1T lemon juice to make garlic mayo.
3. Brush sourdough with olive oil and toast crisp on both sides — you can use the same pan you seared the cheese in.
4. Slice the tomato and red onion, and pull apart the Isabelle grapes.
5. Spread the garlic mayo from step 2 on the sourdough, top with tomato, haloumi cheese, red onion, and Isabelle grapes, then close with another slice of garlic-mayo sourdough.

Pasta primavera is an Italian-American hybrid dish born in the U.S. in the 1970s, characterized by combining pasta with a variety of fresh vegetables. Today I added asparagus and green peas. Approx. 500kcal pasta primavera, or Greek yogurt-tossed pasta with asparagus
"Primavera" is Italian for "spring." Spring must be coming soon, right?
파스타-프리마베라-혹은-아스파라거스를-넣은-그릭요거트-비빔-파스타.ingredients:
Tagliatelle (as much as you'd like to eat), 4 stalks asparagus, 1 cup green peas, 1 shallot (onion works as a substitute), 2 cloves minced garlic, 1T (like, a generous 2T) Greek yogurt, salt, pepper, butter

👉 like this
1. Add salt to boiling water and cook the asparagus and green peas.
2. Remove the asparagus and peas, then cook the tagliatelle in the same water.
3. Heat a pan with butter, sauté the asparagus and peas, add the shallot, then finally add the minced garlic and sauté quickly, then set aside.
4. In a mixing bowl, combine the tagliatelle, the vegetables from step 3, and the Greek yogurt. Season with salt and pepper.
5. Plate and finish with pepper, pepper, pepper~

I tossed the tagliatelle together with the vegetables in Greek yogurt, but I think it'd be better to toss just the tagliatelle in the yogurt on its own.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #tagliatelle

미나리가리비전.title: #minariandscallopjeon
미나리가리비전.intro:
20250325 #breakfastdiary 1352, 8°C/partly cloudy, 15 min/exercise (S)
Say you had minari (water celery) pancake for breakfast and a lot of people would be surprised, but for someone who's been eating breakfast every single day for about 5 years now — a certified breakfast grandmaster — minari pancake is basically no big deal 🙃
Approx. 490kcal #minariandscallopjeon with sriracha mayo
미나리가리비전.ingredients:
1 bunch minari, 100ml water, 6T frying flour, 1/2 cup scallop meat, vegetable oil

👉 like this
1. Rinse a bunch of minari and cut into 5cm lengths. For extra crispiness, pat dry with a paper towel.
2. Pat dry the thawed scallop meat as well.
3. In a mixing bowl, combine the cut minari and scallop meat with 100ml water and 6T frying flour, and mix evenly.
4. Pour plenty of oil into a frying pan, add the batter from step 3, and fry one side over medium heat like deep-frying. Add a bit more oil around the edges.
5. Once that side is cooked, flip, and add a bit more oil around the edges again.
6. Once fully cooked, plate it. Dip in sriracha mayo (2T mayonnaise, 1t sriracha, 1t lemon juice) to eat.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #minari

Out of habit, the moment I bit into the aralia shoot I thought of spicy vinegared gochujang, but a citrus yogurt dressing isn't bad either. Approx. 147kcal #arailiaandsalmonrolls
두릅연어말이.ingredients:
3 aralia (dureup) shoots, 3 slices smoked salmon, salt, white wine vinegar, (dressing) 1T Greek yogurt, 1T lemon juice, 1 clove minced garlic, 1/2 minced shallot, dill and 1t salt

👉 like this
1. Add salt to boiling water, blanch the aralia shoots for 1 minute, rinse in cold water, and drain.
2. Mix 1T Greek yogurt, 1T lemon juice, 1 clove minced garlic, 1/2 minced shallot, dill, and 1t salt evenly to make the citrus yogurt dressing.
3. Roll the aralia shoots up in the smoked salmon, brush lightly with white wine vinegar, and top with the dressing.

코코넛-오일에-고소하게-볶은-아스파라거스-덮밥.intro:
20250322 #breakfastdiary 1349, 14°C/clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
Morning temperatures finally hit double digits. Spring must be coming. Approx. 298kcal rice bowl with #asparagus roasted savory in coconut oil
코코넛-오일에-고소하게-볶은-아스파라거스-덮밥.ingredients:
5 stalks asparagus, 1 clove garlic, 2T each cashews and coconut flakes, sesame oil, coconut oil, lime juice, salt, pepper, sesame seeds, a little chives

👉 like this
1. Roughly chop the cashews, and toast them with 2T coconut flakes each in a pan for 2-3 minutes, then set aside. (Coconut flakes burn fast — toast the cashews first, and once golden add the coconut flakes.)
2. Wash and trim the asparagus, then cut into 5cm pieces.
3. In a pan, add 1 clove minced garlic, 1T each sesame oil and coconut oil, and sauté the asparagus.
4. Add 1T each soy sauce and lime juice, the cashews and coconut flakes from step 1, and season with salt and pepper.
5. Serve the asparagus from step 4 over rice, and top with sesame seeds and chives.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #asparagus

타히니-그릭요거트-딥을-곁들인-구운자색당근.title: #roastedpurplecarrots with a tahini Greek yogurt dip
타히니-그릭요거트-딥을-곁들인-구운자색당근.intro:
20250321 #breakfastdiary 1348, 7°C/mostly cloudy, 15 min/exercise (S)
On a business trip a while back I spotted purple carrots at a local market and snatched them up right away. Purple carrots have up to 9 times the antioxidants of regular carrots, so today I'm pausing the aging process and getting significantly younger.
But the calories don't go easy on you — approx. 603kcal #roastedpurplecarrots with a tahini Greek yogurt dip
타히니-그릭요거트-딥을-곁들인-구운자색당근.ingredients:
5 purple carrots, 2T Greek yogurt, 1T tahini, a little chopped walnuts, olive oil, salt, pepper
(dressing) 2T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1T whole grain mustard

👉 like this
1. Wash the purple carrots well and cut in half.
2. Heat a pan with olive oil, sprinkle salt and pepper, and place the cut side down. Cook slowly over low heat.
3. Meanwhile, mix 2T Greek yogurt with 1T tahini sauce evenly.
4. Spread the dip from step 3 on a plate, top with the roasted carrots, and drizzle with the vinaigrette dressing. Top with a little walnut.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #carrot

지중해식-선라이즈-토스트.title: Mediterranean sunrise toast
지중해식-선라이즈-토스트.intro:
20250320 #breakfastdiary 1347, 1°C/mostly clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
I'm allergic to arugula/rocket (whatever you call it), so I've been searching for a vegetable that can substitute for its taste, texture, and even appearance — and I think I've finally reached the end of that long journey. Let's all guess together 🙃
Approx. 223kcal Mediterranean sunrise toast made with @honest_meallo sourdough
지중해식-선라이즈-토스트.ingredients:
15g feta cheese, 3T Greek yogurt, 2 slices sourdough, 1 tomato, a little leafy green vegetable, salt, pepper
*makes 2 slices worth, but can easily be done with just 1

👉 like this
1. Mix 15g feta cheese with Greek yogurt until creamy.
2. Heat a pan with olive oil and toast the sourdough crisp on both sides.
3. Dice 1 tomato, drain off a bit of the juice, and toss with salt and pepper.
4. Spread the feta-Greek yogurt mixture from step 1 on the sourdough, top with the leafy greens, then the tomato from step 3.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #sourdough

Q. What leafy green vegetable did I use today to substitute for arugula/rocket?

Yeolmu (young radish) leaves
Chicory
Crown daisy (ssukgat)
Actually just arugula

브로콜리니그린빈풋콩-샐러드.title: #broccolinigreenbeanedamame salad
브로콜리니그린빈풋콩-샐러드.intro:
20250319 #breakfastdiary 1346, -1°C/clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
Listened to Kim Chang-wan's "Cheongchun" (Youth), covered by IU, which opens with "someday it'll fade, this vivid youth." It struck me to wonder how much a 20-something IU could really have understood the meaning of "this youth that will someday pass" when she sang it — and then I remembered Kim Chang-wan wrote this song at 27. I suppose age aside, everyone has love that matters to them, a breakup they can't forget, and their own version of youth.
Today I boiled up edamame, precious like the youth of life itself. Finished with a vinaigrette dressing and coconut chips, 530kcal #broccolinigreenbeanedamame salad
브로콜리니그린빈풋콩-샐러드.ingredients:
3-4 broccolini, 5 green beans, 1 cup edamame, salt, pepper
(dressing) 2T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard

👉 like this
1. Add the broccolini, green beans, and edamame to boiling water with a little salt, blanch for 1-2 minutes, then rinse in cold water and pat dry.
2. Heat a pan with olive oil, add the broccolini and green beans from step 1, season with salt and pepper, and sear quickly over high heat.
3. Plate the broccolini and beans with the edamame, drizzle with the vinaigrette dressing, and top with coconut chips for a fun texture.

Inspired by @nytcooking

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #broccolini

훈제연어샌드위치.title: #smokedsalmonsandwich
훈제연어샌드위치.intro:
20250317 #breakfastdiary 1345, -2°C/clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
The original NYT recipe calls for goat cheese mixed with a bit of yogurt instead of ricotta, but I used ricotta and it came out a bit bland. Better to mix feta with yogurt, or just add more salt. Looks like this will be a bland start to the week.
Approx. 600kcal #smokedsalmonsandwich
훈제연어샌드위치.ingredients:
2 slices sourdough, smoked salmon (as much as you like), 2T ricotta cheese, dill (a little), lemon juice, salt, pepper, olive oil

👉 like this
1. Toast sourdough brushed with olive oil in a hot pan.
2. Spread ricotta cheese on the sourdough and top with smoked salmon.
3. Slice cucumber thin with a mandoline and layer on top of the salmon. Sprinkle everything bagel seasoning (or substitute salt, sesame seeds, pepper) and finish the balance with lemon juice.
4. Chop dill and sprinkle over the cucumber.
5. Spread ricotta on the other slice of sourdough and close the sandwich, then cut in half.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #smokedsalmon

바질볶음밥.title: #basilfriedrice
바질볶음밥.intro:
20250316 #breakfastdiary 1344, 0°C/cloudy
Keeping a jar of basil pesto in the fridge means that when you don't have decent ingredients on hand, or rice just doesn't sound good, you can throw something together as easily as soy-sauce egg rice. Approx. 500kcal #basilfriedrice
바질볶음밥.ingredients:
1 bowl rice, 1 egg, 2T basil pesto, Grana Padano cheese

👉 like this
1. Heat oil in a pan and make a sunny-side-up fried egg.
2. Heat a pan with olive oil, add half a bowl of rice, and stir-fry.
3. Since heat kills the basil aroma, turn off the heat, add 2T basil pesto, and mix evenly.
4. Pack the rice into a bowl, cover with a plate, then flip it out onto the plate.
5. Top the rice with the fried egg, then Grana Padano cheese.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #basil

20250216(2) #breakfastdiary 1315(2), 0°C/cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)

Posting this late — the second camping breakfast from last month, camping-style #roastedpotatoes with a chimichurri-style sauce and grilled haloumi cheese.

Not every campsite has one, but it seems like a lot of campgrounds these days actually have microwaves.

👉 Ingredients: 3 potatoes, 1 haloumi cheese, olive oil, salt, pepper, (sauce) 2 cloves garlic, 1 shallot, 30g parsley chopped, 1 red chili pepper sliced, 3T olive oil, 1T lemon juice, 1t salt, 1t pepper

👉 like this
1. Wash the potatoes under running water, brush with olive oil, season with salt and pepper, put them in a camping baking bag, and microwave for 5 minutes.
2. Chop 2 cloves garlic, 1 shallot, 30g parsley, and slice 1 red chili pepper, then mix with 3T olive oil, 1T lemon juice, 1t salt, and 1t pepper to make the dressing.
3. Heat a pan with olive oil, cut the haloumi cheese into squares, and sear evenly on all sides.
4. Plate the potatoes, score once lengthwise and once crosswise, pry open, top with the prepared sauce, and arrange the haloumi cheese around it.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #potato

일명-케일고구마아몬드샐러드.title: So-called #kalesweetpotatoalmondsalad
일명-케일고구마아몬드샐러드.intro:
20250313 #breakfastdiary 1342, 3°C/partly cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
#massagedkale — pull off just the kale leaves, pour on lemon juice, and massage it, and both taste and aroma improve. Bonus: the acid in lemon juice helps the body absorb the kale's vitamin C.
I thought the sweet pumpkin was still okay, but it turned out to be inedible. After thinking it over for 3.8 seconds, eureka — I had sweet potato. Using up leftover ingredients to the fullest. 350kcal so-called #kalesweetpotatoalmondsalad

1. Wash the kale under running water, pull off just the leaves, and cut into bite-sized pieces. Sprinkle with lemon juice and massage by hand.
2. Peel the sweet potatoes, cube them, then sauté in a pan with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
3. Plate the kale, top with the sweet pumpkin (sic) and almonds, and drizzle with the miso-tahini dressing.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #kale

적양배추둥지.title: #redcabbagenest
적양배추둥지.ingredients:
1/4 red cabbage, 1 egg, salt, pepper, Grana Padano cheese

👉 like this

2. Arrange the red cabbage in a pan, shape it into a nest, and cook over low heat. Once the pan is hot, add olive oil, then the egg, salt, and pepper.
3. Plate and top with Grana Padano cheese.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #redcabbage

감자구이-감자.title: Roasted potato
감자구이-감자.intro:
20250311 #breakfastdiary 1340, 3°C/mostly cloudy
I happened to have some wilting parsley on hand, so I made a chimichurri sauce, but it didn't add up to much volume. Thought about it for 3.8 seconds, then remembered some cherry tomatoes about to go bad, chopped a few in, and now the volume is just right.
Today's invention: #roastedpotato topped with tomato chimichurri
감자구이-감자.ingredients:
1 potato, 3 cherry tomatoes, pepper, a little butter, (chimichurri sauce) 30g parsley leaves only, 1t garlic, 2T olive oil, 1t sugar, 1t salt, 1t lemon juice, 1t red wine vinegar, 1t crushed pepper

👉 like this
1. Wash a russet potato well with skin on, then poke holes with a fork to let steam escape. Brush with olive oil, sprinkle with salt, and bake in the air fryer at 200°C for 40 minutes, flipping once halfway through.
2. Pull off 30g of parsley leaves, and mix with 1t garlic, 2T olive oil, 1t sugar, 1t salt, 1t lemon juice, 1t red wine vinegar, and 1t crushed pepper evenly. Add 3-4 chopped cherry tomatoes.

굴국밥.title: #oysterguksu (rice soup)

20250304 #breakfastdiary 1333, 1°C/cloudy, 15 min/exercise (S)
"Toryeom" is a traditional Korean cooking method used for guksu (rice soup) or jjigae, where you alternately mix the broth and rice back and forth to serve it warm. It both heats the rice and brings the broth to the right temperature.
As rice cools, the starch loses moisture and turns stiff, but toryeom adds moisture and heat back in, making it soft again, while the broth naturally seeps into the rice. It's actually similar to how you make risotto.
Though it's a shame that fewer and fewer restaurants do toryeom these days due to hygiene concerns and labor costs.
Apparently the original method alternates piping-hot broth from a cauldron with cold rice about 50 times, but I don't have that kind of setup or skill, so today I just did it about 5 times, more as a gesture.
Toryeom-style 350kcal #oysterguksu

5. Add 1 clove minced garlic, 1T fish sauce, and a pinch of salt. (Tasting it, I felt like something was missing, so I added 1t seafood powder.)
6. Toryeom the cold rice with the broth, add a little white pepper, and eat.

So even a breakfast that looks identical, made from the same recipe, is never truly the same breakfast twice, if you think about it. Meaning this one — even though I used the same potatoes — was cooked a different way and plated a little more freshly, so it's a "first-time breakfast."

2. Drizzle oil in an oven-safe dish and sear both sides of the potatoes until golden.
3. Add butter, sprinkle salt and pepper, and let it lightly infuse.
4. Add the rosemary, garlic, and shallot for more aroma.
5. Pour in the vegetable stock (250ml) until the potatoes are just submerged, bring to a light simmer, then put in a 180°C oven and bake for 20 minutes until the sauce at the bottom reduces down.
6. Plate and finish with thyme and Maldon salt.

Saw in the news that sit-ups are being dropped from the police physical fitness test. There's been a lot of criticism that sit-ups — 48 in a minute, which I did so diligently back in school — actually wreck your lower back. Experts recommend planks instead of sit-ups, and I'd strongly recommend my beloved workout buddy, the mountain climber, which is similar in spirit.
A 342kcal low-carb cabbage tortilla to protect the value of the 125kcal I burned this morning with 20 minutes of mountain climbers
의-가치를-지켜줄-342kcal-저탄수-양배추-또띠아.ingredients:
1/4 cabbage, 1 tortilla, 2T shredded cheese, 2 eggs, 1T olive oil, 1t salt, 1t pepper, grana padano cheese, 4-5 oyster mushrooms

👉Here's how
1. Heat a pan with olive oil, add salt, pepper, and herbs, and sauté the mushrooms.
2. In a mixing bowl, combine the shredded cabbage with 2 eggs, salt, and pepper, and mix well.
3. Heat olive oil in a pan, pour in the cabbage mixture, and cover with the tortilla.
4. Once the cabbage mixture is cooked, flip it over, top with shredded cheese, and fold in half. (Just aim for the impression of a fold — no need to fold it exactly in half. This way the filling peeks out, which looks a lot more appetizing.)
5. Plate it and top with the sautéed mushrooms and grana padano cheese.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #cabbage

베리-발사믹-그릭요거트볼로.title: Berry Balsamic Greek Yogurt Bowl, Let's Go~
베리-발사믹-그릭요거트볼로.intro:
20250220 #breakfastdiary 1320, -7/partly cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
Apparently among 19th-century Italian nobility, having a wooden barrel at home for aging balsamic vinegar was a mark of "that family's got money." True traditional balsamic vinegar is aged for 12 to 25 years or more, moved between 2-5 barrels of different woods along the way — kind of like a family's heirloom soy sauce passed down for generations, no?
Balsamic vinegar made this way develops a rich aroma, and when that meets the aroma of berries, they complement each other into an even richer flavor. This balsamic x berry pairing works beautifully with yogurt, salad, even steak, but pairing it with ice cream delivers nearly the ultimate pleasure.
Today's breakfast is a simple 90kcal Berry Balsamic Greek Yogurt Bowl, let's go~
베리-발사믹-그릭요거트볼로.ingredients:
2T Greek yogurt, almonds, blackberries and blueberries to taste, 1t balsamic, mint just for looks

👉Here's how
1. In a bowl, put 2T (roughly equal to 3T) Greek yogurt, almonds, blackberries and blueberries.
2. Drizzle 1t balsamic on top.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #berry

고야두부-두부.title: Koyadofu Tofu
고야두부-두부.intro:
20250219 #breakfastdiary 1318, -7/mostly clear, 10 min/exercise (S)
Koyadofu is freeze-dried tofu widely used in Japanese cooking. It's known to have a higher protein content than regular tofu, be easier to digest, and be quite effective at suppressing cholesterol.
Tofu that's been frozen and then thawed gets about 6 times the protein content.
#koyadofu grilled in perilla oil, topped with mentaiko mayo and scallions, approx 350kcal
고야두부-두부.ingredients:
1/2 block tofu (freeze it beforehand and thaw it), perilla oil, mentaiko (pollock roe) mayo, scallions

👉Here's how
1. You can mimic koyadofu by freezing then thawing regular tofu. Take the frozen tofu out before you go to sleep.
2. Cut into bite-size pieces and squeeze out the water. Heat perilla oil in a pan and grill until golden. (Even after squeezing, the tofu keeps releasing water, so a non-stick pan is recommended.)
3. Plate it and top with mentaiko mayo and scallions.

Inspired by @the.dooboo

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #tofu

감자피자.title: #PotatoPizza
감자피자.intro:
20250218 #breakfastdiary 1317, -5/mostly clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
The cleaver commonly called a "chai dao" (菜刀) literally translates to "vegetable knife," but in practice it's used for cutting or mincing fruit, vegetables, or boneless meat. So basically it's just a kitchen knife. It's fairly heavy, but if you use that weight well, you can prep ingredients smoothly without much effort. And of course, it slices pizza just as well as a pizza cutter.
320kcal #potatopizza topped with minced rosemary
감자피자.ingredients:
1 potato, 2 tortillas (15cm), 1T ricotta cheese, 1t salt, a little rosemary, 1T olive oil

👉Here's how
1. Slice the potato with a mandoline and sprinkle with salt. This makes it crispier.
2. Brush olive oil on a pie pan, lay down a tortilla, and spread 1T ricotta cheese. Add another tortilla on top, squeeze the water out of the sliced potato, and spread it evenly. Sprinkle 1t salt.
3. Mince rosemary and scatter it on top. Drizzle with a swirl of olive oil and bake in a 180°C oven for 30 minutes. (Or you can just pan-fry it.)
4. Cut into quarters with a light touch using the chai dao.

Inspired by @cosatipreparopercena

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #potato

통감자구이-는-뭐라고-불러야하나.title: What Should I Call This #WholeRoastedPotato?
통감자구이-는-뭐라고-불러야하나.intro:
20250217 #breakfastdiary 1316, -4/mostly clear, 10 min/exercise (M)
The store had russet potatoes for sale, so I grabbed some right away. Unlike most of the waxy potato varieties common in Korea, russets are a classic starchy potato, and thanks to their fluffy texture they taste even better roasted or fried.
They say a moon carrying the sun is called a "sun-moon," so what do I call this 350kcal #wholeroastedpotato carrying mushrooms?
통감자구이-는-뭐라고-불러야하나.ingredients:
1 potato, 3 king trumpet... no wait, gosong mushrooms, 1T shredded cheese, olive oil, salt, pepper, mixed herbs

👉Here's how
1. Wash the potato skin-on, coat with olive oil, sprinkle a little salt, and bake at 190°C for 30 minutes, flipping once halfway through.
2. Meanwhile, melt 1T butter in a heated pan, add salt, pepper, and mixed herbs, and pan-fry the gosong mushrooms.
3. Take the potato out of the oven, cut a cross into the top (don't cut all the way through — 🙅), top with the fried mushrooms and shredded cheese, and torch it. Add a little parsley on top.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #potato

가지피자-2.title: Eggplant Pizza
가지피자-2.intro:
20250216 #breakfastdiary 1315, 0/cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
I'd been thinking that in 2025 I'd try to step outside the kitchen once in a while, but actually cooking outdoors made me realize I've been making breakfast like a hothouse flower this whole time. 🥲 It calls itself a "camping version," though it's not all that different, but anyway, here's a simple #eggplantpizza (350kcal) you can make in 10 minutes, camping-style.
가지피자-2.ingredients: 1 tortilla, 2T tomato sauce, 1 eggplant, salt, pepper, 2T mozzarella cheese, a little basil, grana padano cheese
가지피자-2.steps:
1. Slice one eggplant on a diagonal, sprinkle with salt, and let it sit for a bit.
2. Heat olive oil in a pan, sprinkle the eggplant with salt and pepper, and sear both sides until golden.
3. Spread tomato sauce on the tortilla, top with the grilled eggplant and mozzarella cheese, and bake in a 180°C oven for 10 minutes. (You just need the mozzarella to melt.)
4. Plate it and top with basil and grana padano cheese.

핫피넛버터누들-피넛버터.title: Hot Peanut Butter Noodles
핫피넛버터누들-피넛버터.ingredients:
1 serving somyeon (thin wheat noodles), 1T scallions, 1T peanuts, (dressing) 2T peanut butter, 1T soy sauce, 1T wine vinegar, 2 cloves minced garlic, 1t minced ginger, 2T chili oil, 1T sugar, 1t chili flakes

👉Here's how
1. Add 2t salt to boiling water and cook the somyeon.
2. Meanwhile, let's make the dressing. Mix together 2T peanut butter, 1/2T soy sauce, 1T wine vinegar, 2 cloves minced garlic, 1t minced ginger, 2T chili oil, 1/2T sugar, and 1t chili flakes.
3. Rinse the somyeon in cold water — this makes the noodles chewier.
4. In a mixing bowl, combine the somyeon and dressing and toss well.
5. Plate the somyeon and drizzle with chopped peanuts, scallions, and a touch of five-spice chili oil.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #peanutbutter

샐러드니스와즈-Salade-Niçoise.title: #SaladeNiçoise Salade Niçoise
샐러드니스와즈-Salade-Niçoise.intro:
20250214 #breakfastdiary 1313, -1/mostly clear, 30 min/exercise (S)
If you compared it to Korea, maybe it'd be Busan? A 387kcal #saladeniçoise, in the style of the southern French city of Nice
The five key ingredients are tomato, anchovy, black olives, tuna, and boiled egg, but honestly, throwing in just three — tomato, tuna, and boiled egg — along with whatever veggies you have at home is enough to feel like you've landed somewhere near the Mediterranean.
샐러드니스와즈-Salade-Niçoise.ingredients:
1/2 butterhead lettuce, 1 tomato, 7 olives, basil, 3 radishes, 1 egg, (dressing) 5 sprigs parsley, 2 cloves garlic, 2 olive oil, white wine vinegar, a pinch of salt, pepper

👉Here's how
1. Pick the leaves off 5 sprigs of parsley and mince them. Mince 2 cloves of garlic. Make the dressing with 2 parts olive oil, 2 parts white wine vinegar, a pinch of salt, and pepper.
2. Boil the egg and prep the rest of the ingredients. As for the oil in the tuna can — sometimes I use it, but today I'm tossing it.
3. Plate the ingredients and drizzle with the dressing.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #nice

계란프라이덮밥.title: Fried Egg Rice Bowl
계란프라이덮밥.intro:
20250213 #breakfastdiary 1312, -5/partly cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
Was it episode 2 of Midnight Diner? There was an episode featuring "neko-mamma" (cat rice). In the show, a nameless enka singer would stop by the midnight diner, eat warm rice sprinkled with bonito flakes and soy sauce, and soothe the fatigue of the day.
When nothing tastes good, you just eat rice anyway. #friedeggoverrice (450kcal), where bonito flakes bring the umami.
계란프라이덮밥.ingredients: 1/2 bowl rice (since it's breakfast), 1 egg, 1T tsuyu, 1T mirin, a little scallion
계란프라이덮밥.steps:
1. Mix the tsuyu and mirin, pour half of it in, and fry one sunny-side-up egg.
2. Put rice in a bowl, add a little bonito flakes, top with the fried egg, pour over the remaining tsuyu-mirin mix, and finish with sesame oil and scallions.

를-만들었다.title: I Made ).
를-만들었다.intro:
20250212 #breakfastdiary 1311, -1/snow, 30 min/exercise (S)
Last Saturday's dawn @uglyus.market vegetable box had crown daisy (ssukgat) in it. For the past few days I'd been mulling over how to eat it, and ended up making crown daisy tofu salad paired with tomato — Crown Daisy Tofu Caprese (390kcal).
Crown daisy has the pretty English name "Crown daisy."
를-만들었다.ingredients:
150g crown daisy (ssukgat), 1 block tofu, 1T Korean soup soy sauce, 1T sesame oil, 1t toasted sesame salt, 1 clove garlic, 1 tomato, 1t ground peanuts, 2t balsamic
*Set aside a little crown daisy for plating.

👉Here's how
1. Add 1T salt to boiling water, blanch the crown daisy, rinse in cold water, and squeeze out the moisture.
2. In a mixing bowl, mash the tofu, then add the crown daisy, 1T soup soy sauce, and one minced garlic clove, toss, then add 1T sesame oil and 1t toasted sesame salt, and toss again.
3. Plate the crown daisy and tofu mixture, then thinly slice tomato on top.
4. Top the tomato with ground peanuts, balsamic, and crown daisy.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #crowndaisy

차지키-소스를-곁들인-허브-감자구이.title: Herb Roasted Potatoes with Tzatziki Sauce
차지키-소스를-곁들인-허브-감자구이.intro:
20250211 #breakfastdiary 1310, -7/mostly clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
Tzatziki, made by mixing cucumber, dill, and other refreshing vegetables into Greek yogurt, has a nickname as "Greece's ssamjang." Of course, it's not just a Greek thing — it's also a favorite sauce in nearby Turkey and the Middle East. Making it ahead and letting it sit deepens the flavor, though it doesn't need to sit for long — about an hour is enough.
Crispy, fluffy herb-roasted potatoes (476kcal) served with tzatziki sauce
차지키-소스를-곁들인-허브-감자구이.ingredients:
(roasted potatoes) 2 potatoes, 1T olive oil, 1t salt, 1t pepper, 1T herbs and 1 clove garlic
(tzatziki) 1 cucumber, 2T Greek yogurt, 1T olive oil, 1t salt, 1t pepper, 1 clove garlic, 1T lemon juice
Also feta cheese and parsley
차지키-소스를-곁들인-허브-감자구이.steps:
1. Wash the potatoes skin-on and cut into wedges. Grate in 1 clove garlic, add 1T olive oil, 1t salt, 1t pepper, and 1T herbs, toss well, and roast in a 220°C oven for 20 minutes.
2. Meanwhile, make the tzatziki sauce. Grate the cucumber and squeeze out the water, then combine in a mixing bowl with 2T Greek yogurt, 1t salt, 1t pepper, and 1 clove grated garlic. Taste and add 1T lemon juice to balance the flavor.
3. Plate the roasted potatoes, tzatziki sauce, (a few more slices of cucumber if you have extra), and top with feta cheese and a little parsley.

살구-아몬드-크림치즈를-곁들인-오이래디쉬카르파초.title: Cucumber Radish Carpaccio with Apricot Almond Cream Cheese
살구-아몬드-크림치즈를-곁들인-오이래디쉬카르파초.intro:
20250210 #breakfastdiary 1309, -9/mostly clear, 20 min/exercise (S)
I was trying to figure out how best to eat this vivid, flavorful apricot almond cream cheese, and I figured it would clearly pair well with the flat shapes of cucumber and radish, in both taste and looks.
#cucumberradishcarpaccio (approx 271kcal) served with apricot almond cream cheese
살구-아몬드-크림치즈를-곁들인-오이래디쉬카르파초.ingredients: 1/2 cucumber, 5 radishes, 1 shallot, 1/4 apricot and almond cream cheese, (dressing) 1T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard, a little minced shallot
살구-아몬드-크림치즈를-곁들인-오이래디쉬카르파초.steps:
1. Thinly slice the cucumber and radish with a mandoline.
2. Cut the root off the shallot, peel it, slice it into long thin strips (called a "julienne cut," named after 18th-century French chef Jean Julien), and soak in water.
3. Plate the cucumber, radish, shallot, and cream cheese, and drizzle with the vinaigrette dressing.

두-번에-나눠-먹으면-600kcal.title: , split into two servings, 600kcal each
두-번에-나눠-먹으면-600kcal.intro:
20250209 #breakfastdiary 1308, -3/clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
I read that the origin of the Chinese character 民 (min, "people") traces back to an oracle bone script symbol representing a war prisoner who had lost one eye — evolving from slave, to subject, to today's meaning of "citizen." And yet some people still seem to treat "the people" as though they were war prisoners, slaves, or subjects of an absolute monarch.
A little different from the one I made a few days ago — a flourless strawberry almond #oatbake from a New York Times recipe.
👉Approx 1,200kcal total, split into two servings, 600kcal each
두-번에-나눠-먹으면-600kcal.ingredients:
(topping) 5 strawberries, 2T almonds, (batter) 3T butter, 2 cups milk, 1 egg, 1/4 cup sugar, 2T maple syrup, 1t vanilla extract, 2 cups oats, 1t baking powder, 1t cinnamon powder, 1t salt
*Might work fine with just 1 cup of milk too.

👉Here's how
1. In a mixing bowl, combine the batter ingredients — 3T melted butter (double boiler), 2 cups milk, 1 egg, 1/4 cup sugar, 2T maple syrup, 1t vanilla extract, 2 cups oats, 1t baking powder, 1t cinnamon powder, 1t salt — and mix well.
2. Butter an oven-safe dish, pour in the batter from step 1, top with strawberries and almonds, and bake in a 180°C oven for 30 minutes.

Inspired by @nytcooking

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #oats

두-번에-나눠-먹으면-370kcal.title: , split into two servings, 370kcal each
두-번에-나눠-먹으면-370kcal.intro:
20250208 #breakfastdiary 1307, -12/clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
Fried, roasted, boiled, boiled and mashed... more than a billion people around the world eat potatoes every year, so is there any ingredient more global than the potato?
Today it's #fondantpotato, a French potato dish pan-seared crisp then gently simmered.
👉Approx 740kcal total, split into two servings, 370kcal each
두-번에-나눠-먹으면-370kcal.ingredients:
3 potatoes, 50g butter, rosemary, 5 cloves garlic, 3 shallots, thyme, pepper, vegetable stock (250ml)
*Most solid stock cubes have the amount of water to dilute printed on the package.

👉Here's how
1. Peel the potatoes, cut into 3cm thick rounds, and punch out shapes with a cookie cutter. Soak in water for about 5 minutes, then pat dry.
2. Add butter to a pan, sprinkle salt and pepper, and sear both sides until golden.
3. Add 30g butter, rosemary, garlic, and shallot, and cook the potatoes until the aroma and color deepen further.
4. Pour in the vegetable stock (250ml) prepared beforehand until the potatoes are just submerged, and cook until it reduces down.
5. Plate and finish with thyme and pepper.

바나나오트베이크-바나나.title: Banana Oat Bake
바나나오트베이크-바나나.intro:
20250207 #breakfastdiary 1306, -8/light fog
The classic office worker's breakfast — a batter of banana and oats, simply baked in the oven, not too sweet — #bananaoatbake
It's actually supposed to have 1/4t baking powder, but I didn't have any. Looked it up and found you can substitute baking soda plus something acidic, so I used a little baking soda + 1/4t lemon juice instead, but the batter failed to rise — guess it wasn't quite enough.
👉Approx 356kcal
바나나오트베이크-바나나.ingredients:
1.5 bananas, 1/2 cup oats, 1/2 cup milk, 1/2t peanut butter, 1/2t maple syrup, a pinch of baking soda and 1/4t lemon juice, 1/2t vanilla extract and cinnamon, a pinch of salt

👉Here's how
1. In a blender, combine 1.5 bananas, 1/2 cup oats, 1/2 cup milk, 1/2t peanut butter, 1/2t maple syrup, a little baking soda and 1/4t lemon juice, 1/2t vanilla extract and cinnamon, and a pinch of salt, and blend into a smooth batter.
2. Pour the batter into an oven-safe dish, top with banana and blueberries, and bake in a 180°C oven for 30 minutes.
3. Didn't rise much, but anyway — a little peanut butter and Maldon salt on top~

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #banana

고등어구이-고등어.title: Grilled Mackerel
고등어구이-고등어.intro:
20250206 #breakfastdiary 1305, -12/clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
Q. Microwaved mackerel in 1 minute is nice and simple, but it's a bit lacking in flavor. Like 0% body fat mackerel, you know? 🐟 Any way to make it taste better? 🤔
#grilledmackerel with lentils for heartiness, topped with miso yogurt dip
👉Approx 470kcal
고등어구이-고등어.ingredients: 1/2 cup lentils, 2-3 bay leaves, 2-3 cloves garlic, 1 cleaned mackerel, 1T Greek yogurt, 1t miso, pepper, olive oil
고등어구이-고등어.steps:
1. Use 3 times as much water as lentils, add the sliced bay leaves and garlic, and simmer on low for about 15 minutes.
2. Mix 1T Greek yogurt, 1t miso, and 1t lemon juice to make the miso yogurt dip.
3. Microwave the cleaned mackerel for 1 minute.
4. Plate the lentils, top with the mackerel, add the miso yogurt dip, and sprinkle with pepper.

단호박구이-단호박.title: Roasted Sweet Pumpkin (Danhobak)
단호박구이-단호박.intro:
20250205 #breakfastdiary 1304, -12/partly cloudy
DeepSeek's shockwave, which wiped out 847 trillion won of Nvidia's market cap, has been at the center of controversy for the past few weeks. I read an article summing up its secret as optimization — meaning, combining and refining existing technology well.
Source: Slow News @slowneeskr
At the end of that article, the word "Kaizen" came up, a term I'd heard often long ago. Kaizen is the core of Toyota's production system in Japan, meaning continuous improvement.
Roasted sweet pumpkin has shown up in my breakfasts quite a few times, and it's constantly being improved based on Kaizen.
Today I boosted the nuttiness using ghee and toasted walnuts. #roastedsweetpumpkin, dipped in tomato sauce
👉Approx 176kcal
단호박구이-단호박.ingredients: 1 sweet pumpkin/kabocha (150g), 1t ghee, 1T walnuts, pepper, herbs, parmesan cheese, (tomato sauce) 1/4 onion, 2 cloves garlic, 1 can whole tomatoes, salt, pepper, herbs (1t each)
단호박구이-단호박.steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a pot, sauté the minced garlic and onion, then add the can of whole tomatoes. Add salt, pepper, and herbs and simmer gently. (This is tomato sauce I made last weekend — obviously a store-bought sauce works too.)
2. Toast the walnuts in a pan. This bumps up the nuttiness by about a million times.
3. Melt butter in a heated pan, add pepper and herbs, and roast the pumpkin.
4. Pour the tomato sauce onto the plate, top with the roasted pumpkin, toasted walnuts, and parmesan cheese.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #sweetpumpkin

Q. With dressing it's 669kcal, without it's 300kcal. Give up the calories or give up the flavor? 😃

토마토파마산폴렌타-폴렌타.title: Tomato Parmesan Polenta
토마토파마산폴렌타-폴렌타.intro:
20250204 #breakfastdiary 1303, -12/clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
Yesterday's forecast said it would be cold, cold, and wow, it really is. -12 degrees.
#tomatoparmesanpolenta, the Italian version of corn porridge to warm the body and soul, topped with sautéed tomato and parmesan cheese
👉Approx 300kcal — though adding the dressing bumps the calories up quite a bit. But can you really give up the flavor? 😃
토마토파마산폴렌타-폴렌타.ingredients: 1/2 cup polenta, 1 tomato, parmesan cheese, salt, pepper, herbs (optional), (dressing) 3T olive oil, 1T wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard
토마토파마산폴렌타-폴렌타.steps:
1. A 4:1 ratio of water to polenta works well. Bring water to a boil in a pot and slowly stir in the polenta little by little so it doesn't clump. Add salt and pepper, stir in 1T butter, cover, and let it sit for about 10 minutes.
2. Wash 1 tomato well, cut into wedges, and sauté in a heated pan with olive oil, salt, pepper, and herbs.
3. Plate the polenta, top with the sautéed tomato, and grate parmesan cheese on top to finish.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #polenta

Q. With dressing it's 669kcal, without it's 300kcal. Give up the calories or give up the flavor? 😃

구운버섯메밀국수샐러드-버섯.title: Grilled Mushroom Buckwheat Noodle Salad
구운버섯메밀국수샐러드-버섯.intro:
20250203 #breakfastdiary 1302, 0/mostly clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
Named by @Iamyon.c — #grilledmushroombuckwheatnoodlesalad
Aside from the tahini, it's an easy breakfast made with ingredients almost every household already has.
👉Approx 548kcal
구운버섯메밀국수샐러드-버섯.ingredients: 50g oyster mushrooms (any mushroom works fine), a little butterhead lettuce (lettuce/romaine/whatever works fine too), 80g buckwheat noodles, 1T olive oil, salt, pepper, herbs, (dressing) 1/2T miso, 1T tahini, 1T maple syrup, 1T lime juice, 5T water
구운버섯메밀국수샐러드-버섯.steps:
1. Mix 1/2T miso, 1T tahini, 1T maple syrup, 1T lime juice, and 5T water to make the dressing.
2. Heat olive oil in a pan, add salt, pepper, and herbs, and sauté the mushrooms.
3. Boil the buckwheat noodles, adding cold water three times during boiling, then rinse in cold water. Shake off the water and toss with half the dressing.
4. Tear the lettuce by hand onto a plate, add the buckwheat noodles from step 3, top with the mushrooms, then sprinkle almonds and drizzle the remaining dressing.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #mushroom

Q. Buckwheat noodles, buckwheat noodle salad — what should we call today's breakfast? (Or drop other ideas in the comments~😃)

메밀국수샐러드-버섯.title: Buckwheat Noodle Salad
메밀국수샐러드-버섯.intro:
20250203 #breakfastdiary 1302, 0/mostly clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
Aside from the tahini, it's an easy breakfast made with ingredients almost every household already has — still haven't settled on a good name for it, so for now, #buckwheatnoodlesalad
👉Approx 548kcal
메밀국수샐러드-버섯.ingredients: 50g oyster mushrooms (any mushroom works fine), a little butterhead lettuce (lettuce/romaine/whatever works fine too), 80g buckwheat noodles, 1T olive oil, salt, pepper, herbs, (dressing) 1/2T miso, 1T tahini, 1T maple syrup, 1T lime juice, 5T water
메밀국수샐러드-버섯.steps:
1. Mix 1/2T miso, 1T tahini, 1T maple syrup, 1T lime juice, and 5T water to make the dressing.
2. Heat olive oil in a pan, add salt, pepper, and herbs, and sauté the mushrooms.
3. Boil the buckwheat noodles, adding cold water three times during boiling, then rinse in cold water. Shake off the water and toss with half the dressing.
4. Tear the lettuce by hand onto a plate, add the buckwheat noodles from step 3, top with the mushrooms, then sprinkle almonds and drizzle the remaining dressing.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #mushroom

Q. Buckwheat noodles, buckwheat noodle salad — what should we call today's breakfast? (Or drop other ideas in the comments~😃)

딸기샐러드-딸기.title: Strawberry Salad
딸기샐러드-딸기.intro:
20250202 #breakfastdiary 1301, -3/mostly clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
#strawberrysalad, finished with fresh vegetables and balsamic
Tangy balsamic makes the sweetness of the strawberries pop even more — this kind of pairing, where two flavors that seem like they shouldn't work together end up in unexpected harmony, is called "contrasting pairing." If you look closely at popular foods, you'll often find this kind of surprisingly great match.
👉Approx 266kcal
딸기샐러드-딸기.ingredients: 1 butterhead lettuce, 10 strawberries, 1/2 cup blueberries, a little radicchio, 1T almonds, 30g feta cheese, balsamic glaze
딸기샐러드-딸기.steps:
1. Wash the butterhead lettuce and strawberries under running water.
2. Tear the butterhead lettuce and the leftover radicchio from a few days ago by hand and lay them on a plate.
3. Tuck the strawberries and blueberries into the gaps and add the almonds.
4. Crumble the feta cheese by hand and scatter it on top. I bought the individually wrapped 30g packs, which are just perfect for one serving.
5. Finish with balsamic glaze.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #strawberry

Q. Have you ever had strawberries with balsamic?

4번에-나눠-먹으면-한-번에-약-296kcal다.title: , split into 4 servings, about 296kcal each
4번에-나눠-먹으면-한-번에-약-296kcal다.intro:
20250201 #breakfastdiary 1300, 0/mostly cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
I thought I had tomato sauce stocked up, but turns out I didn't, so I was briefly thrown off, but I made a sauce out of a can of whole tomatoes instead.
In English it's called #StuffedShells, in Italian #ConchiglieRipiene — I think that's an honest name. Combining bits of recipes from here and there, I made #fullystuffedconchiglioni with ricotta cheese + spinach.
It takes a lot of steps so it's time-consuming, but it's the weekend, so it's doable for breakfast. One bite, and the rich ricotta cheese fills your whole mouth.
👉1,184kcal if you eat it all, split into 4 servings, about 296kcal each
4번에-나눠-먹으면-한-번에-약-296kcal다.ingredients: 10 conchiglioni (large pasta shells), 1T mozzarella cheese, 1T shredded cheese, 1 cup tomato sauce, (filling) 4 spinach plants, 2T ricotta cheese, 1 egg, salt, pepper
4번에-나눠-먹으면-한-번에-약-296kcal다.steps:
1. Boil the 10 conchiglioni in salted water for 13 minutes as directed on the package. No need to cook them al dente for this.
2. Blanch the spinach in a pan for 2 minutes. (The roots of Korean spinach are packed with nutrients, but sadly, I trim them off for the texture.)
3. In a mixing bowl, combine the ricotta cheese and spinach, mix, then add a pinch of salt and pepper, mix a bit more. Finally, add 1 egg and mix.
4. Spread tomato sauce in an oven-safe dish, stuff the conchiglioni with the filling from step 3, arrange them neatly, top with shredded cheese and mozzarella cheese, and bake in a 180°C oven for 15 minutes.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #conchiglioni

블랙펄토마토샐러드-목이버섯.title: Black Pearl Tomato Salad (Wood Ear Mushroom)
블랙펄토마토샐러드-목이버섯.intro:
20250131 #breakfastdiary 1299, -5/cloudy
Other recipes using wood ear mushroom tend to be more heavily seasoned, but since this is breakfast, I figured a lighter, lower-resolution dressing would work better. It seems more suited to summer, but surprisingly it doesn't feel out of place even on a snowy day like today. Fighting cold with cold, I guess?
Written as #blackpearltomatosalad, read as wood ear mushroom tomato salad.
👉246kcal
블랙펄토마토샐러드-목이버섯.ingredients: 2 cups wood ear mushrooms, 2 tomatoes, sesame seeds, 1 clove garlic, sesame oil, (dressing) 2T soy sauce, 1T vinegar, 1T mirin
블랙펄토마토샐러드-목이버섯.steps:
1. Soak the wood ear mushrooms in water the night before, before going to sleep.
2. Blanch the wood ear mushrooms in boiling water for 2-3 minutes, rinse in cold water, and squeeze out the moisture.
3. Cut the 2 tomatoes into wedges.
4. Mix 2T soy sauce, 1T vinegar, and 1T mirin with 1 minced garlic clove to make the dressing.
5. In a mixing bowl, combine the wood ear mushrooms, tomatoes, and dressing, and toss well.
6. Plate it and drizzle with sesame oil and sesame seeds.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #woodearmushroom

콜리플라워라이스-콜리플라워.title: Cauliflower Rice
콜리플라워라이스-콜리플라워.intro:
20250130 #breakfastdiary 1298, -9/mostly clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
Doctors don't emphasize sleep, diet, and exercise for no reason. Those three are the easiest and most fundamental way to conduct the hormone orchestra. Just do them, and you can get through the day feeling good without chasing extreme dopamine hits.
Ahn Chul-woo, "Balancing Dopamine: Have you been snacking every night? It's not your fault", Longblack @longblack.co
Humans can get motivated and take on challenges through the neurotransmitter dopamine, but just as much, maybe even more, they need melatonin from quality sleep, endorphins from proper exercise, and serotonin released under the morning sun.
And to produce all these neurotransmitters and hormones, you need a balanced intake of both animal and plant protein — so starting this new year, I'm resolving to eat well, even more diligently.
To put that into practice right away: low-carb, high-protein from both animal and plant sources, plenty of vitamins and minerals from a variety of vegetables, healthy fat from sesame oil, and balance from lemon juice — stir-fried #cauliflowerrice (written as cauliflower rice but really should be read as just "cauliflower")
콜리플라워라이스-콜리플라워.ingredients: 1 cauliflower, 1/2 onion, 1/2 bell pepper, 3 cloves garlic, 1/2 cup peas, 1 sesame oil, 1 egg, soy sauce, salt, lemon juice, parsley
콜리플라워라이스-콜리플라워.steps:
1. Heat oil in a pan and sauté the onion; once translucent, add the minced bell pepper, minced garlic, and peas, sauté, then add sesame oil.
2. Add the prepared cauliflower and stir-fry.
3. Add the egg and soy sauce, stirring until the egg is cooked through.
4. Season with salt to taste, then add lemon juice to balance the flavor.
5. Plate it and finish with parsley.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #cauliflower

파르펠레-파르펠레샐러드.title: Farfalle Farfalle Salad
파르펠레-파르펠레샐러드.intro:
20250129 #breakfastdiary 1297, -6/mostly clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
Since it's Lunar New Year, I felt like breakfast should be a little more dressed up, so I boiled some pretty striped bow-ties. Butterfly, or rather bow-tie shaped pasta, #farfalle, paired with fresh vegetables — #farfallesalad
파르펠레-파르펠레샐러드.ingredients: 2 cups farfalle, broccoli, 1/4 each red and yellow bell pepper, 1T ricotta cheese, (dressing) 3T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard
파르펠레-파르펠레샐러드.steps:
1. Boil the broccoli in boiling water. Drain and cut into small pieces.
2. Boil the striped farfalle in salted water. Meanwhile,
3. Prep the red and yellow bell peppers.
4. In a mixing bowl, combine the farfalle, broccoli, bell peppers, and 1T ricotta cheese.
5. Plate it and drizzle with the vinaigrette dressing.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #farfalle

계란푸딩-계란.title: Egg Pudding
계란푸딩-계란.intro:
20250128 #breakfastdiary 1296, -3/cloudy
It's technically steamed egg, but it has such a jiggly, pudding-like texture that I think it's fair to call it #eggpudding. If it works out, it delivers an amazing texture. Honestly, though, I failed once...😃
계란푸딩-계란.ingredients: 3 eggs, 100ml water, 1T tsuyu, 1T sesame oil, and a pinch of salt
계란푸딩-계란.steps:
1. Boil water in a large pot.
2. Oil the dish you'll use for the egg pudding, add 3 eggs, pour in 100ml of the boiling water, add a pinch of salt, and mix well. Skim off the foam.
3. Place the dish in the pot, cover with a lid, and steam for about 10 minutes.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #egg

시트러스샐러드-라디치오.title: Citrus Salad (Radicchio)
시트러스샐러드-라디치오.intro:
20250127 #breakfastdiary 1295, -1/cloudy
Radicchio, native to Italy, is a bred variety of chicory known for its distinctive bitter flavor.
#citrussalad with radicchio and ricotta cheese — the contrast between bitter radicchio and sweet citrus, plus the crisp radicchio, refreshing citrus, and rich, creamy ricotta cheese, is a charming combination.
This combo is always right.
시트러스샐러드-라디치오.ingredients: 1/4 radicchio, 1 orange and 1 grapefruit, ricotta cheese, (dressing) 3T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard
시트러스샐러드-라디치오.steps:
1. Wash the radicchio under running water and tear it by hand.
2. Peel the orange and grapefruit with a knife and cut out just the segments.
3. In a bowl, layer the radicchio, orange, and grapefruit, then top with the creamy ricotta cheese.
4. Drizzle with the vinaigrette dressing.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #radicchio

보타르가-어란.title: Bottarga (Fish Roe)
보타르가-어란.intro:
20250126 #breakfastdiary 1294, 3/cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
A couple days ago I bought a product called Spaghetti di Gragnano, and it has the texture of fresh pasta. Confirms an unchanging truth once again — expensive things are expensive for a reason.
In Italian it's #bottarga, in Korean #eoran — the star of today's pasta
보타르가-어란.ingredients: Eoran/bottarga (prepare one portion of pollock roe — slice half, use a quarter during cooking, and grate the remaining quarter on top of the plate), spaghetti, olive oil, salt, 2 cloves garlic, 3 pepperoncino
보타르가-어란.steps:
1. Finely mince the garlic; roughly chop the parsley.
2. Prepare the eoran (fish roe) and peel off the membrane.
3. Boil the pasta in salted water.
4. In a heated pan, add olive oil, garlic, and chopped pepperoncino. Add a ladle of pasta water, a ladle of water, and grate in the eoran.
5. Add the pasta to the pan and cook until it thickens; turn off the heat, add parsley, then shake the pan to emulsify (mantecare).
6. Plate it, drizzle with the remaining oil from the pan, and grate more eoran on top. Finish with the sliced eoran on top.

Inspired by @milan__kim

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #eoran

토마토란샐러드-토란.title: Tomato Taro Salad (Toran)
토마토란샐러드-토란.intro:
20250125 #breakfastdiary 1293, 0/mostly cloudy
This morning's Uglyus @uglyus.market vegetable box delivered taro (toran). Wondering how to eat it, I made #tomatotaros salad — using taro instead of potato.
Taro has a mild toxicity so it takes some effort to prepare. But once cleaned properly and tossed with dressing, it delivers a flavor you don't get to enjoy often. Kind of like creamy potato?
토마토란샐러드-토란.ingredients: 2 tomatoes, 5 taros, 2 spinach plants, turmeric, salt, doenjang (soybean paste), (dressing) 3T olive oil, 1T wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard
토마토란샐러드-토란.steps:
1. Add salt and doenjang to boiling water and blanch the taro for about 5 minutes. (This removes the astringent taste and makes the skin easier to peel.) Soak in cold water, peel, then boil for over 20 minutes. (I added a little turmeric thinking it might give a nice yellow color, but it's not really necessary.)
2. Prep the tomato and spinach.
3. In a mixing bowl, combine the tomato, taro, and spinach, pour in the dressing, and toss well.
4. Plate it and finish with pepper, pepper, pepper, pepper~

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #taro

-

꼰낄리오니.title: Conchiglioni
꼰낄리오니.intro:
20250124 #breakfastdiary 1292, -5/partly cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
If you could know something curious in advance — if you had the kind of ability Doctor Strange from the Avengers universe has, to see the future — would you actually be happy?
That's the thought I had while looking at the bus arrival notification at the stop on my way to work. Compared to before, we're already seeing quite a lot of the future.
Conchiglioni is a large snail-shaped pasta, the biggest of that shell-shaped family.
It would probably shock Italy to learn that anchovy fish sauce and mayonnaise go into conchiglioni, but hey, if it tastes good, what can you do?
Conchiglioni pasta tossed in rosé sauce
꼰낄리오니.ingredients: 5 cups conchiglioni, tomato dip, ricotta cheese
꼰낄리오니.steps:
1. Boil the conchiglioni in salted water. Meanwhile,
2. Melt 20g butter in a pan, add minced garlic to render garlic oil, then add 1T chili powder to make chili oil.
3. Pour in 200ml milk, bring to a simmer, add the boiled conchiglioni, then stir in 1T anchovy fish sauce to boost the umami.
4. Taste it (if it seems too salty, add 1 ladle of pasta water; if it's fine, skip that), then add 1T mayonnaise to balance the texture and flavor.
5. Plate it and shave parmesan cheese on top with a knife for some bite.

Inspired by @zesati.pasta

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #conchiglioni

-

그릭요거트볼-키위.title: Greek Yogurt Bowl (Kiwi)
그릭요거트볼-키위.intro:
20250123 #breakfastdiary 1291, 0/mostly cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
A properly breakfast-y, nutrient-packed #greekyogurtbowl
그릭요거트볼-키위.ingredients: Kiwi, apple, Greek yogurt, matcha, peanut butter, granola, walnuts, kaya jam
그릭요거트볼-키위.steps:
1. Mix matcha and peanut butter into the Greek yogurt until well combined.
2. Slice 2 kiwis and 1/4 apple into strips, and top with granola, kaya jam, and walnuts.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #kiwi

봉골레파스타-바지락.title: Vongole Pasta (Clams)
봉골레파스타-바지락.intro:
20250122 #breakfastdiary 1290, 0/mostly cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
Today's breakfast is #vongolepasta from Genaro Contaldo, Jamie Oliver's colleague and mentor. He doesn't add salt to the pasta water, and I honestly didn't notice much difference either way. But when I tasted the broth, I felt it needed some butter, so I added 1t. That hits just right for my taste.
봉골레파스타-바지락.ingredients: Spaghetti, clams, red chili pepper, garlic, olive oil, white wine, parsley, and 1t butter
봉골레파스타-바지락.steps:
1. Boil the spaghetti in boiling water.
2. Store-bought clams are usually already de-sanded, so just give them a light rinse in cold water.
3. Slice 1 red chili pepper and 3 cloves garlic.
4. Heat olive oil in a pan, sauté the red chili and garlic, add the clams, pour in white wine, and cover briefly with a lid. Once the clams open up, they're ready.
5. Add the spaghetti and some pasta water to the pan and cook a bit more. Taste it (Chef Genaro didn't add anything, but) I add 1t butter.
6. Plate the pasta, add the clams, and top with chopped parsley.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #clams

-
