Just as the refreshing broth flavor pulled from the clams with plenty of wine starts to fade, the spiciness of the red chili sneaks up and hits you from behind — #vongolepasta

쏨땀-차요테.title: Som Tam (Chayote)
쏨땀-차요테.intro:
20250121 #breakfastdiary 1289, -3/partly cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
I use the biweekly Uglyus @uglyus.market subscription delivery. There's a fun challenge in making good use of whatever random ingredients show up. As a bonus, it naturally cuts down on how often I use dawn delivery services, which eases the guilt that comes with that too.
#somtam made with chayote, which I got to know thanks to Uglyus.
Chayote has more water content than papaya, so instead of pounding it, toss it lightly together.
쏨땀-차요테.ingredients: 1 chayote, 1/2 corn, 5 shrimp, parsley, fried shallots, (som tam sauce) 2 cloves garlic, fish sauce, coconut sugar, pepperoncino, cherry tomatoes and lemon juice
쏨땀-차요테.steps:
1. Score the shrimp and blanch thoroughly in boiling water.
2. Cut the corn lengthwise and torch it.
3. Julienne the chayote with a mandoline made for som tam.
4. (Keeping the sauce mild since it's breakfast) In a mixing bowl, pound 2 cloves garlic, 1T fish sauce, 1T coconut sugar, and 3 pepperoncino, then add 3 cherry tomatoes and 2T lemon juice and pound a bit more.
5. Add the prepared chayote, parsley, and shrimp to the mixture from step 4 and toss well.
6. Plate the som tam, top with the corn, a little som tam sauce, and finish with fried shallots~

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #chayote

Q. I want som tam right now.

뇨끼-2.title: Gnocchi
뇨끼-2.intro:
20250120 #breakfastdiary 1288, 0/cloudy
I think the true completion of breakfast is doing the dishes, but I rushed out without finishing today. As long as nothing comes up, I make a different breakfast every day from the one before, and there are a couple of things I miss about that — one is taking breakfast photos in natural light, and the other is doing the dishes leisurely in warm water.
Crispy #gnocchi topped with basil pesto and grana padano cheese
뇨끼-2.ingredients: 2 cups frozen gnocchi, 2T basil pesto, grana padano cheese, olive oil, pepper
뇨끼-2.steps:
1. Pan-fry the frozen gnocchi in olive oil until the outside is crispy. Grating cheese on top while frying can make it even crispier.
2. Plate the gnocchi, top with basil pesto and grated grana padano cheese, and finish with pepper.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #gnocchi

시트러스샐러드-시트러스.title: Citrus Salad
시트러스샐러드-시트러스.intro:
20250119 #breakfastdiary 1287, -1/mostly cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
Citrus season is here.
In Samin Nosrat's Salt, Fat, Acid, Heat — Acid chapter, which I first learned about through the Netflix documentary, there's a line: "Acid brings balance and vibrancy to food." Indeed, acidic ingredients like orange or vinegar cut through richness and brighten up flavor. They also aid digestion and help prevent oxidation.
So today, going all in on citrus.
#citrussalad with orange and grapefruit, paired with beet and Greek yogurt
시트러스샐러드-시트러스.ingredients: 1 grapefruit and 1 orange, 1/4 beet, 2T Greek yogurt, a little pistachio, olive oil, cumin, salt, pepper
시트러스샐러드-시트러스.steps:
1. Peel the beet, slice thinly with a mandoline, and toss with cumin, salt, and olive oil.
2. Grate the orange and grapefruit zest, then mix in olive oil, salt, and the squeezed juice of the orange and grapefruit to make the dressing.
3. Mix salt and pepper into the Greek yogurt.
4. Plate the Greek yogurt, top with the orange and grapefruit segments, drizzle the dressing from step 2, and sprinkle with chopped pistachio.

Inspired by @ellenikatalanos

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #citrus

흑백요리사-가자미미역국-미역수프.title: Culinary Class Wars Flounder Seaweed Soup / Seaweed Soup
흑백요리사-가자미미역국-미역수프.intro:
20250118 #breakfastdiary 1286, 0°C/partly cloudy
Instagram feed size is switching to a 4:5 ratio for some users. According to Adam Mosseri (Instagram's CEO), this reflects data showing that most uploaded content is vertical.
In the very distant future, human eyes might even evolve to be vertical.
#flounderseaweedsoup, as seen on Culinary Class Wars — but when I actually made it, it turned into #seaweedsoup topped with braised radish and flounder.
흑백요리사-가자미미역국-미역수프.ingredients: 2 flounder, 1/4 radish, a handful of seaweed, soy sauce, mirin, oyster sauce, seasoned salt, anchovy fish sauce, sesame oil, heavy cream (or milk if you don't have it, or ricotta cheese if you don't have that either)
흑백요리사-가자미미역국-미역수프.steps:
1. Soak the seaweed in water for about 5 minutes.
2. Slightly thaw the frozen flounder, cut into thirds, boil, and pick out the flesh. (Would be nice to make broth from the bones, but skipping that today.)
3. Pour 500ml water, 50ml soy sauce, 50ml mirin, and 10ml anchovy fish sauce into a pot, slice the radish into 1cm rounds, and braise. Cut into shapes with a cookie cutter, though the shape doesn't really matter.
4. In a pot, add sesame oil, blanch the seaweed, then pour in 500ml water, add 2t seasoned salt and 1t oyster sauce, and bring to a boil. (Everyone's taste is different, so adjust the salt to your liking.)
5. Pour the mixture from step 4 into a blender and blend, then pour back into the pot, add 2T ricotta cheese, and simmer a bit more. (Don't strain it — the occasional bite of seaweed is part of the appeal. The show used heavy cream, but I used ricotta since I didn't have any; milk would probably work too.) The seaweed soup is done.
6. Pour the seaweed soup into a bowl, and top with the braised radish and the picked flounder flesh. Pepper, pepper, pepper, pepper~

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #seaweed

사워도우-3.title: Sourdough
사워도우-3.intro:
20250117 #breakfastdiary 1285, -8°C/cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
Sourdough has a low GI thanks to the relatively long fermentation process of its natural yeast. The longer the fermentation (usually 1-2 days at 5°C), the more carbohydrates the yeast breaks down, naturally reducing the amount the body absorbs. It's "what the season does and what time takes on," as I read in a piece by writer Kim Ae-ran.
But as the saying goes, nothing beats too much of anything — eat a lot and it's all pointless anyway. So just one piece for breakfast~😃🫓
Crispy toasted #sourdough topped with ricotta cheese and basil pesto
*GI (Glycemic Index) measures how much blood sugar rises after eating carbohydrates. Eating high-GI foods causes blood sugar to spike sharply, triggering excess insulin release and leading to fat storage. Repeated over time, this can lead to obesity, diabetes, and cardiovascular disease.
사워도우-3.ingredients: 1 slice sourdough, ricotta cheese, basil pesto, pink peppercorn
사워도우-3.steps:
1. Slice the sourdough, heat olive oil in a pan, and toast until crisp.
2. Spread a generous amount of ricotta cheese on the sourdough and top with basil pesto. Finish with pink peppercorn~

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #sourdough

인터스텔라-계란찜-계란.title: Interstellar Steamed Egg (Egg)
인터스텔라-계란찜-계란.intro:
20250116 #breakfastdiary 1284, -6°C/cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
If your steamed egg comes out bland from too little salt, pair it with pesto or chili oil. And if it's too salty, try topping it with ricotta cheese — plus, it looks pretty too.
"We will find a way. We always have" — a line from #Interstellar.

A slightly bland #steamedegg with broccoli and cherry tomatoes, which ended up needing pesto on the side to fix it.
인터스텔라-계란찜-계란.ingredients: 2 eggs, 1/2 cup milk, 1 broccoli, 3-4 cherry tomatoes, mozzarella cheese, salt, pesto or chili oil (nice to have)
인터스텔라-계란찜-계란.steps:
1. In a bowl, combine 2 eggs, 1/2 cup milk, and 1t salt, and mix well.
2. Add the blanched broccoli, cherry tomatoes, and mozzarella cheese, cover with plastic wrap, microwave for 2 minutes, then bake in a 200°C oven for 15 minutes.
3. Since it's barely seasoned, eat it with pesto dressing. Chili oil would probably work nicely too.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #egg

퍼펙트데이즈-팽이버섯곤약볶음-곤약.title: Perfect Days Enoki Konjac Stir-fry (Konjac)
퍼펙트데이즈-팽이버섯곤약볶음-곤약.intro:
20250115 #breakfastdiary 1283, -6°C/mostly clear
Watched #PerfectDays a little while ago. It was full of scenes of an ongoing, everyday routine, and I got the sense that maybe the director was trying to say that a perfect day is exactly that — an ordinary routine kept up. Thinking about it, keeping up your daily routine really is one of the hardest things in the world. It's practically a miracle.
#enokikonjacstirfry served with a magic chili oil made from chili and sesame stir-fried into chili oil, infused with sichuan pepper, garlic, ginger, peanuts, and even doubanjiang from Pidu district in Chengdu, Sichuan — so potent that just a few drops turn any dish Sichuan-style.
퍼펙트데이즈-팽이버섯곤약볶음-곤약.ingredients: Enoki mushroom, as much as you'd like to eat, 1 bag konjac noodles (shirataki), soy sauce, mirin, scallions
퍼펙트데이즈-팽이버섯곤약볶음-곤약.steps:
1. Trim about 2cm off the base of the enoki mushroom stem and pull the mushrooms apart.
2. Drain the konjac noodles, add salt, and rub/massage them.
3. Heat a pan, add a bit of water, blanch the konjac noodles, and once the water reduces, add 1T sesame oil and the enoki mushroom, and mix well.
4. Add 2T soy sauce and 1T mirin and stir-fry.
5. Plate it and top with finely chopped scallion and a little chili oil.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #konjac

시금치파스타-시금치.title: Spinach Pasta
시금치파스타-시금치.intro:
20250114 #breakfastdiary 1282, -1°C/partly cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
Before bed, I put some wilting spinach in water and it perked right back up.
Sadly, I trim off and toss the spinach roots, which are rich in iron and polyphenols.
Surprisingly, the secret behind great Korean-style pasta places is oyster sauce. Italy would be horrified to hear that, but it's true. Today I used fish sauce instead. It doesn't bring quite the same umami as oyster sauce, but it's still excellent.
시금치파스타-시금치.ingredients: Spaghetti, 4-5 spinach plants, 3-4 pepperoncino, 4-5 cloves garlic, 1T fish sauce, parmesan cheese, pepper
시금치파스타-시금치.steps:
1. Boil the spaghetti in salted water. Meanwhile,
2. Wash 4-5 spinach plants under running water and cut off just the roots.
3. Heat olive oil in a pan, sauté the thinly sliced garlic and pepperoncino, then add the pasta, 1 cup pasta water, 1T fish sauce, and spinach, and mix well.
4. Emulsify (mantecare), plate it, and top with parmesan cheese and pepper.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #spinach

카레-양배추.title: Curry (Cabbage)
카레-양배추.intro:
20250108 #breakfastdiary 1281, -6°C/mostly clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
On a cold winter morning that stings the tip of your nose —
Hearty with lentils instead of rice, and packed with peeled tomato and cabbage for extra umami — not curry, #curry
카레-양배추.ingredients: 5 cherry tomatoes, 1/2 onion, 1/4 cabbage, 1 cup lentils, 3 solid curry blocks, salt, pepper, a little butter, olive oil, parsley
카레-양배추.steps:
1. Score the tomatoes, blanch briefly in boiling water, then transfer to cold water and peel.
2. Roughly chop 1/2 onion and 1/4 cabbage, add to a pot with olive oil, sprinkle salt, and sauté until translucent.
3. Add 3 cups water, the prepared tomatoes, 1 cup lentils, and 3 curry blocks, and simmer gently, then stir in a little butter.
4. Plate it and finish with pepper and parsley~

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #cabbage

청경채볶음-고야두부-애쓰지않는요리.title: Stir-fried Bok Choy, Koyadofu, Effortless Cooking
청경채볶음-고야두부-애쓰지않는요리.intro:
20250107 #breakfastdiary 1280, -7°C/clear
Koyadofu is freeze-dried tofu widely used in Japanese cooking. It's known to have a higher protein content than regular tofu, be easier to digest, and be quite effective at suppressing cholesterol.
I pulled out tofu I'd frozen back on 12/29, leftover from making "Don't Despair Just Because Things Don't Go As Planned Mapo Tofu." Thawing frozen tofu and squeezing out the water gives you a texture similar to (though not identical to) koyadofu.
#stirfriedbokchoy with koyadofu-style tofu and king oyster mushroom
청경채볶음-고야두부-애쓰지않는요리.ingredients: 1/2 block tofu, 4 bok choy, 1 king oyster mushroom, 3-4 cloves garlic, 1T oyster sauce, oil, salt, pepper
청경채볶음-고야두부-애쓰지않는요리.steps:
1. Before bed, freeze the tofu, then soak it in water the next day.
2. Cut the tofu into cubes, heat oil in a pan, salt it, and fry until the surface is crisp, then set aside.
3. Heat oil in a pan, sauté minced garlic, add the king oyster mushroom and bok choy, sauté until wilted, then add oyster sauce and cook a bit more.
4. Plate it and finish with pepper, pepper, pepper, pepper

Inspired by @jooboossong

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #koyadofu #effortlesscooking

사워도우-대봉감.title: Sourdough with Persimmon
사워도우-대봉감.intro:
20250106 #breakfastdiary 1279, -1°C/cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
The snow from a couple days ago has melted and the roads are slippery. I pretend I'm a penguin and waddle my way to work.
#sourdough topped with thick Greek yogurt and daebong persimmon
사워도우-대봉감.ingredients: Sourdough, 2T Greek yogurt, 1 daebong persimmon, Maldon salt, olive oil, thyme
사워도우-대봉감.steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a pan and toast the sourdough.
2. Top the sourdough with the thick Greek yogurt, then scoop out the flesh of a ripe daebong persimmon and add it on top.
3. Finish with a little Maldon salt and thyme.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #persimmon

Sourdough with Greek yogurt and persimmons

대파조림-대파.title: Braised Scallion (Daepa)
대파조림-대파.intro:
20250105 #breakfastdiary 1278, 1°C/snow, 20 min/exercise (M)
① Run 60km a week.
② Rest one day a week.
③ Don't push too hard, but keep going.
That's Haruki Murakami's running routine. The third point — "don't push too hard, but keep going" — means leaving some "strength to run tomorrow" rather than pushing yourself to raise performance today. The point is "the rhythm of every day."
Source: Longblack @longblack.co
Since July 13, 2020, as long as nothing comes up, I've been making a different breakfast every day from the one before. Lonely or sad, I still eat. Thinking about it, that's probably its own version of the "daily rhythm" Murakami talked about.
Today's breakfast to keep that rhythm alive is radish and #braisedscallion cooked with balsamic vinegar.
The whole time I was cooking, I kept wondering how it would taste with red wine instead of balsamic vinegar.
대파조림-대파.ingredients: Scallion (white part only), radish, balsamic vinegar, salt, pepper, butter
대파조림-대파.steps:
1. Cut the scallion into 5cm pieces, and finely chop the radish.
2. Add olive oil to a saucepan, sauté the scallion, then add 2T balsamic, 1T water, salt, pepper, and a little butter, and reduce.
3. In the same saucepan used for the scallion, add the radish, 1T balsamic, and a little butter, and reduce.
4. Arrange the scallion neatly on a plate and top with the braised radish.

Inspired by @shun_foodcreator

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #scallion

토마토-2.title: Tomato
토마토-2.intro:
20250104 #breakfastdiary 1277, -5°C/partly cloudy
"I hate New Year's Day" — Antonio Gramsci criticized the custom of cutting off or planning life around a specific date like January 1st. Instead, he emphasized starting each day anew while staying connected to the continuity of the past.
If you decided to start something new for the new year, and it's now been three days (the classic "three-day resolve"), why not reset your resolve today. Not "starting today" or "starting tomorrow" — just start right now, simply. Because there's no such thing as a real break in our lives.
Marinated #tomato with ricotta cheese
토마토-2.ingredients: Cherry tomatoes to taste, 1T ricotta cheese, 1t honey, Maldon salt, pepper
토마토-2.steps:
1. Score the cherry tomatoes, blanch briefly in boiling water, then transfer to cold water and peel.
2. Marinate in olive oil, salt, and pepper for about 10 minutes.
3. Mix 1t honey and a little salt into the ricotta cheese well.
4. Plate the tomatoes and top with the ricotta cheese. Finish with parsley and pepper, pepper, pepper, pepper, pepper

Inspired by @shun_foodcreator

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #tomato

시금치계란수프-시금치.title: Spinach Egg Drop Soup
시금치계란수프-시금치.intro:
20250103 #breakfastdiary 1276, -8°C/mostly cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
When it comes to a good clean broth, nothing beats seasoned salt and chicken stock. A thick #spinacheggdropsoup to warmly wrap up a commute that's really starting to feel like winter.
시금치계란수프-시금치.ingredients: Spinach and mushrooms to taste, 1t seasoned salt, 1t chicken stock, starch, 2 eggs, 1t sesame oil
시금치계란수프-시금치.steps:
1. Season 500ml water in a pot with the seasoned salt and chicken stock, then add roughly chopped spinach and enoki mushroom.
2. Mix starch and water in a 1:1 ratio, and add the slurry gradually to adjust the thickness.
3. Turn off the heat, whisk in 2 eggs. Turn the heat back on, and once the egg is cooked, add a touch of sesame oil.
4. Pour into a bowl and finish with white pepper, pepper, pepper, pepper, pepper

Inspired by @biyou_takumi

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #spinach

새송이버섯샐러드-새송이버섯.title: King Oyster Mushroom Salad
새송이버섯샐러드-새송이버섯.intro:
20250102 #breakfastdiary 1275, -4°C/mostly cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
While putting together a list for the 2024 year-in-review breakfast awards, I noticed that the king oyster mushroom salad I made around this time last year took up a big spot on the list.
But when I remade it, it didn't quite taste the same as back then.
#kingoystermushroomsalad with a chicken-like texture
새송이버섯샐러드-새송이버섯.ingredients: 2 king oyster mushrooms, parsley, black sesame seeds, (dressing) 2T olive oil, 2T perilla seeds, 2T soy sauce, 1T sesame oil
새송이버섯샐러드-새송이버섯.steps:
1. Mix 2 parts olive oil, 2 parts perilla seeds, 2 parts soy sauce, and 1 part sesame oil to make the dressing.
2. Dust off the king oyster mushrooms and shred them along the grain with a fork.
3. Heat a little oil in a pan and sauté the king oyster mushroom to drive off moisture.
4. In a mixing bowl, combine the mushroom and dressing and toss well.
5. Plate it and top with a little black sesame and parsley.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #kingoystermushroom

#kingoystermushroomsalad

Mix 2 parts perilla seeds, 2 parts soy sauce, 1 part sesame oil (turned out too thick, so I added 2 parts olive oil) and pour over blanched king oyster mushroom and toss well. A little black sesame and scallion too.

비트고구마샐러드-비트-고구마.ingredients: 1 beet, 2 sweet potatoes, ricotta cheese, olive oil, salt, pepper, (dressing) 2T olive oil, 1T balsamic vinegar, 1T honey
비트고구마샐러드-비트-고구마.steps:
1. Trim the beet and sweet potato and cut into cubes. Place on an oven tray, add olive oil, salt, and pepper, toss well, and roast in a 200°C oven for 30 minutes.
2. Mix 2T olive oil, 1T balsamic vinegar, and 1T honey to make the dressing.
3. In a mixing bowl, combine the beet and sweet potato with walnuts and the dressing, and toss well.

양배추샐러드-애쓰지않는요리-양배추.title: Cabbage Salad, Effortless Cooking (Cabbage)
양배추샐러드-애쓰지않는요리-양배추.intro:
20241231 #breakfastdiary 1273, -3°C/mostly clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
December 31, 2024 — today, you can slap the word "last" on anything you do. The last breakfast of '24, the last coffee, the last bus, the last goodbye.
If the last something of '24 can carry over into the first something of '25, that alone is something to be grateful for.
양배추샐러드-애쓰지않는요리-양배추.ingredients: Cabbage and dill to taste, 1T olive oil, 1t whole grain mustard, a pinch of salt, 1T mayonnaise, pepper
양배추샐러드-애쓰지않는요리-양배추.steps:
1. Cut the cabbage into bite-size pieces. Add water to a pot, line with parchment paper, place the cabbage in, and steam.
2. Squeeze the water out of the cabbage, put it in a mixing bowl, toss with olive oil, then add dill, whole grain mustard, salt, and mayonnaise, and toss again.
3. Plate it and finish with pepper.

케일샐러드-케일.title: Kale Salad
케일샐러드-케일.ingredients: About 10 kale leaves, beans, 1/2 lemon, (dressing) 3T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard
케일샐러드-케일.steps:
1. Soak the beans overnight before bed. Add water and beans to a pot, salt it, and boil.
2. Wash the kale under running water, trim off the tough stems, roughly chop, put in a mixing bowl, pour in the dressing, and massage in by hand.

마파두부-오히려좋아.title: Mapo Tofu, Turned Out Great Anyway
마파두부-오히려좋아.intro:
20241229 #breakfastdiary 1271, -4°C/clear, 20 min/exercise (M)
The original plan was just plain mapo tofu, but tasting it partway through, it was way too spicy, so I added coconut milk, and it turned into the best #mapotofu in the world. So today's breakfast is named: Don't Despair Just Because Things Don't Go As Planned Mapo Tofu #turnedoutgreatanyway
마파두부-오히려좋아.ingredients: 1 cup coconut milk, starch slurry, 1 king oyster mushroom, 3 stalks bok choy, 1/2 block tofu, white pepper, oil, somyeon (thin noodles), (sauce) 1T soy sauce, 2T doubanjiang, 1T oyster sauce, 1T sugar
마파두부-오히려좋아.steps:
1. Microwave the tofu for 2 minutes, then cut into cubes and set aside.
2. Mix 1T soy sauce, 2T doubanjiang, 1T oyster sauce, and 1T sugar to make the sauce.
3. Blanch the bok choy in boiling water and drain, then boil the somyeon.
4. Finely chop the king oyster mushroom, heat oil in a pan, and sauté with salt and white pepper.
5. Add the sauce from step 1, tofu, and coconut milk to the sautéed mushroom and simmer. Once the tofu has absorbed enough of the sauce, pour in the starch slurry gradually to reach the desired thickness.
6. Plate the somyeon and bok choy, top with the mapo tofu, and finish with parsley.

Note: coconut milk is a fantastic ingredient — like instant noodle soup base, it can revive a dish that's fallen flat, and on top of that, upgrade the flavor about a million times.
Warm rice would probably pair better than somyeon here. Cold, shower-rinsed somyeon doesn't quite fit.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #mapotofu

토마토팍시-토마토.title: Tomato Farci
토마토팍시-토마토.intro:
20241228 #breakfastdiary 1270, -3°C/partly cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
The French word "farci" means "stuffed" in English. It's a dish where you hollow out tomatoes, bell peppers, and the like, and fill them with cooked meat or vegetables.
A fully-stuffed breakfast, 99.9🎶 — #tomatofarci
토마토팍시-토마토.ingredients: 5 tomatoes, (filling) 1/2 onion, 1 clove garlic, 1 king oyster mushroom, 1/4 zucchini, parmesan cheese, breadcrumbs, 1 egg, olive oil, salt, pepper
토마토팍시-토마토.steps:
1. Let's start with the filling for the tomatoes. Heat olive oil in a pan, sauté the minced onion and garlic, then add the minced mushroom with salt, pepper, and herbs, and sauté. Transfer to a mixing bowl,
2. Add the minced zucchini, breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, 1 egg, 1t salt, and 1t pepper, and mix well.
3. Wash the tomatoes well, cut off the tops, hollow them out, brush olive oil inside and out, and fill with the prepared filling.
4. Bake in a 180°C oven for 15 minutes, then remove the tops, raise the temperature to 210°C, and bake for another 15 minutes.

Inspired by #myfrenchovencooking

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #tomato

미옥서원-폴렌타.title: Miokseowon Polenta
미옥서원-폴렌타.intro:
20241227 #breakfastdiary 1269, -7°C/partly cloudy
Somewhere in Boryeong, partway up a mountain, there's supposedly a bookstore with no cell signal — #miokseowon. I'd love to visit sometime.
A quick #polenta
Polenta is a northern Italian dish made from coarsely ground corn flour. It's come a long way to end up struggling here in Korea.
미옥서원-폴렌타.ingredients: 1 cup polenta, 1/2 zucchini, salt, pepper, thyme, parmesan cheese, olive oil, (dressing) 3T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard
미옥서원-폴렌타.steps:
1. Pour polenta and water into a pot at a 1:4 ratio (tried 1:2 once and it came out way too thick), salt it, bring to a boil, and once it thickens, stir in 1T olive oil and 1T parmesan cheese and let it sit for a moment.
2. Cut the zucchini into small, nail-sized pieces, heat olive oil in a pan, add salt, pepper, and — not sure why I even have this at home, but — thyme, torn up, and sauté.
3. Plate the polenta, top with the zucchini, and drizzle with the dressing.

Inspired by #myfrenchsalad

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #polenta

무스테이크-무.title: Radish Steak (Radish)
무스테이크-무.intro:
20241226 #breakfastdiary 1268, -4°C/cloudy, 20 min/exercise (M)
Calmly getting ready for this year's breakfast awards.
My indigestion seems to have cleared up, but there's still a lingering unsettled feeling somehow, so keeping it light with #radishsteak
무스테이크-무.ingredients: As much radish as you'd like, (sauce) soy sauce, mirin, oyster sauce, oligosaccharide syrup, 1T each
무스테이크-무.steps:
1. Wash the radish well, slice into 1cm thick rounds, peel and trim the edges, add water to a microwave-safe dish, and microwave for 5 minutes. (1T water per radish)
2. Meanwhile, let's make the sauce. Mix 1T each of soy sauce, mirin, oyster sauce, and oligosaccharide syrup.
3. Heat oil in a pan and sear the radish, then add the leftover radish broth from microwaving, the sauce, and butter, and cook a bit more.
4. Plate it and add toppings to taste. Parsley goes surprisingly well too.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #radish

울면-울면은안돼.title: Ulmyeon, You Mustn't Cry
울면-울면은안돼.intro:
20241225 #breakfastdiary 1267, -2°C/cloudy, 20min/exercise(M)
There's a song that goes 'don't cry, don't cry, Santa won't give presents to kids who cry,' but the truth is Santa, who has to cut back on flour because of obesity and diabetes, usually says it a little differently: 'You mustn't cry-uh(ulmyeon).' 
So today's breakfast is #ulmyeon, enjoyed like a soup without the heavy wheat noodles, hence #youmustntculmyeon
울면-울면은안돼.ingredients:
Assorted vegetables, assorted seafood, 2 eggs, sesame oil, starch (for the broth seasoning) 2 cloves minced garlic, seafood powder, white pepper, salt

👉Like this
1. Trim whatever vegetables you have at home — onion, carrot, zucchini, bok choy, etc.
2. Prepare seafood like squid, conch, shrimp and blanch in boiling water. (These days you can easily get mixed seafood packs, which is convenient.)
3. Pour 500ml water into a pot, add 2 cloves minced garlic, 1T seafood powder, 1t white pepper, 1t salt, bring to a boil, then add the prepared seafood and vegetables and simmer.
4. Add starch water (starch to water ratio is always 1:1), pour in 2 beaten eggs, add 1t sesame oil, close the lid, let sit briefly, then serve in a bowl.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #ulmyeon

호박수프-호박.title: Pumpkin Soup Pumpkin
호박수프-호박.intro:
20241224 #breakfastdiary 1266, -7°C/clear
My chest felt tight around the solar plexus area. My hands and feet were cold. I must have an upset stomach. What went wrong? I finally got home, took some medicine, and went to bed earlier than usual. Waking up this morning, I feel a bit better. 
Someone once said that getting old is like living every one of 365 days with that same upset-stomach feeling. It's probably like going through daily life carrying the kind of ache you get from a sprained ankle. Only now, at this age, do I vaguely understand why my grandmother always had digestive medicine on hand, why she always smelled of Sinsin pain-relief patches. 
My stomach's still uneasy, but since I have to take medicine I figured I should eat something, so I made this #pumpkinsoup
호박수프-호박.ingredients:
Old pumpkin (about 1 kabocha squash, roughly), 1/2 onion, 100ml milk, 10g butter, 1t salt, 1t sugar, and pepper

👉Like this
1. Best to use a non-stick pan. Drizzle olive oil, dice 1/2 onion and sauté.
2. Peel the old pumpkin, cut into big chunks, add and sauté.
3. Pour in 300ml water, simmer, mash with a masher, then purée finely with a hand blender, pour in 100ml milk and simmer a bit more.
4. Add 10g butter, 1t salt, 1t sugar and simmer a bit more. (Season to taste)
5. Plate it and top with grated macadamia. Pepper pepper pepper pepper before eating~

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #pumpkin

연근구이-오히려좋아-연근.title: Lotus Root, Actually Great, Lotus Root
연근구이-오히려좋아-연근.intro:
20241223 #breakfastdiary 1265, -6°C/partly cloudy
Now
wondering what it means to live on
while lying down
sunlight fell
on my face
I kept my eyes closed
until the light passed
quietly
(Han Kang, Song of the Recovery Period)
I thought maybe this scene was that passage from the Nobel Prize acceptance speech. 
"When I closed my eyes, the orange light of the sun filled the inside of my eyelids. I felt that was the light of life. That indescribably warm light and air were surrounding my body."
Yesterday I lay for a moment like a line drawn in the middle of that light. 
-
#roastedlotusroot with creamy avocado, lightly tossed together
연근구이-오히려좋아-연근.ingredients:
1 lotus root, 1 avocado, pepper, (dressing) 3T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard

👉Like this
1. Wash the lotus root with the skin on and cut into bite-size pieces. Heat a pan with olive oil, add salt salt and pepper pepper and roast.
2. Peel the avocado and cut into cubes. (Mine had gotten too ripe when I cut it, so I used frozen avocado instead. Creamy frozen avocado #actuallygreat)
3. Put the lotus root, avocado, and dressing in a mixing bowl and toss evenly.
4. Plate it and pepper pepper pepper pepper

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #lotusroot

배샐러드-배.title: Pear Salad Pear
배샐러드-배.intro:
20241220 #breakfastdiary 1264, -1°C/cloudy, 20min/exercise(M)
The original recipe uses European pears, which are softer and less sweet than our Korean pears, and through the poaching process the (sour, astringent, etc.) flavors of the European pear get rounded out. 
On the other hand, when you poach a Korean pear in wine, the sweetness decreases, the sourness increases, and its signature crispness disappears entirely. 
If the pear hadn't been poached in wine, it probably wouldn't have blended with the other vegetables, and would have gone on flaunting its own sweetness and crunch the whole time you ate it, standing apart from everything else. 
I think both breakfast and life need balance. 
#pearsalad with caipira lettuce, lentils and walnuts
배샐러드-배.ingredients:
1 pear, 1 cup lentils, caipira lettuce, walnuts (dressing) 3T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, salt, pepper

👉Like this
1. Peel the pear and cut into long strips, pour in 2 cups white wine and poach for about 10 minutes until the wine evaporates, then cool.
2. Lentils to water ratio 1:3 — once the water boils, simmer another 15 minutes on low heat.
3. Lay caipira lettuce on a plate, add the lentils, cooked pear and walnuts, and drizzle the dressing evenly.

Inspired by @raymcvinnie

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #pear

알배기구이-알배기.title: Grilled Napa Cabbage Heart, Napa Cabbage Heart
알배기구이-알배기.intro:
20241219 #breakfastdiary 1263, -8°C/clear, 25min/exercise(S, M)
When the ingredients are good, you don't need fussy fancy dressings or sauces. Just like a seasonal tomato dipped in Maldon salt — grill the cabbage heart until nutty and fragrant, top with grated cheese, and it's heaven, nothing more needed.
알배기구이-알배기.ingredients:
1/2 napa cabbage heart, Grana Padano cheese, salt, olive oil, dill (just a supporting role)

👉Like this
1. Heat a pan with olive oil, salt salt over low heat, and grill the cabbage heart evenly all over. The key is grilling slowly on low heat for a long time.
2. Plate it and grate Grana Padano cheese on top.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #napacabbageheart

리코타치즈딥-석류.title: Ricotta Cheese Dip Pomegranate
리코타치즈딥-석류.intro:
20241218 #breakfastdiary 1262, -8°C/clear
My dearly beloved one, whom I do not love all that much
I could never forget you for the rest of my life
Even knowing this love won't come to me in my turn
I'll keep thinking of you alone, steadily
So then, may you be lovely forever
(Yi Sang, A Poem Like This)
Today's breakfast is #ricottacheesedip with pomegranate that's lovely forever, so it's nice paired with something like sourdough. Of course, eating it straight with a spoon is also fine.
리코타치즈딥-석류.ingredients:
1 cup pomegranate seeds, 1 ricotta cheese (150g), a bit of mint, 1T olive oil, a pinch of salt

👉Like this
1. In a mixing bowl, combine the pomegranate seeds, mint, a pinch of salt and the olive oil, mixing evenly.
2. Grate plenty of lemon zest into the ricotta cheese. Depending on the ricotta's consistency, you can also add a bit of lemon juice.
3. Plate the ricotta dip and top with the pomegranate seeds.

Inspired by @boroughchef

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #pomegranate

연근버섯샐러드-연근.title: Lotus Root and Mushroom Salad, Lotus Root
연근버섯샐러드-연근.intro:
20241217 #breakfastdiary 1261, -6°C/mostly cloudy, 20min/exercise(M)
Root vegetables like sweet potato and carrot have a lot of nutrients in the skin, so it's best to eat them unpeeled whenever possible. Lotus root is the same — eating it with the skin on gives you plenty of polyphenols and vitamin C. Plus, when you lightly pan-sear lotus root, the crunchy texture is just fantastic. 
You can buy herbs like thyme, dill, or mint online for around 1,000-2,000 won, and a little sprinkled on a salad or roast bumps up the flavor by like 28,000 percent, and makes the dish look way more put-together. 
#lotusrootandmushroomsalad with double the flavor thanks to thyme
연근버섯샐러드-연근.ingredients:
Lotus root, shiitake mushrooms, as much as you like (dressing) 1t salt, 2t soy sauce, 2t white wine vinegar, 2T olive oil, 1t whole grain mustard

👉Like this
1. Rinse the lotus root under running water and cut into half-moon shapes.
2. Dust off the shiitake mushrooms, cut off the stems, and slice the caps into long strips.
3. Heat a pan with oil, sauté the lotus root, lower to a simmer, add the mushrooms, toss toss, close the lid and leave it be for a moment.
4. Plate the lotus root and mushrooms, drizzle the dressing on top, then sprinkle minced thyme.

Inspired by @hakkousyokudaigaku

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #lotusroot

엔다이브사과샐러드-엔다이브.title: Endive Apple Salad Endive
엔다이브사과샐러드-엔다이브.intro:
20241216 #breakfastdiary 1260, -5°C/partly cloudy, 20min/exercise(M)
Over the past several years, cooking breakfast every morning, I've picked up all sorts of cuts, big and small. Handling knives and fire, the two most dangerous tools and elements in the world, always while racing against my commute time — it would be strange NOT to get hurt. Today too, I sliced my finger on the mandoline and the bleeding wouldn't stop, which flustered me for a moment. 
The whole world is watching our country's democratic resilience. Of course, I think that's the opposite of the question that came up in Han Kang's Nobel lecture — can the present help the past? Can the living save the dead? — I think it was thanks to the past helping the present, and the dead saving the living. 
On my way to work, like our country's Wolverine-level healing factor, the cut on my finger is now just a faint trace. 
Bleeding a little, here's #endiveapplesalad
엔다이브사과샐러드-엔다이브.ingredients:
1 endive, 1/2 apple, mint, Emmental cheese, walnuts, pink peppercorns, (dressing) 3T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard

👉Like this
1. Rinse the endive under running water and separate leaf by leaf.
2. Slice the apple, skin on, with a mandoline.
3. Arrange the endive, apple, cheese, mint, walnuts and pink peppercorns on a plate, then drizzle the dressing.

Inspired by @leplat_pmj

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #endive

다시만난세계-쪽파볶음면-쪽파.title: The World We Meet Again, Stir-fried Scallion Noodles, Scallion
다시만난세계-쪽파볶음면-쪽파.intro:
20241215 #breakfastdiary 1259, 0°C/mostly clear, 20min/exercise(M)
At some point SoSi's song "The World We Meet Again" became the anthem of the times, huh
#stirfriedscallionnoodles using capellini instead of somyeon
다시만난세계-쪽파볶음면-쪽파.ingredients:
Capellini, scallions, soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar

👉Like this
1. Boil the capellini in salted boiling water.
2. Wash the scallions thoroughly; cut half into 10cm lengths and finely chop the rest.
3. Heat oil in a pan, add the 10cm-cut scallions, pour in half the soy sauce mixture (1T soy sauce, 1T oyster sauce, 1/2T sugar), stir-fry, then set aside.
4. In the pan, add the chopped scallions, the remaining soy sauce mixture, and the capellini, and stir-fry.
5. Plate the capellini and top with the set-aside scallions.

Inspired by @uglyus.market

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #scallion

양파엔다이브구이-양파.title: Roasted Onion and Endive, Onion
양파엔다이브구이-양파.intro:
20241214 #breakfastdiary 1258, -4°C/clear
When you season roasted onion and endive with coarse Maldon salt, the seasoning doesn't fully dissolve in, so you get little bursts of saltiness here and there — and that's incredibly appealing.
양파엔다이브구이-양파.ingredients:
2 onions, 1 endive, olive oil, soy-based sliced ham, Maldon salt, garlic powder, pepper

👉Like this
1. Wash the onions and endive thoroughly and pat dry, then cut the onions into wedges and the endive into four pieces.
2. Lay the onion and endive on a pan, drizzle with olive oil, and roast in a 180°C oven for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with thyme, Maldon salt, and garlic powder. (Since they didn't brown enough, I torched them lightly for color.)
3. Blanch the sliced ham in boiling water.
4. Plate the onion and endive with the sliced ham. Pepper pepper pepper pepper~

Inspired by #myfrenchovencooking

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #onion

가자미구이-가자미.title: Grilled Flounder, Flounder
가자미구이-가자미.intro:
20241213 #breakfastdiary 1257, -3°C/cloudy, 20min/exercise(M)
 
From Han Kang's Nobel Prize in Literature lecture: 
In the moment I felt language was the thread connecting us, that my questions were plugging into that thread through which the light and current of life flows. I offer my deepest thanks to everyone who has been connected, and who will be connected, through that thread.
You can easily find the full text by searching. You'll feel both a lump in your throat and your chest swelling at the same time. 
These days it's so nice that you can easily get fish already cleaned and prepped for cooking. #grilledflounder
가자미구이-가자미.ingredients:
1-2 pre-cleaned flounder, 1 lemon, olive oil, salt, pepper, pink peppercorns, herbs (thyme, dill, etc.)

👉Like this
1. Thaw the flounder, rinse under running water, and score the body. Season with olive oil, salt and pepper, then roast in a 180°C oven for 30 minutes. Check on it, bump up the temperature a bit, and roast another 10 minutes.
2. Slice 1/2 lemon and add it in, top with dill, thyme and pink peppercorns, squeeze the remaining 1/2 lemon over it to finish~

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #flounder

양파구이-양파.title: Grilled Onion, Onion
양파구이-양파.intro:
20241212 #breakfastdiary 1256, -4°C/clear
It's nearly year-end but it's hard to greet the new year calmly these days. 
#grilledonion topped with grilled shrimp and tomato dip
양파구이-양파.ingredients:
1 onion, 1 shrimp, a good amount of butter, salt, pepper, herbs (optional)

👉Like this
1. Peel the onion, trim off just the sprouting top and the rooted bottom, wrap in cling film and microwave for 2 minutes. (Leave the inner skin on to help it keep its shape.)
2. Melt butter in a heated pan, cut the warmed onion in half, and slowly roast on low heat.
3. On the side, season the shrimp with salt, pepper and herbs and grill it too.
4. Plate the onion, add the tomato dip and shrimp, and finish with pepper.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #onion

대파구이-대파.title: Grilled Leek, Leek
대파구이-대파.intro:
20241211 #breakfastdiary 1255, 2°C/cloudy, 20min/exercise(M)
(Feels a bit dated to still be citing Webster's, but,) apparently Webster's word of the year is "Polarization." Defined as a split into two starkly contrasting opposites — specifically, a state where a society or group's opinions, beliefs, and interests concentrate only at the two extremes. #grilledleek with a soft-boiled egg and basil pesto
대파구이-대파.ingredients:
2-3 leeks (white sheaths only), 1 egg, basil pesto, olive oil, salt, pepper

👉Like this
1. Wash the green leeks thoroughly and cut away the sheath. (The green part is the leaf blade, the white part is the sheath.) Also cut a bit of the leaf blade into thin strips to top the grilled leek with later.
2. Heat a pan with olive oil, sprinkle salt and pepper, and slowly grill the leek.
3. Plate the leek, top with the reserved leek strips and the soft-boiled egg, then add basil pesto.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #leek

나이몽호이텃-어쑤언.title: Nai Mong Hoi Tod, Oyster Omelet
나이몽호이텃-어쑤언.intro:
20241210 #breakfastdiary 1254, 0°C/partly cloudy, 20min/exercise(M)
At long last, oyster season has arrived. 
I found a video of #NaiMongHoiTod, a famously Michelin-recognized Thai oyster omelet spot in Bangkok, and after replaying it several times, I recreated a moist Thai-style oyster omelet — #oyster omelet (Or Suan)
나이몽호이텃-어쑤언.ingredients:
1 cup scallions, 1 cup oysters, 1/2T fish sauce, 2 eggs, (starch water) starch and water prepared 1:1 (today's breakfast needs 2 ladles)

👉Like this
1. Blanch the oysters in boiling water and cool them in ice water.
2. Make Thai-style scrambled eggs. Heat oil in a pan, mix 2 eggs with 1 ladle of starch water, pour into the pan and fry crisp, adding more oil here and there.
3. In the pan, add scallions, oysters, and fish sauce in order, then add 1 ladle of starch water and stir-fry.
4. Plate the scrambled eggs and top with the oysters from step 3. (Add blanched bean sprouts on top if you like.) Serve with white pepper or a sriracha + sweet chili dressing.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #oysteromelet

청경채표고버섯볶음-청경채.title: Stir-fried Bok Choy and Shiitake, Bok Choy
청경채표고버섯볶음-청경채.intro:
20241209 #breakfastdiary 1253, -5°C/partly cloudy
#stirfriedbokchoyandshiitake — you just need bok choy and shiitake mushrooms and it comes together in 10 minutes flat
청경채표고버섯볶음-청경채.ingredients:
2 bok choy, 5 cloves garlic, 4 shiitake mushrooms, (seasoning) 2T soy sauce, 1T oyster sauce, a pinch of salt, starch water (1T starch, 1T water)

👉Like this
1. Cut the bok choy in half and blanch in boiling water with a pinch of salt.
2. Dust off the shiitake mushrooms, cut into 1cm pieces, and blanch briefly in boiling water.
3. Heat oil in a pan, sauté minced garlic, then add the shiitake, seasoning, and starch water and stir-fry.
4. Arrange the bok choy neatly on a plate and pile the cooked shiitake in the center.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #bokchoy

가지구이-가지.title: Grilled Eggplant, Eggplant
가지구이-가지.intro:
20241208 #breakfastdiary 1252, 0°C/clear, 20min/exercise(M)
'If nothing comes up, I make a different breakfast every day from the one before,' but 'something' came up. I missed my kitchen and my breakfasts. 
Usually quinoa is boiled in a pot of water, but roasting it in an oiled pan gives it a fun crispy texture. #grilledeggplant with sautéed quinoa and a spicy tomato dip from @farm_nevertheless
가지구이-가지.ingredients:
1 eggplant, 1T quinoa, olive oil, a bit of scallion, (dressing) 3T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard

👉Like this
1. Wash the eggplant, cut in half, heat a pan with olive oil, and grill it, starting cut-side down. Set aside.
2. Lower the heat and sauté the quinoa in the same pan the eggplant was cooked in.
3. Plate the grilled eggplant and quinoa, and top with thinly sliced scallion, tomato, and the dressing.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #eggplant

오늘-조식에-쓰인-양파-토마토-시금치는-저마다-익는-속도가-달라서-한.title: 20241203 #breakfastdiary 1251, -4°C/cloudy
오늘-조식에-쓰인-양파-토마토-시금치는-저마다-익는-속도가-달라서-한.intro:
20241203 #breakfastdiary 1251, -4°C/cloudy
The onion, tomato, and spinach used in today's breakfast each cook at a different pace, so if you throw them all in one pot at once, some end up overcooked and mushy while others stay undercooked and grassy-tasting — a total flop. Chickpeas even need to be soaked in water for at least a night before you can cook them. Everything has its own pace. Probably not just ingredients. 
A morning plate of spinach and chickpeas
오늘-조식에-쓰인-양파-토마토-시금치는-저마다-익는-속도가-달라서-한.ingredients:
Spinach, 1/2 onion, 1 cup chickpeas, 1 tomato, (dressing) 3T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard

👉Like this
1. Soaked the chickpeas in water last night before bed. In the morning, boil them in salted boiling water.
2. Heat a pan with olive oil and sauté onion sliced lengthwise along the grain. Set aside once translucent.
3. Cut the tomato into bite-size pieces and sauté with salt salt, pepper pepper. (Only the tomato gets seasoned.) Set aside.
4. Add the boiled chickpeas to the pan and sauté briefly. Coat lightly with olive oil and set aside.
5. In the hot pan, add the spinach, drizzle a little olive oil, and cook only until just wilted from the residual heat.
6. Arrange the onion, spinach, tomato and chickpeas on a plate and drizzle with vinaigrette dressing.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #salad

20241202 #breakfastdiary 1250, 6°C/partly cloudy, 20min/exercise(M)
I'm allergic to arugula, so I've searched around and tried a lot of alternatives, but honestly nothing beats spinach. And it's spinach season right now. 
#crepeeggwrap #CrepeEggWrap topped with seasonal spinach and tomato
크레페에그랩-크레페.ingredients:
1 crepe, 1 tomato, soy-based sliced ham, 1 egg, spinach, parmesan cheese, olive oil

👉Like this
1. Heat a pan with olive oil and lay the crepe flat in it.
2. Crack one egg in the center of the crepe, lay sliced ham around the edge, then fold it over gently.
3. Plate it, top with spinach and tomato, and sprinkle parmesan cheese~

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #crepe

애플시나몬브레드-시나몬.title: Apple Cinnamon Bread, Cinnamon

20241201 #breakfastdiary 1249, 0°C/cloudy, 20min/exercise(M)
Polls are one of the easiest and laziest ways of reading public sentiment. A leader shouldn't just chase numbers, but should read the invisible underlying direction.
(Slow News)
If the iPhone had been designed by polling, the simple design we know today would have disappeared, replaced by a front covered in countless buttons. So said Steve Jobs. Insight and leadership that transcend the times begin beyond the numbers.

Croissant dough (enough to fill mini pound cake molds), 1/2 apple, 2T butter, 1/2 cup sugar, 1T cinnamon

👉Like this
1. Cut the croissant dough into quarters and let it thaw.
2. Prepare melted butter (bain-marie),
3. Mix 1/2 cup sugar with the cinnamon.
4. Dip the dough in the melted butter, then in the sugar-cinnamon mix, layer with chopped apple, and stack it into the pound cake mold in layers. Bake in a 180°C oven for 20 minutes.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #cinnamon

Thank you
winter always
makes us humble.

Winter has arrived.

1 cup quinoa, 1 sweet potato, 1/4 lotus root, 1/4 onion, (dressing) 3T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard

👉Like this
1. Add 1 cup quinoa, 2 cups water, 1T olive oil, and a pinch of salt, simmer on low heat for 15 minutes, then close the lid and let it steam for another 10 minutes.
2. Peel the sweet potato and lotus root; cut the sweet potato into long pieces and roast in a pan, and slice the lotus root 0.5cm thick and roast with olive oil.
3. Soak the onion in water, then mince it.

고구마샐러드.title: Sweet Potato Salad
고구마샐러드.intro:
20241129 #breakfastdiary 1247, -5°C/partly cloudy
The first snow came. I still hadn't fully let go of autumn, yet winter's first heart arrived out of nowhere. Even the crickets couldn't stop their crying, and snow poured down as if the sky had a hole punched in it. The gingko trees along the street, not yet done growing their leaves, hastily shed green leaves instead of the usual yellow ones. Who sent this urgent word of early first snow, arriving here and there

2 sweet potatoes, parsley, olive oil, salt, (dressing) 1/2t miso, 1t tahini, 1T water

2. Heat a pan with olive oil and grill the sweet potato slices on both sides. Salt salt.
3. Plate the sweet potato, drizzle the dressing, and add a little minced parsley~

감태파스타-감태-콩두.title: Gamtae Pasta, Gamtae Kongdu

20241127 #breakfastdiary 1245, -2°C/mostly cloudy
As I wrote on the profile of my Instagram account how.about.breakfast, aka Mr. Breakfast Diary, I tend to prefer chopsticks over a fork. 
Last night, I wrote down that one sentence and stared at it for about an hour before falling asleep to the sound of falling snow. I comfort my lack of sleep with the nutty, salty flavor of gamtae (seaweed flakes).

Spaghetti, garlic (as much as you like), peperoncino, (Kongdu) gamtae pesto, gamtae (seaweed flakes), olive oil, salt, tuna fish sauce

1. Boil the spaghetti in salted boiling water. Meanwhile,
2. Heat a pan with olive oil and sauté the garlic and peperoncino.
3. Add 2 ladles of pasta water, the spaghetti, and the gamtae pesto, and stir-fry. A teaspoon of tuna fish sauce brings the flavor to life. Turn off the heat and mantecare~
4. Plate the spaghetti and tear gamtae over the top.

3 endives, sliced ham (made from soy), plenty of garlic, pepper, olive oil, (dressing) 3T olive oil, 1T white wine vinegar, 1t whole grain mustard

1. Wash the endive thoroughly, cut in half, heat a pan with olive oil, and grill. Grill the garlic alongside it too. (The garlic cloves were small so I grilled them whole — I'd recommend slicing them first.) Set aside,
2. Grill the sliced ham using the residual heat.
3. Plate the endive, top with the sliced ham and garlic, and add the dressing, pepper pepper pepper

20241124 #breakfastdiary 1242, -1°C/mostly clear, 20min/exercise(M)
#chestnutsoup made with the peeled chestnuts my mom gave me

1 onion, 3 cups peeled chestnuts, butter, 1/2T salt (to taste), 1 cup milk (add gradually to adjust consistency)

👉Like this
1. Melt butter in a pot, cut up the onion and sauté.
2. Cut the peeled chestnuts into chunks and add, sautéing together. If it gets dry from the starch, add water little by little while sautéing. Once the chestnuts seem cooked, add enough water to cover them, close the lid, and simmer for 3-4 minutes.
3. Set aside a bit of chestnut for garnish, then pour in the milk and blend with a hand blender. (It splatters a lot. Felt like I was wrestling the chestnuts.)
4. Season with salt, mix evenly, and plate. Mince the reserved chestnut and top it on, add pepper pepper, and parsley too.

#roastedpotatoes smothered in parmesan cheese, oven-baked crispy

20241120 #breakfastdiary 1238, 1°C/cloudy, 20min/exercise(M)
I called it #chayoteapplesalad but really it's closer to a som tam made with chayote instead of green papaya. 
In Thai it's called Tum fakmeaw. Tum means to pound, fakmeaw means chayote, so it's a very literal name. 
Since it's breakfast, I kept it mild~
차요테사과샐러드-차요테.ingredients:
1 chayote, 1 apple, 1 tomato, 1/4 carrot, a bit of cashews (dressing) 1 clove garlic, 2 peperoncino, 1T palm sugar, 1T cashews, 2T lime juice, 1T fish sauce

👉Like this
1. Slice 1/2 apple thin and soak in water.
2. Pound the garlic and peperoncino in a mortar. (My mortar was small so I stopped here) Transfer to a mixing bowl, add palm sugar, cashews, pour in lime juice and fish sauce, add cut tomato, and press and mash it all together.
3. Julienne the chayote and apple, add to the bowl, pour the dressing over and mix evenly.
4. Lay the soaked apple slices on a plate, and top with the dressed chayote and apple, julienned carrot, and cashews.

Inspired by #hotthaikitchen

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #chayote

대파수프-라이프수프-대파.ingredients:
1 leek (white part only), 2T flour, 20g butter, 100ml milk, 300ml water, 1t salt

2. Melt the butter in a pan, add the flour and stir constantly, then pour in the water, add salt, and simmer until it thickens.
3. Add the leek and simmer for about 5 minutes.
4. Add the milk and simmer a bit more. Adjust the consistency with the milk. Pepper pepper pepper, 

Since I love pepper, plate it and pepper pepper pepper~

20241118 #breakfastdiary 1236, -2°C/mostly clear, 20min/exercise(M)

I heard recently that when making Thai oyster omelets like hoy tod or or suan, mixing sriracha and sweet chili sauce half and half works great, so I tried it on grilled napa cabbage heart. 
Korean napa cabbage heart topped generously with Thai sriracha & sweet chili sauce and cilantro, Thai-style #napacabbagehearsalad

1/2 napa cabbage heart, cilantro, fried shallots
(dressing) 1T sriracha sauce, 1T sweet chili sauce

1. Remove the outer leaves of the cabbage heart, cut in half, heat a pan with olive oil, and grill evenly all over. (It didn't brown as much as I expected, so I used a torch.)
2. Plate the cabbage heart, drizzle the dressing, and top with cilantro and fried shallots.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #napacabbageheart

반미.title: Banh Mi
반미.intro:
20241117 #breakfastdiary 1235, 7°C/cloudy, 20min/exercise(M)
Today's breakfast is the Vietnamese baguette sandwich #banhmi. Instead of meat, I made tofu taste meat-like, and it turned out pretty convincing.
반미.ingredients:
Banh mi baguette, 1 block tofu, olive oil, pickled carrot and daikon, cilantro, 1/4 cucumber, sriracha sauce and mayonnaise
(seasoning) 1T soy sauce, 1T oligo syrup, 1T oyster sauce, salt

👉Like this
1. Heat a pan with olive oil, add the seasoning, and sauté the tofu. Sauté over high heat to drive off the moisture.
2. Cut the baguette in half and toast crisp in a pan. The key is toasting it crisp over low heat. (Today I zoned out for a moment and burned it.)
3. Spread mayonnaise on the baguette, layer the meaty tofu, pickled carrot and daikon, cucumber, sriracha sauce, and cilantro, then close with the other baguette half.

Oh, here's the recipe for the pickled carrot and daikon (the pickle that goes in banh mi) I made a few days ago: julienne 1 carrot and an equal volume of daikon with a mandoline, salt for about 15 minutes, then squeeze out the liquid firmly. In the jar you'll store the pickles in, add the carrot and daikon, then pour over a boiled-and-cooled mixture of 200ml water, 200ml vinegar, and 3t sugar until the carrot and daikon are submerged.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #banhmi

#pumpkinsalad made from a big pumpkin, cut up

20241115 #breakfastdiary 1233, 12°C/cloudy

샤프론리조또-샤프론.title: Saffron Risotto, Saffron
샤프론리조또-샤프론.intro:
20241113 #breakfastdiary 1231, 8°C/mostly clear, 20min/exercise(M)

#grilledradish paired with grilled mushrooms, flavored with a vinaigrette dressing

Sautéed Radishes with Mushrooms

#sweetpotatoboat topped with tuna tossed in avocado and mentaiko mayonnaise

1 sweet potato, 1 cup avocado, 1 (small) can of tuna, mentaiko mayo, pickles, scallions, plus pepper

There's the 10,000-hour rule, which says you need at least 10,000 hours of practice to become an expert in a field, but recent studies suggest practice alone isn't what makes the best. For instance, in chess, factors like intelligence and working memory, and in sports, things like oxygen utilization rate, matter just as much as practice volume. Still, for an amateur, the starting point is practice volume after all. 
Started an exercise called mountain climbers on 7/28, and today, 11/5, marks day 100. It's a move where you repeatedly pull your knees alternately toward your chest in a plank position with arms extended, like climbing a mountain quickly — very cost-effective in a lot of ways. 
The results after 100 days? If you search around, there are tons of dramatic mountain climber before-and-after videos, but that's someone else's story. Our bodies aren't built to change that easily. I'm content just to have found a kind of #mycompanionexercise to stick with for life.

When, and how much, one should open one's heart.

In modern usage, geumjatap is used to mean 'a great achievement to be remembered by later generations' rather than its original meaning, and honestly that phrase fits this dish's flavor really well.

In Korea too, up until the 1920s the term referred to the actual pyramid structure, but from the 1930s it started being used to mean 'a great achievement to be remembered by later generations,' and by now it seems the original meaning of the pyramid structure has nearly vanished, leaving only the meaning of a great achievement. #breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #lotusroot

량피.title: Liangpi
량피.intro:
20241016 #breakfastdiary 1207, 14°C/mostly cloudy, 20 min/exercise(M) 
 
Liangpi (凉皮) is a traditional dish from northwestern China, a cold noodle dish usually enjoyed in summer. One way of making it is to pour hot oil over the base seasoning to bring out its aroma, then toss it with the noodles — I've been seeing this method everywhere lately, 
so today's breakfast is a liangpi-style tofu skin toss using tofu skin instead of noodles (not sure I should even call this a 'toss,')
량피.ingredients:
Tofu skin, 1 cup oil
(Stage 1 sauce) lots of chopped green onion, minced garlic 1, chili powder 1, sugar 1, sesame seeds 1
(Stage 2 sauce) soy sauce 2, water 2
*Doesn't matter if it's T (tablespoon) or t (teaspoon). Just add roughly that much.

👉Like this
Soak the tofu skin in water the night before, then blanch in boiling water and cut into 10cm pieces.
Pour piping-hot oil (about 200°C) over the stage-1 sauce to bring the aroma up as much as possible, then mix thoroughly. Pour in the stage-2 sauce.
Put the tofu skin on a plate and drizzle with the sauce. Toss.
Add peanut butter if you want — it's delicious.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #liangpi

Tofu skin cooked liangpi (Chinese cold noodle)

Not spicy.

20241015 #breakfastdiary 1206, 16°C/cloudy, 20 min/exercise(M) 
 
Nothing beats #polenta for using up leftover odds and ends of vegetables in the fridge. Adding bell pepper or zucchini is nice too.

Polenta 2/3 cup

Pour water into a pot, salt it, pepper it. Once it boils, slowly stir in the polenta little by little so it doesn't clump. Turn the heat down very low and simmer about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. (Today it's a loose, southern-Italy style)
Cut the eggplant and onion into medium dice (1.2cm), then sauté in a hot pan with olive oil, salt, pepper, herbs.
Spoon the polenta onto a plate and pile the sautéed vegetables on top.

A galette is a flat cake that was originally made savory as a meal substitute. The original recipe finishes with honey instead of salt, but topping it with Maldon salt gives a fun crunchy texture without being too salty.

Olive oil

Mix miso, tahini, and water together to make the dressing.
Heat olive oil in a pan, salt and pepper it, and sauté the simply trimmed asparagus.
Plate the asparagus, pour the dressing generously over it, add a bit of chopped parsley, then grate macadamia nut on top.

비건스테이크-아스파라거스.title: Vegan steak, asparagus
비건스테이크-아스파라거스.intro:
20241010 #breakfastdiary 1201, 14°C/mostly cloudy, 20 min/exercise(M) 
Demis Hassabis (CEO of Google DeepMind) and John Jumper (Google DeepMind researcher) won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry. Apparently for developing something that predicts and designs protein structures. It's said to have compressed research that would have taken centuries. We're living in that kind of era. 
#Veganstake with sautéed asparagus and a poached egg, made to taste like meat using soy protein and the like
비건스테이크-아스파라거스.ingredients:
Vegan steak, 1
Asparagus, 5
Egg, 1
Mayonnaise 1T
Lemon juice 2T
Dijon mustard 1t
A little chopped green onion
Also salt, pepper

👉Like this
Heat olive oil in a pan and sear the vegan steak well on both sides.
In the same pan, trim and sauté the asparagus with salt and pepper.
Pour 2/3 cup water into a cup, strain the egg white through a sieve, then microwave for 1 minute 10 seconds to make a poached egg. It looks a bit off — let's cover it with dressing.
Mix mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, and lemon juice to make an aioli-style dressing.
Layer the steak, asparagus, and poached egg on a plate in that order, cover with the dressing, then top with chopped green onion and pepper~

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #asparagus

토마토타르타르-토마토.title: Tomato tartare, tomato

20241009 #breakfastdiary 1200, 16°C/clear, 20 min/exercise(M) 
When you hear "tartare," you usually think of steak tartare. It's a dish enjoyed across Russia, Eastern Europe, and Central Europe, similar to our yukhoe (Korean raw beef). There's a story that meat was kept under a horse's saddle for long-distance travel, and by the time the journey was over, the meat had tenderized and become good to eat — seasoned simply and enjoyed that way. Today's is #tomatotartare made with tomato instead of meat.
Ah, tomato pairs well with mint. Usually the longer-lasting spearmint is used, but today it's apple mint.
토마토타르타르-토마토.ingredients:
Sweet tomatoes, 5
Onion, 1/4
Capers, 10
Apple mint, a handful
Olive oil, salt, pepper

👉Like this
Score the tomatoes, blanch in boiling water, then dunk in cold water and peel. Dice and drain the excess liquid through a sieve.
Put the tomato in a mixing bowl, add chopped onion, capers, and apple mint, then mix with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Place a mousse ring on a plate, fill with the prepared tomato, and top with a bit of apple mint.

#breakfast #recipe #miraclemorning #tomato

배-갈아만든배-곱게썰어먹는배.title: Pear, blended pear drink, thinly sliced pear

20241006 #breakfastdiary 1197, 16°C/cloudy, 20 min/exercise(M) 
 
When you say #pear, what comes to mind is #Garamandeunbae (a Korean pear-juice drink brand). Unlike in Korea, overseas — in a 2015 Australian GQ feature — it became known as a hangover drink and turned into a massive hit. They apparently even call the pear "IdH" (doesn't the handwritten '배' look a bit like IdH?). 
Afterward the market saw a wave of copycats — Garameogeun-bae (Hanmi Pharm), Garabusun-bae (Sangaria), Garaseomandeun-bae (Samjin Ginseng), Garaneoeun-bae (Sinsong Foods), Gopgegaleun-bae (Myungjin Foods), Saksakgaleun-bae (Ilhwa), Garaseosiwonhan-bae (Yuhan), Anbanggaraneoeun-bae (Samho Foods), Meogeobwatna-galeun-bae (Binlac), Sigoljipgarasoneoeun-bae (Sammi Foods), Garaneoeun-gohyang-bae (Kwangdong Pharm), Gollasogaleun-bae (Dongwon Industries), Sseoleoseogaleun-bae (Onnuri Foods) — but all of them disappeared, and only the original survived. Anyway, that was a long preamble, but today's breakfast is #thinlyslicedpear.
배-갈아만든배-곱게썰어먹는배.ingredients:
In-season pear, 1/2
Fresh mozzarella cheese, 1
Olive oil, salt, lemon 1/2 (lemon zest, lemon juice), pepper to taste

Layer pear and mozzarella cheese neatly on a plate, then add olive oil, salt, pepper, a little lemon juice, and lemon zest.

폴렌타-3.title: Polenta
폴렌타-3.intro:
20240930 #breakfastdiary 1191, 22°C/partly cloudy, 20 min/exercise(M) 
A conversation, a meal, or an encounter with someone close to you — would it have been better to know in advance that it was your last one with them, or better to have no idea and find out suddenly later? Either way, I suppose as time passes the regret settles and the sadness scatters. 
#Polenta with mushrooms
Polenta originated in north-central Italy — coarsely ground cornmeal. Apparently in the north it's firm, and it gets looser as you go south. I was aiming for southern-style polenta, but ended up with northern-style. If you want the southern style, add plenty more butter and simmer it less.
폴렌타-3.ingredients:
Polenta, 1 cup (serves 2)
Butter 4T (2T for sautéing the mushrooms, the other 2T goes into the polenta)
Mushrooms, 4 cups
Onion, 1/4
Also olive oil 2T, parmesan cheese, herbs, salt

👉Like this

Meanwhile, heat 2T butter and olive oil in a pan and sauté the onion. Once it's cooked enough, add the mushrooms and sauté. Add salt and herbs.
Stir 2T butter and plenty of parmesan cheese into the polenta and mix well.
Spoon the polenta into a bowl, top with the mushrooms, and lay wide-cut shavings of parmesan on top.

가지탕수-가지.title: Eggplant sweet and sour, eggplant
가지탕수-가지.intro:
20240922 #breakfastdiary 1187, 19°C/mostly cloudy, 25 min/exercise(S, M) 
One of the most pointless debates in Korea is the "dip it or pour it" debate over sweet and sour pork — should you dip the meat in the sauce, or pour the sauce over it? 
According to a 2022 Hankook Research survey, 60% preferred dipping versus 22% pouring, showing dipping is more popular. Of course there was also an 18% response saying both are about the same, which probably includes some indifferent "why are you even asking this" reactions. Conclusion: whoever's paying gets to choose, or just ask for a side plate and everyone eats however they like. 
Today's eggplant sweet and sour has the sauce poured on lightly, more in the dipping spirit. 
You need 2 eggplants, 5 cherry tomatoes, and lemon (optional). 
Roll the eggplant with a rolling pin and cut off the ends to remove moisture. Tear it apart by hand. 
Toss with a little olive oil and starch, then bake at 180°C for 20 minutes (take it out at 10 minutes to mix). Of course it can't be as crispy as deep-fried. 
Meanwhile, combine soy sauce 2, vinegar 2, allulose 3, plus 1/2 oyster sauce for umami, with 150ml water, add cherry tomatoes cut into 4 pieces, and simmer briefly. Pour in a starch slurry (starch:water = 1:1) and mix well. 
Today it's poured-on style — plate the eggplant, pour over the tomato sauce, and top with a bit of lemon zest.

애호박샐러드-애호박.title: Zucchini salad, zucchini
애호박샐러드-애호박.intro:
20240921 #breakfastdiary 1186, 19°C/drizzle, 20 min/exercise(M) 
An unexpected morning schedule turned this into lunch instead of breakfast. 
Stopped by the mart to buy Greek yogurt, but got home and realized it was just regular yogurt. "Well, regular yogurt will taste good in its own way too," I figure. 
You need zucchini, feta cheese, Greek yogurt, and pesto. 
Slice the zucchini thin with a mandoline, put in a mixing bowl, toss with olive oil and salt, then grill in a pan. 
Mix in 2 parts Greek yogurt, 1 part feta cheese, and a bit of chopped parsley, then plate it. (If it's regular yogurt, use about 5 parts.) 
Top with the grilled zucchini and pesto. Finish with pepper~

옥수수갈비-옥수수.title: Corn ribs, corn
옥수수갈비-옥수수.intro:
20240920 #breakfastdiary 1185, 25°C/rain, 20 min/exercise(M) 
Coating it in batter and deep-frying would probably taste even better, but I couldn't recommend that to my body for breakfast, so instead: air-fried with no oil, topped with grated almonds instead of cheese — #cornribs 🌽
Cut 2 ears of corn, put in a mixing bowl, add 1 olive oil, and mix. Mix in 1/4 salt, 1 garlic powder, 1 paprika powder. Air-fry at 200°C for 15 minutes, flipping partway through. 
Plate the roasted corn, top with chopped parsley and grated almonds using a grater, and finish with lime juice~

칼몬드파스타-칼몬드.title: Calmond pasta, calmond
칼몬드파스타-칼몬드.intro:

This is the #calmondpasta I bought a few days ago from Karinji/Ringane Snack Bar in Hapjeong. It apparently has garlic scapes in it, but I didn't have any so I substituted frozen green beans. 
Turns out after buying it that it wasn't actually plain calmond but "gimscalmond" with seaweed added. 
You need spaghetti, garlic, pepperoncino, and calmond. 
Boil the spaghetti in salted water. 
Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté thinly sliced garlic, then add 2 chopped pepperoncinos, 1 fish sauce, today's kick — 2 calmond, the spaghetti, and 1/2 cup pasta water, sauté, then add green beans and sauté a bit more. 
Turn off the heat and mantecare. 
Plate the spaghetti and top with a little calmond~
👆To recreate the store-bought taste, use 1 fish sauce; if you prefer a milder taste, skip the fish sauce or use only 1/2 — the gimscalmond is plenty salty on its own.

매시드포테이토-감자.title: Mashed potato, potato
매시드포테이토-감자.intro:
20240918 #breakfastdiary 1183, 28°C/cloudy, 20 min/exercise(M) 
Updated to iOS 18. The Photos app UI changed drastically and it's a bit confusing. The background-removal feature looks useful, but it's only supported on iPhone 15 and up, so it's just a pipe dream for me. 
#Mashedpotato loaded with garlic and herbs 
You need potatoes, garlic, milk, butter, and herbs. Use whatever herbs you like, or parsley works too. 
Put whole garlic cloves, garlic, and herbs in a dish, cover with parchment paper, and roast in a 200°C oven for 30 minutes. 
Peel 4 potatoes and boil in salted water. 
Mash the potatoes in a pan, then add the roasted garlic, 2 butter, and 1/2 cup milk and mix well. Add pepper, chopped parsley and thyme, and season with salt. 
Plate it and top with a bit of garlic and herbs.

Chuseok. Holidays call for hometown flavors. I meant to make tom yum soup but didn't have the right other ingredients on hand, so I made #tomyumpasta with tom yum paste and coconut milk instead.

Blanch the shrimp in boiling water. 
Boil the spaghetti in salted water. 
Heat oil in a pan and sauté 1/4 onion; once translucent, add 1 cup coconut milk and tom yum paste (enough for 2-3 servings). Taste and add 1/2 cup pasta water. Add chopped parsley. 
Add the spaghetti, turn off the heat, mantecare, then add the shrimp and mix a bit more so the sauce soaks in. 
Plate it, top with shrimp, and add a bit of chopped parsley.

Mix 1 miso with 1 tsuyu and prepare. 
Cut the avocado in half and fill the hollow with the miso-tsuyu mixture. 
Cover with plastic wrap and freeze for 30 minutes. 
Sesame oil before eating~

오이샐러드-오이.title: Cucumber salad, cucumber

20240914 #breakfastdiary 1179, 23°C/clear, 30 min/exercise(M)

Sauté onion in olive oil in a coated pot, then add the green curry paste and sauté a bit more. 
Pour in 300ml water and bring to a boil, then add whatever ingredients you like and simmer a bit more. (green peas, okra, boiled potato, shrimp, celery, prepped tomato) Taste it and add 1/4 seasoned salt, 1 oligosaccharide syrup.

Plate it and top with a bit of sliced red chili pepper.

Green peas and sourdough tossed in Thai chili paste

Mayor Oh Se-hoon's Nodeul Island project is nothing more than tourism infrastructure that has nothing to do with the daily lives of Seoul's citizens or the city's sustainable future. Daily life is repetition, but tourism is something you visit once, take a photo of, and leave. Because it has no repeat visitors, accessibility and usability were probably never even considered in the first place. If Heatherwick's winning design actually gets built, it'll flood Instagram for a while, but it won't be long before it becomes just a structure people only look at from a distance. (This particular design is crude as a piece of architecture, too.) It might reel in foreign tourists who came because of Instagram, but it won't leave them with a good impression. Imagine getting off the subway, walking 800 meters under the blazing sun, waiting forever for an elevator, and then standing on a 20-meter-high aerial walkway getting hit by a biting river wind. It's genuinely absurd.
(Writing by architect Nam Sang-mun)
버섯샐러드-버섯-아무튼피트니스.ingredients: 1/4 head broccoli, 1 egg, 2 cups mushrooms, 1 clove garlic, sauce (1T soy sauce, 2T balsamic), 3-4 lettuce leaves, 1T olive oil, a pinch of pepper
버섯샐러드-버섯-아무튼피트니스.steps:
1. Blanch the broccoli in boiling water. 
2. Soft-boil the egg. 
3. Brush the dust off the mushrooms and cut into bite-sized pieces. 
4. Crush and mince 1 clove of garlic with a knife. 
5. Mix 1 part soy sauce and 2 parts balsamic to make the sauce.
6. Heat olive oil in a pan, sauté the mushrooms from step 3, then add the minced garlic from step 4 and the sauce from step 5 and sauté, then add the broccoli and sauté a little longer.  
7. Plate the lettuce cut into bite-sized pieces, the mixture sautéed in step 6, and the boiled egg, then add olive oil and pepper.

여름가지절임-가지-아무튼피트니스.title: Tofu with Soy-Pickled Eggplant
여름가지절임-가지-아무튼피트니스.intro:
20240824 #breakfastdiary 1157, 29°C/mostly cloudy
The #summereggplantpickle I'd planned to soak the night before and eat for breakfast fell through because I overslept, so today it's more of a pickled-eggplant-style dish instead. 
You need tofu and eggplant. 
Add kelp to 300ml of water and once it just starts to boil, remove the kelp. Add 3T soy sauce, 2T cooking wine, and 1T sugar, and simmer a bit longer. 
Cut the eggplant into finger-sized pieces and sauté in olive oil in a heated pan. Put the eggplant in a bowl, pour over the soy sauce, and let it sit for a while. Ideally you'd soak it overnight so the sauce fully soaks in. 
Rinse the tofu under running water, then microwave for 2 minutes to remove moisture. 
Plate the tofu, top with the eggplant, and add the beet sauerkraut I made a couple of days ago. Finish with a drizzle of sesame oil~
여름가지절임-가지-아무튼피트니스.ingredients: 1 block tofu, 1 eggplant, (sauce) 1 sheet kelp, 3T soy sauce, 2T cooking wine, 1T sugar, 1T beet sauerkraut, olive oil, sesame oil
여름가지절임-가지-아무튼피트니스.steps:
1. Prepare 1 block of tofu. Microwave for 2 minutes to remove moisture. 
2. Boil 300ml of water. Add the kelp, and once the water just starts to boil, remove the kelp. Add 3T soy sauce, 2T cooking wine, and 1T sugar, and simmer a bit longer. 
3. Cut the eggplant into finger-sized pieces and sauté in a pan with olive oil. 
4. Put the eggplant in a bowl, pour over the sauce from step 2, and let it sit until the eggplant has soaked up enough of the sauce. 
5. Plate the tofu from step 1, top with the eggplant from step 4, and add the beet-dyed sauerkraut. Finish with a little sesame oil.

아스파라거스그리비슈토스트-아스파라거스-아무튼피트니스.title: Asparagus Gribiche Toast
아스파라거스그리비슈토스트-아스파라거스-아무튼피트니스.intro:
20240823 #breakfastdiary 1156, 26°C/mostly clear, 20min/exercise (M)
Sourdough kept in the freezer and thawed a little at a time is a great breakfast staple. Fresh out of the freezer, brushing it with olive oil and toasting it for about 5 minutes works fine, but if you take it out before bed, it's in perfect shape to pan-toast by morning.
Today's breakfast, asparagus gribiche toast, needs sourdough, 4-5 stalks of asparagus, 2 eggs, a little capers, and mayonnaise.
Brush both sides of the sourdough with olive oil and toast in a pan until crisp.
Hard-boil the eggs, taking your time.
Trim the asparagus's tough stems with a peeler; cut the stems into 1cm pieces and the tips (about 10cm) separately, then sauté in a hot pan with olive oil.
In a bowl, combine the egg, asparagus stems, a good pinch of salt, a good pinch of pepper, mayonnaise, and today's kick — capers — and mix well. (Set the tips aside separately.) Let's call this asparagus gribiche.
Top the sourdough with the gribiche, the asparagus tips, and a final pinch of pepper.

For various reasons, I stopped by the library this weekend and browsed the 'Anyway' essay series. I thought — small as each book is, this series really holds a wonderfully wide and deep range of tastes. Curious what the very first title in the series was like, I borrowed 'Anyway, Fitness' — it reads easily and is genuinely fun. If you're considering getting into fitness for diet or health reasons, I'd recommend it. It might just be a very cheerful way to start.
🐍 A tangent: on page 18, there's this line — 'Down on all fours, alternating arms and legs (mountain climbers) — the "act like a dog" version comes in a surprising number of variations too' (p.18).
I can say from experience: the mountain climber, where you're braced on all fours alternating only your legs while your arms stay fixed, is a genuinely great exercise.

How does feeling arrive?
The way a flower blooms for the first time on its tree
Is that how feeling comes?
The way a flower falls for the first time from its tree
Is that how feeling fades?
A drop of water on paper
That won't dry for the longest time
Then where the drop disappears
A stain is left, twisted
A mark that never goes away
— Lee Seong-bok, 'Feeling'
아스파라거스그리비슈토스트-아스파라거스-아무튼피트니스.ingredients:
- 2 slices sourdough
- (asparagus gribiche) 2 eggs, 3 stalks asparagus, 2T mayonnaise, 2t capers, salt, pepper
아스파라거스그리비슈토스트-아스파라거스-아무튼피트니스.steps:
1. Brush the sourdough with olive oil and toast both sides. 
2. Hard-boil 2 eggs in boiling water for about 10 minutes. 
3. Trim the asparagus stems and cut into 1cm pieces. Cut the tips (to use as topping) into 10cm pieces, then sauté in a pan with olive oil, salt, and pepper. 
4. In a mixing bowl, combine the egg from step 2, the asparagus stems from step 3, 2T mayonnaise, 2t capers, salt, and pepper, and mix well. 
5. Top the sourdough from step 1 with the asparagus gribiche from step 4 and the reserved asparagus tips from step 3. Finish with pepper.

라임우동-라임메밀-라임.title: Lime Udon
라임우동-라임메밀-라임.intro:
20240822 #breakfastdiary 1155, 27°C/partly cloudy, 30min/exercise (S, M)
Every summer I make lime udon once or twice. The recipe gets upgraded every year — this time, buckwheat noodles instead of udon, and a very, very simple broth. If I had to describe the flavor, it's got a bittersweet finish that makes it lime buckwheat noodles.
You'll need buckwheat noodles, 2 limes, and tsuyu (soup base).
Mix tsuyu and water in a 1:3 ratio and squeeze in half a lime. Sniff sniff sniff — my hands are full of lime scent now.
Boil the buckwheat noodles, pouring in cold water three times or so, then rinse several times in cold water.
Place the noodles in a bowl, pour in the broth, and top with thinly sliced lime.

I thought — small as each book is, this series really holds a wonderfully wide and deep range of tastes. 라임우동-라임메밀-라임.ingredients: 1 serving buckwheat noodles, 2 limes (one for topping, one for the broth), tsuyu
라임우동-라임메밀-라임.steps:
1. Mix tsuyu and water in a 1:3 ratio, then squeeze in half a lime. 
2. Boil the buckwheat noodles, pouring in cold water about three times, then rinse in cold water. 
3. Place the noodles from step 2 in a bowl, pour over the broth from step 1, and arrange thinly sliced lime neatly on top.

썬키친-브로콜리구이-브로콜리.title: Grilled Broccoli Salad
썬키친-브로콜리구이-브로콜리.intro:
20240821 #breakfastdiary 1154, 26°C/heavy rain, 25min/exercise(S, M)
The #grilledbroccoli I ate so deliciously at #SunKitchen
You need broccoli, (store-bought) sauerkraut, beet, and almonds.
Last night before bed, I julienned some beet and tossed it into the sauerkraut. Woke up this morning to find a beautiful purple sauerkraut ready.
Blanch the broccoli in boiling water. Just briefly. Drain off a bit of moisture, then stir-fry over high heat in olive oil in a hot pan. Need to cook off the moisture to make it crispy.
Plate the broccoli and top with sauerkraut and almonds.
Felt a bit bare, so I mixed some whole grain mustard into olive oil and drizzled it on lightly.
👆I think without boiling — either pan-frying with enough moisture cooked off, or oven-roasting — is what brings out that crispy flavor.
-

썬키친-브로콜리구이-브로콜리.ingredients: 1/2 broccoli, 2T sauerkraut, 1T almonds, 1/4 beet, (dressing) 1T olive oil, 1t whole grain mustard
썬키친-브로콜리구이-브로콜리.steps:
1. Julienne 1/4 beet and let it sit in the sauerkraut for 2-3 hours. 
2. Blanch the broccoli in boiling water for 1 minute. Drain, then stir-fry in a pan with olive oil over high heat. 
3. Plate the broccoli and top with the sauerkraut and a little chopped almond. 
4. Drizzle a little of the dressing (1T olive oil, 1t whole grain mustard) on top.

오렌지토스트-오렌지-아무튼피트니스.title: Orange Toast

20240820 #breakfastdiary 1153, 28°C/mostly cloudy, 20min/exercise(M)

오렌지토스트-오렌지-아무튼피트니스.ingredients: 1 sourdough, 2 oranges, 1T cream cheese, a little pistachio and mint, olive oil, a pinch of Maldon salt
오렌지토스트-오렌지-아무튼피트니스.steps:
1. Brush olive oil on the sourdough and toast both sides until crispy. 
2. Spread a generous amount of cream cheese on the sourdough and sprinkle on today's kick — Maldon salt. On top, layer the two kinds of thinly sliced orange, chopped pistachio, honey, and mint in that order.

메밀면-2.title: Buckwheat Noodles
메밀면-2.intro:
20240819 #breakfastdiary 1152, 27°C/partly cloudy, 20min/exercise(M) 
Sticky weather calls for sticky okra and even stickier mountain yam. If I had to sum it up in a four-character idiom like "fight fire with fire," what would be the right phrase?
Summer #buckwheatnoodles with mountain yam and okra
Peel the mountain yam, cut into 2-3cm pieces, put it in a plastic bag, and crush it with a rolling pin.
Blanch the frozen okra in boiling water.
Boil the noodles in salted water, pouring in cold water about three times as you go.
Mix water and anchovy noodle broth in a 7:1 ratio to make the broth.
Place the noodles in a bowl, pour over the broth, and top with the mountain yam and okra.  
-
