메밀면-2.ingredients: 1 mountain yam (whole piece), 1 cup okra, anchovy noodle broth, 1 serving buckwheat noodles
메밀면-2.steps:
1. Peel the mountain yam, cut into 2-3cm pieces, put it in a plastic bag, and crush with a rolling pin. 
2. Blanch the frozen okra briefly in boiling water. 
3. Prepare the broth by mixing store-bought anchovy noodle broth and water in a 7:1 ratio. 
4. Boil the buckwheat noodles, pouring in cold water about three times as you go. Rinse in cold water. 
5. Place the noodles in a bowl, pour over the broth from step 3, and top with the prepared mountain yam and okra.

연어덮밥-연어.title: Salmon Rice Bowl
연어덮밥-연어.intro:
20240818 #breakfastdiary 1151, 25°C/mostly cloudy, 20min/exercise(M) 
Prepare 200g of raw salmon fillet. It varies by person, but that's just a touch short of 2 servings. You'll need a little scallion. Beyond that, prepare mirin, sesame oil, chicken stock, seasoned salt, and pepper. It's fine if you're missing one or two of these — as long as the salmon itself tastes good, that's what matters.
연어덮밥-연어.ingredients: 200g salmon, 1T scallion, 2T mirin, 2T sesame oil, 1/2t chicken stock, 1/2t seasoned salt, pepper
연어덮밥-연어.steps:
1. Cut the salmon into long strips, put it in a bowl with the scallion (white part), 2T mirin, 2T sesame oil, 1/2t chicken stock, 1/2t seasoned salt, and a little pepper, and mix well. 
2. Since I won't be using sushi vinegar today, season the salmon to taste with the (unbeatable) seasoned salt.

애호박타르트-애호박.title: Zucchini Tart
애호박타르트-애호박.intro:
20240817 #breakfastdiary 1150, 28°C/mostly sunny, 20min/exercise(M) 
I keep the late critic Hwang Hyun-san's book close by and open it now and then. Here's a tweet of his from around this time in 2016.
August 16, 2016, 3:49 AM
Went down to Tongyeong for literary-world business. Took the express bus down in the morning and came back up on the night bus. The whole way back, the Baekjung moon hung white in the sky.
Tomorrow is Baekjung — so the moon I saw yesterday was the Baekjung moon after all.
애호박타르트-애호박.ingredients: 1 sheet croissant dough, 1T ricotta cheese or thick Greek yogurt, a little parsley, 1/2 zucchini, salt, pepper, a little parsley
애호박타르트-애호박.steps:
1. Julienne the zucchini with a mandoline, sprinkle with salt, and let sit for about 30 minutes until the moisture releases. Rinse briefly in water and squeeze out the liquid. Now you've got nicely firm zucchini.  
2. Mix chopped parsley, a good bit of salt, and a good bit of pepper into the Greek yogurt. 
3. Poke holes in the croissant dough with a fork, then layer on the Greek yogurt, shredded cheese, and zucchini in that order. 
4. Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.

아보카도버섯샐러드-아보카도.title: Avocado Mushroom Salad, Avocado
아보카도버섯샐러드-아보카도.intro:
20240816 #breakfastdiary 1149, 26°C/sunny, 20min/exercise(M)
The baby bok choy was looking wilted, so I soaked it in water before bed, but when I woke up it was even more wilted — totally unusable. Turns out if you soak young leafy greens with delicate cell structure in water too long, the cells absorb too much moisture and burst or get damaged. Probably not just baby bok choy that does that.
In place of the baby bok choy, I wash the greens (probably butterhead lettuce) under running water and pat dry.
The avocado is in perfect condition. Cut it in half and remove the pit.
Heat a pan with olive oil, salt, pepper, and sear the brown shimeji mushrooms.
On a plate, layer the greens, avocado, then mushrooms in that order, and drizzle with vinaigrette.
@eyvstory I used the mountain salt for this breakfast for the first time — thank you! 😃

파스타-2.title: Pasta
파스타-2.intro:
20240815 #breakfastdiary 1148, 30°C/mostly sunny, 50min/exercise(S, M)
The world of pasta is truly vast and full of shapes of all kinds. I don't know why I even have this in my kitchen, but it's acini de pepe — Italian for "peppercorns" — tossed in tomato sauce, some kind of pasta anyway.
Boil a cup of acini de pepe in salted water. About 4-5 minutes is enough.
In a pan, heat olive oil, sauté minced garlic and onion, add salt, pepper, tomato, and sauté lightly. Add about 3 of store-bought tomato sauce.
Add the boiled acini de pepe and some pasta water, and simmer a bit more.
Pile it onto a plate and finish with grana padano cheese and parsley~
@eyvstory Started using the mountain salt today. Will put it to good use~😃

스낵당근-당근.title: Snack Carrots, Carrot
스낵당근-당근.intro:
20240814 #breakfastdiary 1147, 28°C/mostly sunny, 25min/exercise(S, M)
Ah, hot again this morning too.
From last week's vegetable box from Uglyus, the #snackcarrots that I'd passed over a few times finally made an appearance. Pan-searing brings out the vegetable's natural sweetness. The pairing with sour cream I'd been curious about turned out pretty good too.
Wash the snack carrots well and pat dry.
Heat a pan with olive oil, salt, pepper, and sear the snack carrots.
Plate some sour cream, arrange the snack carrots nicely on top, then parsley and vinaigrette~
Dip in the sour cream to eat.

부추덮밥-부추.title: Garlic Chive Rice Bowl, Garlic Chives
부추덮밥-부추.intro:
20240813 #breakfastdiary 1146, 28°C/mostly sunny, 25min/exercise(S, M)
I'm not a huge fan of bibimbap, where you mix rice and various vegetables all together in one bowl. It feels like all the ingredients' individual character gets mashed together. So today's breakfast isn't a mixed garlic chive bibimbap, but a #garlicchivericeBowl that you just quietly spoon up.
Wash the garlic chives under running water and cut into 0.5cm pieces.
In a bowl, put (store-bought) brown rice konjac rice, pour in a mix of 1/2 gochujang and 2 water, 1/2 soy sauce, sprinkle sesame seeds, then cover with the garlic chives.
Top with an egg yolk and sesame oil~

감자칩프리타타-감자칩.title: Potato Chip Frittata, Potato Chips
감자칩프리타타-감자칩.intro:
20240812 #breakfastdiary 1145, 27°C/mostly sunny, 20min/exercise(M)
#potatochipfrittata made from potato chips I happened to have on hand
In a bowl, whisk 3 eggs and 1 of sour cream, then add the potato chips, mix evenly, and let sit for 10 minutes.
Heat a pan with olive oil, pour in the batter, and cook over medium heat. (Lower heat depending on your pan's condition 🔥)
Hup, flip it and cook the other side too.
Plate it, crumble more potato chips on top, and add sour cream and finely chopped parsley.
👆This breakfast really depends entirely on the texture of the chips — a light-textured chip like Pocachip or a potato chip might work well too~
Thanks to @skyjeep72, ate well today~

버섯샐러드-버섯.title: Mushroom Salad, Mushroom
버섯샐러드-버섯.intro:
20240811 #breakfastdiary 1144, 30°C/mostly cloudy, 20min/exercise(M)
The @uglyus.market vegetable box arrived. Gosong mushrooms, brown shimeji, plus mini king oyster mushrooms I already had at home — a #mushroomsalad with all three kinds.
Slice the mini king oyster mushrooms and the gosong mushrooms (which look like brown button mushrooms) and prep them. The small, cute brown shimeji mushrooms probably don't need slicing.
Heat a pan with olive oil, sauté garlic, then add the mini king oyster mushrooms, gosong mushrooms, and brown shimeji mushrooms in that order, with salt and pepper.
Wash the baby bok choy well under running water, plate it, and top with the mushrooms.
Sprinkle with grana padano cheese~

👆Better to sauté the garlic separately and set it aside, then add it back in later. It burns otherwise.

아보카도계란토스트-아보카도.title: Avocado Egg Toast, Avocado
아보카도계란토스트-아보카도.intro:
20240810 #breakfastdiary 1143, 29°C/mostly cloudy, 20min/exercise(M)
Not sure if the sourdough is huge or the avocado is small — #avocadoeggtoast
Brush @honest_meallo sourdough with olive oil and toast it in a pan.
The avocado is perfectly ripe. Cut it and prep.
Fry an egg with salt and pepper.
On the sourdough, place the avocado and fried egg, then finish with salt, chili oil, and red pepper flakes~

메밀국수-우니.title: Buckwheat Noodles, Uni
메밀국수-우니.intro:
20240809 #breakfastdiary 1142, 26°C/partly cloudy, 25min/exercise(S, M)
If perfectly ripened avocado is the poster child for creamy texture on land, then sea urchin roe, uni, must be its counterpart from the sea.
Super simple #buckwheatnoodles topped with uni
Mix tsuyu and water in a 1:1 ratio to make the dipping sauce.
Boil buckwheat noodles, adding cold water partway through, then massage them under cold water.
Prep any garnishes you have on hand, like chili, cucumber, or seaweed.
Plate the buckwheat noodles and top with uni. Carefully pour on the sauce.

버섯토스트-버섯.title: Mushroom Toast, Mushroom
버섯토스트-버섯.intro:
20240808 #breakfastdiary 1141, 25°C/cloudy, 25min(S, M)
Sourdough's GI index is 49. Under 55 is generally classified as low. Just saying.
Put three garlic cloves in a small dish, pour in olive oil, and bake at 180°C in the air fryer for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat a pan with olive oil and toast the sourdough.
Thinly slice shiitake mushrooms and cook them in the same pan used for the sourdough, with salt and pepper.
The garlic burned. I poured in too little oil, and there wasn't time to redo it. Oh well, can't be helped.
Plate the sourdough, mash the garlic on top, then add the shiitake mushrooms.
A little chopped parsley, grana padano cheese~

건강검진으로-조식-쉽니다.title: 20240807 #breakfastdiary 1140, 26°C/partly cloudy, 30min
건강검진으로-조식-쉽니다.intro:
20240807 #breakfastdiary 1140, 26°C/partly cloudy, 30min(S)
Skipping breakfast today for a health checkup. (Not confident about this one since last year.)
For an account posting a different breakfast every single day, this is a pretty big deal.

버섯페투치네-버섯.title: Mushroom Fettuccine, Mushroom
버섯페투치네-버섯.intro:
20240806 #breakfastdiary 1139, 27°C/partly cloudy, 30min(S, M)
Fettuccine is about 0.5cm, tagliatelle 0.9cm, pappardelle around 2-3cm — talking about the noodle width here. The wider the noodle, the greater the surface area, so it absorbs sauce better and the sauce clings more, making the flavor richer. These three are apparently the go-to noodles for creamy mushroom pasta.

Anyway, breakfast
1. The act of making breakfast
The relativity of breakfast time
The quiet perseverance of breakfast pancakes
Oven cooking
We'll find the answers. We always have.
Like the catchphrase "Pass the civil service exam with EduO, pass the real estate license exam with EduO too" that made you wonder which cram school's ad copy this actually was — the movie Interstellar had a famous line that, perhaps unintentionally, made 400,000 exam-takers' hearts race.
The protagonists, on a journey to find humanity's new home, decide after fierce debate on Miller's planet as their destination. There's no time to spare, not even a moment — because one hour on Miller's planet equals seven years back on Earth. But contrary to hope, engulfed by a massive tidal wave on Miller's planet, the protagonists come away empty-handed, having wasted a staggering 23 years, 4 months, and 8 days of Earth time, heading back to the mothership in sorrow. And there they reunite with a companion who has aged alone, in solitude, for that same 23 years, 4 months, and 8 days.
Morning commute prep time = time on Miller's planet
Since the global pandemic there have been many changes, and thanks to that, great systems like remote work and flexible hours have been introduced — but even now, roughly 00% of office workers who still have to commute at a set morning time every day always wonder: why does the time spent getting ready for work fly by so fast? According to a reliable survey, apparently a whopping 00% of office workers skip breakfast — and that's not even counting the time to make or eat it.
How about this: you think you woke up at your usual time, but suddenly the morning air feels oddly different, sending a chill down your spine, and then you confirm you woke up exactly one hour late. From that moment, your own personal 100m dash begins.
Only those who've experienced it know. Just as one hour on Miller's planet equals seven years of Earth time, the time zone of your morning prep is different. It's relative. It flows by incomparably fast. There's the temperature the weather service announces (that's one thing) and then there's something like a separate "feels-like" temperature.
The immersive time that begins with breakfast prep, and relative time
There's a hidden trick to making and eating breakfast during this kind of morning rush before heading to work. It's immersion. You'd think immersion would make time fly faster, but unexpectedly, when you get absorbed in preparing breakfast, time tends to pass more slowly. There's a saying about losing track of time doing something, but that doesn't seem to apply here. Of course, getting immersed while making breakfast doesn't happen smoothly every day. On days when an ingredient you were sure was in the fridge turns out not to be there, or has gone bad, or there's not quite enough — those are the days time flies unusually fast. And on those days, it's not just time that flies — things get knocked over, spilled, and you even end up cutting yourself with a knife.
So on days when breakfast goes well, it feels like something out of a physics textbook on relativity. This is how I proved the relativity of breakfast. Of course, there's no way to prove it to anyone else. People call this a mental victory.
My breakfast's kick:
So do I set aside time for this every day? Sometimes I do take a taxi. After all, getting immersed every single day isn't easy, is it? This holds true even if you swap out "breakfast" for something else. You'll get the strange experience of time flowing relatively slowly. And that's something Dr. Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi, who wrote about the joy of flow, passionately argued as well.
(That part's a lie)
Generally, digging deep into or getting absorbed in something is called "flow."
-----------------------------------------
Murphy's Law doesn't mean bad things happen. It means what can happen, will happen.

Doing breakfast in the face of relativity means
Using time efficiently
And from the moment you wake up, check the digital clock, get ready as leisurely-but-quickly as usual, then suddenly notice the leading digit has gone up by one —

🤔I boiled the gnocchi too long and it fell apart. I thought milk could substitute for heavy cream, but that was a big miscalculation. The perilla leaves I used instead of basil should probably be chopped finer next time.

토마토냉파스타-토마토.title: Cold Tomato Pasta, Tomato
토마토냉파스타-토마토.intro:
20240713 #breakfastdiary 1116, 27°C/mostly sunny
Used capellini instead of the noodles in the original recipe, and the noodles feel a bit disconnected from the rest. Guess that's just how my heart feels too,
A grated, blended #coldtomatopasta made with 2 grated tomatoes
Boil 4 cups of water with 3 sheets of kelp, and (before the water fully boils) remove the kelp and strain through a sieve.
Grate 2 peeled tomatoes and 1 clove garlic, mix with 1.5 cups of the kelp broth, 2 of soy sauce, 1 of mirin, lemon juice, and 0.5 of sugar and plum extract to make the broth. Taste it — a bit bland. Add salt,
Boil capellini in salted water.
Plate the capellini, pour over the broth, and since it feels a bit bare, top with a little chopped chicory. Add black sesame and a bit of sesame oil too~

애호박오르조-애호박.title: Zucchini Orzo, Zucchini
애호박오르조-애호박.intro:
20240712 #breakfastdiary 1115, 22°C/mostly cloudy, 38min/exercise(S)
I agonize over it every single morning.
How to name today's breakfast so it's neither too long nor too short, holding back from attention-grabbing phrasing, keeping it as easy and plain as possible, while still showing off its charm as much as possible. Of course, since there's never enough time, most days I just name it after one or two of the day's main ingredients and hit share.
For instance, instead of some overwrought, magazine-style name like "Namyangju zucchini oiled with herb-infused aroma, crushed walnuts pan-toasted for that handmade touch, and organic orzo wrapped in a vinaigrette elevated with lemon juice and dill," today's breakfast is simply #zucchiniorzo. Like that.
Toast a handful of walnuts in a dry pan, no oil.
Boil 1/2 cup of orzo in salted water for however long the package indicates. (Usually short pastas like this take under 5 minutes.)
Slice zucchini, heat a pan with olive oil, add minced garlic, and sauté with salt, pepper, and mixed herbs.
Over the seared zucchini, pour a vinaigrette made from the orzo, 1 of lemon juice, and dill, mix evenly, and top with hand-crushed walnuts.

토스트.title: Toast
토스트.intro:
20240711 #breakfastdiary 1114, 22°C/mostly cloudy
Guacamole and moist scrambled eggs topped with ricotta cheese #toast
Brush bread with olive oil and toast both sides until crisp.
Mix 4 of avocado, salt, pepper, and 2 of lime juice thoroughly.
Mix 2 eggs, salt, pepper, and 2 of milk well, and pour into a pan. Cook briefly, only until the scrambled eggs still have that moist texture.
On the bread, layer avocado, scrambled eggs, then ricotta cheese in that order.

라자냐-2.title: Lasagna
라자냐-2.intro:
20240710 #breakfastdiary 1113, 23°C/mostly cloudy, 28min/exercise(S)
Contrary to the forecast, the morning sun is peeking through — thinking it might just evaporate all my pending issues away.
No oven, no meat, flavored with zucchini and tomato — the taste of summer, #lasagna
Boil one sheet of lasagna in salted water. (It was too big, so I cut it in half for plating.)
Heat a pan with olive oil, add 1/2 minced garlic, salt, pepper, mixed herbs, and one chopped tomato, and sauté. (Took a bite and thought something was missing — forgot the garlic. Anyway,)
Slice 1/2 zucchini into half-moons and sauté with salt and pepper.
On a plate, stack in two layers: lasagna, ricotta cheese, tomato, zucchini, chopped perilla leaves, and parmesan cheese.

푸실리샐러드-양파장아찌-들기름메밀국수.title: Fusilli Salad & Pickled Onion Perilla Buckwheat Noodles
푸실리샐러드-양파장아찌-들기름메밀국수.intro:
20240709, #BreakfastDiary 11112, 23°C/cloudy, 94% humidity
Rainy season, the whole world damp. Dreamed about breakfast and woke up wanting #FusilliSalad.
Boil fusilli in salted water. Drain and toss lightly with olive oil so it doesn't dry out.
Quarter the cherry tomatoes, halve the seeded cherries, and chop the basil.
Combine everything in a bowl, pour over vinaigrette, toss well, and plate.
Finish with black pepper. This recipe was jotted down from somewhere long ago and I never recorded the source - sorry about that, I'll credit it properly from now on.

20240628, #BreakfastDiary 1101, 23°C/mostly cloudy, 20min/exercise (S)
Buckwheat noodles with perilla oil, paired with #PickledOnions.
Mix perilla oil 1, soy sauce 1, plum extract 1, vinegar 0.5, and ground perilla seed 1 into a dressing (this ratio suits capellini-style noodles; double it for buckwheat noodles).
Roll up the perilla leaves and slice thin.
Boil the buckwheat noodles thoroughly, then rinse in cold water.
Plate the noodles with perilla leaves and the pickled onions I started soaking the night before, pour over the dressing - and since that alone felt a little bare, finish with perilla oil from Okhee Mill @okhee_mill.
Referenced a recipe from @junggourmet.
🧅 Pickled onions: mix water 2, soy sauce 1, sugar 1, vinegar 1, bring to a boil, pour over sliced onion in a jar, and that's it.

복숭아토스트-토스트.title: Peach Toast, Toast
복숭아토스트-토스트.intro:
20240708 #breakfastdiary 1111, 22°C/rain, 18min/exercise(S)
Raining on the way to work. Even if rain splashes onto me from the bus, subway, or the person next to me's umbrella, I'll try to let it slide a little~☔️😃
#peachtoast with ricotta cheese, walnut, and honey
Brush bread said to be made with native yeast with olive oil and air-fry at 180°C for 10 minutes, flipping partway through.
Slice today's ripe peach into wedges and sear lightly in a buttered pan. Brings out even more sweetness.
Spread ricotta cheese on the bread, top with peach and chopped walnuts, and seal it in place with honey so it doesn't run away.

토마토까르파초-토마토.title: Tomato Carpaccio, Tomato
토마토까르파초-토마토.intro:
20240707 #breakfastdiary 1110, 22°C/mostly cloudy
Of course you have to use very fresh meat, but when slicing it thin, you have to cut it as thin as when slicing prosciutto. Add a bit of sauce and it becomes carpaccio. The secret of this dish is that it lays everything bare — like a newborn baby, in a raw, naked state. (Alessandro Marzo Magno, The Genius of Taste)
#tomatocarpaccio with the tomato's flesh laid completely bare
Let's make the dressing. Mix vinaigrette with chopped walnuts, capers, and dill thoroughly.
Drizzle olive oil on a plate and arrange thinly sliced tomato and ricotta cheese.
Add the dressing on top and garnish with raspberries.
*Every household has its own vinaigrette — mine's 3 olive oil, 1 white wine vinegar, 1/4 whole grain mustard

체리치커리샐러드.title: Cherry Chicory Salad
체리치커리샐러드.intro:
20240706 #breakfastdiary 1109, 25°C/rain
#cherrychicorysalad with added quinoa
Simmer 1/2 cup red quinoa with 1 cup water, 1 of olive oil, and salt over low heat. Once the water reduces, turn off the heat and let it sit for about 15 minutes.
In a bowl, combine the quinoa, pitted cherries, chopped chicory, and a vinaigrette made with 1 of lemon juice, salt, and pepper, and mix evenly.

타르틴.title: Tartine
타르틴.intro:
20240705 #breakfastdiary 1108, 21°C/partly cloudy, 18min/exercise(S)
The recipe I referenced used burrata cheese, but I swapped in ricotta. It's relatively cheaper and I think the taste doesn't differ much. The brand is Bel Giolioso — much creamier compared to other products.
#tartine baked with tomatoes laid underneath(?)
Line a pan with parchment paper, add olive oil, balsamic, pepper, salt, and cherry tomatoes, cover with dough, poke air holes with a fork, and brush with egg wash.
Bake at 180°C for 20 minutes, then (hup!) flip it over, top with ricotta cheese and chopped basil, and say ahh~🦖

오이감자샐러드.title: Cucumber Potato Salad
오이감자샐러드.intro:
20240704 #breakfastdiary 1107, 22°C/mostly cloudy
Mixed turmeric powder into the potatoes for a nice yellow color, but once mixed in with the other ingredients, it was a bit much. In the end, the potatoes stole the whole show — #cucumberpotatosalad
Dice the potatoes, mix in a bit of turmeric for a nice color, and air-fry at 180°C for 10 minutes. Crispy outside, slightly underdone inside.
Slice 1/2 cucumber, salt it, and after 10 minutes squeeze out the moisture and prep.
Prep boiled eggs, green olives, and prosciutto.
Mix 5 of olive oil, 1 of wine vinegar, 1 of lemon juice, 1/2 of whole grain mustard, and 1 of honey thoroughly, then add a bit of dill to make the dressing.
In a bowl, combine the potato, cucumber, prosciutto, green olives, and dressing, and mix thoroughly.
Plate it, finish with pepper, and dig in heartily.
-
Stigma was a term in ancient Greek society for a kind of "brand" burned onto the bodies of slaves, prisoners, criminals — those deemed ethically or morally unacceptable. In Latin, the word stigma itself refers to the branding mark made by pressing a red-hot iron onto livestock to signify ownership. (Yoo Sun-hee)
In English, turmeric — I sometimes use it in breakfast. Especially when boiling potatoes, adding a bit gives it a more appetizing yellow color, but the fatal downside is that turmeric powder stains on the sink or dishes are stubborn, almost like a brand, and don't wash off easily. Still, it just takes a lot of effort to remove — it's not permanently stuck forever.

양송이버섯-까르파초.title: Button Mushroom Carpaccio
양송이버섯-까르파초.intro:
20240703 #breakfastdiary 1106, 23°C/mostly cloudy, 15min/exercise(S)
It's unsettling how a situation of someone single-handedly doing everything themselves — banging the drum, playing the janggu, headbutting bare ground — gets dressed up as "individual skill," and eventually gets repackaged as an organizational success story.
(Park Seo-gang, Why Chungju-man Is Uncomfortable)
Without acknowledging the harsh conditions, generalizing from an extremely small number of cases shouldn't be a thing. It's precisely because it's public.
Adding wasabi to vinaigrette gives it a subtle umami depth. #buttonmushroom salad or #carpaccio flavored with wasabi vinaigrette
Dust off the button mushrooms and slice thin with a mandoline, then prep.
Mix 1/2 cup olive oil, 1 of lemon juice, 1 of wine vinegar, sugar, salt, pepper, and 1/2 of wasabi thoroughly.
In a bowl, add the button mushrooms and thinly sliced parmesan cheese, pour the dressing over, and mix thoroughly.

열무.title: Yeolmu (Young Radish)
열무.intro:
20240702 #breakfastdiary 1105, 23°C/rain, 27min/exercise(S)
Apparently yeolmu's English name is "young summer radish." What a cute name.
Yeolmu salad tossed in miso tahini dressing and a tomato basil sandwich (a.k.a. Napoleon Bakery's eldest daughter sandwich)
Deciding to steadily work through the 1kg of yeolmu I bought a couple days ago. The yeolmu leaves and stems are on the thick, tough side. Cut the relatively thin, tender leaves into 5cm pieces.
Mix 1 of miso, 2 of tahini dressing, pour in 1/2 cup water to make the dressing, pour it over, crush in a handful of walnuts, and mix thoroughly.
Pit and chop 10 cherry tomatoes. Chop a handful of basil too. Mix with 3 of soy mayo, salt, pepper, and 1 of balsamic thoroughly. Prep complete.
Layer tomato basil on bread, fold in half, then in half again, and plate alongside the yeolmu salad.

열무잎-오믈렛.title: Yeolmu Leaves, Omelet
열무잎-오믈렛.intro:
20240701 #breakfastdiary 1104, 23°C/mostly cloudy, 18min/exercise(L)
Wrapped up the first half of 2024. (👆Check the Highlights for the 24 First-Half Na.Breakfast Awards!)
On a journey to find substitute greens since I'm allergic to arugula. Today it's yeolmu leaves.
#omelet with #yeolmuleaves on the side
Heat a pan with olive oil, chop one tomato and blanch it. Beat 2 eggs and pour in, add spinach. Add feta cheese and fold roughly in half. Rough is the key. Rough, irregular omelet is today's concept.
Plate it, top with yeolmu leaves, and grate grana padano cheese over it.

콩샐러드-콩.title: Bean Salad, Beans
콩샐러드-콩.intro:
20240630 #breakfastdiary 1103, 21°C/drizzle, 64min/(29min W, 35min S)
There are really so many kinds of beans. The seller doesn't always label them clearly, so I just guess based on shape.
#beansalad made with 6 kinds of beans: black soybean, black cowpea, princess cowpea, tiger bean, chickpea, and kidney bean
Soak the beans in water the night before. Boil in salted water, then let cool a bit.
Meanwhile, chop bell pepper and cucumber.
Mix 3 of olive oil, 1 of wine vinegar, and 1/4 of whole grain mustard to prep the vinaigrette.
In a bowl, combine 1 cup beans, 1 cup bell pepper, 1 cup cucumber, and the vinaigrette, mix thoroughly, and plate. Crumble feta cheese on top by hand, with olive oil and pepper

애호박시금치파이-애호박.title: Zucchini Spinach Pie, Zucchini
애호박시금치파이-애호박.intro:
20240629 #breakfastdiary 1102, 23°C/partly cloudy
The first half of 2024 is wrapping up. Time to revisit what I thought about at the start of the year. Prepping the mid-year review for the Na.Breakfast Awards.
Heat a pan with olive oil and lightly sauté spinach with salt and pepper. In a bowl, lightly mix 2 eggs with the sautéed spinach.
Line a pound cake mold with parchment paper, layer thinly sliced zucchini, shredded cheese, sautéed spinach, shredded cheese, zucchini, and mozzarella cheese, and bake at 180°C for 20 minutes.

양파장아찌-들기름메밀국수-국수.title: Pickled Onion, Perilla Oil Buckwheat Noodles, Noodles
양파장아찌-들기름메밀국수-국수.intro:
20240628 #breakfastdiary 1101, 23°C/mostly cloudy, 20min/exercise(S)
Last year alone, 1,124 tanghulu shops opened. Just as prevalent online is perilla oil noodles. (Even BTS's Jungkook has made them.) Adding one more to the pile.
#perillaoilbuckwheatnoodles with #pickledonion on the side
Mix 1 of perilla oil, 1 of soy sauce, 1 of plum extract, 0.5 of vinegar, and 1 of perilla seed powder to make the dressing. (This ratio is enough if using a pasta like capellini; double it if using buckwheat noodles.)
Roll perilla leaves up and slice thin.
Boil buckwheat noodles in boiling water thoroughly, then drain and rinse in cold water.
Plate the buckwheat noodles, perilla leaves, and the pickled onion soaked before bed, pour the dressing over — and since that alone feels a bit bare, finish with Okhee Mill @okhee_mill perilla oil~
🧅For pickled onion, mix 2 of water, 1 of soy sauce, 1 of sugar, and 1 of vinegar, bring to a boil, pour over sliced onion in a jar — done!

치즈피자-슈레드치즈.title: Cheese Pizza, Shredded Cheese
치즈피자-슈레드치즈.intro:

Like the poet Jung Hyun-jong's line, staking their past, present, and even future, the new hires have arrived. Hope they make it through without hurting body or mind,
Yesterday I thought this would be easy, got cocky, and ruined it — not even sure what to call this thing — anyway, no flour, edges a million times crispier — #cheesepizza
Layer shredded cheese in a pan like pizza dough. Add 2 eggs, thinly sliced tomato, baby spinach, salt, pepper,
Plate it, fold in half, and cut into easy-to-eat pieces.

휴브리스-페타치즈-블루베리.title: Hubris, Feta Cheese, Blueberry
휴브리스-페타치즈-블루베리.intro:
20240626 #breakfastdiary 1099, 19°C/sunny, 18min/exercise(S)
In Greek mythology, this was a term for humans arrogantly disregarding human limits. In short, from the gods' perspective, the arrogance and conceit of humans overstepping their bounds.
Arnold Toynbee borrowed this term to describe how a person who has tasted success grows arrogant, eventually stops listening to others, indulges in stubbornness, and heads toward ruin — calling it hubris.
After ruining today's breakfast, something I thought would be easy, with sheer arrogance, I had this thought. Of course, it's not something that only happens at the breakfast table. Anyway, so today's breakfast is simply #fetacheese with #blueberry,
Wash the blueberries well under running water, put them in a bowl with a bit of feta cheese, olive oil, and mint to fill the gap~

문어샐러드-문어.title: Octopus Salad, Octopus
문어샐러드-문어.intro:
20240625 #breakfastdiary 1098, 18°C/sunny, 27min/exercise(S)

Cut 2 potatoes, boil in salted water, then drain and cool in cold water.
Cut the octopus leg into bite-sized pieces.
In a bowl, combine the potato, octopus, olives, and vinaigrette, and mix thoroughly.
Plate it, top with parsley, and finish with pepper,

수퍼내추럴-디토-그릭요거트.title: Supernatural, Ditto, Greek Yogurt
수퍼내추럴-디토-그릭요거트.intro:
20240624 #breakfastdiary 1097, 20°C/mostly cloudy, 18min/exercise(S)
Rhythm upbeat, melody bittersweet
NewJeans' Japanese debut double single #Supernatural still pursues this same direction, just like previous tracks such as #Ditto. Looked it up — still going strong, producer #250
Upbeat seared apricot, bittersweet, generously dolloped Greek yogurt — #greekyogurt with seared apricot on the side
Melt butter in a pan, cut apricots in half, and sear cut-side down first. Sprinkle a little sugar and use a torch to caramelize... ah, out of butane gas. Gently flip the apricots over instead.
Plate the Greek yogurt, top with the seared apricot, drizzle drizzle, and add a few mint leaves.

쿠스쿠스.title: Couscous
쿠스쿠스.intro:
20240623 #breakfastdiary 1096, 26°C/mostly cloudy, 21min/exercise(W)
Place a mint leaf on your palm and smash it hard to burst the veins, and the intense mint aroma bursts out. Usually done when making mojitos, but the mint garnish on breakfast needs this same smack to really bring out its aroma.
#couscous, even better chilled in the fridge
In a pot, add 200g couscous, 1 of olive oil, salt, pour in 200g boiling water, and let sit for about 20 minutes.
Melt butter in a pan, add potato, bell pepper, onion, eggplant, and tomato cut into 1cm pieces, and sauté with salt and pepper. (Cook it slightly on the salty side.)
In a bowl, combine the couscous and the sautéed vegetables, mix thoroughly. Plate it, top with more sautéed vegetables and a few mint leaves.

타이망고샐러드-망고.title: Thai Mango Salad, Mango
타이망고샐러드-망고.intro:
20240622 #breakfastdiary 1095, 22°C/rain, 27min/exercise(S)
#thaimangosalad made with leftover mango from making mango sticky rice a couple days ago
Mix 2 of lime juice, 1 of fish sauce, 1 of sweet chili sauce, and 1 of coconut sugar thoroughly to prep the dressing.
Slice red onion and soak in water.
Cut mango, cucumber, and bell pepper into long strips and put in a bowl. Add the soaked red onion and a bit of chopped parsley too.
Pour the dressing over and mix thoroughly.
Plate it and top with fried shallot and a bit of mint.

문어까르파초-문어.title: Octopus Carpaccio, Octopus

#octopuscarpaccio with marinated tomato on the side (would love to sit in the shade with this and a glass of Riesling.)

Mix finely chopped cherry tomato (1cm pieces), chopped parsley, 3 of olive oil, 1 of wine vinegar, 1/4 of whole grain mustard, and 1 of lemon juice thoroughly.
Pour the dressing over the octopus and finish with pepper~

감자샐러드-감자-4.title: Potato Salad, Potato
감자샐러드-감자-4.intro:
how.about.breakfast
20240619 #breakfastdiary 1092, 23°C/partly cloudy, 21min/exercise(S)
The salty prosciutto and crunchy red onion are the standout stars. #potatosalad with prosciutto and red onion
Peel 3 potatoes, steam for 20 minutes. The potatoes aren't very big. Let cool a bit, dice, and put in a bowl.

Pour in vinaigrette and mix thoroughly. Add a few pieces of prosciutto and mix a bit more. Pepper right before eating~

망고찰밥-망고.title: Mango Sticky Rice, Mango
망고찰밥-망고.intro:
20240618 #breakfastdiary 1091, 21°C/sunny, 27min/exercise(S)
Mango sticky rice, or Khao Neeo Mamuang — #mangostickyrice is a Thai dessert. To Korean eyes the combination of rice and fruit looks pretty bizarre, but eaten with a dessert mindset, it's sweet yet filling, leaving you feeling rich in body and mind. On the other hand, it makes me think that the rice cakes we eat here, in Thailand, evolved in this direction by meeting tropical fruit.
Soak 100g glutinous rice in water before bed. In the morning, steam for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, pour a pack/can of coconut milk into a pot and simmer over low heat with salt. (When eating as dessert I'd add about 3 of sugar, but skipping it since this is breakfast — still sweet even without it.)
In a bowl, add the glutinous rice, pour in 1/2 of the simmered coconut milk, mix thoroughly, and let sit for a bit.
Add a cornstarch slurry (1 cornstarch, 2 water) to the remaining coconut milk and simmer gently.
Plate it using a mousse ring, add the glutinous rice, then top with mango. Pour the coconut milk over.

페타치즈수박샐러드-수박.title: Feta Cheese Watermelon Salad, Watermelon
페타치즈수박샐러드-수박.intro:
20240617 #breakfastdiary 1090, 19°C/partly cloudy, 27min/exercise(S)

Longblack @longblack.co

Plate it, top with feta cheese and mint, olive oil, and pepper~

살구크로스티니-살구.title: Apricot Crostini Apricot
살구크로스티니-살구.intro:
20240616 #breakfastdiary 1089, 23°C/sunny, 
Apricot season has arrived. I tried one and it's still sour. No wait — apricots are just naturally a little tart. 
Once caramelized, that sour-sweet combo tastes like a master of push-and-pull romance. Ricotta cheese with apricot kernels (feat. toasted almonds) and mint also pairs well. 
Melt butter, xylose sugar, and a bit of vanilla extract in a pan and stir slowly over low heat. Add the apricots, washed clean and halved, and simmer for about 5-10 minutes. 
Spread ricotta cheese on a crisply toasted baguette, top with the caramelized apricots, almonds, and mint, and finish with honey~

초당옥수수푸실리-옥수수.title: Chodang Sweet Corn Fusilli Corn
초당옥수수푸실리-옥수수.intro:
20240615 #breakfastdiary 1088, 21°C/cloudy, 38 min/workout(S) 
In English it's called super sweet corn — no cream added, so it's a clean, in-season sweetness #chodangsweetcornfusilli
Prepare 2 ears of chodang sweet corn. Use 1 for the sauce and the other as a topping. 
Peel the corn and knock off the kernels. They don't come off cleanly, so I decide to cut them off with a knife instead. 
Boil the corn cobs in 500ml of water. 
In a pan, sauté butter and half the corn kernels, then pour in 1 cup of the corn cob stock and simmer a bit longer. Let it cool slightly, then blend finely to make the corn sauce. 
Salt the boiling water and cook the rigatoni. 
In a pan, sauté butter and the remaining corn, then add the corn sauce and rigatoni. Season with salt. Mantecare slowly~ 
Plate it and add parmesan cheese — I forgot the pepper, but it would probably be nice too. 
Referenced a recipe from the YouTube channel Yorijori Modori.

가지롤라티니-가지.title: Eggplant Rollatini Eggplant
가지롤라티니-가지.intro:
20240614 #breakfastdiary 1087, 22°C/sunny
The oven. This little wonder sometimes gives you the same thrill as a last-place runner catching up to the leader on the final lap. 
Wash 2 eggplants clean and slice them lengthwise. 
Heat olive oil in a pan, salt and pepper, and grill the eggplant on both sides until golden. Move to a plate and let cool slightly. 
Mix 3 [scoops] of ricotta cheese with 1 grated garlic clove and 1 [part] lemon juice. 
Pour a generous layer of tomato sauce into a cast iron pot, top the eggplant slices with ricotta, roll them up, and lay them on the sauce. Sprinkle shredded cheese generously and bake at 220°C for 20 minutes. 
Finish with parmesan cheese, pile it onto a baguette, and take a big bite~😃
Referenced a recipe from @foodsforweightloss. 
-
Usually in the morning I wake up, 1) do some light exercise, 2) wash up, and 3) start prepping breakfast. 
By the time I start prepping breakfast — when I can visibly feel time passing — the minutes flow in big chunks toward my commute time. 
On oven days, though, I prep breakfast before washing up, put it in the oven, and get ready for work while the oven timer counts down. On those days, anxiety creeps in that I might be running later than usual, but the moment right after washing up, being greeted by a beautifully finished breakfast — there's a certain thrill of a come-from-behind victory to it.

트러플파스타-트러플.title: Truffle Pasta Truffle
트러플파스타-트러플.intro:
20240613 #breakfastdiary 1086, 20°C/mostly sunny, 27 min/workout(S) 
There's more button mushroom in here than actual truffle, but the truffle aroma is more than enough to overpower everything else. If there's a flaw, it's that the aroma is artificial, 🤔(hmm) 
Salt the boiling water and cook the pasta. 
Melt a knob of butter in a pan, add 3 chopped button mushrooms with a pinch of salt, and once the mushrooms turn golden, add 3 [parts] truffle sauce (taste and salt as needed) and mix well. 
Add the pasta and 1/2 cup of pasta water, stir well, and once the pasta water reduces, turn off the heat and mantecare~
Plate it and top with parmesan cheese and parsley.

트러플.title: Truffle
트러플.intro:
20240612 #breakfastdiary 1085, 20°C/mostly sunny
So my score is... 'reveal in 60 seconds' kind of taste, you could say? 😃
I once bought the same brand's beer and beer-flavored drink (a.k.a. non-alcoholic beer) to taste-test side by side. The beer-flavored drink had a malty beer flavor about ten times stronger, so much so that I felt like I could easily tell them apart even blind. It seems the more lacking and thin something is, the louder it tends to shout. 
I heard there's a menu item that serves truffle alongside a fried egg, and I got curious about the taste and aroma, but dried truffle just doesn't seem to cut it. Or maybe my sense of smell has just been spoiled by that potato chip that introduced me to the world of truffle with a mere 0.0000007% truffle content, because the taste and aroma here feel lukewarm. Sniff sniff sniff🐽🐽🐽
Fried egg with dried truffle, a pinch of salt, and truffle oil~
-
Anyway, even though that potato chip only contains a whopping 0.0000007% truffle, its strong truffle aroma numbed my sense of smell — and now, facing real dried truffle, I don't get that familiar truffle scent at all. Is this my nose's fault?

뢰스티-감자-2.title: Rösti Potato
뢰스티-감자-2.intro:
20240611 #breakfastdiary 1084, 21°C/partly cloudy, 28 min/workout(W) 
While Korean-style potato pancakes (made by grating potatoes and mixing in flour, egg, etc.) are crisp outside and moist inside, rösti is made from shredded potato and stays crispy and crunchy all the way through. 
A Western-style potato pancake with a lemon-scented Greek yogurt on the side #rosti
Grate 3 potatoes and let them sit with a pinch of salt for about 10 minutes. Squeeze firmly to remove plenty of moisture, then mix in 1 [part] starch evenly. 
Heat olive oil in a pan and lay down the potato. Check that it's golden brown, then flip. 
Plate it and top with Greek yogurt mixed with lemon juice and wholegrain mustard, plus a bit of chopped scallion. 
I think sauerkraut would go nicely with this too.

호밀크래커샌드-연어샌드.title: Rye Cracker Sandwich Salmon Sandwich
호밀크래커샌드-연어샌드.intro:
20240610 #breakfastdiary 1083, 20°C/sunny, 27 min/workout(F) 
The word 'sandwich' supposedly comes from 18th-century England, when the Earl of Sandwich, John Montagu, was seen eating meat tucked into bread, and people around him started saying 'I'll have the same as Sandwich (the Earl)' — believe it or not~🥪
#ryecrackersandwich with salmon tartare
In a bowl, mix chopped salmon, olive oil, lemon juice, a pinch of salt, a dash of pepper, chopped onion, and scallion to make the salmon tartare. 
Top a rye cracker with the salmon tartare and cover with another rye cracker. Stand the cracker up and add a dollop of Greek yogurt. Finish with chopped scallion.

오이샐러드-낫토.title: Cucumber Salad Natto
오이샐러드-낫토.intro:
20240609 #breakfastdiary 1082, 21°C/mostly cloudy, 21 min/workout(T) 
Namemiso (なめみそ) is a seasoned miso made by mixing in various ingredients so it can be eaten as a side dish on its own. Among its varieties, kinzanji miso (きんざんじみそ) — which looks like barley but is actually made with wheat — has a fun, chunky texture you can bite into, and it's savory and salty, making it perfect for dipping cucumber or celery (great as a drinking snack too). 
Thinking of kinzanji miso, I mixed natto + barley rice + tsuyu + wasabi. It came out tasting quite a bit like kinzanji-miso-flavored natto, the way imitation crab tastes like crab. 
#cucumbersalad topped with kinzanji-miso-flavored natto 
This has fiber, protein, and a moderate amount of carbs — a complete food, you could say? 
Mix 1 pack of natto with an equal amount of barley rice, 1 [part] tsuyu, and 1/4 [part] wasabi until well combined.
Slice half a cucumber and arrange neatly on a plate, then top with the kinzanji-miso-flavored natto. Eat the cucumber topped with the natto.

바게뜨-토스트.title: Baguette Toast
바게뜨-토스트.intro:
20240608 #breakfastdiary 1081, 18°C/drizzle, 29 min/workout(W) 
The plants I pass on my morning workout or walk have grown so fast I barely recognize them. It's summer. 
Today's breakfast is a crisply toasted baguette piled with ricotta cheese and roasted tomatoes #baguette 
In an oven-safe pot, add cherry tomatoes and garlic, drizzle with olive oil, add a pinch of salt and pepper, and bake at 200°C for 30 minutes. The tomatoes were fully cooked but the garlic wasn't, so a bit longer 
Brush the baguette with olive oil and toast for 5 minutes. 
Mash the garlic and spread it on the baguette, top with ricotta cheese and cherry tomatoes, sprinkle chopped parsley, finish with pepper~
The crispy texture of the baguette is the highlight. 
Referenced a recipe from @yumi_enjoy_life.

오이샐러드-오이-2.title: Cucumber Salad Cucumber
오이샐러드-오이-2.intro:
20240607 #breakfastdiary 1080, 19°C/mostly cloudy, 21 min/workout(Y)
#cucumbersalad made from cucumber 'noodles' (?) peeled in a long spiral 
Mix soy sauce 1, chili oil 1, vinegar 1, 2 cloves minced garlic, and a pinch of salt to make the dressing. 
Spiralize 2 cucumbers into long strands. (This turned out to require more forearm strength than expected, so I stopped after 1.5 cucumbers,) add a handful of chopped parsley, a bit of chopped scallion, and 1-2 sliced cherry tomatoes, then pour the dressing over and mix well. 
Referenced a recipe from @foodieholly.

대구찜-대구.title: Steamed Cod Cod
대구찜-대구.intro:
20240606 #breakfastdiary 1079, 20°C/mostly cloudy, 29 min/workout(W)
Chinese-style #steamedcod, generously scented with ginger 
Top the cod with julienned ginger and steam for about 15 minutes. 
Put the steamed cod over rice, top with long-cut scallion and parsley, then heat 1/2 cup of oil in a pan until very hot and pour it over the cod. (Today the amount of oil was absolutely not enough.) 
Mix dark soy sauce and oyster sauce 1:1 and pour over. Top with chopped scallion.

페스토피자-피자.title: Pesto Pizza Pizza
페스토피자-피자.intro:
20240605 #breakfastdiary 1078, 19°C/mostly sunny
On a busy morning, you'd think a slow oven-based breakfast wouldn't be possible, but somehow, in a flurry, once you just get it into the oven, you can calmly get ready for work for the length of the timer — surprisingly convenient. 
#pestopizza made with croissant dough, its layers rippling and alive 
I took the croissant dough out before going to bed, and it naturally thawed and did its first proof overnight. 
Line an oven tray with foil, brush on a little olive oil, then lay the dough on top and shape it. 
Spread basil pesto, then layer on shredded pizza cheese, tomato, and mozzarella in that order, and bake at 180°C for 20 minutes. 
Plate it, add a bit more pesto, and finish with basil.

알만추-구운가지샐러드-가지.title: Almanchu Grilled Eggplant Salad Eggplant
알만추-구운가지샐러드-가지.intro:
20240604 #breakfastdiary 1077, 19°C/sunny, 29 min/workout(W) 
There's a newly trending way of seeking dates called #Almanchu these days. It stands for 'algorithm-based match-seeking,' where you meet someone, then check what their social media algorithm (like Instagram) has recommended for them before deciding whether to pursue things further. 
Alright, let's take a quick look at today's recommended feed or search suggestions. Any recommended content that would be an instant turn-off? Oh, you say you're not seeking any dates? 🤔
(My-breakfast-diary) algorithm's breakfast today is entirely carried by the miso-tahini dressing in this #grilledeggplantsalad 
Wash 2 eggplants clean, cut into 10cm pieces, add olive oil, a pinch of salt, a dash of pepper, herbs, and paprika powder, and roast in a 210°C oven for 20 minutes. (Ovens vary, so treat the time as a rough guide.) Meanwhile, 
Heat olive oil in a pan and grill the red onion. 
Plate the eggplant, then drizzle with a dressing made from miso and tahini mixed in a 1:2 ratio with 1/2 cup of water added, plus a splash of balsamic. 
Top with chopped parsley and the grilled red onion, and finish with sesame seeds~
Referenced a recipe from @somethingnutritious. 
-
On a busy morning, you'd think an oven-based breakfast wouldn't be possible, but somehow, once you just get it into the oven, you can calmly get ready for work for the length of the timer — surprisingly convenient.

유기농뻥튀기-뻥튀기.title: Organic Rice Puff Rice Puff
유기농뻥튀기-뻥튀기.intro:
20240603 #breakfastdiary 1076, 19°C/sunny, 21 min/workout(Y) 
Rice puffs made from organic grains with no added salt can be a healthy ingredient — as long as you eat them in moderation. 
To eat it in a hearty way, and anticipating it would be bland, I added a pinch of salt and pepper here and there, but it's still bland. I'd recommend spreading a little soy mayo on the rice puff. 
#organicricepuff topped with scrambled egg and roasted tomato
Melt a knob of butter in a pan, add 2 eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper, and mix well to make scrambled eggs. 
Set aside, and in the same pan, slice a tomato and grill it on both sides with a pinch of salt, a dash of pepper, and herbs. 
Top the organic unsalted rice puff with the scrambled egg and roasted tomato. Add a little chopped basil too.

오이탕탕카펠리니-오이탕탕이-타타키큐리.title: Smashed Cucumber Capellini Smashed Cucumber (Tataki Kyuri)
오이탕탕카펠리니-오이탕탕이-타타키큐리.intro:
20240602 #breakfastdiary 1075, 20°C/sunny, 29 min/workout(W) 
Capellini's nickname is Angel's Hair. If you want to see why with your own eyes, try boiling it in a pan instead of a pot. It's breathtakingly beautiful. 
Boil the capellini in boiling water. Meanwhile, 
Mix soy sauce 2, honey 1/2, vinegar 1, minced garlic 1/2, sesame oil 1, and sesame seeds to make the dressing. 
Beat a Chwicheong cucumber thoroughly and tear it into bite-sized pieces by hand. 
Put the cucumber in a bowl, pour the dressing over, and mix well. Don't pour all the dressing in — save a little. 
Plate the capellini and top with the smashed cucumber. It doesn't sit as prettily as I'd imagined. Pour the reserved dressing over and top with bonito flakes. 
Referenced @soonsoon.wife.

리가토니페스토파스타-리카토니.title: Rigatoni Pesto Pasta Rigatoni
리가토니페스토파스타-리카토니.intro:
20240601 #breakfastdiary 1074, 19°C/partly cloudy
June
by Lee Sang-guk
The June I know hides between May and July, and most people don't notice it, letting it pass by. In June, purple kudzu flowers bloom no bigger than a fingernail, and sweetfish build their homes in the river. The sky is so full of open air that it climbs higher still, and the clouds are whiter than gardenia blossoms. The sound of water, bored all day long, calls out its own name as it comes down the mountain, and since the world is hollow and quiet like a bird's nest, I want to live like an empty house again•••
I start June 2024 quietly. 
Salt the boiling water and cook 2 cups of rigatoni. 
In a heated pan, add 2 heaping [spoons] of pesto and the rigatoni, pour in 1/2 cup of pasta water, and simmer. Turn off the heat and mantecare~
Plate it and sprinkle with basil and grana padano cheese~

뇨끼-3.title: Gnocchi
뇨끼-3.intro:
20240531 #breakfastdiary 1073, 18°C/sunny
I'm not angry, I'm just drained. 
I'm not upset, I'm just drained. 
I'm not sick anywhere, I'm just drained. 
I haven't fallen out of like with you, I'm just drained. 
I'm just drained because I've been outside. 
Source unclear, but it mostly rings true. Let's refill that drained energy with today's #gnocchi, flavored with Greek yogurt mixed with tahini dressing and pesto, 
Boil 2 cups of store-bought gnocchi in salted boiling water. Once they float up, scoop them out, then boil 1/2 cup of peas. 
Heat olive oil in a pan, add the boiled gnocchi and peas, 2 small [spoons] of pesto, and 1/2 cup of pasta water, and cook a little longer. Turn off the heat and mantecare, 
Mix 2 heaping [spoons] of Greek yogurt with 2 small [spoons] of tahini dressing well. 
Spread the Greek yogurt on a plate and top with the prepared gnocchi. 
Adding parmesan cheese would probably be nice too.

참치샐러드까나페-참치.title: Tuna Salad Canapé Tuna
참치샐러드까나페-참치.intro:
20240530 #breakfastdiary 1072, 18°C/cloudy
Using Greek yogurt instead of mayo, and rye crackers said to be 73% rye instead of regular crackers, this veggie-packed #tunasaladcanape comes with a lot less guilt 
Soak the red onion in water briefly before using. In a bowl, mix drained tuna (a small can is enough), chopped celery, red onion, 1 small [spoon] of Dijon mustard, 1 heaping [spoon] of Greek yogurt, a pinch of salt, and a dash of pepper. 
Top a rye cracker with chopped avocado and cucumber, then pile on the veggie-packed tuna salad. Finish with chopped scallion and pepper

두부낫토샐러드-두부.title: Tofu Natto Salad Tofu
두부낫토샐러드-두부.intro:
20240529 #breakfastdiary 1071, 14°C/sunny
It doesn't match perfectly, but there's an oyakodon vibe to this. Just like chicken (the parent) and egg (the child) both go into that dish, here tofu and natto have each given their all to build the flavor. 
Pat dry a block of tofu, add a chunk of ricotta cheese, and mix gently (careful not to mash it too much). 
Plate it, top with natto, egg yolk, and scallion, and finish with 3 [parts] tsuyu and perilla oil~
Referenced a recipe from @yoriharu.cook. 
As in the original recipe, you're supposed to use coarse hand-made tofu rather than regular tofu. I tried adding ricotta cheese to boost the density, but it just wiped out the clean, light flavor instead. 
Having tasted it, I think using sesame oil instead of perilla oil would be better (maybe because of the egg yolk).

아보카도토마토샐러드-아보카도.title: Avocado Tomato Salad Avocado
아보카도토마토샐러드-아보카도.intro:
20240528 #breakfastdiary 1070, 16°C/sunny, 28 min/workout(W) 
Almost every Rembrandt portrait uses strong lighting angled toward the subject from the viewer's front-left at about 45 degrees, giving the face a sense of depth. 
Taking a breakfast photo every morning, I often feel a little wistful. Almost always, gorgeous lighting is a luxury I can't afford — I just wish for a bit more natural light. 
Today it's the avocado-tomato combo, so it has a slight guacamole vibe #avocadotomatosalad
Thaw frozen avocado at room temperature, add a pinch of salt, and mash with a fork. It's nice to leave some chunks. 
Cut off the tomato's stem, score a cross on top, blanch in boiling water, then transfer to cold water and peel. Chop finely, then press firmly to remove moisture. 
Shred store-bought chicken breast and pan-fry until golden. Since something crispy is needed, a little char is fine too (just a little). 
Plate the avocado, tomato, and chicken breast, and top with vinaigrette dressing.

토마토모짜렐라샐러드-카프레제.title: Tomato Mozzarella Salad Caprese
토마토모짜렐라샐러드-카프레제.intro:
20240527 #breakfastdiary 1069, 15°C/mostly sunny, 21 min/workout(Y) 
Watch the magic of how spreading it flat makes it home cooking, while stacking it up somehow turns it into fine dining. Italian Capri-style #tomatomozzarellasalad
Slice the prettiest tomato in the world, and prep mozzarella cheese and basil. 
Mix 1/2 [part] basil pesto with 3 [parts] olive oil to adjust the consistency. 
Stack the tomato, mozzarella, and basil, and top with basil pesto. Add fried shallots. (I picked fried shallots thinking something crispy would be nice, but I don't recommend it — chopped nuts would be better.)

대구찜-대구-2.title: Steamed Cod Cod
대구찜-대구-2.intro:
20240526 #breakfastdiary 1068, 19°C/cloudy, 29 min/workout(W) 
Since it's the weekend, I took my time prepping breakfast. Last week I bought peas still in their pods, and since podding them felt like a chore, I finally shelled them — unlike frozen peas, they came out all different sizes. Nice. 
Peas tossed in ricotta cheese with #steamedcod
Boil the peas in salted water, let cool slightly, and remove the skins. That gives about 1 cup of peas. 
In a bowl, mix 1 cup of peas, 2T ricotta cheese, a pinch of salt, olive oil, and lemon juice well. Pour in 1/2 cup of milk too. 
Thaw the cod, season with olive oil, a pinch of salt, and a dash of pepper, and steam after about 10 minutes. (Today I was short on time, so I steamed it while still partly frozen, with salt and pepper, for about 10 minutes.) 
Plate the peas and lay the cod on top. Finish with vinaigrette dressing~

토마토오르조-오르조.title: Tomato Orzo Orzo
토마토오르조-오르조.intro:
20240525 #breakfastdiary 1067, 19°C/cloudy
I don't know much about the world of meat, but depending on how it's cut this way or that, the flavor comes alive, and new names get attached to the cuts, like skirt, chuck flap, or white meat. 
It's the same in the world of pasta — big, small, long, short, every spaghetti shape has its own distinct charm. Orzo, shaped like a grain, is a pasta with a pretty fun texture. 
Salt the boiling water and cook 1 cup of orzo. 
Heat olive oil in a pan, pour in tomato sauce, add the orzo, and simmer gently. 
Plate the orzo, top with olives, and finish with parmesan cheese and pepper.

미소파스타-파스타.title: Miso Pasta Pasta
미소파스타-파스타.intro:
20240524 #breakfastdiary 1066, 16°C/mostly cloudy, 21 min/workout(Y) 
Something I newly realized this time is that few ingredients are as perfect for quick cooking as miso. Most miso-based dishes we know, like miso ramen or miso soup, are made with just the ingredients you can see on the surface. Today's breakfast, #misopasta, is the same. I tried improvising with garlic and red pepper, but it seems like miso alone could achieve a similar flavor. 
In a pan, add 2 [parts] butter, sliced garlic, and 1/2 [part] miso, and mix. It doesn't blend well at first, but adding 1/2 cup of pasta water loosens it up nicely. Grate in a generous mound of parmesan cheese. 
Add the cooked pasta and mantecare. 
Plate it and top with red pepper flakes. Natto or an egg yolk on top would be nice too. 
Referenced a recipe from @brekkyattiffanys.

고추장파스타-파스타.title: Gochujang Pasta Pasta
고추장파스타-파스타.intro:
20240523 #breakfastdiary 1065, 17°C/sunny
There's fun in slightly twisting recipes you've picked up. Like today's breakfast — using mint instead of basil and discovering the flavor combo of gochujang + mint~ 
Honestly, Archimedes-level 'eureka' discoveries like this happen all the time during breakfast hour. 
#gochujangpasta with mint
In a pan, sauté 2 [parts] butter with sliced garlic. (A mandoline makes slicing garlic easier, though of course it burns fast so keep an eye on it.) Mix in 1 [part] milk, 1 [part] gochujang, and 1 [part] each of honey and vinegar to make the sauce. 
Add the salted, boiled pasta to the sauce, then add 1 [part] butter, a good splash of pasta water, and a little milk, and mix a bit more. 
No basil today, so I substitute mint. Finish with pepper. 
Referenced a recipe from Italy's Fabri @fabrilicious — swapping milk for cream🥛, mint for basil~

베트남식피자-반짱느엉.title: Vietnamese-Style Pizza Banh Trang Nuong
베트남식피자-반짱느엉.intro:
20240522 #breakfastdiary 1064, 15°C/cloudy
Basic version starts at 3,000 won, with the price going up depending on the type and number of toppings — it feels a lot like Korean street toast #vietnamesestylepizza #banhtrangnuong
Put rice paper in a pan, crack in 1 egg, add a pinch of salt and a little chopped scallion, fold in half, and grill on both sides. 
Depending on preference, you can also add mushrooms, shrimp, fried shallots, and so on. 
Overcome by hunger, I lost my composure and ate it before shooting any photos, so the photo shows the basic version — the reel will feature the (no less than) king oyster mushroom topping add-on~

전두부-물고기.title: Fried Tofu Fish
전두부-물고기.intro:
20240521 #breakfastdiary 1063, 17°C/partly cloudy, 21 min/workout(Y)
Cut a block of fried tofu into three, and score it with cuts to look like a fish. 
A touch of soy sauce and sesame oil, 
They say the head is the tastiest part of a fish, so I eat it starting from the head. 
Referenced a recipe from @shinomoco_2525.

계란찜유감-당근브로콜리계란찜-계란찜.title: Steamed Egg Regrets Carrot Broccoli Steamed Egg Steamed Egg
계란찜유감-당근브로콜리계란찜-계란찜.intro:
20240520 #breakfastdiary 1062, 16°C/cloudy, 21 min/workout(Y)
Steamed egg turned out to take a lot more time than expected for a breakfast. I couldn't wait those extra few minutes, so I ended up with an undercooked steamed egg. #steamedeggregrets
Salt the boiling water and cook the julienned carrot and broccoli. For a soft, moist texture, boil them thoroughly — until basically all the nutrients are destroyed. 
Mix 3 eggs with a pinch of salt and 1t starch, blend well, and strain through a sieve. (The eggs weren't enough, so I added 1/2 cup of milk.) 
Oil a container, pour in the egg mixture, then layer in the carrot and broccoli. Cover with plastic wrap, poke a vent hole, and steam thoroughly for 20 minutes or more. Cooking equipment varies by household, so treat this time as just a reference.

애플크로와상-크로와상.title: Apple Croissant Croissant
애플크로와상-크로와상.intro:
20240519 #breakfastdiary 1061, 16°C/sunny, 20 min/workout(Y)
#applecroissant topped with pistachio
Lay out 3 sheets of square dough, cut into rectangles, and spread apple jam on top. Roll up into 2 croissants. For the second version, use a chunk of mozzarella cheese instead of apple jam. Roll up into another 2 croissants. 
Brush the croissants with egg wash, top with chopped pistachio, and bake at 200°C for 15 minutes.

인살라타카프레제.title: Insalata Caprese
인살라타카프레제.intro:
20240518 #breakfastdiary 1060, 19°C/mostly sunny
Tomato mozzarella salad is also called caprese, which comes from insalata caprese (insalata - salad, caprese - Capri-style), meaning a salad in the style of Italy's Capri region. 
Since nothing goes into it besides tomato, mozzarella, basil, and olive oil, this is a breakfast where the quality of the raw ingredients really matters. I've never had it in Italy myself, but apparently Korean tomatoes tend to be blander than Italian ones, so it's said to be good to season with salt or similar. Today I seasoned it with balsamic. 
Plate the tomato and mozzarella cheese, season with olive oil and balsamic. Finish with basil~

News that GPT-4o has been released. (Pronounced 'GPT four oh' — the 'Omni' meaning 'everything' in Latin.) I gave it a photo of today's breakfast and asked it to explain the recipe. 
-
A bruschetta recipe using blood orange is simple yet delicious. Here are the ingredients and steps to make it.
Ingredients
4 slices of baguette or country bread
1 cup ricotta cheese (or 1 cup feta cheese)
2 blood oranges
A handful of fresh mint leaves (or basil leaves)
2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
Salt and pepper
Preparation
1. Prepare the bread:
Slice the baguette or country bread about 1cm thick.
Toast the sliced bread in an oven or toaster until crisp. (Preheat the oven to 180°C and bake for about 5-7 minutes.)
2. Prepare the blood orange:
Peel the blood orange and slice thinly. Remove any seeds.
3. Prepare the cheese:
If using ricotta cheese, stir gently until smooth.
If using feta cheese, crumble finely.
4. Assemble the bruschetta:
Spread ricotta cheese evenly over the toasted bread.
Layer the sliced blood orange on top of the cheese.
Add fresh mint leaves.
Drizzle lightly with extra virgin olive oil.
Season with salt and pepper.
Finish
Plate the finished bruschetta and serve.
Enjoy the harmonious flavor of the fresh blood orange's tang, the creamy cheese, and the crispy bread.
This recipe is a simple, healthy, and delicious dish you can make with fresh ingredients. The combination of varied flavors also makes it great for special occasions or simple party food.
-

20240414 #breakfastdiary 1033, 19°C/sunny, 27 min/workout(T) 
Someone once said that a sense of ease comes from your bank balance, and kindness comes from sugar and carbs. Lately I feel like I've been treating the people around me kindly. That's probably not great news for my body. 
Mix 3 [parts] olive oil, 1/4 cumin, 1/4 salt, 1/4 chili powder, and 1 [part] lime juice well. Pat dry the thawed cod, coat evenly with the dressing, and let it sit for 15 minutes. 
Mix 3 [parts] yogurt with 1 [part] lime juice and 1/2 [part] garlic powder well. 
In a bowl, mix shallot, 1 [part] minced garlic, tomato, and lettuce with 1 [part] lime juice well. 
Heat olive oil in a pan and grill the marinated cod. 
(ow, hot,) On a toasted tortilla, layer the cod, yogurt, the prepared filling, avocado, more yogurt, and cilantro. 
Adding cumin brings it a bit closer to an authentic South American flavor — #fishtaco

감자오븐구이-감자.title: Oven-Roasted Potato Potato
감자오븐구이-감자.intro:
20240413 #breakfastdiary 1032, 18°C/sunny, 38 min/workout(W) 
1 hour of cooking time, and 2 hours total including prep and eating — a real long-take breakfast. While the potato baked in the oven, I made the cilantro pesto I'd been putting off all week and even got the dishes done — so satisfying. 
I had some Australian potatoes left from last time, so I made #ovenroastedpotato. It reaffirms my thinking that starchy, floury potatoes are ideal for this kind of dish. 
Score the potato with cuts, brush with olive oil, and bake at 180°C for 60 minutes. 
Melt 2 [parts] butter in a pot, mince 1 clove of garlic, and mix well to prep. 
Raise the oven to 210°C and brush on the butter 3 times, once every 10 minutes. 
Top with Maldon salt and chopped cilantro. 
Recipe from @weightloss.mediterraneandiet.

버섯대파오르조-오르조.title: Mushroom Scallion Orzo Orzo
버섯대파오르조-오르조.intro:
20240412 #breakfastdiary 1031, 13°C/partly cloudy, 26 min/workout(T) 
The original recipe uses chicken instead of mushroom. For some reason I didn't feel like eating chicken poached in water for breakfast, so I swapped it for mushroom — and so today's breakfast is one whose name gives everything away, utterly honest, #mushroomscallionorzo
Let 1/2 cup of cream cheese sit at room temperature, then mix in 2 [parts] garlic powder evenly. 
Boil 500ml of water in a pot. Once boiling, add 1 cup each of orzo, peas, scallion, and king trumpet mushroom, and simmer about 10 more minutes. Once the water reduces, turn off the heat, add the prepared garlic cream cheese, and mix well. Season with salt to taste. Makes about 2 servings. 
Referenced a recipe from @_myfirstmeals.

베이글.intro:
20240411 #breakfastdiary 1030, 11°C/cloudy (a light drizzle on my commute right now), 29 min/workout(W) 
If the director is 60 or older, deduct 10 points. Because it's hard for people around a director to voice a differing opinion.

Split an @la_farina140 La Farina bagel in half and toast at 180°F for 5 minutes. 
Top the toasted bagel with diced avocado (meant to sprinkle a little lime juice but forgot), everything bagel seasoning, mint, olive oil, and finally crush pink peppercorns by hand on top. 
☝️I expected the mint to play a role like the little star candies in hardtack biscuits, but its role turned out smaller than expected in the flavor. The bagel itself is nice and chewy~🥯

수플레또띠아-또띠아.title: Soufflé Tortilla
수플레또띠아-또띠아.intro:
20240410 #breakfastdiary 1029, 11°C/cloudy, 35min/workout(W)
It was definitely a fluffy, bouncy soufflé omelette on the pan, but once it hit the plate it settled into more of a rolled egg — #souffletortilla
The foam always deflates so easily.
Separate the whites from 2 eggs and whip them into a meringue.
Season the yolks with a pinch of salt, fold them into the meringue along with chopped cilantro and mozzarella cheese, being careful not to deflate the foam.
Heat a pan with olive oil, pour in the batter, and once the bottom is cooked through, fold it in half and plate it. Eat it topped with sriracha dressing and cilantro.

명란파스타-파스타.title: Mentaiko Pasta
명란파스타-파스타.intro:
20240409 #breakfastdiary 1028, 9°C/sunny
A one-pan #mentaikopasta that taught me a lesson: minced garlic burns the instant you look away from the pan.
Heat olive oil in a pan (after burning the first batch by looking away for a second), then crisp up a second round of minced garlic with 2 chili peppers.
Pour in 550ml of water, and once it boils, add the pasta and keep boiling until the noodles are cooked through.
Add 1 tbsp fish sauce and a knob of butter, and simmer a bit longer. Once the pasta water has reduced, turn off the heat, add the mentaiko, and toss to finish. Plate it and top with mentaiko and scallions.
I didn't have chives, so I used scallions instead — their bold aroma pairs really well with the mentaiko.
Recipe referenced from @salimpop_official.

또띠아-2.title: Tortilla Egg Bowl
또띠아-2.intro:
20240408 #breakfastdiary 1027, 11°C/cloudy
Which part is the food and which part is the dish? Food and dish — and me, who ate even the dish — becoming one, a kind of oneness with nature. #tortilla
Line a small bowl with a tortilla, crack in 2 eggs, add tomato, cheese (mozzarella if you have it), and chopped shallot, season with salt and pepper, then bake in the air fryer for 10 minutes.
Set the now-crispy tortilla, which has become a little bowl of its own, onto a plate, and top with avocado, chopped cilantro, and parmesan cheese. Drizzle with sriracha sauce to taste.
Spoon out the filling and eat, then break the tortilla into nacho-like pieces to scoop up every last bit — nothing wasted.

검은콩후무스-후무스.title: Black Bean Hummus
검은콩후무스-후무스.intro:
20240407 #breakfastdiary 1026, 14°C/sunny, 56min/workout(W, Y)
I figured there was no reason hummus couldn't be made with black beans, but the density and texture turned out so different that it just confirmed chickpeas really are the right call for hummus — #blackbeanhummus
The night before, soak 300g black beans in water. Boil the 300g black beans in salted water. Rinse in cold water and let cool slightly.
Blend the cooked beans with 1 tbsp tahini, 1 tbsp lime juice, 1 clove garlic, 1/4 tsp cumin, 2 tbsp olive oil, and 1/2 tsp salt. Set some of the bean cooking water aside and pour it in gradually to adjust the consistency (I ended up using about 1 cup).
Add mint leaves and cilantro and blend to finish. Plate it and top with olive oil and chopped pistachios. It's great on its own, but also delicious dipped with toasted sourdough.

가지샐러드-가지-2.title: Eggplant Salad
가지샐러드-가지-2.intro:
20240406 #breakfastdiary 1025, 13°C/cloudy
"I believe the future of beauty lies in beauty for everyone — in inclusion. And technology is what makes that possible."
In 2023, L'Oréal launched a tremor-stabilizing device for lipstick and mascara. In 2024, it even showed up in a CES keynote. Wait, a cosmetics company doing tech?
It seems like every industry is converging toward tech. But the philosophy behind it makes all the difference. L'Oréal had its own — "Inclusive Tech," technology built around inclusion.
With a heart open to including even the eggplant, here's #eggplantsalad with Greek yogurt.
Mix 3 tbsp Greek yogurt, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp lemon juice, and a pinch of salt until well combined.
Cut the eggplant into finger-sized pieces, sprinkle with salt, and let sit for a bit.
Chop cilantro, garlic, and walnuts, then mix with 2 tbsp olive oil and a pinch of salt to make the dressing.
Heat olive oil in a pan, lightly sauté the eggplant, then add the dressing and toss together.
Spread the prepared Greek yogurt on a plate and top with the eggplant.

애호박파스타-애호박-애호박파스다.title: Zucchini Pasta
애호박파스타-애호박-애호박파스다.intro:
20240405 #breakfastdiary 1024, 11°C/cloudy
A whole zucchini, spiralized into #zucchinipasta
Trim the stem off one zucchini, wash it well, and spiralize it into noodle(?) strands. Sprinkle with salt and let sit for a bit.
Heat olive oil in a pan, sauté garlic, then add shrimp, pepper, and red pepper flakes and cook.
Add the zucchini noodles and 1/4 tsp chicken stock, tossing gently so the noodles don't break. Once they've softened enough, plate it.
One whole zucchini, spiralized into #zucchinipasta

더치베이비.title: Dutch Baby
더치베이비.intro:
20240404 #breakfastdiary 1023, 10°C/cloudy, 21min/workout(Y)
Fu Bao the panda from Everland has left for China. Since she was born here, saying she "returned" doesn't quite fit — even though the rule is that pandas born outside China must go back before age four.
#dutchbaby pancake
Blend 2 eggs, 120g milk, and 60g all-purpose flour into a smooth batter.
Preheat the oven to 240°C with a cast iron pan inside. Once preheated, take the pan out, add a knob of butter, pour in the batter, and bake for about 15 minutes.
Top with blueberries and a dusting of powdered sugar — a few mint leaves on top and the flavor explodes about a million times over.

두부피토마토볶음-흔한채소가흔하지않은술안주가되었습니다-토마토.title: Tofu Skin and Tomato Stir-Fry
두부피토마토볶음-흔한채소가흔하지않은술안주가되었습니다-토마토.intro:
20240403 #breakfastdiary 1022, 12°C/cloudy
According to Wikipedia, fuzhu (Chinese: 腐竹, pinyin: fǔzhú) is dried tofu skin used in Chinese cooking — the thin film that forms on the surface when making tofu is gathered, rolled into long sticks, pressed, and dried.
(Source: Wikipedia)
Fuzhu in Chinese, yuba in Japanese, dubupi in Korean — whatever you call it, here's #tofuskinandtomatostirfry with it.
1. Heat oil in a pan and lightly stir-fry the tofu skin.
2. Mix 1 tbsp starch with 4 tbsp water to make a starch slurry.
3. Score 2 Daejeo tomatoes, blanch in boiling water, peel, and cut into wedges.
4. Slice 1 clove of garlic thinly (a mandoline makes this easy).
Heat a little oil in a pan and stir-fry the garlic, then the tomato, then add the prepared tofu skin along with 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1/4 tsp sesame oil, salt, and pepper.
A recipe from the #commonvegetablesbecomeuncommondrinkingsnacks series.

감자샐러드-감자-5.title: Potato Salad
감자샐러드-감자-5.intro:
20240402 #breakfastdiary 1021, 8°C/mostly cloudy
A couple of days ago I spotted Australian potatoes at the market and grabbed them without hesitation. I couldn't confirm the variety, but the elongated shape suggests they're a starchy type.
Potatoes are classified by starch content into starchy and waxy — starchy potatoes have higher starch content and fall apart easily, making them great for fried dishes like french fries, while waxy potatoes have relatively lower starch and hold their shape, making them better for soups and stews.
So making a salad — neither fried nor a soup — with starchy potatoes... is that some kind of compromise in between?
A generous handful of dill for +10 fragrance, and the slightly crumbly texture only adds to the charm — #potatosalad
Cut the potatoes into bite-sized pieces, salt them, and boil in water. Let cool slightly, then transfer to a bowl and gently mix in chopped dill and vinaigrette dressing.
Plate it, and since pepper is basically mandatory, finish with a bit of pink pepper before eating.

완두콩후무스-흔한채소가흔하지않은술안주가되었습니다-완두콩.title: Green Pea Hummus
완두콩후무스-흔한채소가흔하지않은술안주가되었습니다-완두콩.intro:
20240401 #breakfastdiary 1020, 7°C/mostly sunny
I misjudged the cooking time and ended up having to take a taxi to work, but it was a worthwhile choice. #greenpeahummus
Boil 300g green peas in salted water. Transfer to cold water and let cool slightly.
Blend the cooked peas with 4 tbsp of the pea cooking water, 1 tbsp tahini, 1 tbsp lime juice, 1 clove garlic, 1/4 tsp cumin, 2 tbsp olive oil, and 1/2 tsp salt.
Add mint leaves and cilantro and blend to finish. Plate it and grind in olive oil and pink pepper by hand. I ate it with sourdough for dipping.
☝️(Of course you could easily finish it solo, but,) this makes a good amount to share happily between two.
☝Use the pea cooking water to adjust the consistency.
☝️Tahini is easy to make yourself — just blend 1/2 cup toasted sesame seeds with about 2 tbsp olive oil. In other words, it's sesame dressing.
A recipe from the #commonvegetablesbecomeuncommondrinkingsnacks series.
Q. If you had to choose, green pea hummus or chickpea hummus — which one would you pick?

딸기타르틴-그럴수록요리-딸기.title: Strawberry Tartine
딸기타르틴-그럴수록요리-딸기.intro:
20240331 #breakfastdiary 1019, 7°C/mostly sunny, 27min/workout(🏃‍♂️)
In France, apparently, anything spread or piled onto a thin slice of bread is called a tartine — a Parisian-style #strawberrytartine.
Slice a baguette horizontally and toast it in a pan. Wash the strawberries well, remove the stems, and slice thinly.
Spread butter on the baguette, top with strawberries, and sprinkle with xylose sugar. Add a few mint leaves if you have some at home.
#cookanyway recipe by @necozawaemi.
☝️Microwave the butter for 15 seconds to make it easier to spread.
☝️Regular sugar works fine instead of xylose sugar. Powdered sugar, however, isn't a good substitute.

새우타코-타코.title: Shrimp Tacos
새우타코-타코.intro:
20240330 #breakfastdiary 1018, 6°C/cloudy
One of the prompts that improves ChatGPT's answers is "Let's think step by step." Generative AI modeled itself after human thinking, so the same trick applies to us too.
What should I eat today? Let's think step by step — let's have #shrimptacos ~🌮🍤
Big, chunky shrimp would've been nice, but I didn't have any. So with the small ones I had, I patted them dry, put them in a bowl with olive oil, salt, pepper, paprika, and minced garlic, and mixed well. Heated olive oil in a pan and lightly seared the shrimp.
No sour cream on hand. So I made a quick substitute by mixing 1 tbsp cream cheese, 2 tbsp yogurt, and 4 tbsp fresh cream with about 2 tbsp lemon juice.
Prepped 1 tomato, some shallot (soaked in water to take the sharp edge off), 1/4 head of lettuce, and cilantro.
Toasted a tortilla in a pan, plated it, then topped with lettuce, shallot, tomato, shrimp, the mock sour cream, and cilantro.

달래비빔국수-달래.title: Wild Chive Noodles
달래비빔국수-달래.intro:
20240329 #breakfastdiary 1017, 6°C/cloudy (fine dust: very bad, ultrafine dust: bad)
Before bed, I trimmed the wild chives and left them soaking in water. Root by root, trimming them took way longer than expected. Anyway,
Boil the noodles, and meanwhile mix 1 tbsp each of soy sauce, vinegar, red pepper flakes, gochujang, and sugar with 1/4 tsp each of minced garlic, sesame oil, and sesame seeds to make the dressing. Adding 1 tbsp plum extract brings a nice tangy kick.
Rinse the noodles well in cold water, place in a bowl, pour on the dressing, and top with the wild chives.
☝️As expected, this is spicy for breakfast. But it's delicious.
Recipe referenced from @veggie_rabbit.

참외-파파야멜론-파파야멜론샐러드.title: Papaya Melon Salad
참외-파파야멜론-파파야멜론샐러드.intro:
20240328 #breakfastdiary 1016, 8°C/cloudy (or so they say, but it's raining and I don't have an umbrella), 21min/workout(U)
Looks like a #koreanmelon but it's actually #papayamelon salad
Peel one papaya melon using a som tam grater.
Scoop out the flesh, strain it, and mix with 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp wine vinegar, salt, and pepper to make the dressing.
Slice the papaya melon, arrange it spread out on a plate, and place halved blueberries in the center.
Pour on the dressing, top with mint, and don't leave a drop of the liquid behind~😀
The cross-section of the blueberries is just so pretty.
The som tam grater costs about 1,500 won.
Born between mother Korean melon and father cantaloupe, it takes after its mother's side (basically tastes like Korean melon), paired here with halved blueberries — #papayamelonsalad

잠봉뵈르.title: Jambon-Beurre
잠봉뵈르.intro:
20240327 #breakfastdiary 1015, 5°C/mostly cloudy
Once again, it's the simplest combination of ordinary ingredients that ends up delivering more satisfaction than expected.
In French, jambon means ham, and beurre (pronounced more like "buhr") means butter — #jambonbeurre
Warm a store-bought baguette slightly in the oven. Slice it in half and layer in thick slices of butter and ham.
Made just like the 19th-century French laborers' recipe — nothing but baguette, ham, and butter — #jambonbeurre

엔초비-버터-엔초비파스타.title: Anchovy Butter Pasta
엔초비-버터-엔초비파스타.intro:
20240326 #breakfastdiary 1014, 3°C/drizzle
These are important issues that affect our lives, so let's pay attention:
