뇨끼-토마토-채소뇨끼샐러드.title: Vegetable Gnocchi & Tomato Salad
뇨끼-토마토-채소뇨끼샐러드.intro:
20201108, “When your partner wants to become the baby, that's your cue to be the grown-up who holds them close. When you've had an unbearably hard day, that's your cue to act a little spoiled with your partner. Being able to regress, and being able to hold space for your partner's regression — that's an essential ingredient of a good romantic relationship.” (Choi Ba-ol, Why Love Makes Us Children Again)
Office worker, youngest at get-togethers with seniors and juniors, someone's daughter or son, someone's wife or husband at home — we live wearing all kinds of personas. Keeping up different personas while staying composed isn't easy. That's part of why a protagonist with dozens of personas, like in the movie 'Identity,' makes for such dramatic material. 
Anyway, they say a bit of healthy regression between partners is a good defense mechanism against the anxiety and stress of juggling so many personas — which might explain why being a little clingy and silly with someone you love is forgivable after all. 
-Wash the caipira lettuce thoroughly and cut into bite-sized pieces. (Any leafy green like lettuce or arugula would work well too.)
-Boil #gnocchi in salted water, drain, add olive oil, and toss well
-Heat olive oil in a pan and blanch the prettiest #tomatoes in the world. 
-Pan-toasted walnuts, plus a dressing of olive oil, white wine vinegar, and whole-grain mustard
-Grana Padano cheese, and pepper, pepper, pepper, pepper, pepper

당근-파슬리-그릭요거트.title: French-Style Carrot Salad with Greek Yogurt
당근-파슬리-그릭요거트.intro:
20201107, Night, night, la nuit. Because of the presence or absence of sunlight, human hormone secretion apparently shifts subtly between day and night — which is said to make us lean more rational during the day and more emotional at night. There's even a saying, 'never send a letter written at night,' and it's true: reading back something you wrote late at night or before dawn, after you've slept and woken up, is almost always cringe-inducing. People call this 'the magic of the night.' (Night, Namu Wiki) 
I once read, in a tweet by the late professor Hwang Hyun-san, that the French proverb 'La nuit porte conseil' means 'the night brings good counsel' — in other words, 'sleep on it and the answer will come to you.' 
So how's your morning today? Have you surrendered to the 'magic of the night' and are cringing at your own texts, or is it a refreshing morning where 'some kind of answer came to you'? Or neither? 
Wash the prettiest #carrot in the world and grate it into thin shreds, then let it marinate briefly in a dressing of olive oil, white wine vinegar, and whole-grain mustard. Top with chopped #parsley, #greekyogurt, pepper, and #pinkpepper. #Frenchstylecarrotsalad — also great stuffed into #pitabread.

기록의쓸모-티핑포인트-브로콜리.title: Broccoli & Salted Pollock Roe Rice Bowl
기록의쓸모-티핑포인트-브로콜리.intro:
20201106, 'Marketers, free yourselves from context! Doing something without context can actually feel more genuine. These days people will watch anything as long as it's fun, even without a clear beginning, middle, and end.' (...)
The point was that people now consume content regardless of context. What I found interesting is that even when you pull up the data on video content, you often can't tell at all which moment people liked, or why they even started watching. What I like about a video and what my friend likes about it can be completely different. (Lee Seung-hee (@2tnnd), #TheUseOfRecordkeeping)
Quite a while ago, I was put in charge of a viral video project. The mood on the team wasn't great, and I wasn't happy with the video's quality either. We burned through the ad budget and I'd more or less given up on it — but a few months later, views suddenly started spiking somewhere in Eastern Europe, and it went viral worldwide from there. Broadcasters like Discovery Channel and Fuji TV picked it up soon after and even followed up with interviews of the people in it. 
Just like with video content today, the tipping point of success is always hard to predict. So people say there's no need to obsess over substance, taste, or context — but maybe that #tippingpoint actually starts precisely from that obsessive habit(?) of tallying up substance, taste, and context, quietly stacking up inside each of us. 
Chop #broccoli and scatter it over freshly cooked rice, add a bit of salted pollock roe (#myeongran) on top, and finish with a drizzle of perilla oil. A hearty, warm #breakfast #morningmeal #breakfasttable ##broccolipollockroerice

브로콜리너마저-그린빈토마토샐러드-그린빈.title: Even Broccoli, You Too: Green Bean Tomato Salad
브로콜리너마저-그린빈토마토샐러드-그린빈.intro:
20201105, Sun had meticulously mapped out all the places she wanted to visit, and planned out the most efficient route to see as much of them as possible. 
It was a world Yoon had never experienced. 
(...) 
A trip that relies entirely on instinct — that was Yoon's way. A trip that relies entirely on a schedule — that was Sun's way. (Jung Yi-hyun, The Basics of Travel) 
I bought salted pollock roe last night, planning to make broccoli-roe rice, only to find the broccoli had already gone bad and unusable. (Truly, 'even the #broccoli betrayed me.') After thinking it over for a moment, I gathered up whatever leftover ingredients I had in the fridge and threw together a salad — and it turned out looking good, and tasting good too. 
It got me thinking. A trip planned around carefully chosen places to eat and visit, complete with a route, a rain-day backup plan, and a calculated budget, would certainly be nice — but so would a trip like Yoon's, relying on instinct, wandering and stumbling onto people, scenery, and food along the way. Like this morning's chance encounter with #greenbeantomatosalad. 
Blanch #greenbeans in a pan with a splash of water, and slice tomato to a good size and plate it alongside. Add #fetacheese, then finish with a dressing of olive oil, white wine vinegar, and whole-grain mustard, plus pepper and parsley flakes. #breakfast #morningmeal #breakfasttable #salad

미국대선특집조식-아메리칸브렉퍼스트-팬케이크.title: US Election Special: American Breakfast Pancakes
미국대선특집조식-아메리칸브렉퍼스트-팬케이크.intro:
20201104, Right now, votes are still being counted in the US presidential election. According to one poll, 90% of Biden supporters said they were worried about climate change, versus only 23% of Trump supporters. The Doomsday Clock, weighed down by US-Iran tensions, the climate crisis, and fake news, currently sits at 100 seconds to midnight — 23:58:20. It's already too late to turn it back, but there should still be ways to slow it down. Which is exactly why I find myself caring so much about another country's election. 
Anyway, today it's #USElectionSpecialBreakfast, and the most classic #AmericanBreakfast dish of all: #pancakes
Following the instructions on the box of #NoBrandPancakeMix, I whisked in one egg and 110ml of milk, then gently poured the batter onto the pan over low heat. The mix makes four pancakes total:
(Rushing) the first one, ruined.
(Okay, next) the second, I waited it out, still ruined.
The third, a half-success.
The fourth, #perfect 
Feel free to add syrup, honey, or an assortment of berries to taste. #breakfast #morningmeal #pancakes
*A note: getting that nice golden color on a pancake takes #quietpersistence. In the still hush of dawn, gently pouring the batter and just watching it (really, just watching), it felt a bit like casting a line into a calm river and waiting.

시티팝-디깅클럽서울-그린빈.title: City Pop, Digging Club Seoul, and a Green Bean Salad
시티팝-디깅클럽서울-그린빈.intro:
20201103, "City Pop" is a symbol of Japan's bubble economy in the 70s and 80s — inevitably full of optimism and romance. Funky drums and bass topped off with dazzling synthesizers, glamour itself. Thanks to the retro boom of the past few years, there have been quite a few city pop remakes since 2019. The standout project among them is "Digging Club Seoul," which raised the banner of "shining a light on overlooked, ahead-of-their-time music that deserves attention." Songs like Kim Hyun-chul's "After a Long Time" sung by George, Yoon Su-il's "Beautiful" sung by Stella Jang, and Mono's "You Are Always" sung by Daybreak — these are the kinds of tracks. 
For the middle-aged and older, it's nostalgia; for the 1020 generation, it's freshness — and maybe, without knowing it, it foresaw an era where COVID would come to collapse everything. As if to say: soak in nostalgia for the past and forget the pain of the present, just for a while. #citypop #citypop #diggingclubseoul 
#greenbean and #peas boiled quickly in salted water, while sliced garlic sizzles in a pan of olive oil — once it looks about ready, in go the green beans and peas to cook together. 마이크로모먼츠-니스풍참치샐러드-카이피라.title: Micro-Moments, Niçoise Tuna, and Kaipira Lettuce
마이크로모먼츠-니스풍참치샐러드-카이피라.intro:
20201102, a story from a book I once read, "The Power of Moments." Chris realized he'd left his son's stuffed giraffe, "Joshie," behind at the Ritz-Carlton, and asked the hotel to send it back. He comforted his son by saying, "Joshie is just on vacation, you'll see him soon" (and let the hotel in on the story too). A while later the hotel sent the toy back, along with photos of Joshie the giraffe lounging on a pool chair, driving a golf cart, and getting a massage at the spa. (Thanks to the staff's thoughtfulness, he really was on vacation.) Chris and his family ended up remembering that hotel more for the 'moment' the giraffe arrived than for any service they got during their actual stay. 
In this age of flooding media and content, there's no shortage of theories about how to capture a user's 'micro-moments.' But once you strip away all the excess, I think only 'authenticity' is left standing. 
#micromoments refers to those brief instants when someone searches on their smartphone for information they're curious about, or something they want, and instantly satisfies that urge. #micromoments
Today's breakfast is a #niçoisetunasalad. Wash the tender #kaipira lettuce well and cut it into bite-sized pieces, then top with black olives, tomato, boiled egg, and well-drained #tuna. Blanch briefly in a pan with a little water and a pinch of salt before adding. Finish with a dressing of olive oil, whole-grain mustard, and white wine vinegar. #breakfast #breakfast #salad #myfrenchstylesalad 
*Kaipira could probably be swapped for lettuce or any other leafy green.

폴리매스-큐레이션-옥수수.title: Polymaths, Curation, and Buttered Corn
폴리매스-큐레이션-옥수수.intro:
20201101, somehow, it's already the first day of November. There's a word, "polymath." According to Wikipedia, it means "a person of great talent with broad expertise across many fields — in simple terms, someone who knows a great deal. Nearly all ancient scientists would count as polymaths by today's standards." Leonardo da Vinci — scientist, thinker, and brilliant artist all at once — is a great example. #polymath #polymath
Thinking back on the '10,000-hour rule,' becoming an expert in a given field is still admirable, but given that the internet now shares almost all information in real time, and technology keeps pushing back the limits of what humans can do, I find myself thinking you don't necessarily have to be an expert in just one field anymore. This is an age that calls for #curation — an eye for information, the ability to use technology effectively, and an open-minded creativity that cuts across many disciplines. Of course, there's a paradox lurking there too: to gain that kind of ability, don't you still need to put in 10,000 hours in at least one field? Anyway, apparently "Polymath" has been selling quite well as a book lately. 
Lightly pan-sear the prettiest #corn in the world in butter, then top one half with #fetacheese and the other with #gradapadanocheese, a little #parsley, #paprikapowder, and #pepper — a #breakfast #breakfast #salad that fills the heart right up. #grilledcorn #myfrenchstylesalad

할로윈-집콕할로윈-할로윈사과.title: A Stay-Home Halloween and Halloween Apples
할로윈-집콕할로윈-할로윈사과.intro:
(Halloween Special) A festival celebrated every October 31st across the English-speaking world. The commonly used spelling is 'Halloween,' though under the official Korean transliteration rules it's technically rendered 'Helloween' (source: Namu Wiki). Still, to us, '#halloween' is the familiar one. 
In Catholicism, November 1st is 'All Saints' Day,' so the story goes that the souls of the dead wandered the streets the night before, on October 31st, and that's how Halloween came to be. Not entirely baseless, it seems. Still, with everyone on edge this year, it's probably best to hold off on outdoor Halloween activities. 
A super-simple treat that kids and grown-ups alike will love, made for a #stayhomehalloween: #halloweenapples #apple
*Check the story for how to make them~

퍼블리-마키아벨리-군주론.title: Publy, Machiavelli, and The Prince
퍼블리-마키아벨리-군주론.intro:
20201030, according to brain science, systems of competition and pressure trigger the human 'fight-or-flight' response. This neural reaction is similar to the 'brain hijack' phenomenon* that occurs when we're suddenly faced with a physical threat, like running into a dangerous wild animal. 
*A phenomenon where the amygdala seizes control of the brain — in a crisis, the brain gets 'hijacked' by the amygdala and becomes unable to do even things it could normally handle with ease. (Jang Jae-woong & Sanghyo Yijae, Understanding Agile Philosophy (1)) #publy #publy
Now picture a boss who habitually treats employees with a domineering attitude and abusive language. Most of the time, the moment employees stand in front of him, they freeze up and can't even get out what they'd normally say — which only triggers another round of the same domineering, abusive behavior. #machiavelli probably never heard of #brainhijack, but even The Prince has a passage saying a ruler doesn't need to be kind or moral — he should be cold and ruthless. So then, what should you do when you run into a dangerous wild animal? Haha.
Had one lonely #tomato left in the fridge, so I rinsed some rice, laid the peeled tomato on top, cooked it for 10 minutes, turned off the heat and let it steam for 5 more, then lightly mashed the tomato. Transferred it to a bowl with some good olive oil, and a little #parmigiano to season it — #tomatoricepot #breakfast #breakfast #ricepot #breakfasttable

수카라-토마토-브라타치즈.title: Sukara, Tomatoes, and Burrata
수카라-토마토-브라타치즈.intro:
20201029, someday, days like these will never come to us again. Waking up early one dawn by chance and marveling at the beauty of the red glow rising in the sky, feeling the day imprint itself anew; or looking up at the deep blue sky on the walk home in a drizzle too light to bother with an umbrella; or a tall tree overhead holding raindrops on its leaves until they drip down onto your face, one by one. (Albi, the Child Raised on Goat's Milk) 
I saw the news that #sukara is renewing itself — for various reasons, apparently transforming into an eco-friendly takeout-only shop. Sitting at that well-worn wooden table, trading warm, sometimes awkward, sometimes thrilling conversation over a meal — 'that time' turned out to be the last time. And a last time always cuts deeper, precisely because you never know it's the last time while it's happening. 
*Still, I think Sukara has transformed for the better. 
Slice the #tomato crosswise and lay the pieces out neatly, top with pretty #burrata, a little good olive oil, and pepper. #tomatosalad #breakfast #breakfast #breakfasttable #breakfast #salad

삼성-이건희-아보카도.title: Samsung, Lee Kun-hee, and Avocado Crostini
삼성-이건희-아보카도.intro:
20201028, the way Chairman Lee stumbled through failures and hardships in running his business shows, more precisely, what the achievements that followed actually meant and taught. Whatever it is that Samsung's — and more broadly Korean business's — next generation of executives should genuinely learn from will be drawn out of that very process. What, after all, can you learn from an infallible god raised high up into the sky? He becomes nothing but an object of awe and worship. (Kim Young-bae, Why the Emperor Stayed in Seclusion) #samsung #leekunhee
Behind the huge shadow cast by Samsung's success in semiconductors, home appliances, and smartphones — with Samsung Electronics as the flagship — there were failures too, in automobiles (Renault Samsung) and retail (Homeplus). Some argue that the massive failures that drove the company to the brink are exactly what forced it to choose and focus, and ultimately built today's Samsung. And alongside his 'achievements,' it shouldn't be forgotten that there's a long list of 'faults' too — collusion between business and politics, illegal succession of management control, union-free management, and more. 
Before the #avocado gets overripe, #avocadocrostini
1. Drizzle olive oil in a pan and lightly toast the bread. 
2. Cut the tomato and let it marinate briefly in a dressing of olive oil, wine vinegar, and whole-grain mustard. 
3. Lay the marinated tomato from step 2 (gently woken up) on the toasted bread and sprinkle with a little salt. Arrange sliced avocado neatly on top, then drizzle with olive oil, pepper, and lemon juice. Finish with lemon zest. (Used tangerine zest instead, since I was out of lemon.)

다수결-숙의-토마토.title: Majority Rule, Deliberation, and a Caprese Moment
다수결-숙의-토마토.intro:
20201027, say there are two proposals. Proposal A has the support of 51 out of 100 members, and Proposal B has 49. Is the heart of majority rule simply putting it to a vote and passing whichever one gets 51? No. Through the process of debating both proposals, support for a revised A′ might climb to 61, or support for a revised B′ might reach 70. Built into the principle of majority rule is this process of 'deliberation' — using discussion and negotiation to shape a revised proposal or alternative that more members can agree on than either original. (Lee Chul-hee, Misunderstandings About Majority Rule) #majorityrule #deliberation
Today's an all-day workshop day. I wonder — true to the real meaning of majority rule, will discussion and negotiation actually produce better proposals that a wider majority can get behind? 
Thinly slice #tomato and #mozzarella and plate them, add basil and olives, then finish with good olive oil, balsamic, and a little pepper — #caprese, which literally means 'salad of Capri,' from southern Italy. #breakfast #breakfasttable #salad 
Put this straight on top of a pizza, and you've got a #margherita pizza.

다시마-새우-새우다시마샐러드.title: Kelp, Shrimp, and a Salty Morning
다시마-새우-새우다시마샐러드.intro:
20201026, rather than raising a workforce to use decades down the line, making sure the workforce already alive can keep functioning well for longer is where a healthy population cycle actually begins. That's also where the real use of Fourth Industrial Revolution technologies like AI and robots lies. If the lives of the elderly and of women become more fulfilling and comfortable, the birth rate will gradually start to stir. Fixing low birth rates shouldn't be the first button to button on the population problem — it should be the last. We've got it backwards. (Kwak No-pil, How Should We Face an Era of Childless Elders)
According to Statistics Korea, our population is set to start declining as early as next year, 2021. But considering that globally, falling birth rates are driven by things like poverty reduction, gender equality, and digitalization — and that they're actually a plus for climate change and food security — there's no need to be entirely discouraged. If low birth rates and an aging population are simply unavoidable, let's stop clinging only to birth-rate incentives and change our perspective instead. 
Pan-sear the #shrimp I prepped last night and lay it over well-washed #kelp, then finish with a dressing of olive oil, white wine vinegar, and whole-grain mustard, plus a little dill, pepper, and lemon juice. #shrimpkelpsalad #breakfast #breakfasttable #salad #kelpsalad #myfrenchstylesalad 
(Aside) It's brutal. A mouthful of overly salty kelp hits me square in the face. 
But don't worry — a bowl of rice will cover up the saltiness.

양파-양파팍시-제니아테일러.intro:

블루베리-클랜베리-라즈베리.title: Blueberries, Cranberries, and Raspberries
블루베리-클랜베리-라즈베리.intro:
"At work, we sometimes end up living as characters that betray our own nature. While carrying out the role we've been given, we somehow grow past the hard edges of our own self. We become bigger and bigger people." (Son Yeol-eum, from an interview for "It's All Unnie If It's Cool") 
However introverted, extroverted, or somewhere in between our natures may be, each of us is out there working hard, betraying — and sometimes hiding — our given personality in our own way. Out of curiosity I bought some #edibleflowers and tried them on an #avocadobowl, but it turned out to be a bit much — reminded me of the patterned baggy pants (aka 'mompe') hanging in a market stall. Anyway, #breakfast #salad

블루베리-클랜베리-라즈베리-2.title: Blueberries, Cranberries, and Raspberries
블루베리-클랜베리-라즈베리-2.intro:
"At work, we sometimes end up living as characters that betray our own nature. While carrying out the role we've been given, we somehow grow past the hard edges of our own self. We become bigger and bigger people." (Son Yeol-eum, from an interview for "It's All Unnie If It's Cool") 
However introverted, extroverted, or somewhere in between our natures may be, each of us is out there working hard, betraying — and sometimes hiding — our given personality in our own way. Still, like Son Yeol-eum said, I want to believe that this day-to-day grind is making me into a bigger, broader person. 
20201022, before heading to work, today's #breakfasttable is #blueberries #cranberries #raspberries (frozen berries, for short), with #fetacheese, a little pepper and balsamic — #frozenberrysaladwithfetacheese
Out of curiosity I bought some #edibleflowers and tried them on an #avocadobowl, but it turned out to be a bit much — reminded me of the patterned baggy pants (aka 'mompe') hanging in a market stall. Anyway, #breakfast #salad

우리말-국립국어원무리수-브라타치즈.title: Korean Language, Overreach, and Burrata with Grapes
우리말-국립국어원무리수-브라타치즈.intro:
20201020, 'seumateuhada' ('to be smart') has apparently been accepted as a loanword by now, defined in the Korean dictionary as 'neat and stylish in bearing, or clean-cut in appearance.' Since 'smart' is now used far more broadly than that, the dictionary's definition probably needs expanding too. (Source: Hankyoreh) 
Today's article also touched on terms like 'Smart New Deal' and 'Green New Deal,' asking why the government couldn't even find proper Korean words for its own core policies. Not just language but everything in the world changes, and we have to change along with it — and that process is bound to involve plenty of trial and error. That even includes the National Institute of Korean Language's overreach, like trying to purify 'vogue-style' phrasing, replace 'gold miss' with 'golden single woman,' or swap 'follower' for 'attached companion.' #koreanlanguage #nationalinstituteoverreach
#burrata and the prettiest #grapes in the world, with pepper and a little good olive oil — #shinemuscat #breakfast #salad #breakfast
Looks like it's going to be a day where I keep thinking about grapes,

재택-원격근무-연어세비체.title: Working From Home and Salmon Ceviche
재택-원격근무-연어세비체.intro:
20201019, "We now need to rethink the workplace, not as a fixed location, but as a hub we gather at when needed to work together and interact in the ways innovation requires." (Source: Hankyoreh) 
COVID-19 is largely to blame, but Germany's Federal Ministry of Labour is reportedly preparing legislation that would mandate 24 days a year of remote or work-from-home work, aimed at strengthening workers' rights and preventing work from bleeding into private life. As the quote suggests, humans are supposedly at their most creative when they gather and put their heads together, so I do worry about how remote work might change (or erode) human creativity. But then again, won't we end up finding "new paths" within these constraints too? This is partly a reflection after recently sitting through some remote classes myself. #workfromhome #remotework 
The moment I woke up, I put the salmon I'd left in the fridge to marinate in lemon extract. A few moments later — chicory, red onion, tomato, tangerine, olives, a little leftover couscous from yesterday, and finally the marinated salmon, woken up and laid on top, finished with a dressing of olive oil, pepper, and salt. #salmonceviche #breakfast #breakfast #salad
*(Sometimes, making breakfast first thing in the morning, I catch myself wondering if I'm secretly filming an episode of #pleasetakecareofmyfridge — but it turns out that show wrapped back in 2019, so never mind.) Ceviche (Spanish: cebiche, ceviche) is a raw fish salad eaten across Peru and other parts of Latin America. Fish or seafood is sliced thin like sashimi and marinated in lemon or lime juice, cilantro, chili, onion, salt, and the like before eating. (Source: Wikipedia)

오픈하우스서울-브릭웰-엔다이브.title: Open House Seoul, Brick Well, and Endive
오픈하우스서울-브릭웰-엔다이브.intro:
20201018, every city seems to have its own 'building open house festival' — France's 'Heritage Days,' the UK's 'Open House London,' that sort of thing. Calling them 'buildings' makes it sound a little dry, but touring a beautifully designed house or building with the architect themselves as your guide (that's really the author giving the lecture in person) is a genuinely special experience. Luckily, Korea has held its own #openhouseseoul around this time every year since 2014. See @openhouse_seoul for details. 
(It feels bittersweet to credit COVID-19 for this, but) this year stands out for new formats like VisitYourself for solo visits, plus video and livestream options. Special04 even includes #brickwell in Seochon, which set Instagram ablaze earlier this year. 
*(Thinking back on last year) for on-site bookings, if you're not lightning-fast on the reservation button, slots vanish instantly. On-site booking opens Monday, 10/19 at 2:00 PM! (There's a note about splitting reservations between those under and over 50, apparently to account for people less comfortable with digital booking — which is touching, but also...)
Wash the prettiest #endive in the world thoroughly, add a few toasted walnuts, and dress with olive oil, whole-grain mustard, and white wine vinegar. #breakfast #salad #yesthisisstrictlyjustanappetizer

기후위기-완두콩.title: Climate Crisis and Peas
기후위기-완두콩.intro:
20201017, according to research by crow researcher Michael Westerfield, crows make distinct sounds meaning "human," "cat," and "dog." Koshik, an elephant at Everland, learned human words like "hello," "sit," and "lie down." Once grown and living with a female elephant, Koshik spoke to her in elephant language, but communicated with people in Korean. (Source: Hankyoreh) 
Which is exactly why we need to shift away from a hierarchical worldview that places humans above and animals and nature below. They're already talking — all that's left is for the human gaze looking at them to change. Maybe the answer to the #climatecrisis lies right there too. 
Tiger beans, black beans, chickpeas, and kidney beans soaked overnight, plus the prettiest #peas in the world, with a little paprika and tomato. #breakfast #salad

루꼴라-치커리-아보카도.title: Rocket Allergies, Chicory, and Avocado
루꼴라-치커리-아보카도.intro:
20201016, the Greek word 'αλλεργία' (allergia, meaning 'abnormal reaction') is where 'allergy' comes from, and the anglicized pronunciation is commonly used in Korean too. Symptoms can range from just feeling off, itchy, or breaking out, all the way to serious breathing difficulty in severe cases. (Source: Namu Wiki)
Causes are wildly varied — from fruits like the peaches that famously starred in the Oscar-winning Parasite, to nuts like walnuts, vegetables like taro, and even dust, metal, and water. 
Meanwhile, allergies you never had can also show up as you age — and I've developed one to #rocket. I used to enjoy it often, but one day my mouth suddenly swelled up, and it took a full day for the swelling to go down. 
So for today's breakfast, instead of rocket, I used bitter #chicory, which tastes closest to rocket (or so I'm telling myself — really, it's just what was left in the fridge), dressed with olive oil, whole-grain mustard, and white wine vinegar, topped with #avocado. Ta-da~, in no time at all, a #breakfast that will pump some good energy into the day is born. #salad #breakfast #myfrenchstylesalad

스크린타임-넷플릭스-소셜딜레마.title: Screen Time, Netflix, and Endive Salad
스크린타임-넷플릭스-소셜딜레마.intro:
20201015, checking my #screentime, I was apparently glued to my phone (a staggering) 6 hours and 16 minutes a day on average. Excluding sleep, that's roughly a third of my entire day handed over to my phone. 
Just like Tristan Harris says — that the pull-down-to-refresh design of social media, where you drag your finger down the screen looking for something more entertaining, works exactly like a slot machine — I, and all of us, keep refreshing our phone screens every day chasing a stronger hit. Even right now. #netflix #thesocialdilemma 
Thinking of that sad story about a flight attendant at Airline K who got pulled from first-class duty after serving a dish with endive to a chairman who'd asked for it to be left out — because she didn't know what endive was (or didn't realize it was hidden in the salad) — I thoroughly seared #endive on both sides in a pan with fragrant butter, then finished with pepper, parsley, and a little balsamic. #endivesalad #salad #breakfast #looksliketinynapacabbageatfirstglance

디지털화폐-암호화폐-토마토.title: Digital Currency, Crypto, and Tomatoes
디지털화폐-암호화폐-토마토.intro:
20201014, last week, the government of Shenzhen in China's Guangdong province held a lottery giving away a total of 10 million yuan (about 1.7 billion won) in digital yuan. Nearly 2 million people applied, and 50,000 winners each received 200 yuan (about 34,000 won) in digital yuan. Shenzhen said retailers like Walmart, local supermarkets, and pharmacies all took part in the digital yuan payment trial. #digitalcurrency 
Governments' worries, which started with concerns over Facebook's digital currency Libra taking off, are now barreling straight toward digital currencies of their own. 
Once currency goes digital, thorough tracking and control become possible — and that will hand an extra boost to the already-stronger grip governments have gained since COVID. I'm curious how the showdown will play out between that and cryptocurrency, which started out flying the flag of decentralization. #cryptocurrency
Sear #tomato in a pan with olive oil, then top with parsley and #dicedfetacheese (I really love that phrase, 'diced'). Finish with pepper. #salad #breakfast #myfrenchstylesalad

수익실현-비욘드미트-치커리.title: Taking Profits, Beyond Meat, and Chicory with Oysters
수익실현-비욘드미트-치커리.intro:
20201013, let's imagine. Say I'm an angel investor, and there are two promising startups. One has the technology to make a 'plant-based patty that tastes almost like meat,' similar to the Impossible Burger, here in Korea. The other has technology that can keep freshly steamed tofu's savory flavor and texture intact for a full month. I wouldn't think twice — I'd invest in the tofu startup. (Moon Jung-hoon, The Future of Korea's Plant-Based Protein Market)
I wonder how many vegetarians are really out there still missing the taste of meat so much that they go looking for a 'plant-based patty that tastes like meat.' And I wonder how much demand there will really be for patty-based burgers across Asia going forward (when you picture the typical breakfast of an Asian office worker, most either skip it or keep it very simple). That's why I trimmed some of my position last night in the stock of a company that 'manufactures plant-based patties that taste like meat.' #takingprofits #beyondmeat
Bitter, appealing #chicory with a dressing (minced onion, whole-grain mustard, white wine vinegar, olive oil), and #oysters cleaned thoroughly with salt, piled high with #lime. #chicoryoystersalad #breakfast #miraclemorning #salad

치커리-사과-모닝루틴.title: Chicory, Apple, and a Morning Routine
치커리-사과-모닝루틴.intro:
20201012, "I sincerely send warm regards to our beloved compatriots in the south as well, and hope that this health crisis will soon be overcome, so that North and South can once again clasp hands together." 
A line from North Korean leader Kim Jong-un's speech at the military parade marking the 75th anniversary of the Workers' Party's founding. It likely reflects an effort to console a people worn down by a complicated mix of external factors — last month's shooting incident, the U.S. presidential election — layered on top of an endless 'virus' to fight off, and a seemingly never-ending monsoon season (read: climate crisis). 
I don't necessarily think the two divided states have to become one. But at the very least, I hope nothing drives the Korean peninsula toward extreme crisis, not even the smallest threat. Beyond that, there's a mountain of problems that humanity — that all of us — need to solve by "clasping hands together." 
Went to the market yesterday and picked up some bitter #chicory. Cut into bite-sized pieces and paired with seasonal #apple, olive oil, balsamic, and some nuts, it makes for a very well-behaved #breakfast. #salad #morningroutine

새우메밀국수샐러드-조식-샐러드.title: Shrimp Soba Noodle Salad
새우메밀국수샐러드-조식-샐러드.intro:
20201011, "If a thing can be done in thirty minutes but you take thirty years to do it, sooner or later you will have to do thirty years' worth of work in thirty minutes, and it will be a hell of a job." (George Bernard Shaw, A Chronicle of Intellect)
It's the line that comes to mind whenever I'm tempted to put off the dishes after breakfast. Though of course it doesn't only apply to breakfast.
Boil buckwheat (soba) noodles, rinse in cold water, then toss with a pinch of salt and olive oil. Top with shrimp pan-seared with salt and pepper, add pine nuts, finish with dressing and the prettiest parsley in the world. #shrimpsobanoodlesalad #breakfastdiary #salad #miraclemorning #morningroutine #sobanoodles

BTS유니버스-비타민-뿌셔뿌셔.title: BTS Universe Vitamin Lettuce Ramen Salad
BTS유니버스-비타민-뿌셔뿌셔.intro:
20201010, Around the release of Avengers 3, there was a lot of talk about the narrative structure of the Marvel Cinematic Universe. Come to think of it, Star Wars also had a vast web of stories beyond the classic trilogy, prequels, and sequels — animation, comics, and more, all filling in the shared timeline of its universe.
Once a story is built on a shared universe and fandom is layered on top of it, that story becomes sustainable forever.
Which is why I keep coming back to thinking about the greatness of the #BTSuniverse — albums, short films, webtoons, even a UN speech, all built on one consistent narrative that keeps evolving as it's shared with ARMYs around the world.
The prettiest vitamin lettuce in the world with tomato, and Ppushu Ppushu (crushed ramen snack) in bulgogi flavor, a good shake of pepper, balsamic dressing #ramensalad #breakfastdiary #salad #miraclemorning #morningroutine #morning

군만두-올드보이-박찬욱.title: Fried Dumplings, Oldboy, Park Chan-wook
군만두-올드보이-박찬욱.intro: The price of carelessly letting slip a secret was terrible. But the true suffering Oh Dae-su endured may not have been the fifteen years of confinement with no explanation given no matter how many times he asked — it may have been the 129,600 fried dumplings he was forced to eat, eight a meal, for fifteen years straight.

가지-가지샐러드-조식.title: Eggplant Salad
가지-가지샐러드-조식.intro:
20201009, Do you know what I was like, how I lived?
You know what despair is; then
winter should have meaning for you.
I did not expect to survive,
earth suppressing me. I didn't expect
to waken again, to feel
in damp earth my body
able to respond again, remembering
after so long how to open again
in the cold light
of earliest spring —
afraid, yes, but among you again
crying yes risk joy
in the raw wind of the new world.
(Louise Glück, Snowdrops)
Sear the prettiest eggplant in the world in a pan with olive oil, then toss with minced onion, wholegrain mustard, vinegar, and olive oil dressing. #eggplantsalad #breakfastdiary #salad #morningroutine #miraclemorning

양송이-양송이샐러드-모닝.title: Button Mushroom Salad, Morning
양송이-양송이샐러드-모닝.intro:
20201008, "Full legalization of abortion!"
"I am the one who is life!"
Are those women some kind of 'Megal' I've heard about?
(My Crazy Feminist Girlfriend, Min Ji-hyung)
A passage from a book I happen to be reading these days. Supporting abortion rights = 'Megal' (feminist slur) — probably a fair reflection of how many men actually see it.
The government has proposed a revision to the criminal code that keeps the crime of abortion on the books but allows termination without conditions within 14 weeks of pregnancy.
But a person who learns late that they're pregnant — because of sexual assault, disability, being a minor — or who can't afford the cost of a termination, or who has a serious health problem, still can't legally terminate after 24 weeks, and can be punished with up to a year in prison or a fine of up to 2 million won.
Given that this touches on the question of life itself, and that this is the first revision to the law in 66 years, is this really as far as it should go?
Wash button mushrooms and pat dry, then slice lengthwise and toss with olive oil, wholegrain mustard, vinegar, and minced onion dressing. #buttonmushroomsalad #breakfastdiary #salad #morning #morningmenu

모닝루틴.title: Morning Routine Bean Salad
모닝루틴.intro:

Both sides invoke fairness, but it won't be easy to come up with criteria everyone's satisfied with. Makes me wonder whether anything ever stays fixed in place. Meanwhile, some are making the (bold?) argument that the whole special-exemption system is a leftover from the Park Chung-hee era's military dictatorship and should just be scrapped.

양파-조식-해장음식.title: Onion Soup for Breakfast and the Morning After
양파-조식-해장음식.intro:
20201006, "Children really do grow up too fast for it to feel fair. And it's only in facing that that I could finally understand what the seasons do and what time is responsible for — what March does, what July accomplishes. May or September, it was the same." (Ipdong, Kim Ae-ran)
Chuseok has passed, the commute has turned chilly enough that a scarf has claimed a corner of my bag, and with the sun's position shifted, the afternoon light now falls warm across my back. I find myself thinking, often, about all of this — "what the seasons do and what time is responsible for."
Sauté one onion in fragrant butter for about 30 minutes, add a little chicken stock, and there you have a wonderful #breakfast that also happens to be the perfect #hangovercure — #onionsoup #miraclemorning #morningroutine

테슬라-뉴노멀-토마토샐러드.intro:
20201005, On the first commute of Q4 2020, with the temperature suddenly dropping — traditionally, a company's value is judged by three measures: stability, profitability, and growth potential. Lately, tech stocks, Tesla especially, have seen their share price skyrocket (quadrupling in half a year) on growth potential almost alone, despite a market share of under 1%. Is this a rerun of the bubble bursting like in the early 2000s, or is it the real opening shot of a genuine new normal? #Tesla #newnormal

마이크로어그레션-파프리카-조식.title: Microaggressions, Bell Pepper Ratatouille
마이크로어그레션-파프리카-조식.intro:

Even the routine holiday or everyday greetings — got a job yet? seeing anyone? when are you getting married? when are you having kids? — are worth thinking hard about again. #microaggression

In old Western superstition, green was once thought to bring misfortune, even branded as the devil's color at one point. But look closer and green sits right where luck and misfortune change hands — the gambling table, the racetrack. Maybe that's why Hulk's and Loki's costumes are green — they stand right at the crossing point of good and evil. Meanwhile,
hoping to read today's luck and misfortune at the table, I laid down the last of the bok choy (unseen but there), then piled on sprouts, Shine Muscat grapes, green olives, avocado, and broccoli, with olive oil, balsamic, and a good crack of pepper — an all-out pursuit of green for #todaysbreakfast #breakfast #breakfaststagram
*I fell asleep imagining how this combination would taste, and it turned out to have every sweet-and-salty element already in it, so — just as I'd hoped — it needed no special dressing at all.

On the 4th floor of the Tiffany store on Fifth Avenue in Manhattan, New York, there's a place called The Blue Box Cafe (#blueboxcafe) with a Breakfast at Tiffany brunch set. 산시엔미펀-우리의계절은.title: Sanxian Mifen and Our Seasons
산시엔미펀-우리의계절은.intro:
Yesterday's walk home met a breeze that made me crave a warm bowl of soup, and there were still ingredients left over from the weekend shopping. 
Apparently people in Hunan — Mao's hometown — start their day with a bowl of #sanxianmifen. Maybe that's just down to #ourseasons — about as unrealistic as saying "Koreans start every day with rice and hot soup." Hunan, meanwhile, positions itself as the true home of spicy food within China. (Move aside, Sichuan.) 
I checked the broth I'd simmered the night before going to bed (dried shiitake, onion, scallion, the shiitake soaking water, and the real star, chicken stock), seasoned some pork with plenty of pepper and salt, and got the bok choy, chives, and shiitake mushrooms ready. I boiled rice noodles, piled them in a bowl with the prepared ingredients, and poured the broth generously over the top. 
A mild, kid-friendly version of #sanxianmifen. #breakfast #breakfastgram

아침을먹다가생각한것들.intro:
"A street-cart recipe goes like this: beat an egg. Finely chop whatever vegetables you like — carrot, cabbage, and so on — and mix them into the egg. (...) Sprinkle on some sugar (lol) and finish with ketchup." (#thoughtsthatcomeoverbreakfast, p.66)
"The moment I've thought through tomorrow's breakfast before bed, peeked in the fridge, finished my simple prep, washed up, and lain down in bed — that's when I finally feel the day is truly over, and it makes me happy. I hope tomorrow morning I can start the day just as lightly, in the very same mood. Good night, so it can be a good morning." (#thoughtsthatcomeoverbreakfast, p.187)
For office workers and students racing against the clock, I think #streettoast counts as #morningcomfort. Standing steadfastly on the way to work, it always delivers the carbs (bread) and protein (egg) you need to get through the day. And of course, what really completes the flavor of street toast is the sugar and ketchup.
*From time to time I'd like to talk about breakfast I come across in books, films, or elsewhere — not just the breakfast I make every morning.

구운-채소-샐러드.title: Roasted Vegetable Salad
구운-채소-샐러드.intro: #Sundaybreakfastflex pan-#grilledzucchini, #tomato with ricotta cheese, #bellpepper stuffed with onion, zucchini and tomato #ratatouille, and roasted #onion to handle today's richness #breakfaststagram #todaysbreakfast #breakfast
구운-채소-샐러드.ingredients: 1 zucchini, 2 shrimp, 1 onion, 1 egg, 1 tomato, a little ricotta cheese, 1 bell pepper, salt, pepper, a little herbs, 2t parmesan cheese
구운-채소-샐러드.steps:
1. Halve the zucchini and sear it cut-side down first in a pan with olive oil. Thaw the shrimp, pat dry, season with salt and pepper, and cook. Top the zucchini with the shrimp. 
2. Halve the onion and sear it cut-side down the same way as the zucchini. Top with a soft-boiled egg. 
3. Halve the tomato too and sear it lightly in a pan with olive oil. Top with a little ricotta cheese. 
4. Halve the bell pepper and scoop out the inside. Dice zucchini, onion, tomato, and bell pepper into equal sizes, sauté with salt, pepper, and herbs in a pan, then stuff the mixture into the bell pepper. Top with a little parmesan cheese.
